Lillahi ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi vain tubdu ma fiy anfusikum av tuxfuhu yuhasibkum bihi Allohu fayag'firu liman yashao vayu'azzibu man yashao vaAllohu 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun

Amana alrrasulu bima onzila ilayhi min rabbihi valmuminuna kullun amana biAllohi vamalaikatihi vakutubihi varusulihi la nufarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulihi vaqalu sami'na vata'na g'ufranaka rabbana vailayka almasiyru

La yukallifu Allohu nafsan illa vus'aha laha ma kasabat va'alayha ma iktasabat rabbana la tuaxizna in nasiyna av axtana rabbana vala tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'ala allaziyna min qablina rabbana vala tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bihi vao'fu 'anna vaig'fir lana vairhamna anta mavlana faonsurna 'ala alqavmi alkafiriyna
Aliflammiym
Allohu la ilaha illa huva alhayyu alqayyumu
Nazzala 'alayka alkitaba bialhaqqi musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi vanzala alttavrata valinjiyla
Min qablu hudan lilnnasi vanzala alfurqana inna allaziyna kafaru biayati Allohi lahum 'azabun shadiydun vaAllohu 'aziyzun zu intiqamin
Inna Alloha la yaxfa 'alayhi shayon fiy alardi vala fiy alssamai
Huva allaziy yusavvirukum fiy alarhami kayfa yashao la ilaha illa huva al'aziyzu alhakiymu

Huva allaziy anzala 'alayka alkitaba minhu ayatun muhkamatun hunna ommu alkitabi vaoxaru mutashabihatun famma allaziyna fiy qulubihim zayg'un fayattabi'una ma tashabaha minhu ibtig'a alfitnati vaibtig'a taviylihi vama ya'lamu taviylahu illa Allohu valrrasixuna fiy al'ilmi yaquluna amanna bihi kullun min 'indi rabbina vama yazzakkaru illa olu alalbabi
Rabbana la tuzig' qulubana ba'da iz hadaytana vahab lana min ladunka rahmatan innaka anta alvahhabu
Rabbana innaka jami'u alnnasi liyavmin la rayba fiyhi inna Alloha la yuxlifu almiy'ada
Inna allaziyna kafaru lan tug'niya 'anhum amvaluhum vala avladuhum mina Allohi shayan vaolaika hum vaqudu alnnari
Kadabi ali fir'avna vallaziyna min qablihim kazzabu biayatina faxazahumu Allohu bizunubihim vaAllohu shadiydu al'iqabi
Qul lillaziyna kafaru satug'labuna vatuhsharuna ila jahannama vabisa almihadu

Qad kana lakum ayatun fiy fiatayni iltaqata fiatun tuqatilu fiy sabiyli Allohi vaoxra kafiratun yaravnahum mizlayhim raya al'ayni vaAllohu yuayyidu binasrihi man yashao inna fiy zalika la'ibratan lioliy alabsari

Zuyyina lilnnasi hubbu alshshahavati mina alnnisai valbaniyna valqanatiyri almuqantarati mina alzzahabi valfiddati valxayli almusavvamati valan'ami valharzi zalika mata'u alhayati alddunya vaAllohu 'indahu husnu almabi
Qul aonabbiokum bixayrin min zalikum lillaziyna ittaqav 'inda rabbihim jannatun tajriy min tahtiha alanharu xalidiyna fiyha vazvajun mutahharatun varidvanun mina Allohi vaAllohu basiyrun bial'ibadi
Allaziyna yaquluna rabbana innana amanna faig'fir lana zunubana vaqina 'azaba alnnari
Alssabiriyna valssadiqiyna valqanitiyna valmunfiqiyna valmustag'firiyna bialashari
Shahida Allohu annahu la ilaha illa huva valmalaikatu vaolu al'ilmi qaiman bialqisti la ilaha illa huva al'aziyzu alhakiymu
Inna alddiyna 'inda Allohi alislamu vama ixtalafa allaziyna utu alkitaba illa min ba'di ma jahumu al'ilmu bag'yan baynahum vaman yakfur biayati Allohi fainna Alloha sariy'u alhisabi

Fain hajjuka faqul aslamtu vajhiya lillahi vamani ittaba'ani vaqul lillaziyna utu alkitaba valommiyyiyna aslamtum fain aslamu faqadi ihtadav vain tavallav fainnama 'alayka albalag'u vaAllohu basiyrun bial'ibadi
Inna allaziyna yakfuruna biayati Allohi vayaqtuluna alnnabiyyiyna big'ayri haqqin vayaqtuluna allaziyna yamuruna bialqisti mina alnnasi fabashshirhum bi'azabin aliymin
Olaika allaziyna habitat a'maluhum fiy alddunya valaxirati vama lahum min nasiriyna
Alam tara ila allaziyna utu nasiyban mina alkitabi yud'avna ila kitabi Allohi liyahkuma baynahum zumma yatavalla fariyqun minhum vahum mu'riduna
Zalika biannahum qalu lan tamassana alnnaru illa ayyaman ma'dudatin vag'arrahum fiy diynihim ma kanu yaftaruna
Fakayfa iza jama'nahum liyavmin la rayba fiyhi vavuffiyat kullu nafsin ma kasabat vahum la yuzlamuna
Quli llohumma malika almulki tutiy almulka man tashao vatanzi'u almulka mimman tashao vatu'izzu man tashao vatuzillu man tashao biyadika alxayru innaka 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun
Tuliju allayla fiy alnnahari vatuliju alnnahara fiy allayli vatuxriju alhayya mina almayyiti vatuxriju almayyita mina alhayyi vatarzuqu man tashao big'ayri hisabin
La yattaxizi almuminuna alkafiriyna avliya min duni almuminiyna vaman yaf'al zalika falaysa mina Allohi fiy shayin illa an tattaqu minhum tuqatan vayuhazzirukumu Allohu nafsahu vaila Allohi almasiyru
Qul in tuxfu ma fiy sudurikum av tubduhu ya'lamhu Allohu vaya'lamu ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi vaAllohu 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun
Yavma tajidu kullu nafsin ma 'amilat min xayrin muhdaran vama 'amilat min suin tavaddu lav anna baynaha vabaynahu amadan ba'iydan vayuhazzirukumu Allohu nafsahu vaAllohu raufun bial'ibadi
Qul in kuntum tuhibbuna Alloha faittabi'uniy yuhbibkumu Allohu vayag'fir lakum zunubakum vaAllohu g'afurun rahiymun
Qul atiy'u Alloha valrrasula fain tavallav fainna Alloha la yuhibbu alkafiriyna
Inna Alloha istafa adama vanuhan vala ibrahiyma vala 'imrana 'ala al'alamiyna
Zurriyyatan ba'duha min ba'din vaAllohu samiy'un 'aliymun
Iz qalati imratu 'imrana rabbi inniy nazartu laka ma fiy batniy muharraran fataqabbal minniy innaka anta alssamiy'u al'aliymu
Falamma vada'aza qalat rabbi inniy vada'tuha onza vaAllohu a'lamu bima vada'at valaysa alzzakaru kalonza vainniy sammaytuha maryama vainniy o'iyzuha bika vazurriyyataha mina alshshaytani alrrajiymi

Fataqabbalaha rabbuha biqabulin hasanin vanbataha nabatan hasanan vakaffalaha zakariyya kullama daxala 'alayha zakariyya almihraba vajada 'indaha rizqan qala ya maryamu anna laki haza qalat huva min 'indi Allohi inna Alloha yarzuqu man yashao big'ayri hisabin
Hunalika da'a zakariyya rabbahu qala rabbi hab liy min ladunka zurriyyatan tayyibatan innaka samiy'u alddu'ai
Fanadazu almalaikatu vahuva qaimun yusalliy fiy almihrabi anna Alloha yubashshiruka biyahya musaddiqan bikalimatin mina Allohi vasayyidan vahasuran vanabiyyan mina alssalihiyna
Qala rabbi anna yakunu liy g'ulamun vaqad balag'aniya alkibaru vaimratiy 'aqirun qala kazalika Allohu yaf'alu ma yashao
Qala rabbi ij'al liy ayatan qala ayatuka alla tukallima alnnasa zalazata ayyamin illa ramzan vaozkur rabbaka kaziyran vasabbih bial'ashiyyi valibkari
Vaiz qalati almalaikatu ya maryamu inna Alloha istafaki vatahharaki vaistafaki 'ala nisai al'alamiyna
Ya maryamu oqnutiy lirabbiki vaosjudiy vairka'iy ma'a alrraki'iyna
Zalika min anbai alg'aybi nuhiyhi ilayka vama kunta ladayhim iz yulquna aqlamahum ayyuhum yakfulu maryama vama kunta ladayhim iz yaxtasimuna
Iz qalati almalaikatu ya maryamu inna Alloha yubashshiruki bikalimatin minhu ismuhu almasiyhu 'iysa ibnu maryama vajiyhan fiy alddunya valaxirati vamina almuqarrabiyna
Vayukallimu alnnasa fiy almahdi vakahlan vamina alssalihiyna
Qalat rabbi anna yakunu liy valadun valam yamsasniy basharun qala kazaliki Allohu yaxluqu ma yashao iza qada amran fainnama yaqulu lahu kun fayakunu
Vayu'allimuhu alkitaba valhikmata valttavrata valinjiyla

Varasulan ila baniy israiyla anniy qad jitukum biayatin min rabbikum anniy axluqu lakum mina alttiyni kahayati alttayri fanfuxu fiyhi fayakunu tayran biizni Allohi vaobrio alakmaha valabrasa vaohyiy almavta biizni Allohi vaonabbiokum bima takuluna vama taddaxiruna fiy buyutikum inna fiy zalika layatan lakum in kuntum muminiyna
Vamusaddiqan lima bayna yadayya mina alttavrati valiohilla lakum ba'da allaziy hurrima 'alaykum vajitukum biayatin min rabbikum faittaqu Alloha vatiy'uni
Inna Alloha rabbiy varabbukum fao'buduhu haza siratun mustaqiymun
Falamma ahassa 'iysa minhumu alkufra qala man ansariy ila Allohi qala alhavariyyuna nahnu ansaru Allohi amanna biAllohi vaishhad bianna muslimuna
Rabbana amanna bima anzalta vaittaba'na alrrasula faoktubna ma'a alshshahidiyna
Vamakaru vamakara Allohu vaAllohu xayru almakiriyna

Iz qala Allohu ya 'iysa inniy mutavaffiyka varafi'uka ilayya vamutahhiruka mina allaziyna kafaru vaja'ilu allaziyna ittaba'uka favqa allaziyna kafaru ila yavmi alqiyamati zumma ilayya marji'ukum fahkumu baynakum fiyma kuntum fiyhi taxtalifuna
Famma allaziyna kafaru fao'azzibuhum 'azaban shadiydan fiy alddunya valaxirati vama lahum min nasiriyna
Vamma allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati fayuvaffiyhim ojurahum vaAllohu la yuhibbu alzzalimiyna
Zalika natluhu 'alayka mina alayati valzzikri alhakiymi
Inna masala 'iysa 'inda Allohi kamasali adama xalaqahu min turabin summa qala lahu kun fayakunu
Alhaqqu min rabbika fala takun mina almumtariyna
Faman hajjaka fiyhi min ba'di ma jaka mina al'ilmi faqul ta'alav nad'u abnana vabnakum vanisana vanisakum vanfusana vanfusakum zumma nabtahil fanaj'al la'nata Allohi 'ala alkazibiyna
Inna haza lahuva alqasasu alhaqqu vama min ilahin illa Allohu vainna Alloha lahuva al'aziyzu alhakiymu
Fain tavallav fainna Alloha 'aliymun bialmufsidiyna

Qul ya ahla alkitabi ta'alav ila kalimatin savain baynana vabaynakum alla na'buda illa Alloha vala nushrika bihi shayan vala yattaxiza ba'duna ba'dan arbaban min duni Allohi fain tavallav faqulu ishhadu bianna muslimuna
Ya ahla alkitabi lima tuhajjuna fiy ibrahiyma vama onzilati alttavratu valinjiylu illa min ba'dihi afala ta'qiluna
Hantum haolai hajajtum fiyma lakum bihi 'ilmun falima tuhajjuna fiyma laysa lakum bihi 'ilmun vaAllohu ya'lamu vantum la ta'lamuna
Ma kana ibrahiymu yahudiyyan vala nasraniyyan valakin kana haniyfan musliman vama kana mina almushrikiyna
Inna avla alnnasi biibrahiyma lallaziyna ittaba'uhu vahaza alnnabiyyu vallaziyna amanu vaAllohu valiyyu almuminiyna
Vaddat taifatun min ahli alkitabi lav yudillunakum vama yudilluna illa anfusahum vama yash'uruna
Ya ahla alkitabi lima takfuruna biayati Allohi vantum tashhaduna
Ya ahla alkitabi lima talbisuna alhaqqa bialbatili vataktumuna alhaqqa vantum ta'lamuna
Vaqalat taifatun min ahli alkitabi aminu biallaziy onzila 'ala allaziyna amanu vajha alnnahari vaokfuru axirahu la'llohum yarji'una

Vala tuminu illa liman tabi'a diynakum qul inna alhuda huda Allohi an yuta ahadun misla ma utiytum av yuhajjukum 'inda rabbikum qul inna alfadla biyadi Allohi yutiyhi man yashao vaAllohu vasi'un 'aliymun
Yaxtassu birahmatihi man yashao vaAllohu zu alfadli al'aziymi

Vamin ahli alkitabi man in tamanhu biqintarin yuaddihi ilayka vaminhum man in tamanhu bidiynarin la yuaddihi ilayka illa ma dumta 'alayhi qaiman zalika biannahum qalu laysa 'alayna fiy alommiyyiyna sabiylun vayaquluna 'ala Allohi alkaziba vahum ya'lamuna
Bala man avfa bi'ahdihi vaittaqa fainna Alloha yuhibbu almuttaqiyna

Inna allaziyna yashtaruna bi'ahdi Allohi vaymanihim zamanan qaliylan olaika la xalaqa lahum fiy alaxirati vala yukallimuhumu Allohu vala yanzuru ilayhim yavma alqiyamati vala yuzakkiyhim valahum 'azabun aliymun

Vainna minhum lafariyqan yalvuna alsinatahum bialkitabi litahsabuhu mina alkitabi vama huva mina alkitabi vayaquluna huva min 'indi Allohi vama huva min 'indi Allohi vayaquluna 'ala Allohi alkaziba vahum ya'lamuna

Ma kana libasharin an yutiyahu Allohu alkitaba valhukma valnnubuvvata summa yaqula lilnnasi kunu 'ibadan liy min duni Allohi valakin kunu rabbaniyyiyna bima kuntum tu'allimuna alkitaba vabima kuntum tadrusuna
Vala yamurakum an tattaxizu almalaikata valnnabiyyiyna arbaban ayamurukum bialkufri ba'da iz antum muslimuna

Vaiz axaza Allohu miyzaqa alnnabiyyiyna lama ataytukum min kitabin vahikmatin zumma jakum rasulun musaddiqun lima ma'akum latuminunna bihi valatansurunnahu qala aqrartum vaxaztum 'ala zalikum isriy qalu aqrarna qala faishhadu vana ma'akum mina alshshahidiyna
Faman tavalla ba'da zalika faolaika humu alfasiquna
Afag'ayra diyni Allohi yabg'una valahu aslama man fiy alssamavati valardi tav'an vakarhan vailayhi yurja'una

Qul amanna biAllohi vama onzila 'alayna vama onzila 'ala ibrahiyma vaisma'iyla vaishaqa vaya'quba valasbati vama utiya musa va'iysa valnnabiyyuna min rabbihim la nufarriqu bayna ahadin minhum vanahnu lahu muslimuna
Vaman yabtag'i g'ayra alislami diynan falan yuqbala minhu vahuva fiy alaxirati mina alxasiriyna
Kayfa yahdiy Allohu qavman kafaru ba'da iymanihim vashahidu anna alrrasula haqqun vajahumu albayyinatu vaAllohu la yahdiy alqavma alzzalimiyna
Olaika jazaohum anna 'alayhim la'nata Allohi valmalaikati valnnasi ajma'iyna
Xalidiyna fiyha la yuxaffafu 'anhumu al'azabu vala hum yunzaruna
Illa allaziyna tabu min ba'di zalika vaslahu fainna Alloha g'afurun rahiymun
Inna allaziyna kafaru ba'da iymanihim zumma izdadu kufran lan tuqbala tavbatuhum vaolaika humu alddalluna
Inna allaziyna kafaru vamatu vahum kuffarun falan yuqbala min ahadihim milo alardi zahaban valavi iftada bihi olaika lahum 'azabun aliymun vama lahum min nasiriyna
Lan tanalu albirra hatta tunfiqu mimma tuhibbuna vama tunfiqu min shayin fainna Alloha bihi 'aliymun
Kullu altta'ami kana hillan libaniy israiyla illa ma harrama israiylu 'ala nafsihi min qabli an tunazzala alttavratu qul fatu bialttavrati faotluha in kuntum sadiqiyna
Famani iftara 'ala Allohi alkaziba min ba'di zalika faolaika humu alzalimuna
Qul sadaqa Allohu faittabi'u millata ibrahiyma haniyfan vama kana mina almushrikiyna
Inna avvala baytin vudi'a lilnnasi lallaziy bibakkata mubarakan vahudan lil'alamiyna
Fiyhi ayatun bayyinatun maqamu ibrahiyma vaman daxalahu kana aminan valillahi 'ala alnnasi hijju albayti mani istata'a ilayhi sabiylan vaman kafara fainna Alloha g'aniyyun 'ani al'alamiyna
Qul ya ahla alkitabi lima takfuruna biayati Allohi vaAllohu shahiydun 'ala ma ta'maluna
Qul ya ahla alkitabi lima tasudduna 'an sabiyli Allohi man amana tabg'unaha 'ivajan vantum shuhadao vama Allohu big'afilin 'amma ta'maluna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu in tutiy'u fariyqan mina allaziyna utu alkitaba yaruddukum ba'da iymanikum kafiriyna
Vakayfa takfuruna vantum tutla 'alaykum ayatu Allohi vafiykum rasuluhu vaman ya'tasim biAllohi faqad hudiya ila siratin mustaqiymin
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu ittaqu Alloha haqqa tuqatihi vala tamutunna illa vantum muslimuna

Vai'tasimu bihabli Allohi jamiy'an vala tafarraqu vaozkuru ni'mata Allohi 'alaykum iz kuntum a'dan fallafa bayna qulubikum fasbahtum bini'matihi ixvanan vakuntum 'ala shafa hufratin mina alnnari fanqazakum minha kazalika yubayyinu Allohu lakum ayatihi la'allakum tahtaduna
Valtakun minkum ommatun yad'una ila alxayri vayamuruna bialma'rufi vayanhavna 'ani almunkari vaolaika humu almuflihuna
Vala takunu kallaziyna tafarraqu vaixtalafu min ba'di ma jahumu albayyinatu vaolaika lahum 'azabun 'aziymun
Yavma tabyaddu vujuhun vatasvaddu vujuhun famma allaziyna isvaddat vujuhuhum akafartum ba'da iymanikum fazuqu al'azaba bima kuntum takfuruna
Vamma allaziyna ibyaddat vujuhuhum fafiy rahmati Allohi hum fiyha xaliduna
Tilka ayatu Allohi natluha 'alayka bialhaqqi vama Allohu yuriydu zulman lil'alamiyna
Valillahi ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi vaila Allohi turja'u alomuru
Kuntum xayra ommatin oxrijat lilnnasi tamuruna bialma'rufi vatanhavna 'ani almunkari vatuminuna biAllohi valav amana ahlu alkitabi lakana xayran lahum minhumu almuminuna vaksaruhumu alfasiquna
Lan yadurrukum illa azan vain yuqatilukum yuvallukumu aladbara zumma la yunsaruna

Duribat 'alayhimu alzzillatu ayna ma zuqifu illa bihablin mina Allohi vahablin mina alnnasi vabau big'adabin mina Allohi vaduribat 'alayhimu almaskanatu zalika biannahum kanu yakfuruna biayati Allohi vayaqtuluna alanbiya big'ayri haqqin zalika bima 'asav vakanu ya'taduna
Laysu savan min ahli alkitabi ommatun qaimatun yatluna ayati Allohi ana allayli vahum yasjuduna
Yuminuna biAllohi valyavmi alaxiri vayamuruna bialma'rufi vayanhavna 'ani almunkari vayusari'una fiy alxayrati vaolaika mina alssalihiyna
Vama yaf'alu min xayrin falan yukfaruhu vaAllohu 'aliymun bialmuttaqiyna
Inna allaziyna kafaru lan tug'niya 'anhum amvaluhum vala avladuhum mina Allohi shayan vaolaika ashabu alnnari hum fiyha xaliduna
Mazalu ma yunfiquna fiy hazihi alhayati alddunya kamazali riyhin fiyha sirrun asabat harza qavmin zalamu anfusahum fahlakazu vama zalamahumu Allohu valakin anfusahum yazlimuna

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la tattaxizu bitanatan min dunikum la yalunakum xabalan vaddu ma 'anittum qad badati albag'dao min afvahihim vama tuxfiy suduruhum akbaru qad bayyanna lakumu alayati in kuntum ta'qiluna

Hantum olai tuhibbunahum vala yuhibbunakum vatuminuna bialkitabi kullihi vaiza laqukum qalu amanna vaiza xalav 'addu 'alaykumu alanamila mina alg'ayzi qul mutu big'ayzikum inna Alloha 'aliymun bizati alssuduri
In tamsaskum hasanatun tasuhum vain tusibkum sayyiatun yafrahu biha vain tasbiru vatattaqu la yadurrukum kayduhum shayan inna Alloha bima ya'maluna muhiytun
Vaiz g'adavta min ahlika tubavvio almuminiyna maqa'ida lilqitali vaAllohu samiy'un 'aliymun
Iz hammat taifatani minkum an tafshala vaAllohu valiyyuhuma va'ala Allohi falyatavakkali almuminuna
Valaqad nasarakumu Allohu bibadrin vantum azillatun faittaqu Alloha la'allakum tashkuruna
Iz taqulu lilmuminiyna alan yakfiyakum an yumiddakum rabbukum bizalazati alafin mina almalaikati munzaliyna
Bala in tasbiru vatattaqu vayatukum min favrihim haza yumdidkum rabbukum bixamsati alafin mina almalaikati musavvimiyna
Vama ja'alahu Allohu illa bushra lakum valitatmainna qulubukum bihi vama alnnasru illa min 'indi Allohi al'aziyzi alhakiymi
Liyaqta'a tarafan mina allaziyna kafaru av yakbitahum fayanqalibu xaibiyna
Laysa laka mina alamri shayon av yatuba 'alayhim av yu'azzibahum fainnahum zalimuna
Valillahi ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi yag'firu liman yashao vayu'azzibu man yashao vaAllohu g'afurun rahiymun
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la takulu alrriba ad'afan muda'afatan vaittaqu Alloha la'allakum tuflihuna
Vaittaqu alnnara allatiy o'iddat lilkafiriyna
Vatiy'u Alloha valrrasula la'allakum turhamuna
Vasari'u ila mag'firatin min rabbikum vajannatin 'arduha alssamavatu valardu o'iddat lilmuttaqiyna
Allaziyna yunfiquna fiy alssarrai valddarrai valkazimiyna alg'ayza val'afiyna 'ani alnnasi vaAllohu yuhibbu almuhsiniyna
Vallaziyna iza fa'alu fahishatan av zalamu anfusahum zakaru Alloha faistag'faru lizunubihim vaman yag'firu alzzunuba illa Allohu valam yusirru 'ala ma fa'alu vahum ya'lamuna
Olaika jazaohum mag'firatun min rabbihim vajannatun tajriy min tahtiha alanharu xalidiyna fiyha vani'ma ajru al'amiliyna
Qad xalat min qablikum sunanun fasiyru fiy alardi faonzuru kayfa kana 'aqibatu almukazzibiyna
Haza bayanun lilnnasi vahudan vamav'izatun lilmuttaqiyna
Vala tahinu vala tahzanu vantumu ala'lavna in kuntum muminiyna
In yamsaskum qarhun faqad massa alqavma qarhun mizluhu vatilka alayyamu nudaviluha bayna alnnasi valiya'lama Allohu allaziyna amanu vayattaxiza minkum shuhada vaAllohu la yuhibbu alzzalimiyna
Valiyumahhisa Allohu allaziyna amanu vayamhaqa alkafiriyna
Am hasibtum an tadxulu aljannata valamma ya'lami Allohu allaziyna jahadu minkum vaya'lama alssabiriyna
Valaqad kuntum tamannavna almavta min qabli an talqavhu faqad raytumuhu vantum tanzuruna
Vama muhammadun illa rasulun qad xalat min qablihi alrrusulu afain mata av qutila inqalabtum 'ala a'qabikum vaman yanqalib 'ala 'aqibayhi falan yadurra Alloha shayan vasayajziy Allohu alshshakiriyna
Vama kana linafsin an tamuta illa biizni Allohi kitaban muajjalan vaman yurid zavaba alddunya nutihi minha vaman yurid zavaba alaxirati nutihi minha vasanajziy alshshakiriyna
Vakayyin min nabiyyin qatala ma'ahu ribbiyyuna kasiyrun fama vahanu lima asabahum fiy sabiyli Allohi vama da'ufu vama istakanu vaAllohu yuhibbu alssabiriyna
Vama kana qavlahum illa an qalu rabbana ig'fir lana zunubana vaisrafana fiy amrina vazabbit aqdamana vaonsurna 'ala alqavmi alkafiriyna
Fatahumu Allohu savaba alddunya vahusna savabi alaxirati vaAllohu yuhibbu almuhsiniyna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu in tutiy'u allaziyna kafaru yaruddukum 'ala a'qabikum fatanqalibu xasiriyna
Bali Allohu mavlakum vahuva xayru alnnasiriyna
Sanulqiy fiy qulubi allaziyna kafaru alrru'ba bima ashraku biAllohi ma lam yunazzil bihi sultanan vamavahumu alnnaru vabisa mazva alzzalimiyna

Valaqad sadaqakumu Allohu va'dahu iz tahussunahum biiznihi hatta iza fashiltum vatanaza'tum fiy alamri va'asaytum min ba'di ma arakum ma tuhibbuna minkum man yuriydu alddunya vaminkum man yuriydu alaxirata zumma sarafakum 'anhum liyabtaliyakum valaqad 'afa 'ankum vaAllohu zu fadlin 'ala almuminiyna
Iz tus'iduna vala talvuna 'ala ahadin valrrasulu yad'ukum fiy oxrakum fazabakum g'amman big'ammin likayla tahzanu 'ala ma fatakum vala ma asabakum vaAllohu xabiyrun bima ta'maluna

Zumma anzala 'alaykum min ba'di alg'ammi amanatan nu'asan yag'sha taifatan minkum vataifatun qad ahammazum anfusuhum yazunnuna biAllohi g'ayra alhaqqi zanna aljahiliyyati yaquluna hal lana mina alamri min shayin qul inna alamra kullahu lillahi yuxfuna fiy anfusihim ma la yubduna laka yaquluna lav kana lana mina alamri shayon ma qutilna hahuna qul lav kuntum fiy buyutikum labaraza allaziyna kutiba 'alayhimu alqatlu ila madaji'ihim valiyabtaliya Allohu ma fiy sudurikum valiyumahhisa ma fiy qulubikum vaAllohu 'aliymun bizati alssuduri
Inna allaziyna tavallav minkum yavma iltaqa aljam'ani innama istazllohumu alshshaytanu biba'di ma kasabu valaqad 'afa Allohu 'anhum inna Alloha g'afurun haliymun

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la takunu kallaziyna kafaru vaqalu liixvanihim iza darabu fiy alardi av kanu g'uzzan lav kanu 'indana ma matu vama qutilu liyaj'ala Allohu zalika hasratan fiy qulubihim vaAllohu yuhyiy vayumiytu vaAllohu bima ta'maluna basiyrun
Valain qutiltum fiy sabiyli Allohi av muttum lamag'firatun mina Allohi varahmatun xayrun mimma yajma'una
Valain muttum av qutiltum laila Allohi tuhsharuna

Fabima rahmatin mina Allohi linta lahum valav kunta fazzan g'aliyza alqalbi lainfaddu min havlika fao'fu 'anhum vaistag'fir lahum vashavirhum fiy alamri faiza 'azamta fatavakkal 'ala Allohi inna Alloha yuhibbu almutavakkiliyna
In yansurkumu Allohu fala g'aliba lakum vain yaxzulkum faman za allaziy yansurukum min ba'dihi va'ala Allohi falyatavakkali almuminuna
Vama kana linabiyyin an yag'ulla vaman yag'lul yati bima g'alla yavma alqiyamati zumma tuvaffa kullu nafsin ma kasabat vahum la yuzlamuna
Afamani ittaba'a ridvana Allohi kaman ba bisaxatin mina Allohi vamavahu jahannamu vabisa almasiyru
Hum darajatun 'inda Allohi vaAllohu basiyrun bima ya'maluna
Laqad manna Allohu 'ala almuminiyna iz ba'aza fiyhim rasulan min anfusihim yatlu 'alayhim ayatihi vayuzakkiyhim vayu'allimuhumu alkitaba valhikmata vain kanu min qablu lafiy dalalin mubiynin
Avalamma asabatkum musiybatun qad asabtum mizlayha qultum anna haza qul huva min 'indi anfusikum inna Alloha 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun
Vama asabakum yavma iltaqa aljam'ani fabiizni Allohi valiya'lama almuminiyna

Valiya'lama allaziyna nafaqu vaqiyla lahum ta'alav qatilu fiy sabiyli Allohi avi idfa'u qalu lav na'lamu qitalan laittaba'nakum hum lilkufri yavmaizin aqrabu minhum liliymani yaquluna biafvahihim ma laysa fiy qulubihim vaAllohu a'lamu bima yaktumuna
Allaziyna qalu liixvanihim vaqa'adu lav ata'una ma qutilu qul faidrau 'an anfusikumu almavta in kuntum sadiqiyna
Vala tahsabanna allaziyna qutilu fiy sabiyli Allohi amvatan bal ahyaon 'inda rabbihim yurzaquna
Farihiyna bima atahumu Allohu min fadlihi vayastabshiruna biallaziyna lam yalhaqu bihim min xalfihim alla xavfun 'alayhim vala hum yahzanuna
Yastabshiruna bini'matin mina Allohi vafadlin vanna Alloha la yudiy'u ajra almuminiyna
Allaziyna istajabu lillahi valrrasuli min ba'di ma asabahumu alqarhu lillaziyna ahsanu minhum vaittaqav ajrun 'aziymun
Allaziyna qala lahumu alnnasu inna alnnasa qad jama'u lakum faixshavhum fazadahum iymanan vaqalu hasbuna Allohu vani'ma alvakiylu
Fainqalabu bini'matin mina Allohi vafadlin lam yamsashum suon vaittaba'u ridvana Allohi vaAllohu zu fadlin 'aziymin
Innama zalikumu alshshaytanu yuxavvifu avliyahu fala taxafuhum vaxafuni in kuntum muminiyna
Vala yahzunka allaziyna yusari'una fiy alkufri innahum lan yadurru Alloha shayan yuriydu Allohu alla yaj'ala lahum hazzan fiy alaxirati valahum 'azabun 'aziymun
Inna allaziyna ishtaravu alkufra bialiymani lan yadurru Alloha shayan valahum 'azabun aliymun
Vala yahsabanna allaziyna kafaru annama numliy lahum xayrun lianfusihim innama numliy lahum liyazdadu izman valahum 'azabun muhiynun

Ma kana Allohu liyazara almuminiyna 'ala ma antum 'alayhi hatta yamiyza alxabiyza mina alttayyibi vama kana Allohu liyutli'akum 'ala alg'aybi valakinna Alloha yajtabiy min rusulihi man yashao faminu biAllohi varusulihi vain tuminu vatattaqu falakum ajrun 'aziymun

Vala yahsabanna allaziyna yabxaluna bima atahummu Allohu min fadlihi huva xayran lahum bal huva sharrun lahum sayutavvaquna ma baxilu bihi yavma alqiyamati valillahi miyrazu alssamavati valardi vaAllohu bima ta'maluna xabiyrun
Laqad sami'a Allohu qavla allaziyna qalu inna Alloha faqiyrun vanahnu ag'niyaon sanaktubu ma qalu vaqatlahumu alanbiya big'ayri haqqin vanaqulu zuqu 'azaba alhariyqi
Zalika bima qaddamat aydiykum vanna Alloha laysa bizallamin lil'abiydi

Allaziyna qalu inna Alloha 'ahida ilayna alla numina lirasulin hatta yatiyana biqurbanin takuluhu alnnaru qul qad jakum rusulun min qabliy bialbayyinati vabiallaziy qultum falima qataltumuhum in kutum sadiqiyna
Fain kazzabuka faqad kuzziba rusulun min qablika jau bialbayyinati valzzuburi valkitabi almuniyri
Kullu nafsin zaiqatu almavti vainnama tuvaffavna ojurakum yavma alqiyamati faman zuhziha 'ani alnnari vaodxila aljannata faqad faza vama alhayatu alddunya illa mata'u alg'ururi
Latublavunna fiy amvalikum vanfusikum valatasma'unna mina allaziyna utu alkitaba min qablikum vamina allaziyna ashraku azan kaziyran vain tasbiru vatattaqu fainna zalika min 'azmi alomuri
Vaiz axaza Allohu miyzaqa allaziyna utu alkitaba latubayyinunnahu lilnnasi vala taktumunahu fanabazuhu vara zuhurihim vaishtarav bihi zamanan qaliylan fabisa ma yashtaruna
La tahsabanna allaziyna yafrahuna bima atav vayuhibbuna an yuhmadu bima lam yaf'alu fala tahsabannahum bimafazatin mina al'azabi valahum 'azabun aliymun
Valillahi mulku alssamavati valardi vaAllohu 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun
Inna fiy xalqi alssamavati valardi vaixtilafi allayli valnnahari layatin lioliy alalbabi
Allaziyna yazkuruna Alloha qiyaman vaqu'udan va'ala junubihim vayatafakkaruna fiy xalqi alssamavati valardi rabbana ma xalaqta haza batilan subhanaka faqina 'azaba alnnari
Rabbana innaka man tudxili alnnara faqad axzaytahu vama lilzzalimiyna min ansarin
Rabbana innana sami'na munadiyan yunadiy liliymani an aminu birabbikum famanna rabbana faig'fir lana zunubana vakaffir 'anna sayyiatina vatavaffana ma'a alabrari
Rabbana vatina ma va'adtana 'ala rusulika vala tuxzina yavma alqiyamati innaka la tuxlifu almiy'ada

Faistajaba lahum rabbuhum anniy la odiy'u 'amala 'amilin minkum min zakarin av onza ba'dukum min ba'din fallaziyna hajaru vaoxriju min diyarihim vauzu fiy sabiyliy vaqatalu vaqutilu laokaffiranna 'anhum sayyiatihim valaodxilannahum jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu zavaban min 'indi Allohi vaAllohu 'indahu husnu alzzavabi
La yag'urrannaka taqallubu allaziyna kafaru fiy albiladi
Mata'un qaliylun summa mavahum jahannamu vabisa almihadu
Lakini allaziyna ittaqav rabbahum lahum jannatun tajriy min tahtiha alanharu xalidiyna fiyha nuzulan min 'indi Allohi vama 'inda Allohi xayrun lilabrari

Vainna min ahli alkitabi laman yuminu biAllohi vama onzila ilaykum vama onzila ilayhim xashi'iyna lillahi la yashtaruna biayati Allohi samanan qaliylan olaika lahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim inna Alloha sariy'u alhisabi
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu isbiru vasabiru varabitu vaittaqu Alloha la'allakum tuflihuna

Ya ayyuha alnnasu ittaqu rabbakumu allaziy xalaqakum min nafsin vahidatin vaxalaqa minha zavjaha vabazza minhuma rijalan kaziyran vanisan vaittaqu Alloha allaziy tasaluna bihi valarhama inna Alloha kana 'alaykum raqiyban
Vatu alyatama amvalahum vala tatabaddalu alxabiysa bialttayyibi vala takulu amvalahum ila amvalikum innahu kana huban kabiyran
Vain xiftum alla tuqsitu fiy alyatama fainkihu ma taba lakum mina alnnisai mazna vazulaza varuba'a fain xiftum alla ta'dilu favahidatan av ma malakat aymanukum zalika adna alla ta'ulu
Vatu alnnisa saduqatihinna nihlatan fain tibna lakum 'an shayin minhu nafsan fakuluhu haniyan mariyan
Vala tutu alssufaha amvalakumu allatiy ja'ala Allohu lakum qiyaman vaorzuquhum fiyha vaoksuhum vaqulu lahum qavlan ma'rufan

Vaibtalu alyatama hatta iza balag'u alnnikaha fain anastum minhum rushdan faidfa'u ilayhim amvalahum vala takuluha israfan vabidaran an yakbaru vaman kana g'aniyyan falyasta'fif vaman kana faqiyran falyakul bialma'rufi faiza dafa'tum ilayhim amvalahum fashhidu 'alayhim vakafa biAllohi hasiyban
Lilrrijali nasiybun mimma taraka alvalidani valaqrabuna valilnnisai nasiybun mimma taraka alvalidani valaqrabuna mimma qalla minhu av kasura nasiyban mafrudan
Vaiza hadara alqismata olu alqurba valyatama valmasakiynu faorzuquhum minhu vaqulu lahum qavlan ma'rufan
Valyaxsha allaziyna lav taraku min xalfihim zurriyyatan di'afan xafu 'alayhim falyattaqu Alloha valyaqulu qavlan sadiydan
Inna allaziyna yakuluna amvala alyatama zulman innama yakuluna fiy butunihim naran vasayaslavna sa'iyran

Yusiykumu Allohu fiy avladikum lilzzakari mizlu hazzi alonzayayni fain kunna nisan favqa iznatayni falahunna zuluza ma taraka vain kanat vahidatan falaha alnnisfu valiabavayhi likulli vahidin minhuma alssudusu mimma taraka in kana lahu valadun fain lam yakun lahu valadun vavarizahu abavahu faliommihi alzzuluzu fain kana lahu ixvatun faliommihi alssudusu min ba'di vasiyyatin yusiy biha av daynin abaokum vabnaokum la tadruna ayyuhum aqrabu lakum naf'an fariydatan mina Allohi inna Alloha kana 'aliyman hakiyman

Valakum nisfu ma taraka azvajukum in lam yakun lahunna valadun fain kana lahunna valadun falakumu alrrubu'u mimma tarakna min ba'di vasiyyatin yusiyna biha av daynin valahunna alrrubu'u mimma taraktum in lam yakun lakum valadun fain kana lakum valadun falahunna alzzumunu mimma taraktum min ba'di vasiyyatin tusuna biha av daynin vain kana rajulun yurazu kalalatan avi imratun valahu axun av oxtun falikulli vahidin minhuma alssudusu fain kanu akzara min zalika fahum shurakao fiy alzzuluzi min ba'di vasiyyatin yusa biha av daynin g'ayra mudarrin vasiyyatan mina Allohi vaAllohu 'aliymun haliymun
Tilka hududu Allohi vaman yuti'i Alloha varasulahu yudxilhu jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu xalidiyna fiyha vazalika alfavzu al'aziymu
Vaman ya'si Alloha varasulahu vayata'adda hududahu yudxilhu naran xalidan fiyha valahu 'azabun muhiynun
Vallatiy yatiyna alfahishata min nisaikum faistashhidu 'alayhinna arba'atan minkum fain shahidu famsikuhunna fiy albuyuti hatta yatavaffahunna almavtu av yaj'ala Allohu lahunna sabiylan
Vallazani yatiyaniha minkum fazuhuma fain taba vaslaha fa'ridu 'anhuma inna Alloha kana tavvaban rahiyman
Innama alttavbatu 'ala Allohi lillaziyna ya'maluna alssua bijahalatin zumma yatubuna min qariybin faolaika yatubu Allohu 'alayhim vakana Allohu 'aliyman hakiyman
Valaysati alttavbatu lillaziyna ya'maluna alssayyiati hatta iza hadara ahadahumu almavtu qala inniy tubtu alana vala allaziyna yamutuna vahum kuffarun olaika a'tadna lahum 'azaban aliyman

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la yahillu lakum an tarizu alnnisa karhan vala ta'duluhunna litazhabu biba'di ma ataytumuhunna illa an yatiyna bifahishatin mubayyinatin va'ashiruhunna bialma'rufi fain karihtumuhunna fa'asa an takrahu shayan vayaj'ala Allohu fiyhi xayran kaziyran
Vain aradtumu istibdala zavjin makana zavjin vataytum ihdahunna qintaran fala taxuzu minhu shayan ataxuzunahu buhtanan vaizman mubiynan
Vakayfa taxuzunahu vaqad afda ba'dukum ila ba'din vaxazna minkum miyzaqan g'aliyzan
Vala tankihu ma nakaha abaokum mina alnnisai illa ma qad salafa innahu kana fahishatan vamaqtan vasa sabiylan

Hurrimat 'alaykum ommahatukum vabanatukum vaxavatukum va'ammatukum vaxalatukum vabanatu alaxi vabanatu aloxti vaommahatukumu allatiy arda'nakum vaxavatukum mina alrrada'ati vaommahatu nisaikum varabaibukumu allatiy fiy hujurikum min nisaikumu allatiy daxaltum bihinna fain lam takunu daxaltum bihinna fala junaha 'alaykum vahalailu abnaikumu allaziyna min aslabikum van tajma'u bayna aloxtayni illa ma qad salafa inna Alloha kana g'afuran rahiyman

Valmuhsanatu mina alnnisai illa ma malakat aymanukum kitaba Allohi 'alaykum vaohilla lakum ma vara zalikum an tabtag'u biamvalikum muhsiniyna g'ayra musafihiyna fama istamta'tum bihi minhunna fatuhunna ojurahunna fariydatan vala junaha 'alaykum fiyma taradaytum bihi min ba'di alfariydati inna Alloha kana 'aliyman hakiyman

Vaman lam yastati' minkum tavlan an yankiha almuhsanati almuminati famin ma malakat aymanukum min fatayatikumu almuminati vaAllohu a'lamu biiymanikum ba'dukum min ba'din fainkihuhunna biizni ahlihinna vatuhunna ojurahunna bialma'rufi muhsanatin g'ayra masafihatin vala muttaxizati axdanin faiza ohsinna fain atayna bifahishatin fa'alayhinna nisfu ma 'ala almuhsanati mina al'azabi zalika liman xashiya al'anata minkum van tasbiru xayrun lakum vaAllohu g'afurun rahiymun
Yuriydu Allohu liyubayyina lakum vayahdiyakum sunana allaziyna min qablikum vayatuba 'alaykum vaAllohu 'aliymun hakiymun
VaAllohu yuriydu an yatuba 'alaykum vayuriydu allaziyna yattabi'una alshshahavati an tamiylu maylan 'aziyman
Yuriydu Allohu an yuxaffifa 'ankum vaxuliqa alinsanu da'iyfan
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la takulu amvalakum baynakum bialbatili illa an takuna tijaratan 'an taradin minkum vala taqtulu anfusakum inna Alloha kana bikum rahiyman
Vaman yaf'al zalika 'udvanan vazulman fasavfa nusliyhi naran vakana zalika 'ala Allohi yasiyran
In tajtanibu kabaira ma tunhavna 'anhu nukaffir 'ankum sayyiatikum vanudxilkum mudxalan kariyman
Vala tatamannav ma faddala Allohu bihi ba'dakum 'ala ba'din lilrrijali nasiybun mimma iktasabu valilnnisai nasiybun mimma iktasabna vaisalu Alloha min fadlihi inna Alloha kana bikulli shayin 'aliyman
Valikullin ja'alna mavaliya mimma taraka alvalidani valaqrabuna vallaziyna 'aqadat aymanukum fatuhum nasiybahum inna Alloha kana 'ala kulli shayin shahiydan

Alrrijalu qavvamuna 'ala alnnisai bima faddala Allohu ba'dahum 'ala ba'din vabima anfaqu min amvalihim falssalihatu qanitatun hafizatun lilg'aybi bima hafiza Allohu vallatiy taxafuna nushuzahunna fa'izuhunna vaohjuruhunna fiy almadaji'i vaidribuhunna fain ata'nakum fala tabg'u 'alayhinna sabiylan inna Alloha kana 'aliyyan kabiyran
Vain xiftum shiqaqa baynihima faib'asu hakaman min ahlihi vahakaman min ahliha in yuriyda islahan yuvaffiqi Allohu baynahuma inna Alloha kana 'aliyman xabiyran

Vao'budu Alloha vala tushriku bihi shayan vabialvalidayni ihsanan vabiziy alqurba valyatama valmasakiyni valjari ziy alqurba valjari aljunubi valssahibi bialjanbi vaibni alssabiyli vama malakat aymanukum inna Alloha la yuhibbu man kana muxtalan faxuran
Allaziyna yabxaluna vayamuruna alnnasa bialbuxli vayaktumuna ma atahumu Allohu min fadlihi va'tadna lilkafiriyna 'azaban muhiynan
Vallaziyna yunfiquna amvalahum ria alnnasi vala yuminuna biAllohi vala bialyavmi alaxiri vaman yakuni alshshaytanu lahu qariynan fasa qariynan
Vamaza 'alayhim lav amanu biAllohi valyavmi alaxiri vanfaqu mimma razaqahumu Allohu vakana Allohu bihim 'aliyman
Inna Alloha la yazlimu mizqala zarratin vain taku hasanatan yuda'ifha vayuti min ladunhu ajran 'aziyman
Fakayfa iza jina min kulli ommatin bishahiydin vajina bika 'ala haolai shahiydan
Yavmaizin yavaddu allaziyna kafaru va'asavu alrrasula lav tusavva bihimu alardu vala yaktumuna Alloha hadiyzan

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la taqrabu alssalata vantum sukara hatta ta'lamu ma taquluna vala junuban illa 'abiriy sabiylin hatta tag'tasilu vain kuntum marda av 'ala safarin av ja ahadun minkum mina alg'aiti av lamastumu alnnisa falam tajidu man fatayammamu sa'iydan tayyiban faimsahu bivujuhikum vaydiykum inna Alloha kana 'afuvvan g'afuran
Alam tara ila allaziyna utu nasiyban mina alkitabi yashtaruna alddalalata vayuriyduna an tadillu alssabiyla
VaAllohu a'lamu bia'daikum vakafa biAllohi valiyyan vakafa biAllohi nasiyran

Mina allaziyna hadu yuharrifuna alkalima 'an mavadi'ihi vayaquluna sami'na va'asayna vaisma' g'ayra musma'in vara'ina layyan bialsinatihim vata'nan fiy alddiyni valav annahum qalu sami'na vata'na vaisma' vaonzurna lakana xayran lahum vaqvama valakin la'anahumu Allohu bikufrihim fala yuminuna illa qaliylan

Ya ayyuha allaziyna utu alkitaba aminu bima nazzalna musaddiqan lima ma'akum min qabli an natmisa vujuhan fanaruddaha 'ala adbariha av nal'anahum kama la'anna ashaba alssabti vakana amru Allohi maf'ulan
Inna Alloha la yag'firu an yushraka bihi vayag'firu ma duna zalika liman yashao vaman yushrik biAllohi faqadi iftara izman 'aziyman
Alam tara ila allaziyna yuzakkuna anfusahum bali Allohu yuzakkiy man yashao vala yuzlamuna fatiylan
Onzur kayfa yaftaruna 'ala Allohi alkaziba vakafa bihi izman mubiynan
Alam tara ila allaziyna utu nasiyban mina alkitabi yuminuna bialjibti valttag'uti vayaquluna lillaziyna kafaru haolai ahda mina allaziyna amanu sabiylan
Olaika allaziyna la'anahumu Allohu vaman yal'ani Allohu falan tajida lahu nasiyran
Am lahum nasiybun mina almulki faizan la yutuna alnnasa naqiyran
Am yahsuduna alnnasa 'ala ma atahumu Allohu min fadlihi faqad atayna ala ibrahiyma alkitaba valhikmata vataynahum mulkan 'aziyman
Faminhum man amana bihi vaminhum man sadda 'anhu vakafa bijahannama sa'iyran
Inna allaziyna kafaru biayatina savfa nusliyhim naran kullama nadijat juluduhum baddalnahum juludan g'ayraha liyazuqu al'azaba inna Alloha kana 'aziyzan hakiyman
Vallaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati sanudxiluhum jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu xalidiyna fiyha abadan lahum fiyha azvajun mutahharatun vanudxiluhum zillan zaliylan
Inna Alloha yamurukum an tuaddu alamanati ila ahliha vaiza hakamtum bayna alnnasi an tahkumu bial'adli inna Alloha ni'imma ya'izukum bihi inna Alloha kana samiy'an basiyran

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu atiy'u Alloha vatiy'u alrrasula vaoliy alamri minkum fain tanaza'tum fiy shayin farudduhu ila Allohi valrrasuli in kuntum tuminuna biAllohi valyavmi alaxiri zalika xayrun vahsanu taviylan

Alam tara ila allaziyna yaz'umuna annahum amanu bima onzila ilayka vama onzila min qablika yuriyduna an yatahakamu ila alttag'uti vaqad omiru an yakfuru bihi vayuriydu alshshaytanu an yudillahum dalalan ba'iydan
Vaiza qiyla lahum ta'alav ila ma anzala Allohu vaila alrrasuli rayta almunafiqiyna yasudduna 'anka sududan
Fakayfa iza asabazum musiybatun bima qaddamat aydiyhim zumma jauka yahlifuna biAllohi in aradna illa ihsanan vatavfiyqan
Olaika allaziyna ya'lamu Allohu ma fiy qulubihim fa'rid 'anhum va'izhum vaqul lahum fiy anfusihim qavlan baliyg'an
Vama arsalna min rasulin illa liyuta'a biizni Allohi valav annahum iz zalamu anfusahum jauka faistag'faru Alloha vaistag'fara lahumu alrrasulu lavajadu Alloha tavvaban rahiyman
Fala varabbika la yuminuna hatta yuhakkimuka fiyma shajara baynahum summa la yajidu fiy anfusihim harajan mimma qadayta vayusallimu tasliyman
Valav anna katabna 'alayhim ani oqtulu anfusakum avi oxruju min diyarikum ma fa'aluhu illa qaliylun minhum valav annahum fa'alu ma yu'azuna bihi lakana xayran lahum vashadda tazbiytan
Vaizan lataynahum min ladunna ajran 'aziyman
Valahadaynahum siratan mustaqiyman
Vaman yuti'i Alloha valrrasula faolaika ma'a allaziyna an'ama Allohu 'alayhim mina alnnabiyyiyna valssiddiyqiyna valshshuhadai valssalihiyna vahasuna olaika rafiyqan
Zalika alfadlu mina Allohi vakafa biAllohi 'aliyman
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu xuzu hizrakum fainfiru zubatin avi infiru jamiy'an
Vainna minkum laman layubattianna fain asabatkum musiybatun qala qad an'ama Allohu 'alayya iz lam akun ma'ahum shahiydan
Valain asabakum fadlun mina Allohi layaqulanna kan lam takun baynakum vabaynahu mavaddatun ya laytaniy kuntu ma'ahum fafuza favzan 'aziyman
Falyuqatil fiy sabiyli Allohi allaziyna yashruna alhayata alddunya bialaxirati vaman yuqatil fiy sabiyli Allohi fayuqtal av yag'lib fasavfa nutiyhi ajran 'aziyman

Vama lakum la tuqatiluna fiy sabiyli Allohi valmustad'afiyna mina alrrijali valnnisai valvildani allaziyna yaquluna rabbana axrijna min hazihi alqaryati alzzalimi ahluha vaij'al lana min ladunka valiyyan vaij'al lana min ladunka nasiyran
Allaziyna amanu yuqatiluna fiy sabiyli Allohi vallaziyna kafaru yuqatiluna fiy sabiyli alttag'uti faqatilu avliya alshshaytani inna kayda alshshaytani kana da'iyfan

Alam tara ila allaziyna qiyla lahum kuffu aydiyakum vaqiymu alssalata vatu alzzakata falamma kutiba 'alayhimu alqitalu iza fariyqun minhum yaxshavna alnnasa kaxashyati Allohi av ashadda xashyatan vaqalu rabbana lima katabta 'alayna alqitala lavla axxartana ila ajalin qariybin qul mata'u alddunya qaliylun valaxiratu xayrun limani ittaqa vala tuzlamuna fatiylan

Aynama takunu yudrikkumu almavtu valav kuntum fiy burujin mushayyadatin vain tusibhum hasanatun yaqulu hazihi min 'indi Allohi vain tusibhum sayyiatun yaqulu hazihi min 'indika qul kullun min 'indi Allohi famali haolai alqavmi la yakaduna yafqahuna hadiyzan
Ma asabaka min hasanatin famina Allohi vama asabaka min sayyiatin famin nafsika varsalnaka lilnnasi rasulan vakafa biAllohi shahiydan
Man yuti'i alrrasula faqad ata'a Alloha vaman tavalla fama arsalnaka 'alayhim hafiyzan
Vayaquluna ta'atun faiza barazu min 'indika bayyata taifatun minhum g'ayra allaziy taqulu vaAllohu yaktubu ma yubayyituna fa'rid 'anhum vatavakkal 'ala Allohi vakafa biAllohi vakiylan
Afala yatadabbaruna alqurana valav kana min 'indi g'ayri Allohi lavajadu fiyhi ixtilafan kasiyran

Vaiza jahum amrun mina alamni avi alxavfi aza'u bihi valav radduhu ila alrrasuli vaila oliy alamri minhum la'alimahu allaziyna yastanbitunahu minhum valavla fadlu Allohi 'alaykum varahmatuhu laittaba'tumu alshshaytana illa qaliylan
Faqatil fiy sabiyli Allohi la tukallafu illa nafsaka vaharridi almuminiyna 'asa Allohu an yakuffa basa allaziyna kafaru vaAllohu ashaddu basan vashaddu tankiylan
Man yashfa' shafa'atan hasanatan yakun lahu nasiybun minha vaman yashfa' shafa'atan sayyiatan yakun lahu kiflun minha vakana Allohu 'ala kulli shayin muqiytan
Vaiza huyyiytum bitahiyyatin fahayyu biahsana minha av rudduha inna Alloha kana 'ala kulli shayin hasiyban
Allohu la ilaha illa huva layajma'annakum ila yavmi alqiyamati la rayba fiyhi vaman asdaqu mina Allohi hadiysan
Fama lakum fiy almunafiqiyna fiatayni vaAllohu arkasahum bima kasabu aturiyduna an tahdu man adalla Allohu vaman yudlili Allohu falan tajida lahu sabiylan

Vaddu lav takfuruna kama kafaru fatakununa savan fala tattaxizu minhum avliya hatta yuhajiru fiy sabiyli Allohi fain tavallav faxuzuhum vaoqtuluhum hayzu vajadtumuhum vala tattaxizu minhum valiyyan vala nasiyran

Illa allaziyna yasiluna ila qavmin baynakum vabaynahum miyzaqun av jaukum hasirat suduruhum an yuqatilukum av yuqatilu qavmahum valav sha Allohu lasallatahum 'alaykum falaqatalukum faini i'tazalukum falam yuqatilukum valqav ilaykumu alssalama fama ja'ala Allohu lakum 'alayhim sabiylan

Satajiduna axariyna yuriyduna an yamanukum vayamanu qavmahum kulla ma ruddu ila alfitnati orkisu fiyha fain lam ya'tazilukum vayulqu ilaykumu alssalama vayakuffu aydiyahum faxuzuhum vaoqtuluhum hayzu zaqiftumuhum vaolaikum ja'alna lakum 'alayhim sultanan mubiynan

Vama kana limuminin an yaqtula muminan illa xatan vaman qatala muminan xatan fatahriyru raqabatin muminatin vadiyatun musallamatun ila ahlihi illa an yassaddaqu fain kana min qavmin 'aduvvin lakum vahuva muminun fatahriyru raqabatin muminatin vain kana min qavmin baynakum vabaynahum miysaqun fadiyatun musallamatun ila ahlihi vatahriyru raqabatin muminatin faman lam yajid fasiyamu shahrayni mutatabi'ayni tavbatan mina Allohi vakana Allohu 'aliyman hakiyman
Vaman yaqtul muminan muta'ammidan fajazaohu jahannamu xalidan fiyha vag'adiba Allohu 'alayhi vala'anahu va'adda lahu 'azaban 'aziyman

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu iza darabtum fiy sabiyli Allohi fatabayyanu vala taqulu liman alqa ilaykumu alssalama lasta muminan tabtag'una 'arada alhayati alddunya fa'inda Allohi mag'animu kaziyratun kazalika kuntum min qablu famanna Allohu 'alaykum fatabayyanu inna Alloha kana bima ta'maluna xabiyran

La yastaviy alqa'iduna mina almuminiyna g'ayru oliy alddarari valmujahiduna fiy sabiyli Allohi biamvalihim vanfusihim faddala Allohu almujahidiyna biamvalihim vanfusihim 'ala alqa'idiyna darajatan vakullan va'ada Allohu alhusna vafaddala Allohu almujahidiyna 'ala alqa'idiyna ajran 'aziyman
Darajatin minhu vamag'firatan varahmatan vakana Allohu g'afuran rahiyman

Inna allaziyna tavaffahumu almalaikatu zalimiy anfusihim qalu fiyma kuntum qalu kunna mustad'afiyna fiy alardi qalu alam takun ardu Allohi vasi'atan fatuhajiru fiyha faolaika mavahum jahannamu vasat masiyran
Illa almustad'afiyna mina alrrijali valnnisai valvildani la yastatiy'una hiylatan vala yahtaduna sabiylan
Faolaika 'asa Allohu an ya'fuva 'anhum vakana Allohu 'afuvvan g'afuran

Vaman yuhajir fiy sabiyli Allohi yajid fiy alardi murag'aman kasiyran vasa'atan vaman yaxruj min baytihi muhajiran ila Allohi varasulihi summa yudrixu almavtu faqad vaqa'a ajruhu 'ala Allohi vakana Allohu g'afuran rahiyman
Vaiza darabtum fiy alardi falaysa 'alaykum junahun an taqsuru mina alssalati in xiftum an yaftinakumu allaziyna kafaru inna alkafiriyna kanu lakum 'aduvvan mubiynan

Vaiza kunta fiyhim faqamta lahumu alssalata faltaqum taifatun minhum ma'aka valyaxuzu aslihatahum faiza sajadu falyakunu min varaikum valtati taifatun oxra lam yusallu falyusallu ma'aka valyaxuzu hizrahum vaslihatahum vadda allaziyna kafaru lav tag'fuluna 'an aslihatikum vamti'atikum fayamiyluna 'alaykum maylatan vahidatan vala junaha 'alaykum in kana bikum azan min matarin av kuntum marda an tada'u aslihatakum vaxuzu hizrakum inna Alloha a'adda lilkafiriyna 'azaban muhiynan
Faiza qadaytumu alssalata faozkuru Alloha qiyaman vaqu'udan va'ala junubikum faiza itmanantum faqiymu alssalata inna alssalata kanat 'ala almuminiyna kitaban mavqutan
Vala tahinu fiy ibtig'ai alqavmi in takunu talamuna fainnahum yalamuna kama talamuna vatarjuna mina Allohi ma la yarjuna vakana Allohu 'aliyman hakiyman
Inna anzalna ilayka alkitaba bialhaqqi litahkuma bayna alnnasi bima araka Allohu vala takun lilxainiyna xasiyman
Vaistag'firi Alloha inna Alloha kana g'afuran rahiyman
Vala tujadil 'ani allaziyna yaxtanuna anfusahum inna Alloha la yuhibbu man kana xavvanan aziyman
Yastaxfuna mina alnnasi vala yastaxfuna mina Allohi vahuva ma'ahum iz yubayyituna ma la yarda mina alqavli vakana Allohu bima ya'maluna muhiytan
Hantum haolai jadaltum 'anhum fiy alhayati alddunya faman yujadilu Alloha 'anhum yavma alqiyamati am man yakunu 'alayhim vakiylan
Vaman ya'mal suan av yazlim nafsahu zumma yastag'firi Alloha yajidi Alloha g'afuran rahiyman
Vaman yaksib isman fainnama yaksibuhu 'ala nafsihi vakana Allohu 'aliyman hakiyman
Vaman yaksib xatiyatan av isman summa yarmi bihi bariyan faqadi ihtamala buhtanan vaisman mubiynan

Valavla fadlu Allohi 'alayka varahmatuhu lahammat taifatun minhum an yudilluka vama yudilluna illa anfusahum vama yadurrunaka min shayin vanzala Allohu 'alayka alkitaba valhikmata va'allamaka ma lam takun ta'lamu vakana fadlu Allohi 'alayka 'aziyman
La xayra fiy kaziyrin min najvahum illa man amara bisadaqatin av ma'rufin av islahin bayna alnnasi vaman yaf'al zalika ibtig'a mardati Allohi fasavfa nutiyhi ajran 'aziyman
Vaman yushaqiqi alrrasula min ba'di ma tabayyana lahu alhuda vayattabi' g'ayra sabiyli almuminiyna nuvallihi ma tavalla vanuslihi jahannama vasat masiyran
Inna Alloha la yag'firu an yushraka bihi vayag'firu ma duna zalika liman yashao vaman yushrik biAllohi faqad dalla dalalan ba'iydan
In yad'una min dunihi illa inasan vain yad'una illa shaytanan mariydan
La'anahu Allohu vaqala lattaxizanna min 'ibadika nasiyban mafrudan

Valaodillannahum valaomanniyannahum valamurannahum falayubattikunna azana alan'ami valamurannahum falayug'ayyirunna xalqa Allohi vaman yattaxizi alshshaytana valiyyan min duni Allohi faqad xasira xusranan mubiynan
Ya'iduhum vayumanniyhim vama ya'iduhumu alshshaytanu illa g'ururan
Olaika mavahum jahannamu vala yajiduna 'anha mahiysan
Vallaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati sanudxiluhum jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu xalidiyna fiyha abadan va'da Allohi haqqan vaman asdaqu mina Allohi qiylan
Laysa biamaniyyikum vala amaniyyi ahli alkitabi man ya'mal suan yujza bihi vala yajid lahu min duni Allohi valiyyan vala nasiyran
Vaman ya'mal mina alssalihati min zakarin av onza vahuva muminun faolaika yadxuluna aljannata vala yuzlamuna naqiyran
Vaman ahsanu diynan mimman aslama vajhahu lillahi vahuva muhsinun vaittaba'a millata ibrahiyma haniyfan vaittaxaza Allohu ibrahiyma xaliylan
Valillahi ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi vakana Allohu bikulli shayin muhiytan

Vayastaftunaka fiy alnnisai quli Allohu yuftiykum fiyhinna vama yutla 'alaykum fiy alkitabi fiy yatama alnnisai allatiy la tutunahunna ma kutiba lahunna vatarg'abuna an tankihuhunna valmustad'afiyna mina alvildani van taqumu lilyatama bialqisti vama taf'alu min xayrin fainna Alloha kana bihi 'aliyman

Vaini imratun xafat min ba'liha nushuzan av i'radan fala junaha 'alayhima an yusliha baynahuma sulhan valssulhu xayrun vaohdirati alanfusu alshshuhha vain tuhsinu vatattaqu fainna Alloha kana bima ta'maluna xabiyran
Valan tastatiy'u an ta'dilu bayna alnnisai valav harastum fala tamiylu kulla almayli fatazaruha kalmu'allaqati vain tuslihu vatattaqu fainna Alloha kana g'afuran rahiyman
Vain yatafarraqa yug'ni Allohu kullan min sa'atihi vakana Allohu vasi'an hakiyman

Valillahi ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi valaqad vassayna allaziyna utu alkitaba min qablikum vaiyyakum ani ittaqu Alloha vain takfuru fainna lillahi ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi vakana Allohu g'aniyyan hamiydan
Valillahi ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi vakafa biAllohi vakiylan
In yasha yuzhibkum ayyuha alnnasu vayati biaxariyna vakana Allohu 'ala zalika qadiyran
Man kana yuriydu savaba alddunya fa'inda Allohi savabu alddunya valaxirati vakana Allohu samiy'an basiyran

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu kunu qavvamiyna bialqisti shuhada lillahi valav 'ala anfusikum avi alvalidayni valaqrabiyna in yakun g'aniyyan av faqiyran faAllohu avla bihima fala tattabi'u alhava an ta'dilu vain talvu av tu'ridu fainna Alloha kana bima ta'maluna xabiyran

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu aminu biAllohi varasulihi valkitabi allaziy nazzala 'ala rasulihi valkitabi allaziy anzala min qablu vaman yakfur biAllohi vamalaikatihi vakutubihi varusulihi valyavmi alaxiri faqad dalla dalalan ba'iydan
Inna allaziyna amanu zumma kafaru zumma amanu zumma kafaru zumma izdadu kufran lam yakuni Allohu liyag'fira lahum vala liyahdiyahum sabiylan
Bashshiri almunafiqiyna bianna lahum 'azaban aliyman
Allaziyna yattaxizuna alkafiriyna avliya min duni almuminiyna ayabtag'una 'indahumu al'izzata fainna al'izzata lillahi jamiy'an

Vaqad nazzala 'alaykum fiy alkitabi an iza sami'tum ayati Allohi yukfaru biha vayustahzao biha fala taq'udu ma'ahum hatta yaxudu fiy hadiyzin g'ayrihi innakum izan mizluhum inna Alloha jami'u almunafiqiyna valkafiriyna fiy jahannama jamiy'an

Allaziyna yatarabbasuna bikum fain kana lakum fazun mina Allohi qalu alam nakun ma'akum vain kana lilkafiriyna nasiybun qalu alam nastahviz 'alaykum vanamna'kum mina almuminiyna faAllohu yahkumu baynakum yavma alqiyamati valan yaj'ala Allohu lilkafiriyna 'ala almuminiyna sabiylan
Inna almunafiqiyna yuxadi'una Alloha vahuva xadi'uhum vaiza qamu ila alssalati qamu kusala yurauna alnnasa vala yazkuruna Alloha illa qaliylan
Muzabzabiyna bayna zalika la ila haolai vala ila haolai vaman yudlili Allohu falan tajida lahu sabiylan
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la tattaxizu alkafiriyna avliya min duni almuminiyna aturiyduna an taj'alu lillahi 'alaykum sultanan mubiynan
Inna almunafiqiyna fiy alddarki alasfali mina alnnari valan tajida lahum nasiyran
Illa allaziyna tabu vaslahu vai'tasamu biAllohi vaxlasu diynahum lillahi faolaika ma'a almuminiyna vasavfa yuti Allohu almuminiyna ajran 'aziyman
Ma yaf'alu Allohu bi'azabikum in shakartum vamantum vakana Allohu shakiran 'aliyman
La yuhibbu Allohu aljahra bialssui mina alqavli illa man zulima vakana Allohu samiy'an 'aliyman
In tubdu xayran av tuxfuhu av ta'fu 'an suin fainna Alloha kana 'afuvvan qadiyran
Inna allaziyna yakfuruna biAllohi varusulihi vayuriyduna an yufarriqu bayna Allohi varusulihi vayaquluna numinu biba'din vanakfuru biba'din vayuriyduna an yattaxizu bayna zalika sabiylan
Olaika humu alkafiruna haqqan va'tadna lilkafiriyna 'azaban muhiynan
Vallaziyna amanu biAllohi varusulihi valam yufarriqu bayna ahadin minhum olaika savfa yutiyhim ojurahum vakana Allohu g'afuran rahiyman

Yasaluka ahlu alkitabi an tunazzila 'alayhim kitaban mina alssamai faqad salu musa akbara min zalika faqalu arina Alloha jahratan faxazazumu alssa'iqatu bizulmihim zumma ittaxazu al'ijla min ba'di ma jazumu albayyinatu fa'afavna 'an zalika vatayna musa sultanan mubiynan
Varafa'na favqahumu alttura bimiyzaqihim vaqulna lahumu odxulu albaba sujjadan vaqulna lahum la ta'du fiy alssabti vaxazna minhum miyzaqan g'aliyzan
Fabima naqdihim miysaqahum vakufrihim biayati Allohi vaqatlihimu alanbiya big'ayri haqqin vaqavlihim qulubuna g'ulfun bal taba'a Allohu 'alayha bikufrihim fala yuminuna illa qaliylan
Vabikufrihim vaqavlihim 'ala maryama buhtanan 'aziyman

Vaqavlihim inna qatalna almasiyha 'iysa ibna maryama rasula Allohi vama qataluhu vama salabuhu valakin shubbiha lahum vainna allaziyna ixtalafu fiyhi lafiy shakkin minhu ma lahum bihi min 'ilmin illa ittiba'a alzzanni vama qataluhu yaqiynan
Bal rafa'ahu Allohu ilayhi vakana Allohu 'aziyzan hakiyman
Vain min ahli alkitabi illa layuminanna bihi qabla mavtihi vayavma alqiyamati yakunu 'alayhim shahiydan
Fabizulmin mina allaziyna hadu harramna 'alayhim tayyibatin ohillat lahum vabisaddihim 'an sabiyli Allohi kaziyran
Vaxzihimu alrriba vaqad nuhu 'anhu vaklihim amvala alnnasi bialbatili va'tadna lilkafiriyna minhum 'azaban aliyman

Lakini alrrasixuna fiy al'ilmi minhum valmuminuna yuminuna bima onzila ilayka vama onzila min qablika valmuqiymiyna alssalata valmutuna alzzakata valmuminuna biAllohi valyavmi alaxiri olaika sanutiyhim ajran 'aziyman

Inna avhayna ilayka kama avhayna ila nuhin valnnabiyyiyna min ba'dihi vavhayna ila ibrahiyma vaisma'iyla vaishaqa vaya'quba valasbati va'iysa vayyuba vayunusa vaharuna vasulaymana vatayna davuda zaburan
Varusulan qad qasasnahum 'alayka min qablu varusulan lam naqsushum 'alayka vakallama Allohu musa takliyman
Rusulan mubashshiriyna vamunziriyna lialla yakuna lilnnasi 'ala Allohi hujjatun ba'da alrrusuli vakana Allohu 'aziyzan hakiyman
Lakini Allohu yashhadu bima anzala ilayka anzalahu bi'ilmihi valmalaikatu yashhaduna vakafa biAllohi shahiydan
Inna allaziyna kafaru vasaddu 'an sabiyli Allohi qad dallu dalalan ba'iydan
Inna allaziyna kafaru vazalamu lam yakuni Allohu liyag'fira lahum vala liyahdiyahum tariyqan
Illa tariyqa jahannama xalidiyna fiyha abadan vakana zalika 'ala Allohi yasiyran
Ya ayyuha alnnasu qad jakumu alrrasulu bialhaqqi min rabbikum faminu xayran lakum vain takfuru fainna lillahi ma fiy alssamavati valardi vakana Allohu 'aliyman hakiyman

Ya ahla alkitabi la tag'lu fiy diynikum vala taqulu 'ala Allohi illa alhaqqa innama almasiyhu 'iysa ibnu maryama rasulu Allohi vakalimatuhu alqaha ila maryama varuhun minhu faminu biAllohi varusulihi vala taqulu salasatun intahu xayran lakum innama Allohu ilahun vahidun subhanahu an yakuna lahu valadun lahu ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi vakafa biAllohi vakiylan
Lan yastankifa almasiyhu an yakuna 'abdan lillahi vala almalaikatu almuqarrabuna vaman yastankif 'an 'ibadatihi vayastakbir fasayahshuruhum ilayhi jamiy'an

Famma allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati fayuvaffiyhim ojurahum vayaziyduhum min fadlihi vamma allaziyna istankafu vaistakbaru fayu'azzibuhum 'azaban aliyman vala yajiduna lahum min duni Allohi valiyyan vala nasiyran
Ya ayyuha alnnasu qad jakum burhanun min rabbikum vanzalna ilaykum nuran mubiynan
Famma allaziyna amanu biAllohi vai'tasamu bihi fasayudxiluhum fiy rahmatin minhu vafadlin vayahdiyhim ilayhi siratan mustaqiyman

Yastaftunaka quli Allohu yuftiykum fiy alkalalati ini imruon halaka laysa lahu valadun valahu oxtun falaha nisfu ma taraka vahuva yarizuha in lam yakun laha valadun fain kanata iznatayni falahuma alzzuluzani mimma taraka vain kanu ixvatan rijalan vanisan falilzzakari mizlu hazzi alonzayayni yubayyinu Allohu lakum an tadillu vaAllohu bikulli shayin 'aliymun
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu avfu bial'uqudi ohillat lakum bahiymatu alan'ami illa ma yutla 'alaykum g'ayra muhilliy alssaydi vantum hurumun inna Alloha yahkumu ma yuriydu

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la tuhillu sha'aira Allohi vala alshshahra alharama vala alhadya vala alqalaida vala ammiyna albayta alharama yabtag'una fadlan min rabbihim varidvanan vaiza halaltum faistadu vala yajrimannakum shananu qavmin an saddukum 'ani almasjidi alharami an ta'tadu vata'avanu 'ala albirri valttaqva vala ta'avanu 'ala alizmi val'udvani vaittaqu Alloha inna Alloha shadiydu al'iqabi

Hurrimat 'alaykumu almaytatu valddamu valahmu alxinziyri vama ohilla lig'ayri Allohi bihi valmunxaniqatu valmavquzatu valmutaraddiyatu valnnatiyhatu vama akala alssabu'u illa ma zakkaytum vama zubiha 'ala alnnusubi van tastaqsimu bialazlami zalikum fisqun alyavma yaisa allaziyna kafaru min diynikum fala taxshavhum vaixshavni alyavma akmaltu lakum diynakum vatmamtu 'alaykum ni'matiy varadiytu lakumu alislama diynan famani idturra fiy maxmasatin g'ayra mutajanifin liizmin fainna Alloha g'afurun rahiymun

Yasalunaka maza ohilla lahum qul ohilla lakumu alttayyibatu vama 'allamtum mina aljavarihi mukallibiyna tu'allimunahunna mimma 'allamakumu Allohu fakulu mimma amsakna 'alaykum vaozkuru isma Allohi 'alayhi vaittaqu Alloha inna Alloha sariy'u alhisabi

Alyavma ohilla lakumu alttayyibatu vata'amu allaziyna utu alkitaba hillun lakum vata'amukum hillun lahum valmuhsanatu mina almuminati valmuhsanatu mina allaziyna utu alkitaba min qablikum iza ataytumuhunna ojurahunna muhsiniyna g'ayra musafihiyna vala muttaxiziy axdanin vaman yakfur bialiymani faqad habita 'amaluhu vahuva fiy alaxirati mina alxasiriyna

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu iza qumtum ila alssalati faig'silu vujuhakum vaydiyakum ila almarafiqi vaimsahu biruusikum varjulakum ila alka'bayni vain kuntum junuban faittahharu vain kuntum marda av 'ala safarin av ja ahadun minkum mina alg'aiti av lamastumu alnnisa falam tajidu man fatayammamu sa'iydan tayyiban faimsahu bivujuhikum vaydiykum minhu ma yuriydu Allohu liyaj'ala 'alaykum min harajin valakin yuriydu liyutahhirakum valiyutimma ni'matahu 'alaykum la'allakum tashkuruna
Vaozkuru ni'mata Allohi 'alaykum vamiyzaqahu allaziy vazaqakum bihi iz qultum sami'na vata'na vaittaqu Alloha inna Alloha 'aliymun bizati alssuduri

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu kunu qavvamiyna lillahi shuhada bialqisti vala yajrimannakum shananu qavmin 'ala alla ta'dilu i'dilu huva aqrabu lilttaqva vaittaqu Alloha inna Alloha xabiyrun bima ta'maluna
Va'ada Allohu allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati lahum mag'firatun vajrun 'aziymun
Vallaziyna kafaru vakazzabu biayatina olaika ashabu aljahiymi
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu ozkuru ni'mata Allohi 'alaykum iz hamma qavmun an yabsutu ilaykum aydiyahum fakaffa aydiyahum 'ankum vaittaqu Alloha va'ala Allohi falyatavakkali almuminuna

Valaqad axaza Allohu miyzaqa baniy israiyla vaba'azna minhumu iznay 'ashara naqiyban vaqala Allohu inniy ma'akum lain aqamtumu alssalata vataytumu alzzakata vamantum birusuliy va'azzartumuhum vaqradtumu Alloha qardan hasanan laokaffiranna 'ankum sayyiatikum valaodxilannakum jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu faman kafara ba'da zalika minkum faqad dalla sava alssabiyli

Fabima naqdihim miyzaqahum la'annahum vaja'alna qulubahum qasiyatan yuharrifuna alkalima 'an mavadi'ihi vanasu hazzan mimma zukkiru bihi vala tazalu tattali'u 'ala xainatin minhum illa qaliylan minhum fao'fu 'anhum vaisfah inna Alloha yuhibbu almuhsiniyna
Vamina allaziyna qalu inna nasara axazna miyzaqahum fanasu hazzan mimma zukkiru bihi fag'rayna baynahumu al'adavata valbag'da ila yavmi alqiyamati vasavfa yunabbiohumu Allohu bima kanu yasna'una
Ya ahla alkitabi qad jakum rasuluna yubayyinu lakum kasiyran mimma kuntum tuxfuna mina alkitabi vaya'fu 'an kasiyrin qad jakum mina Allohi nurun vakitabun mubiynun
Yahdiy bihi Allohu mani ittaba'a ridvanahu subula alssalami vayuxrijuhum mina alzzulumati ila alnnuri biiznihi vayahdiyhim ila siratin mustaqiymin

Laqad kafara allaziyna qalu inna Alloha huva almasiyhu ibnu maryama qul faman yamliku mina Allohi shayan in arada an yuhlika almasiyha ibna maryama vaommahu vaman fiy alardi jamiy'an valillahi mulku alssamavati valardi vama baynahuma yaxluqu ma yashao vaAllohu 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun

Vaqalati alyahudu valnnasara nahnu abnao Allohi vahibbaohu qul falima yu'azzibukum bizunubikum bal antum basharun mimman xalaqa yag'firu liman yashao vayu'azzibu man yashao valillahi mulku alssamavati valardi vama baynahuma vailayhi almasiyru
Ya ahla alkitabi qad jakum rasuluna yubayyinu lakum 'ala fatratin mina alrrusuli an taqulu ma jana min bashiyrin vala naziyrin faqad jakum bashiyrun vanaziyrun vaAllohu 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun
Vaiz qala musa liqavmihi ya qavmi ozkuru ni'mata Allohi 'alaykum iz ja'ala fiykum anbiya vaja'alakum mulukan vatakum ma lam yuti ahadan mina al'alamiyna
Ya qavmi odxulu alarda almuqaddasata allatiy kataba Allohu lakum vala tartaddu 'ala adbarikum fatanqalibu xasiriyna
Qalu ya musa inna fiyha qavman jabbariyna vainna lan nadxulaha hatta yaxruju minha fain yaxruju minha fainna daxiluna
Qala rajulani mina allaziyna yaxafuna an'ama Allohu 'alayhima odxulu 'alayhimu albaba faiza daxaltumuhu fainnakum g'alibuna va'ala Allohi fatavakkalu in kuntum muminiyna
Qalu ya musa inna lan nadxulaha abadan ma damu fiyha faizhab anta varabbuka faqatila inna hahuna qa'iduna
Qala rabbi inniy la amliku illa nafsiy vaxiy faofruq baynana vabayna alqavmi alfasiqiyna
Qala fainnaha muharramatun 'alayhim arba'iyna sanatan yatiyhuna fiy alardi fala tasa 'ala alqavmi alfasiqiyna
Vaotlu 'alayhim naba ibnay adama bialhaqqi iz qarraba qurbanan fatuqubbila min ahadihima valam yutaqabbal mina alaxari qala laqtulannaka qala innama yataqabbalu Allohu mina almuttaqiyna
Lain basatta ilayya yadaka litaqtulaniy ma ana bibasitin yadiya ilayka liaqtulaka inniy axafu Alloha rabba al'alamiyna
Inniy oriydu an tabua biizmiy vaizmika fatakuna min ashabi alnnari vazalika jazao alzzalimiyna
Fatavva'at lahu nafsuhu qatla axiyhi faqatalahu fasbaha mina alxasiriyna
Faba'aza Allohu g'uraban yabhazu fiy alardi liyuriyahu kayfa yuvariy savata axiyhi qala ya vaylata a'ajaztu an akuna mizla haza alg'urabi faovariya savata axiy fasbaha mina alnnadimiyna

Min ajli zalika katabna 'ala baniy israiyla annahu man qatala nafsan big'ayri nafsin av fasadin fiy alardi fakannama qatala alnnasa jamiy'an vaman ahyaha fakannama ahya alnnasa jamiy'an valaqad ja zum rusuluna bialbayyinati zumma inna kaziyran minhum ba'da zalika fiy alardi lamusrifuna

Innama jazao allaziyna yuharibuna Alloha varasulahu vayas'avna fiy alardi fasadan an yuqattalu av yusallabu av tuqatta'a aydiyhim varjuluhum min xilafin av yunfav mina alardi zalika lahum xizyun fiy alddunya valahum fiy alaxirati 'azabun 'aziymun
Illa allaziyna tabu min qabli an taqdiru 'alayhim fai'lamu anna Alloha g'afurun rahiymun
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu ittaqu Alloha vaibtag'u ilayhi alvasiylata vajahidu fiy sabiylihi la'allakum tuflihuna
Inna allaziyna kafaru lav anna lahum ma fiy alardi jamiy'an vamizlahu ma'ahu liyaftadu bihi min 'azabi yavmi alqiyamati ma tuqubbila minhum valahum 'azabun aliymun
Yuriyduna an yaxruju mina alnnari vama hum bixarijiyna minha valahum 'azabun muqiymun
Valssariqu valssariqatu faiqta'u aydiyahuma jazan bima kasaba nakalan mina Allohi vaAllohu 'aziyzun hakiymun
Faman taba min ba'di zulmihi vaslaha fainna Alloha yatubu 'alayhi inna Alloha g'afurun rahiymun
Alam ta'lam anna Alloha lahu mulku alssamavati valardi yu'azzibu man yashao vayag'firu liman yashao vaAllohu 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun

Ya ayyuha alrrasulu la yahzunka allaziyna yusari'una fiy alkufri mina allaziyna qalu amanna biafvahihim valam tumin qulubuhum vamina allaziyna hadu samma'una lilkazibi samma'una liqavmin axariyna lam yatuka yuharrifuna alkalima min ba'di mavadi'ihi yaquluna in utiytum haza faxuzuhu vain lam tutavhu faihzaru vaman yuridi Allohu fitnatahu falan tamlika lahu mina Allohi shayan olaika allaziyna lam yuridi Allohu an yutahhira qulubahum lahum fiy alddunya xizyun valahum fiy alaxirati 'azabun 'aziymun
Samma'una lilkazibi akkaluna lilssuhti fain jauka faohkum baynahum av a'rid 'anhum vain tu'rid 'anhum falan yadurruka shayan vain hakamta faohkum baynahum bialqisti inna Alloha yuhibbu almuqsitiyna
Vakayfa yuhakkimunaka va'indahumu alttavratu fiyha hukmu Allohi zumma yatavallavna min ba'di zalika vama olaika bialmuminiyna

Inna anzalna alttavrata fiyha hudan vanurun yahkumu biha alnnabiyyuna allaziyna aslamu lillaziyna hadu valrrabbaniyyuna valahbaru bima istuhfizu min kitabi Allohi vakanu 'alayhi shuhada fala taxshavu alnnasa vaixshavni vala tashtaru biayatiy zamanan qaliylan vaman lam yahkum bima anzala Allohu faolaika humu alkafiruna

Vakatabna 'alayhim fiyha anna alnnafsa bialnnafsi val'ayna bial'ayni valanfa bialanfi valozuna bialozuni valssinna bialssinni valjuruha qisasun faman tasaddaqa bihi fahuva kaffaratun lahu vaman lam yahkum bima anzala Allohu faolaika humu alzzalimuna

Vaqaffayna 'ala azarihim bi'iysa ibni maryama musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi mina alttavrati vataynahu alinjiyla fiyhi hudan vanurun vamusaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi mina alttavrati vahudan vamav'izatan lilmuttaqiyna
Valyahkum ahlu alinjiyli bima anzala Allohu fiyhi vaman lam yahkum bima anzala Allohu faolaika humu alfasiquna

Vanzalna ilayka alkitaba bialhaqqi musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi mina alkitabi vamuhayminan 'alayhi faohkum baynahum bima anzala Allohu vala tattabi' ahvahum 'amma jaka mina alhaqqi likullin ja'alna minkum shir'atan vaminhajan valav sha Allohu laja'alakum ommatan vahidatan valakin liyabluvakum fiy ma atakum faistabiqu alxayrati ila Allohi marji'ukum jamiy'an fayunabbiokum bima kuntum fiyhi taxtalifuna

Vani ohkum baynahum bima anzala Allohu vala tattabi' ahvahum vaihzarhum an yaftinuka 'an ba'di ma anzala Allohu ilayka fain tavallav fai'lam annama yuriydu Allohu an yusiybahum biba'di zunubihim vainna kaziyran mina alnnasi lafasiquna
Afahukma aljahiliyyati yabg'una vaman ahsanu mina Allohu hukman liqavmin yuqinuna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la tattaxizu alyahuda valnnasara avliya ba'duhum avliyao ba'din vaman yatavllohum minkum fainnahu minhum inna Alloha la yahdiy alqavma alzzalimiyna
Fatara allaziyna fiy qulubihim maradun yusari'una fiyhim yaquluna naxsha an tusiybana dairatun fa'asa Allohu an yatiya bialfazi av amrin min 'indihi fayusbihu 'ala ma asarru fiy anfusihim nadimiyna
Vayaqulu allaziyna amanu ahaolai allaziyna aqsamu biAllohi jahda aymanihim innahum lama'akum habitat a'maluhum fasbahu xasiriyna

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu man yartadda minkum 'an diynihi fasavfa yatiy Allohu biqavmin yuhibbuhum vayuhibbunahu azillatin 'ala almuminiyna a'izzatin 'ala alkafiriyna yujahiduna fiy sabiyli Allohi vala yaxafuna lavmata laimin zalika fadlu Allohi yutiyhi man yashao vaAllohu vasi'un 'aliymun
Innama valiyyukumu Allohu varasuluhu vallaziyna amanu allaziyna yuqiymuna alssalata vayutuna alzzakata vahum raki'una
Vaman yatavalla Alloha varasulahu vallaziyna amanu fainna hizba Allohi humu alg'alibuna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la tattaxizu allaziyna ittaxazu diynakum huzuvan vala'iban mina allaziyna utu alkitaba min qablikum valkuffara avliya vaittaqu Alloha in kuntum muminiyna
Vaiza nadaytum ila alssalati ittaxazuha huzuvan vala'iban zalika biannahum qavmun la ya'qiluna
Qul ya ahla alkitabi hal tanqimuna minna illa an amanna biAllohi vama onzila ilayna vama onzila min qablu vanna aksarakum fasiquna

Qul hal onabbiokum bisharrin min zalika mazubatan 'inda Allohi man la'anahu Allohu vag'adiba 'alayhi vaja'ala minhumu alqiradata valxanaziyra va'abada alttag'uti olaika sharrun makanan vadallu 'an savai alssabiyli
Vaiza jaukum qalu amanna vaqad daxalu bialkufri vahum qad xaraju bihi vaAllohu a'lamu bima kanu yaktumuna
Vatara kasiyran minhum yusari'una fiy alismi val'udvani vaklihimu alssuhta labisa ma kanu ya'maluna
Lavla yanhahumu alrrabbaniyyuna valahbaru 'an qavlihimu alisma vaklihimu alssuhta labisa ma kanu yasna'una

Vaqalati alyahudu yadu Allohi mag'lulatun g'ullat aydiyhim valu'inu bima qalu bal yadahu mabsutatani yunfiqu kayfa yashao valayaziydanna kasiyran minhum ma onzila ilayka min rabbika tug'yanan vakufran valqayna baynahumu al'adavata valbag'da ila yavmi alqiyamati kullama avqadu naran lilharbi atfaha Allohu vayas'avna fiy alardi fasadan vaAllohu la yuhibbu almufsidiyna
Valav anna ahla alkitabi amanu vaittaqav lakaffarna 'anhum sayyiatihim valadxalnahum jannati alnna'iymi
Valav annahum aqamu alttavrata valinjiyla vama onzila ilayhim min rabbihim lakalu min favqihim vamin tahti arjulihim minhum ommatun muqtasidatun vakasiyrun minhum sa ma ya'maluna
Ya ayyuha alrrasulu ballig' ma onzila ilayka min rabbika vain lam taf'al fama ballag'ta risalatahu vaAllohu ya'simuka mina alnnasi inna Alloha la yahdiy alqavma alkafiriyna

Qul ya ahla alkitabi lastum 'ala shayin hatta tuqiymu alttavrata valinjiyla vama onzila ilaykum min rabbikum valayaziydanna kasiyran minhum ma onzila ilayka min rabbika tug'yanan vakufran fala tasa 'ala alqavmi alkafiriyna
Inna allaziyna amanu vallaziyna hadu valssabiuna valnnasara man amana biAllohi valyavmi alaxiri va'amila salihan fala xavfun 'alayhim vala hum yahzanuna
Laqad axazna miyzaqa baniy israiyla varsalna ilayhim rusulan kullama jahum rasulun bima la tahva anfusuhum fariyqan kazzabu vafariyqan yaqtuluna
Vahasibu alla takuna fitnatun fa'amu vasammu summa taba Allohu 'alayhim summa 'amu vasammu kasiyrun minhum vaAllohu basiyrun bima ya'maluna

Laqad kafara allaziyna qalu inna Alloha huva almasiyhu ibnu maryama vaqala almasiyhu ya baniy israiyla o'budu Alloha rabbiy varabbakum innahu man yushrik biAllohi faqad harrama Allohu 'alayhi aljannata vamavahu alnnaru vama lilzzalimiyna min ansarin
Laqad kafara allaziyna qalu inna Alloha zalizu zalazatin vama min ilahin illa ilahun vahidun vain lam yantahu 'amma yaquluna layamassanna allaziyna kafaru minhum 'azabun aliymun
Afala yatubuna ila Allohi vayastag'firunahu vaAllohu g'afurun rahiymun
Ma almasiyhu ibnu maryama illa rasulun qad xalat min qablihi alrrusulu vaommuhu siddiyqatun kana yakulani altta'ama onzur kayfa nubayyinu lahumu alayati zumma onzur anna yufakuna
Qul ata'buduna min duni Allohi ma la yamliku lakum darran vala naf'an vaAllohu huva alssamiy'u al'aliymu
Qul ya ahla alkitabi la tag'lu fiy diynikum g'ayra alhaqqi vala tattabi'u ahva qavmin qad dallu min qablu vadallu kasiyran vadallu 'an savai alssabiyli
Lu'ina allaziyna kafaru min baniy israiyla 'ala lisani davuda va'iysa ibni maryama zalika bima 'asav vakanu ya'taduna
Kanu la yatanahavna 'an munkarin fa'aluhu labisa ma kanu yaf'aluna
Tara kaziyran minhum yatavallavna allaziyna kafaru labisa ma qaddamat lahum anfusuhum an saxita Allohu 'alayhim vafiy al'azabi hum xaliduna
Valav kanu yuminuna biAllohi valnnabiyyi vama onzila ilayhi ma ittaxazuhum avliya valakinna kaziyran minhum fasiquna

Latajidanna ashadda alnnasi 'adavatan lillaziyna amanu alyahuda vallaziyna ashraku valatajidanna aqrabahum mavaddatan lillaziyna amanu allaziyna qalu inna nasara zalika bianna minhum qissiysiyna varuhbanan vannahum la yastakbiruna
Vaiza sami'u ma onzila ila alrrasuli tara a'yunahum tafiydu mina alddam'i mimma 'arafu mina alhaqqi yaquluna rabbana amanna faoktubna ma'a alshshahidiyna
Vama lana la numinu biAllohi vama jana mina alhaqqi vanatma'u an yudxilana rabbuna ma'a alqavmi alssalihiyna
Fazabahumu Allohu bima qalu jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu xalidiyna fiyha vazalika jazao almuhsiniyna
Vallaziyna kafaru vakazzabu biayatina olaika ashabu aljahiymi
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la tuharrimu tayyibati ma ahalla Allohu lakum vala ta'tadu inna Alloha la yuhibbu almu'tadiyna
Vakulu mimma razaqakumu Allohu halalan tayyiban vaittaqu Alloha allaziy antum bihi muminuna

La yuaxizukumu Allohu biallag'vi fiy aymanikum valakin yuaxizukum bima 'aqqadtumu alaymana fakaffaratuhu it'amu 'asharati masakiyna min avsati ma tut'imuna ahliykum av kisvatuhum av tahriyru raqabatin faman lam yajid fasiyamu zalazati ayyamin zalika kaffaratu aymanikum iza halaftum vaihfazu aymanakum kazalika yubayyinu Allohu lakum ayatihi la'allakum tashkuruna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu innama alxamru valmaysiru valansabu valazlamu rijsun min 'amali alshshaytani faijtanibuhu la'allakum tuflihuna
Innama yuriydu alshshaytanu an yuqi'a baynakumu al'adavata valbag'da fiy alxamri valmaysiri vayasuddakum 'an zikri Allohi va'ani alssalati fahal antum muntahuna
Vatiy'u Alloha vatiy'u alrrasula vaihzaru fain tavallaytum fai'lamu annama 'ala rasulina albalag'u almubiynu
Laysa 'ala allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati junahun fiyma ta'imu iza ma ittaqav vamanu va'amilu alssalihati zumma ittaqav vamanu zumma ittaqav vahsanu vaAllohu yuhibbu almuhsiniyna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu layabluvannakumu Allohu bishayin mina alssaydi tanaluhu aydiykum varimahukum liya'lama Allohu man yaxafuhu bialg'aybi famani i'tada ba'da zalika falahu 'azabun aliymun

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la taqtulu alssayda vantum hurumun vaman qatalahu minkum muta'ammidan fajazaon mizlu ma qatala mina alnna'ami yahkumu bihi zava 'adlin minkum hadyan balig'a alka'bati av kaffaratun ta'amu masakiyna av 'adlu zalika siyaman liyazuqa vabala amrihi 'afa Allohu 'amma salafa vaman 'ada fayantaqimu Allohu minhu vaAllohu 'aziyzun zu intiqamin
Ohilla lakum saydu albahri vata'amuhu mata'an lakum valilssayyarati vahurrima 'alaykum saydu albarri ma dumtum huruman vaittaqu Alloha allaziy ilayhi tuhsharuna

Ja'ala Allohu alka'bata albayta alharama qiyaman lilnnasi valshshahra alharama valhadya valqalaida zalika lita'lamu anna Alloha ya'lamu ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi vanna Alloha bikulli shayin 'aliymun
I'lamu anna Alloha shadiydu al'iqabi vanna Alloha g'afurun rahiymun
Ma 'ala alrrasuli illa albalag'u vaAllohu ya'lamu ma tubduna vama taktumuna
Qul la yastaviy alxabiysu valttayyibu valav a'jabaka kasratu alxabiysi faittaqu Alloha ya oliy alalbabi la'allakum tuflihuna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la tasalu 'an ashya in tubda lakum tasukum vain tasalu 'anha hiyna yunazzalu alquranu tubda lakum 'afa Allohu 'anha vaAllohu g'afurun haliymun
Qad salaha qavmun min qablikum summa asbahu biha kafiriyna
Ma ja'ala Allohu min bahiyratin vala saibatin vala vasiylatin vala hamin valakinna allaziyna kafaru yaftaruna 'ala Allohi alkaziba vakzaruhum la ya'qiluna
Vaiza qiyla lahum ta'alav ila ma anzala Allohu vaila alrrasuli qalu hasbuna ma vajadna 'alayhi abana avalav kana abaohum la ya'lamuna shayan vala yahtaduna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu 'alaykum anfusakum la yadurrukum man dalla iza ihtadaytum ila Allohi marji'ukum jamiy'an fayunabbiokum bima kuntum ta'maluna

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu shahadatu baynikum iza hadara ahadakumu almavtu hiyna alvasiyyati iznani zava 'adlin minkum av axarani min g'ayrikum in antum darabtum fiy alardi fasabatkum musiybatu almavti tahbisunahuma min ba'di alssalati fayuqsimani biAllohi ini irtabtum la nashtariy bihi zamanan valav kana za qurba vala naktumu shahadata Allohi inna izan lamina alazimiyna

Fain 'uzira 'ala annahuma istahaqqa izman faxarani yaqumani maqamahuma mina allaziyna istahaqqa 'alayhimu alavlayani fayuqsimani biAllohi lashahadatuna ahaqqu min shahadatihima vama i'tadayna inna izan lamina alzzalimiyna
Zalika adna an yatu bialshshahadati 'ala vajhiha av yaxafu an turadda aymanun ba'da aymanihim vaittaqu Alloha vaisma'u vaAllohu la yahdiy alqavma alfasiqiyna
Yavma yajma'u Allohu alrrusula fayaqulu maza ojibtum qalu la 'ilma lana innaka anta 'allamu alg'uyubi

Iz qala Allohu ya 'iysa ibna maryama ozkur ni'matiy 'alayka va'ala validatika iz ayyadtuka biruhi alqudusi tukallimu alnnasa fiy almahdi vakahlan vaiz 'allamtuka alkitaba valhikmata valttavrata valinjiyla vaiz taxluqu mina alttiyni kahayati alttayri biizniy fatanfuxu fiyha fatakunu tayran biizniy vatubrio alakmaha valabrasa biizniy vaiz tuxriju almavta biizniy vaiz kafaftu baniy israiyla 'anka iz jitahum bialbayyinati faqala allaziyna kafaru minhum in haza illa sihrun mubiynun
Vaiz avhaytu ila alhavariyyiyna an aminu biy vabirasuliy qalu amanna vaishhad biannana muslimuna
Iz qala alhavariyyuna ya 'iysa ibna maryama hal yastatiy'u rabbuka an yunazzila 'alayna maidatan mina alssamai qala ittaqu Alloha in kuntum muminiyna
Qalu nuriydu an nakula minha vatatmainna qulubuna vana'lama an qad sadaqtana vanakuna 'alayha mina alshshahidiyna
Qala 'iysa ibnu maryama llohumma rabbana anzil 'alayna maidatan mina alssamai takunu lana 'iydan liavvalina vaxirina vayatan minka vaorzuqna vanta xayru alrraziqiyna
Qala Allohu inniy munazziluha 'alaykum faman yakfur ba'du minkum fainniy o'azzibuhu 'azaban la o'azzibuhu ahadan mina al'alamiyna

Vaiz qala Allohu ya 'iysa ibna maryama anta qulta lilnnasi ittaxizuniy vaommiya ilahayni min duni Allohi qala subhanaka ma yakunu liy an aqula ma laysa liy bihaqqin in kuntu qultuhu faqad 'alimtahu ta'lamu ma fiy nafsiy vala a'lamu ma fiy nafsika innaka anta 'allamu alg'uyubi

Ma qultu lahum illa ma amartaniy bihi ani o'budu Alloha rabbiy varabbakum vakuntu 'alayhim shahiydan ma dumtu fiyhim falamma tavaffaytaniy kunta anta alrraqiyba 'alayhim vanta 'ala kulli shayin shahiydun
In tu'azzibhum fainnahum 'ibaduka vain tag'fir lahum fainnaka anta al'aziyzu alhakiymu
Qala Allohu haza yavmu yanfa'u alssadiqiyna sidquhum lahum jannatun tajriy min tahtiha alanharu xalidiyna fiyha abadan radiya Allohu 'anhum varadu 'anhu zalika alfavzu al'aziymu
Lillahi mulku alssamavati valardi vama fiyhinna vahuva 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun
Alhamdu lillahi allaziy xalaqa alssamavati valarda vaja'ala alzzulumati valnnura zumma allaziyna kafaru birabbihim ya'diluna
Huva allaziy xalaqakum min tiynin zumma qada ajalan vajalun musamman 'indahu zumma antum tamtaruna
Vahuva Allohu fiy alssamavati vafiy alardi ya'lamu sirrakum vajahrakum vaya'lamu ma taksibuna
Vama tatiyhim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanu 'anha mu'ridiyna
Faqad kazzabu bialhaqqi lamma jahum fasavfa yatiyhim anbao ma kanu bihi yastahziuna

Alam yarav kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin makkannahum fiy alardi ma lam numakkin lakum varsalna alssama 'alayhim midraran vaja'alna alanhara tajriy min tahtihim fahlaknahum bizunubihim vanshana min ba'dihim qarnan axariyna
Valav nazzalna 'alayka kitaban fiy qirtasin falamasuhu biaydiyhim laqala allaziyna kafaru in haza illa sihrun mubiynun
Vaqalu lavla onzila 'alayhi malakun valav anzalna malakan laqudiya alamru zumma la yunzaruna
Valav ja'alnahu malakan laja'alnahu rajulan valalabasna 'alayhim ma yalbisuna
Valaqadi istuhzia birusulin min qablika fahaqa biallaziyna saxiru minhum ma kanu bihi yastahziuna
Qul siyru fiy alardi zumma onzuru kayfa kana 'aqibatu almukazzibiyna
Qul liman ma fiy alssamavati valardi qul lillahi kataba 'ala nafsihi alrrahmata layajma'annakum ila yavmi alqiyamati la rayba fiyhi allaziyna xasiru anfusahum fahum la yuminuna
Valahu ma sakana fiy allayli valnnahari vahuva alssamiy'u al'aliymu
Qul ag'ayra Allohi attaxizu valiyyan fatiri alssamavati valardi vahuva yut'imu vala yut'amu qul inniy omirtu an akuna avvala man aslama vala takunanna mina almushrikiyna
Qul inniy axafu in 'asaytu rabbiy 'azaba yavmin 'aziymin
Man yusraf 'anhu yavmaizin faqad rahimahu vazalika alfavzu almubiynu
Vain yamsaska Allohu bidurrin fala kashifa lahu illa huva vain yamsaska bixayrin fahuva 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun
Vahuva alqahiru favqa 'ibadihi vahuva alhakiymu alxabiyru

Qul ayyu shayin akbaru shahadatan quli Allohu shahiydun bayniy vabaynakum vauhiya ilayya haza alquranu lionzirakum bihi vaman balag'a ainnakum latashhaduna anna ma'a Allohi alihatan oxra qul la ashhadu qul innama huva ilahun vahidun vainnaniy bariyon mimma tushrikuna
Allaziyna ataynahumu alkitaba ya'rifunahu kama ya'rifuna abnahum allaziyna xasiru anfusahum fahum la yuminuna
Vaman azlamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allohi kaziban av kazzaba biayatihi innahu la yuflihu alzzalimuna
Vayavma nahshuruhum jamiy'an zumma naqulu lillaziyna ashraku ayna shurakaokumu allaziyna kuntum taz'umuna
Summa lam takun fitnatuhum illa an qalu vaAllohi rabbina ma kunna mushrikiyna
Onzur kayfa kazabu 'ala anfusihim vadalla 'anhum ma kanu yaftaruna
