Vaminhum man yastami'u ilayka vaja'alna 'ala qulubihim akinnatan an yafqahuhu vafiy azanihim vaqran vain yarav kulla ayatin la yuminu biha hatta iza jauka yujadilunaka yaqulu allaziyna kafaru in haza illa asatiyru alavvaliyna
Vahum yanhavna 'anhu vayanavna 'anhu vain yuhlikuna illa anfusahum vama yash'uruna
Valav tara iz vuqifu 'ala alnnari faqalu ya laytana nuraddu vala nukazziba biayati rabbina vanakuna mina almuminiyna
Bal bada lahum ma kanu yuxfuna min qablu valav ruddu la'adu lima nuhu 'anhu vainnahum lakazibuna
Vaqalu in hiya illa hayatuna alddunya vama nahnu bimab'usiyna
Valav tara iz vuqifu 'ala rabbihim qala alaysa haza bialhaqqi qalu bala varabbina qala fazuqu al'azaba bima kuntum takfuruna
Qad xasira allaziyna kazzabu biliqai Allohi hatta iza jazumu alssa'atu bag'tatan qalu ya hasratana 'ala ma farratna fiyha vahum yahmiluna avzarahum 'ala zuhurihim ala sa ma yaziruna
Vama alhayatu alddunya illa la'ibun valahvun valalddaru alaxirati xayrun lillaziyna yattaquna afala ta'qiluna
Qad na'lamu innahu layahzunuka allaziy yaquluna fainnahum la yukazzibunaka valakinna alzzalimiyna biayati Allohi yajhaduna
Valaqad kuzzibat rusulun min qablika fasabaru 'ala ma kuzzibu vauzu hatta atahum nasruna vala mubaddila likalimati Allohi valaqad jaka min nabai almursaliyna

Vain kana kabura 'alayka i'raduhum faini istata'ta an tabtag'iya nafaqan fiy alardi av sullaman fiy alssamai fatatiyahum biayatin valav sha Allohu lajama'ahum 'ala alhuda fala takunanna mina aljahiliyna
Innama yastajiybu allaziyna yasma'una valmavta yab'azuhumu Allohu zumma ilayhi yurja'una
Vaqalu lavla nuzzila 'alayhi ayatun min rabbihi qul inna Alloha qadirun 'ala an yunazzila ayatan valakinna aksarahum la ya'lamuna
Vama min dabbatin fiy alardi vala tairin yatiyru bijanahayhi illa omamun amsalukum ma farratna fiy alkitabi min shayin summa ila rabbihim yuhsharuna
Vallaziyna kazzabu biayatina summun vabukmun fiy alzzulumati man yashai Allohu yudlilhu vaman yasha yaj'alhu 'ala siratin mustaqiymin
Qul araytakum in atakum 'azabu Allohi av atatkumu alssa'atu ag'ayra Allohi tad'una in kuntum sadiqiyna
Bal iyyahu tad'una fayakshifu ma tad'una ilayhi in sha vatansavna ma tushrikuna
Valaqad arsalna ila omamin min qablika faxaznahum bialbasai valddarrai la'llohum yatadarra'una
Falavla iz jahum basuna tadarra'u valakin qasat qulubuhum vazayyana lahumu alshshaytanu ma kanu ya'maluna
Falamma nasu ma zukkiru bihi fatahna 'alayhim abvaba kulli shayin hatta iza farihu bima utu axaznahum bag'tatan faiza hum mublisuna
Faquti'a dabiru alqavmi allaziyna zalamu valhamdu lillahi rabbi al'alamiyna
Qul araytum in axaza Allohu sam'akum vabsarakum vaxatama 'ala qulubikum man ilahun g'ayru Allohi yatiykum bihi onzur kayfa nusarrifu alayati zumma hum yasdifuna
Qul araytakum in atakum 'azabu Allohi bag'tatan av jahratan hal yuhlaku illa alqavmu alzzalimuna
Vama nursilu almursaliyna illa mubashshiriyna vamunziriyna faman amana vaslaha fala xavfun 'alayhim vala hum yahzanuna
Vallaziyna kazzabu biayatina yamassuhumu al'azabu bima kanu yafsuquna
Qul la aqulu lakum 'indiy xazainu Allohi vala a'lamu alg'ayba vala aqulu lakum inniy malakun in attabi'u illa ma yuha ilayya qul hal yastaviy ala'ma valbasiyru afala tatafakkaruna
Vanzir bihi allaziyna yaxafuna an yuhsharu ila rabbihim laysa lahum min dunihi valiyyun vala shafiy'un la'llohum yattaquna
Vala tatrudi allaziyna yad'una rabbahum bialg'adati val'ashiyyi yuriyduna vajhahu ma 'alayka min hisabihim min shayin vama min hisabika 'alayhim min shayin fatatrudahum fatakuna mina alzzalimiyna
Vakazalika fatanna ba'dahum biba'din liyaqulu ahaolai manna Allohu 'alayhim min baynina alaysa Allohu bia'lama bialshshakiriyna

Vaiza jaka allaziyna yuminuna biayatina faqul salamun 'alaykum kataba rabbukum 'ala nafsihi alrrahmata annahu man 'amila minkum suan bijahalatin zumma taba min ba'dihi vaslaha fannahu g'afurun rahiymun
Vakazalika nufassilu alayati valitastabiyna sabiylu almujrimiyna
Qul inniy nuhiytu an a'buda allaziyna tad'una min duni Allohi qul la attabi'u ahvakum qad dalaltu izan vama ana mina almuhtadiyna
Qul inniy 'ala bayyinatin min rabbiy vakazzabtum bihi ma 'indiy ma tasta'jiluna bihi ini alhukmu illa lillahi yaqussu alhaqqa vahuva xayru alfasiliyna
Qul lav anna 'indiy ma tasta'jiluna bihi laqudiya alamru bayniy vabaynakum vaAllohu a'lamu bialzzalimiyna

Va'indahu mafatihu alg'aybi la ya'lamuha illa huva vaya'lamu ma fiy albarri valbahri vama tasqutu min varaqatin illa ya'lamuha vala habbatin fiy zulumati alardi vala ratbin vala yabisin illa fiy kitabin mubiynin
Vahuva allaziy yatavaffakum biallayli vaya'lamu ma jarahtum bialnnahari zumma yab'azukum fiyhi liyuqda ajalun musamman zumma ilayhi marji'ukum zumma yunabbiokum bima kuntum ta'maluna
Vahuva alqahiru favqa 'ibadihi vayursilu 'alaykum hafazatan hatta iza ja ahadakumu almavtu tavaffazu rusuluna vahum la yufarrituna
Summa ruddu ila Allohi mavlahumu alhaqqi ala lahu alhukmu vahuva asra'u alhasibiyna
Qul man yunajjiykum min zulumati albarri valbahri tad'unahu tadarru'an vaxufyatan lain anjana min hazihi lanakunanna mina alshshakiriyna
Quli Allohu yunajjiykum minha vamin kulli karbin summa antum tushrikuna
Qul huva alqadiru 'ala an yab'aza 'alaykum 'azaban min favqikum av min tahti arjulikum av yalbisakum shiya'an vayuziyqa ba'dakum basa ba'din onzur kayfa nusarrifu alayati la'llohum yafqahuna
Vakazzaba bihi qavmuka vahuva alhaqqu qul lastu 'alaykum bivakiylin
Likulli nabain mustaqarrun vasavfa ta'lamuna
Vaiza rayta allaziyna yaxuduna fiy ayatina fa'rid 'anhum hatta yaxudu fiy hadiyzin g'ayrihi vaimma yunsiyannaka alshshaytanu fala taq'ud ba'da alzzikra ma'a alqavmi alzzalimiyna
Vama 'ala allaziyna yattaquna min hisabihim min shayin valakin zikra la'llohum yattaquna

Vazari allaziyna ittaxazu diynahum la'iban valahvan vag'arrazumu alhayatu alddunya vazakkir bihi an tubsala nafsun bima kasabat laysa laha min duni Allohi valiyyun vala shafiy'un vain ta'dil kulla 'adlin la yuxaz minha olaika allaziyna obsilu bima kasabu lahum sharabun min hamiymin va'azabun aliymun bima kanu yakfuruna

Qul anad'u min duni Allohi ma la yanfa'una vala yadurruna vanuraddu 'ala a'qabina ba'da iz hadana Allohu kallaziy istahvazu alshshayatiynu fiy alardi hayrana lahu ashabun yad'unahu ila alhuda itina qul inna huda Allohi huva alhuda vaomirna linuslima lirabbi al'alamiyna
Van aqiymu alssalata vaittaquhu vahuva allaziy ilayhi tuhsharuna
Vahuva allaziy xalaqa alssamavati valarda bialhaqqi vayavma yaqulu kun fayakunu qavluhu alhaqqu valahu almulku yavma yunfaxu fiy alssuri 'alimu alg'aybi valshshahadati vahuva alhakiymu alxabiyru
Vaiz qala ibrahiymu liabiyhi azara atattaxizu asnaman alihatan inniy araka vaqavmaka fiy dalalin mubiynin
Vakazalika nuriy ibrahiyma malakuta alssamavati valardi valiyakuna mina almuqiniyna
Falamma janna 'alayhi allaylu ra kavkaban qala haza rabbiy falamma afala qala la ohibbu alafiliyna
Falamma ra alqamara bazig'an qala haza rabbiy falamma afala qala lain lam yahdiniy rabbiy lakunanna mina alqavmi alddalliyna
Falamma ra alshshamsa bazig'atan qala haza rabbiy haza akbaru falamma afalat qala ya qavmi inniy bariyon mimma tushrikuna
Inniy vajjahtu vajhiya lillaziy fatara alssamavati valarda haniyfan vama ana mina almushrikiyna
Vahajjahu qavmuhu qala atuhajjunniy fiy Allohi vaqad hadani vala axafu ma tushrikuna bihi illa an yasha rabbiy shayan vasi'a rabbiy kulla shayin 'ilman afala tatazakkaruna
Vakayfa axafu ma ashraktum vala taxafuna annakum ashraktum biAllohi ma lam yunazzil bihi 'alaykum sultanan fayyu alfariyqayni ahaqqu bialamni in kuntum ta'lamuna
Allaziyna amanu valam yalbisu iymanahum bizulmin olaika lahumu alamnu vahum muhtaduna
Vatilka hujjatuna ataynaha ibrahiyma 'ala qavmihi narfa'u darajatin man nashao inna rabbaka hakiymun 'aliymun
Vavahabna lahu ishaqa vaya'quba kullan hadayna vanuhan hadayna min qablu vamin zurriyyatihi davuda vasulaymana vayyuba vayusufa vamusa vaharuna vakazalika najziy almuhsiniyna
Vazakariyya vayahya va'iysa vailyasa kullun mina alssalihiyna
Vaisma'iyla vailyasa'a vayunusa valutan vakullan faddalna 'ala al'alamiyna
Vamin abaihim vazurriyyatihim vaixvanihim vaijtabaynahum vahadaynahum ila siratin mustaqiymin
Zalika huda Allohi yahdiy bihi man yashao min 'ibadihi valav ashraku lahabita 'anhum ma kanu ya'maluna
Olaika allaziyna ataynahumu alkitaba valhukma valnnubuvvata fain yakfur biha haolai faqad vakkalna biha qavman laysu biha bikafiriyna
Olaika allaziyna hada Allohu fabihudahumu iqtadih qul la asalukum 'alayhi ajran in huva illa zikra lil'alamiyna

Vama qadaru Alloha haqqa qadrihi iz qalu ma anzala Allohu 'ala basharin min shayin qul man anzala alkitaba allaziy ja bihi musa nuran vahudan lilnnasi taj'alunahu qaratiysa tubdunaha vatuxfuna kaziyran va'ullimtum ma lam ta'lamu antum vala abaokum quli Allohu zumma zarhum fiy xavdihim yal'abuna
Vahaza kitabun anzalnahu mubarakun musaddiqu allaziy bayna yadayhi valitunzira omma alqura vaman havlaha vallaziyna yuminuna bialaxirati yuminuna bihi vahum 'ala salatihim yuhafizuna

Vaman azlamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allohi kaziban av qala uhiya ilayya valam yuha ilayhi shayon vaman qala saonzilu mizla ma anzala Allohu valav tara izi alzzalimuna fiy g'amarati almavti valmalaikatu basitu aydiyhim axriju anfusakumu alyavma tujzavna 'azaba alhuni bima kuntum taquluna 'ala Allohi g'ayra alhaqqi vakuntum 'an ayatihi tastakbiruna

Valaqad jitumuna furada kama xalaqnakum avvala marratin vataraktum ma xavvalnakum vara zuhurikum vama nara ma'akum shufa'akumu allaziyna za'amtum annahum fiykum shurakao laqad taqatta'a baynakum vadalla 'ankum ma kuntum taz'umuna
Inna Alloha faliqu alhabbi valnnava yuxriju alhayya mina almayyiti vamuxriju almayyiti mina alhayyi zalikumu Allohu fanna tufakuna
Faliqu alisbahi vaja'ala allayla sakanan valshshamsa valqamara husbanan zalika taqdiyru al'aziyzi al'aliymi
Vahuva allaziy ja'ala lakumu alnnujuma litahtadu biha fiy zulumati albarri valbahri qad fassalna alayati liqavmin ya'lamuna
Vahuva allaziy anshakum min nafsin vahidatin famustaqarrun vamustavda'un qad fassalna alayati liqavmin yafqahuna

Vahuva allaziy anzala mina alssamai man faxrajna bihi nabata kulli shayin faxrajna minhu xadiran nuxriju minhu habban mutarakiban vamina alnnaxli min tal'iha qinvanun daniyatun vajannatin min a'nabin valzzaytuna valrrummana mushtabihan vag'ayra mutashabihin onzuru ila zamarihi iza azmara vayan'ihi inna fiy zalikum layatin liqavmin yuminuna
Vaja'alu lillahi shuraka aljinna vaxalaqahum vaxaraqu lahu baniyna vabanatin big'ayri 'ilmin subhanahu vata'ala 'amma yasifuna
Badiy'u alssamavati valardi anna yakunu lahu valadun valam takun lahu sahibatun vaxalaqa kulla shayin vahuva bikulli shayin 'aliymun
Zalikumu Allohu rabbukum la ilaha illa huva xaliqu kulli shayin fao'buduhu vahuva 'ala kulli shayin vakiylun
La tudrikuhu alabsaru vahuva yudriku alabsara vahuva allatiyfu alxabiyru
Qad jakum basairu min rabbikum faman absara falinafsihi vaman 'amiya fa'alayha vama ana 'alaykum bihafiyzin
Vakazalika nusarrifu alayati valiyaqulu darasta valinubayyinahu liqavmin ya'lamuna
Ittabi' ma uhiya ilayka min rabbika la ilaha illa huva va'rid 'ani almushrikiyna
Valav sha Allohu ma ashraku vama ja'alnaka 'alayhim hafiyzan vama anta 'alayhim bivakiylin
Vala tasubbu allaziyna yad'una min duni Allohi fayasubbu Alloha 'advan big'ayri 'ilmin kazalika zayyanna likulli ommatin 'amalahum zumma ila rabbihim marji'uhum fayunabbiohum bima kanu ya'maluna
Vaqsamu biAllohi jahda aymanihim lain jazum ayatun layuminunna biha qul innama alayatu 'inda Allohi vama yush'irukum annaha iza jat la yuminuna
Vanuqallibu afidatahum vabsarahum kama lam yuminu bihi avvala marratin vanazaruhum fiy tug'yanihim ya'mahuna
Valav annana nazzalna ilayhimu almalaikata vakallamahumu almavta vahasharna 'alayhim kulla shayin qubulan ma kanu liyuminu illa an yasha Allohu valakinna aksarahum yajhaluna
Vakazalika ja'alna likulli nabiyyin 'aduvvan shayatiyna alinsi valjinni yuhiy ba'duhum ila ba'din zuxrufa alqavli g'ururan valav sha rabbuka ma fa'aluhu fazarhum vama yaftaruna
Valitasg'a ilayhi afidatu allaziyna la yuminuna bialaxirati valiyardavhu valiyaqtarifu ma hum muqtarifuna
Afag'ayra Allohi abtag'iy hakaman vahuva allaziy anzala ilaykumu alkitaba mufassalan vallaziyna ataynahumu alkitaba ya'lamuna annahu munazzalun min rabbika bialhaqqi fala takunanna mina almumtariyna
Vatammat kalimatu rabbika sidqan va'adlan la mubaddila likalimatihi vahuva alssamiy'u al'aliymu
Vain tuti' akzara man fiy alardi yudilluka 'an sabiyli Allohi in yattabi'una illa alzzanna vain hum illa yaxrusuna
Inna rabbaka huva a'lamu man yadillu 'an sabiylihi vahuva a'lamu bialmuhtadiyna
Fakulu mimma zukira ismu Allohi 'alayhi in kuntum biayatihi muminiyna

Vama lakum alla takulu mimma zukira ismu Allohi 'alayhi vaqad fassala lakum ma harrama 'alaykum illa ma idturirtum ilayhi vainna kaziyran layudilluna biahvaihim big'ayri 'ilmin inna rabbaka huva a'lamu bialmu'tadiyna
Vazaru zahira alizmi vabatinahu inna allaziyna yaksibuna alizma sayujzavna bima kanu yaqtarifuna
Vala takulu mimma lam yuzkari ismu Allohi 'alayhi vainnahu lafisqun vainna alshshayatiyna layuhuna ila avliyaihim liyujadilukum vain ata'tumuhum innakum lamushrikuna
Ava man kana maytan fahyaynahu vaja'alna lahu nuran yamshiy bihi fiy alnnasi kaman mazaluhu fiy alzzulumati laysa bixarijin minha kazalika zuyyina lilkafiriyna ma kanu ya'maluna
Vakazalika ja'alna fiy kulli qaryatin akabira mujrimiyha liyamkuru fiyha vama yamkuruna illa bianfusihim vama yash'uruna

Vaiza jazum ayatun qalu lan numina hatta nuta mizla ma utiya rusulu Allohi Allohu a'lamu hayzu yaj'alu risalatahu sayusiybu allaziyna ajramu sag'arun 'inda Allohi va'azabun shadiydun bima kanu yamkuruna

Faman yuridi Allohu an yahdiyahu yashrah sadrahu lilislami vaman yurid an yudillahu yaj'al sadrahu dayyiqan harajan kannama yassa''adu fiy alssamai kazalika yaj'alu Allohu alrrijsa 'ala allaziyna la yuminuna
Vahaza siratu rabbika mustaqiyman qad fassalna alayati liqavmin yazzakkaruna
Lahum daru alssalami 'inda rabbihim vahuva valiyyuhum bima kanu ya'maluna

Vayavma yahshuruhum jamiy'an ya ma'shara aljinni qadi istakzartum mina alinsi vaqala avliyaohum mina alinsi rabbana istamta'a ba'duna biba'din vabalag'na ajalana allaziy ajjalta lana qala alnnaru mazvakum xalidiyna fiyha illa ma sha Allohu inna rabbaka hakiymun 'aliymun
Vakazalika nuvalliy ba'da alzzalimiyna ba'dan bima kanu yaksibuna

Ya ma'shara aljinni valinsi alam yatikum rusulun minkum yaqussuna 'alaykum ayatiy vayunzirunakum liqa yavmikum haza qalu shahidna 'ala anfusina vag'arrazumu alhayatu alddunya vashahidu 'ala anfusihim annahum kanu kafiriyna
Zalika an lam yakun rabbuka muhlika alqura bizulmin vahluha g'afiluna
Valikullin darajatun mimma 'amilu vama rabbuka big'afilin 'amma ya'maluna
Varabbuka alg'aniyyu zu alrrahmati in yasha yuzhibkum vayastaxlif min ba'dikum ma yashao kama anshakum min zurriyyati qavmin axariyna
Inna ma tu'aduna latin vama antum bimu'jiziyna
Qul ya qavmi i'malu 'ala makanatikum inniy 'amilun fasavfa ta'lamuna man takunu lahu 'aqibatu alddari innahu la yuflihu alzzalimuna

Vaja'alu lillahi mimma zara mina alharzi valan'ami nasiyban faqalu haza lillahi biza'mihim vahaza lishurakaina fama kana lishurakaihim fala yasilu ila Allohi vama kana lillahi fahuva yasilu ila shurakaihim sa ma yahkumuna
Vakazalika zayyana likaziyrin mina almushrikiyna qatla avladihim shurakaohum liyurduhum valiyalbisu 'alayhim diynahum valav sha Allohu ma fa'aluhu fazarhum vama yaftaruna
Vaqalu hazihi an'amun vaharzun hijrun la yat'amuha illa man nashao biza'mihim van'amun hurrimat zuhuruha van'amun la yazkuruna isma Allohi 'alayha iftiran 'alayhi sayajziyhim bima kanu yaftaruna
Vaqalu ma fiy butuni hazihi alan'ami xalisatun lizukurina vamuharramun 'ala azvajina vain yakun maytatan fahum fiyhi shurakao sayajziyhim vasfahum innahu hakiymun 'aliymun
Qad xasira allaziyna qatalu avladahum safahan big'ayri 'ilmin vaharramu ma razaqahumu Allohu iftiran 'ala Allohi qad dallu vama kanu muhtadiyna

Vahuva allaziy ansha jannatin ma'rushatin vag'ayra ma'rushatin valnnaxla valzzar'a muxtalifan okuluhu valzzaytuna valrrummana mutashabihan vag'ayra mutashabihin kulu min zamarihi iza azmara vatu haqqahu yavma hasadihi vala tusrifu innahu la yuhibbu almusrifiyna
Vamina alan'ami hamulatan vafarshan kulu mimma razaqakumu Allohu vala tattabi'u xutuvati alshshaytani innahu lakum 'aduvvun mubiynun
Zamaniyata azvajin mina alddani iznayni vamina alma'zi iznayni qul alzzakarayni harrama ami alonzayayni amma ishtamalat 'alayhi arhamu alonzayayni nabbiuniy bi'ilmin in kuntum sadiqiyna

Vamina alibili iznayni vamina albaqari iznayni qul alzzakarayni harrama ami alonzayayni amma ishtamalat 'alayhi arhamu alonzayayni am kuntum shuhada iz vassakumu Allohu bihaza faman azlamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allohi kaziban liyudilla alnnasa big'ayri 'ilmin inna Alloha la yahdiy alqavma alzzalimiyna

Qul la ajidu fiy ma uhiya ilayya muharraman 'ala ta'imin yat'amuhu illa an yakuna maytatan av daman masfuhan av lahma xinziyrin fainnahu rijsun av fisqan ohilla lig'ayri Allohi bihi famani idturra g'ayra bag'in vala 'adin fainna rabbaka g'afurun rahiymun

Va'ala allaziyna hadu harramna kulla ziy zufurin vamina albaqari valg'anami harramna 'alayhim shuhumahuma illa ma hamalat zuhuruhuma avi alhavaya av ma ixtalata bi'azmin zalika jazaynahum bibag'yihim vainna lasadiquna
Fain kazzabuka faqul rabbukum zu rahmatin vasi'atin vala yuraddu basuhu 'ani alqavmi almujrimiyna

Sayaqulu allaziyna ashraku lav sha Allohu ma ashrakna vala abaona vala harramna min shayin kazalika kazzaba allaziyna min qablihim hatta zaqu basana qul hal 'indakum min 'ilmin fatuxrijuhu lana in tattabi'una illa alzzanna vain antum illa taxrusuna
Qul falillahi alhujjatu albalig'atu falav sha lahadakum ajma'iyna

Qul halumma shuhadakumu allaziyna yashhaduna anna Alloha harrama haza fain shahidu fala tashhad ma'ahum vala tattabi' ahva allaziyna kazzabu biayatina vallaziyna la yuminuna bialaxirati vahum birabbihim ya'diluna

Qul ta'alav atlu ma harrama rabbukum 'alaykum alla tushriku bihi shayan vabialvalidayni ihsanan vala taqtulu avladakum min imlaqin nahnu narzuqukum vaiyyahum vala taqrabu alfavahisha ma zahara minha vama batana vala taqtulu alnnafsa allatiy harrama Allohu illa bialhaqqi zalikum vassakum bihi la'allakum ta'qiluna

Vala taqrabu mala alyatiymi illa biallatiy hiya ahsanu hatta yablug'a ashuddahu vavfu alkayla valmiyzana bialqisti la nukallifu nafsan illa vus'aha vaiza qultum fai'dilu valav kana za qurba vabi'ahdi Allohi avfu zalikum vassakum bihi la'allakum tazakkaruna
Vanna haza siratiy mustaqiyman faittabi'uhu vala tattabi'u alssubula fatafarraqa bikum 'an sabiylihi zalikum vassakum bihi la'allakum tattaquna
Zumma atayna musa alkitaba tamaman 'ala allaziy ahsana vatafsiylan likulli shayin vahudan varahmatan la'llohum biliqai rabbihim yuminuna
Vahaza kitabun anzalnahu mubarakun faittabi'uhu vaittaqu la'allakum turhamuna
An taqulu innama onzila alkitabu 'ala taifatayni min qablina vain kunna 'an dirasatihim lag'afiliyna

Av taqulu lav anna onzila 'alayna alkitabu lakunna ahda minhum faqad jakum bayyinatun min rabbikum vahudan varahmatun faman azlamu mimman kazzaba biayati Allohi vasadafa 'anha sanajziy allaziyna yasdifuna 'an ayatina sua al'azabi bima kanu yasdifuna

Hal yanzuruna illa an tatiyahumu almalaikatu av yatiya rabbuka av yatiya ba'du ayati rabbika yavma yatiy ba'du ayati rabbika la yanfa'u nafsan iymanuha lam takun amanat min qablu av kasabat fiy iymaniha xayran quli intaziru inna muntaziruna
Inna allaziyna farraqu diynahum vakanu shiya'an lasta minhum fiy shayin innama amruhum ila Allohi zumma yunabbiohum bima kanu yaf'aluna
Man ja bialhasanati falahu 'ashru amzaliha vaman ja bialssayyiati fala yujza illa mizlaha vahum la yuzlamuna
Qul innaniy hadaniy rabbiy ila siratin mustaqiymin diynan qiyaman millata ibrahiyma haniyfan vama kana mina almushrikiyna
Qul inna salatiy vanusukiy vamahyaya vamamatiy lillahi rabbi al'alamiyna
La shariyka lahu vabizalika omirtu vana avvalu almuslimiyna

Qul ag'ayra Allohi abg'iy rabban vahuva rabbu kulli shayin vala taksibu kullu nafsin illa 'alayha vala taziru vaziratun vizra oxra summa ila rabbikum marji'ukum fayunabbiokum bima kuntum fiyhi taxtalifuna
Vahuva allaziy ja'alakum xalaifa alardi varafa'a ba'dakum favqa ba'din darajatin liyabluvakum fiy ma atakum inna rabbaka sariy'u al'iqabi vainnahu lag'afurun rahiymun
Aliflammiymsad
Kitabun onzila ilayka fala yakun fiy sadrika harajun minhu litunzira bihi vazikra lilmuminiyna
Ittabi'u ma onzila ilaykum min rabbikum vala tattabi'u min dunihi avliya qaliylan ma tazakkaruna
Vakam min qaryatin ahlaknaha fajaha basuna bayatan av hum qailuna
Fama kana da'vahum iz jahum basuna illa an qalu inna kunna zalimiyna
Falanasalanna allaziyna orsila ilayhim valanasalanna almursaliyna
Falanaqussanna 'alayhim bi'ilmin vama kunna g'aibiyna
Valvaznu yavmaizini alhaqqu faman zaqulat mavaziynuhu faolaika humu almuflihuna
Vaman xaffat mavaziynuhu faolaika allaziyna xasiru anfusahum bima kanu biayatina yazlimuna
Valaqad makkannakum fiy alardi vaja'alna lakum fiyha ma'ayisha qaliylan ma tashkuruna
Valaqad xalaqnakum summa savvarnakum summa qulna lilmalaikati osjudu liadama fasajadu illa ibliysa lam yakun mina alssajidiyna
Qala ma mana'aka alla tasjuda iz amartuka qala ana xayrun minhu xalaqtaniy min narin vaxalaqtahu min tiynin
Qala faihbit minha fama yakunu laka an tatakabbara fiyha faoxruj innaka mina alssag'iriyna
Qala anzirniy ila yavmi yub'azuna
Qala innaka mina almunzariyna
Qala fabima ag'vaytaniy laq'udanna lahum sirataka almustaqiyma
Summa latiyannahum min bayni aydiyhim vamin xalfihim va'an aymanihim va'an shamailihim vala tajidu aksarahum shakiriyna
Qala oxruj minha mazuman madhuran laman tabi'aka minhum lamlanna jahannama minkum ajma'iyna
Vaya adamu oskun anta vazavjuka aljannata fakula min hayzu shituma vala taqraba hazihi alshshajarata fatakuna mina alzzalimiyna
Favasvasa lahuma alshshaytanu liyubdiya lahuma ma vuriya 'anhuma min savatihima vaqala ma nahakuma rabbukuma 'an hazihi alshshajarati illa an takuna malakayni av takuna mina alxalidiyna
Vaqasamahuma inniy lakuma lamina alnnasihiyna

Fadllohuma big'ururin falamma zaqa alshshajarata badat lahuma savatuhuma vatafiqa yaxsifani 'alayhima min varaqi aljannati vanadahuma rabbuhuma alam anhakuma 'an tilkuma alshshajarati vaqul lakuma inna alshshaytana lakuma 'aduvvun mubiynun
Qala rabbana zalamna anfusana vain lam tag'fir lana vatarhamna lanakunanna mina alxasiriyna
Qala ihbitu ba'dukum liba'din 'aduvvun valakum fiy alardi mustaqarrun vamata'un ila hiynin
Qala fiyha tahyavna vafiyha tamutuna vaminha tuxrajuna
Ya baniy adama qad anzalna 'alaykum libasan yuvariy savatikum variyshan valibasu alttaqva zalika xayrun zalika min ayati Allohi la'llohum yazzakkaruna

Ya baniy adama la yaftinannakumu alshshaytanu kama axraja abavaykum mina aljannati yanzi'u 'anhuma libasahuma liyuriyahuma savatihima innahu yarakum huva vaqabiyluhu min hayzu la taravnahum inna ja'alna alshshayatiyna avliya lillaziyna la yuminuna
Vaiza fa'alu fahishatan qalu vajadna 'alayha abana vaAllohu amarana biha qul inna Alloha la yamuru bialfahshai ataquluna 'ala Allohi ma la ta'lamuna
Qul amara rabbiy bialqisti vaqiymu vujuhakum 'inda kulli masjidin vaod'uhu muxlisiyna lahu alddiyna kama badakum ta'uduna
Fariyqan hada vafariyqan haqqa 'alayhimu alddalalatu innahumu ittaxazu alshshayatiyna avliya min duni Allohi vayahsabuna annahum muhtaduna
Ya baniy adama xuzu ziynatakum 'inda kulli masjidin vakulu vaishrabu vala tusrifu innahu la yuhibbu almusrifiyna

Qul man harrama ziynata Allohi allatiy axraja li'ibadihi valttayyibati mina alrrizqi qul hiya lillaziyna amanu fiy alhayati alddunya xalisatan yavma alqiyamati kazalika nufassilu alayati liqavmin ya'lamuna
Qul innama harrama rabbiya alfavahisha ma zahara minha vama batana valizma valbag'ya big'ayri alhaqqi van tushriku biAllohi ma lam yunazzil bihi sultanan van taqulu 'ala Allohi ma la ta'lamuna
Valikulli ommatin ajalun faiza ja ajaluhum la yastaxiruna sa'atan vala yastaqdimuna
Ya baniy adama imma yatiyannakum rusulun minkum yaqussuna 'alaykum ayatiy famani ittaqa vaslaha fala xavfun 'alayhim vala hum yahzanuna
Vallaziyna kazzabu biayatina vaistakbaru 'anha olaika ashabu alnnari hum fiyha xaliduna

Faman azlamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allohi kaziban av kazzaba biayatihi olaika yanaluhum nasiybuhum mina alkitabi hatta iza jazum rusuluna yatavaffavnahum qalu ayna ma kuntum tad'una min duni Allohi qalu dallu 'anna vashahidu 'ala anfusihim annahum kanu kafiriyna

Qala odxulu fiy omamin qad xalat min qablikum mina aljinni valinsi fiy alnnari kullama daxalat ommatun la'anat oxtaha hatta iza iddaraku fiyha jamiy'an qalat oxrahum liulahum rabbana haolai adalluna fatihim 'azaban di'fan mina alnnari qala likullin di'fun valakin la ta'lamuna
Vaqalat ulahum lioxrahum fama kana lakum 'alayna min fadlin fazuqu al'azaba bima kuntum taksibuna
Inna allaziyna kazzabu biayatina vaistakbaru 'anha la tufattahu lahum abvabu alssamai vala yadxuluna aljannata hatta yalija aljamalu fiy sammi alxiyati vakazalika najziy almujrimiyna
Lahum min jahannama mihadun vamin favqihim g'avashin vakazalika najziy alzzalimiyna
Vallaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati la nukallifu nafsan illa vus'aha olaika ashabu aljannati hum fiyha xaliduna

Vanaza'na ma fiy sudurihim min g'illin tajriy min tahtihimu alanharu vaqalu alhamdu lillahi allaziy hadana lihaza vama kunna linahtadiya lavla an hadana Allohu laqad jat rusulu rabbina bialhaqqi vanudu an tilkumu aljannatu uriztumuha bima kuntum ta'maluna
Vanada ashabu aljannati ashaba alnnari an qad vajadna ma va'adana rabbuna haqqan fahal vajadtum ma va'ada rabbukum haqqan qalu na'am fazzana muazzinun baynahum an la'natu Allohi 'ala alzzalimiyna
Allaziyna yasudduna 'an sabiyli Allohi vayabg'unaha 'ivajan vahum bialaxirati kafiruna
Vabaynahuma hijabun va'ala ala'rafi rijalun ya'rifuna kullan bisiymahum vanadav ashaba aljannati an salamun 'alaykum lam yadxuluha vahum yatma'una
Vaiza surifat absaruhum tilqa ashabi alnnari qalu rabbana la taj'alna ma'a alqavmi alzzalimiyna
Vanada ashabu ala'rafi rijalan ya'rifunahum bisiymahum qalu ma ag'na 'ankum jam'ukum vama kuntum tastakbiruna
Ahaolai allaziyna aqsamtum la yanaluhumu Allohu birahmatin odxulu aljannata la xavfun 'alaykum vala antum tahzanuna
Vanada ashabu alnari ashaba aljannati an afiydu 'alayna mina almai av mimma razaqakumu Allohu qalu inna Alloha harramahuma 'ala alkafiriyna
Allaziyna ittaxazu diynahum lahvan vala'iban vag'arrazumu alhayatu alddunya falyavma nansahum kama nasu liqa yavmihim haza vama kanu biayatina yajhaduna
Valaqad jinahum bikitabin fassalnahu 'ala 'ilmin hudan varahmatan liqavmin yuminuna

Hal yanzuruna illa taviylahu yavma yatiy taviyluhu yaqulu allaziyna nasuhu min qablu qad jat rusulu rabbina bialhaqqi fahal lana min shufa'a fayashfa'u lana av nuraddu fana'mala g'ayra allaziy kunna na'malu qad xasiru anfusahum vadalla 'anhum ma kanu yaftaruna

Inna rabbakumu Allohu allaziy xalaqa alssamavati valarda fiy sittati ayyamin zumma istava 'ala al'arshi yug'shiy allayla alnnahara yatlubuhu haziyzan valshshamsa valqamara valnnujuma musaxxaratin biamrihi ala lahu alxalqu valamru tabaraka Allohu rabbu al'alamiyna
Od'u rabbakum tadarru'an vaxufyatan innahu la yuhibbu almu'tadiyna
Vala tufsidu fiy alardi ba'da islahiha vaod'uhu xavfan vatama'an inna rahmata Allohi qariybun mina almuhsiniyna

Vahuva allaziy yursilu alrriyaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatihi hatta iza aqallat sahaban ziqalan suqnahu libaladin mayyitin fanzalna bihi alma faxrajna bihi min kulli alzzamarati kazalika nuxriju almavta la'allakum tazakkaruna
Valbaladu alttayyibu yaxruju nabatuhu biizni rabbihi vallaziy xabuza la yaxruju illa nakidan kazalika nusarrifu alayati liqavmin yashkuruna
Laqad arsalna nuhan ila qavmihi faqala ya qavmi o'budu Alloha ma lakum min ilahin g'ayruhu inniy axafu 'alaykum 'azaba yavmin 'aziymin
Qala almalao min qavmihi inna lanaraka fiy dalalin mubiynin
Qala ya qavmi laysa biy dalalatun valakinniy rasulun min rabbi al'alamiyna
Oballig'ukum risalati rabbiy vansahu lakum va'lamu mina Allohi ma la ta'lamuna
Ava'ajibtum an jakum zikrun min rabbikum 'ala rajulin minkum liyunzirakum valitattaqu vala'allakum turhamuna
Fakazzabuhu fanjaynahu vallaziyna ma'ahu fiy alfulki vag'raqna allaziyna kazzabu biayatina innahum kanu qavman 'amiyna
Vaila 'adin axahum hudan qala ya qavmi o'budu Alloha ma lakum min ilahin g'ayruhu afala tattaquna
Qala almalao allaziyna kafaru min qavmihi inna lanaraka fiy safahatin vainna lanazunnuka mina alkazibiyna
Qala ya qavmi laysa biy safahatun valakinniy rasulun min rabbi al'alamiyna
Oballig'ukum risalati rabbiy vana lakum nasihun amiynun
Ava'ajibtum an jakum zikrun min rabbikum 'ala rajulin minkum liyunzirakum vaozkuru iz ja'alakum xulafa min ba'di qavmi nuhin vazadakum fiy alxalqi bastatan faozkuru ala Allohi la'allakum tuflihuna
Qalu ajitana lina'buda Alloha vahdahu vanazara ma kana ya'budu abaona fatina bima ta'iduna in kunta mina alssadiqiyna
Qala qad vaqa'a 'alaykum min rabbikum rijsun vag'adabun atujadilunaniy fiy asmain sammaytumuha antum vabaokum ma nazzala Allohu biha min sultanin faintaziru inniy ma'akum mina almuntaziriyna
Fanjaynahu vallaziyna ma'ahu birahmatin minna vaqata'na dabira allaziyna kazzabu biayatina vama kanu muminiyna

Vaila zamuda axahum salihan qala ya qavmi o'budu Alloha ma lakum min ilahin g'ayruhu qad jatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum hazihi naqatu Allohi lakum ayatan fazaruha takul fiy ardi Allohi vala tamassuha bisuin fayaxuzakum 'azabun aliymun
Vaozkuru iz ja'alakum xulafa min ba'di 'adin vabavvakum fiy alardi tattaxizuna min suhuliha qusuran vatanhituna aljibala buyutan faozkuru ala Allohi vala ta'zav fiy alardi mufsidiyna
Qala almalao allaziyna istakbaru min qavmihi lillaziyna istud'ifu liman amana minhum ata'lamuna anna salihan mursalun min rabbihi qalu inna bima orsila bihi muminuna
Qala allaziyna istakbaru inna biallaziy amantum bihi kafiruna
Fa'aqaru alnnaqata va'atav 'an amri rabbihim vaqalu ya salihu itina bima ta'iduna in kunta mina almursaliyna
Faxazazumu alrrajfatu fasbahu fiy darihim jazimiyna
Fatavalla 'anhum vaqala ya qavmi laqad ablag'tukum risalata rabbiy vanasahtu lakum valakin la tuhibbuna alnnasihiyna
Valutan iz qala liqavmihi atatuna alfahishata ma sabaqakum biha min ahadin mina al'alamiyna
Innakum latatuna alrrijala shahvatan min duni alnnisai bal antum qavmun musrifuna
Vama kana javaba qavmihi illa an qalu axrijuhum min qaryatikum innahum onasun yatatahharuna
Fanjaynahu vahlahu illa imratahu kanat mina alg'abiriyna
Vamtarna 'alayhim mataran faonzur kayfa kana 'aqibatu almujrimiyna

Vaila madyana axahum shu'ayban qala ya qavmi o'budu Alloha ma lakum min ilahin g'ayruhu qad jatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum favfu alkayla valmiyzana vala tabxasu alnnasa ashyahum vala tufsidu fiy alardi ba'da islahiha zalikum xayrun lakum in kuntum muminiyna
Vala taq'udu bikulli siratin tu'iduna vatasudduna 'an sabiyli Allohi man amana bihi vatabg'unaha 'ivajan vaozkuru iz kuntum qaliylan fakazzarakum vaonzuru kayfa kana 'aqibatu almufsidiyna
Vain kana taifatun minkum amanu biallaziy orsiltu bihi vataifatun lam yuminu faisbiru hatta yahkuma Allohu baynana vahuva xayru alhakimiyna
Qala almalao allaziyna istakbaru min qavmihi lanuxrijannaka ya shu'aybu vallaziyna amanu ma'aka min qaryatina av lata'udunna fiy millatina qala avalav kunna karihiyna

Qadi iftarayna 'ala Allohi kaziban in 'udna fiy millatikum ba'da iz najjana Allohu minha vama yakunu lana an na'uda fiyha illa an yasha Allohu rabbuna vasi'a rabbuna kulla shayin 'ilman 'ala Allohi tavakkalna rabbana iftah baynana vabayna qavmina bialhaqqi vanta xayru alfatihiyna
Vaqala almalao allaziyna kafaru min qavmihi laini ittaba'tum shu'ayban innakum izan laxasiruna
Faxazazumu alrrajfatu fasbahu fiy darihim jazimiyna
Allaziyna kazzabu shu'ayban kan lam yag'nav fiyha allaziyna kazzabu shu'ayban kanu humu alxasiriyna
Fatavalla 'anhum vaqala ya qavmi laqad ablag'tukum risalati rabbiy vanasahtu lakum fakayfa asa 'ala qavmin kafiriyna
Vama arsalna fiy qaryatin min nabiyyin illa axazna ahlaha bialbasai valddarrai la'llohum yaddarra'una
Zumma baddalna makana alssayyiati alhasanata hatta 'afav vaqalu qad massa abana alddarrao valssarrao faxaznahum bag'tatan vahum la yash'uruna
Valav anna ahla alqura amanu vaittaqav lafatahna 'alayhim barakatin mina alssamai valardi valakin kazzabu faxaznahum bima kanu yaksibuna
Afamina ahlu alqura an yatiyahum basuna bayatan vahum naimuna
Ava amina ahlu alqura an yatiyahum basuna duhan vahum yal'abuna
Afaminu makra Allohi fala yamanu makra Allohi illa alqavmu alxasiruna
Avalam yahdi lillaziyna yarizuna alarda min ba'di ahliha an lav nashao asabnahum bizunubihim vanatba'u 'ala qulubihim fahum la yasma'una
Tilka alqura naqussu 'alayka min anbaiha valaqad jazum rusuluhum bialbayyinati fama kanu liyuminu bima kazzabu min qablu kazalika yatba'u Allohu 'ala qulubi alkafiriyna
Vama vajadna liaksarihim min 'ahdin vain vajadna aksarahum lafasiqiyna
Zumma ba'azna min ba'dihim musa biayatina ila fir'avna vamalaihi fazalamu biha faonuzur kayfa kana 'aqibatu almufsidiyna
Vaqala musa ya fir'avnu inniy rasulun min rabbi al'alamiyna
Haqiyqun 'ala an la aqula 'ala Allohi illa alhaqqa qad jitukum bibayyinatin min rabbikum farsil ma'iya baniy israiyla
Qala in kunta jita biayatin fati biha in kunta mina alssadiqiyna
Falqa 'asahu faiza hiya zu'banun mubiynun
Vanaza'a yadahu faiza hiya baydao lilnnaziriyna
Qala almalao min qavmi fir'avna inna haza lasahirun 'aliymun
Yuriydu an yuxrijakum min ardikum famaza tamuruna
Qalu arjih vaxahu varsil fiy almadaini hashiriyna
Yatuka bikulli sahirin 'aliymin
Vaja alssaharatu fir'avna qalu inna lana lajran in kunna nahnu alg'alibiyna
Qala na'am vainnakum lamina almuqarrabiyna
Qalu ya musa imma an tulqiya vaimma an nakuna nahnu almulqiyna
Qala alqu falamma alqav saharu a'yuna alnnasi vaistarhabuhum vajau bisihrin 'aziymin
Vavhayna ila musa an alqi 'asaka faiza hiya talqafu ma yafikuna
Favaqa'a alhaqqu vabatala ma kanu ya'maluna
Fag'ulibu hunalika vainqalabu sag'iriyna
Vaolqiya alssaharatu sajidiyna
Qalu amanna birabbi al'alamiyna
Rabbi musa vaharuna
Qala fir'avnu amantum bihi qabla an azana lakum inna haza lamakrun makartumuhu fiy almadiynati lituxriju minha ahlaha fasavfa ta'lamuna
Laoqati'anna aydiyakum varjulakum min xilafin summa laosallibannakum ajma'iyna
Qalu inna ila rabbina munqalibuna
Vama tanqimu minna illa an amanna biayati rabbina lamma jatna rabbana afrig' 'alayna sabran vatavaffana muslimiyna
Vaqala almalao min qavmi fir'avna atazaru musa vaqavmahu liyufsidu fiy alardi vayazaraka valihataka qala sanuqattilu abnahum vanastahyiy nisahum vainna favqahum qahiruna
Qala musa liqavmihi ista'iynu biAllohi vaisbiru inna alarda lillahi yurisuha man yashao min 'ibadihi val'aqibatu lilmuttaqiyna
Qalu uziyna min qabli an tatiyana vamin ba'di ma jitana qala 'asa rabbukum an yuhlika 'aduvvakum vayastaxlifakum fiy alardi fayanzura kayfa ta'maluna
Valaqad axazna ala fir'avna bialssiniyna vanaqsin mina alzzamarati la'llohum yazzakkaruna
Faiza jazumu alhasanatu qalu lana hazihi vain tusibhum sayyiatun yattayyaru bimusa vaman ma'ahu ala innama tairuhum 'inda Allohi valakinna akzarahum la ya'lamuna
Vaqalu mahma tatina bihi min ayatin litasharana biha fama nahnu laka bimuminiyna
Farsalna 'alayhimu alttufana valjarada valqummala valddafadi'a valddama ayatin mufassalatin faistakbaru vakanu qavman mujrimiyna
Valamma vaqa'a 'alayhimu alrrijzu qalu ya musa od'u lana rabbaka bima 'ahida 'indaka lain kashafta 'anna alrrijza lanuminanna laka valanursilanna ma'aka baniy israiyla
Falamma kashafna 'anhumu alrrijza ila ajalin hum balig'uhu iza hum yankuzuna
Faintaqamna minhum fag'raqnahum fiy alyammi biannahum kazzabu biayatina vakanu 'anha g'afiliyna

Vavrazna alqavma allaziyna kanu yustad'afuna mashariqa alardi vamag'aribaha allatiy barakna fiyha vatammat kalimatu rabbika alhusna 'ala baniy israiyla bima sabaru vadammarna ma kana yasna'u fir'avnu vaqavmuhu vama kanu ya'rishuna
Vajavazna bibaniy israiyla albahra fatav 'ala qavmin ya'kufuna 'ala asnamin lahum qalu ya musa ij'al lana ilahan kama lahum alihatun qala innakum qavmun tajhaluna
Inna haolai mutabbarun ma hum fiyhi vabatilun ma kanu ya'maluna
Qala ag'ayra Allohi abg'iykum ilahan vahuva faddalakum 'ala al'alamiyna
Vaiz anjaynakum min ali fir'avna yasumunakum sua al'azabi yuqattiluna abnakum vayastahyuna nisakum vafiy zalikum balaon min rabbikum 'aziymun
Vava'adna musa salasiyna laylatan vatmamnaha bi'ashrin fatamma miyqatu rabbihi arba'iyna laylatan vaqala musa liaxiyhi haruna oxlufniy fiy qavmiy vaslih vala tattabi' sabiyla almufsidiyna

Valamma ja musa limiyqatina vakallamahu rabbuhu qala rabbi ariniy anzur ilayka qala lan taraniy valakini onzur ila aljabali faini istaqarra makanahu fasavfa taraniy falamma tajalla rabbuhu liljabali ja'alahu dakkan vaxarra musa sa'iqan falamma afaqa qala subhanaka tubtu ilayka vana avvalu almuminiyna
Qala ya musa inniy istafaytuka 'ala alnnasi birisalatiy vabikalamiy faxuz ma ataytuka vakun mina alshshakiriyna
Vakatabna lahu fiy alalvahi min kulli shayin mav'izatan vatafsiylan likulli shayin faxuzha biquvvatin vamur qavmaka yaxuzu biahsaniha saoriykum dara alfasiqiyna

Sasrifu 'an ayatiya allaziyna yatakabbaruna fiy alardi big'ayri alhaqqi vain yarav kulla ayatin la yuminu biha vain yarav sabiyla alrrushdi la yattaxizuhu sabiylan vain yarav sabiyla alg'ayyi yattaxizuhu sabiylan zalika biannahum kazzabu biayatina vakanu 'anha g'afiliyna
Vallaziyna kazzabu biayatina valiqai alaxirati habitat a'maluhum hal yujzavna illa ma kanu ya'maluna
Vaittaxaza qavmu musa min ba'dihi min huliyyihim 'ijlan jasadan lahu xuvarun alam yarav annahu la yukallimuhum vala yahdiyhim sabiylan ittaxazuhu vakanu zalimiyna
Valamma suqita fiy aydiyhim varav annahum qad dallu qalu lain lam yarhamna rabbuna vayag'fir lana lanakunanna mina alxasiriyna

Valamma raja'a musa ila qavmihi g'adbana asifan qala bisama xalaftumuniy min ba'diy a'ajiltum amra rabbikum valqa alalvaha vaxaza birasi axiyhi yajurruhu ilayhi qala ibna omma inna alqavma istad'afuniy vakadu yaqtulunaniy fala tushmit biya ala'da vala taj'alniy ma'a alqavmi alzzalimiyna
Qala rabbi ig'fir liy valiaxiy vadxilna fiy rahmatika vanta arhamu alrrahimiyna
Inna allaziyna ittaxazu al'ijla sayanaluhum g'adabun min rabbihim vazillatun fiy alhayati alddunya vakazalika najziy almuftariyna
Vallaziyna 'amilu alssayyiati zumma tabu min ba'diha vamanu inna rabbaka min ba'diha lag'afurun rahiymun
Valamma sakata 'an musa alg'adabu axaza alalvaha vafiy nusxatiha hudan varahmatun lillaziyna hum lirabbihim yarhabuna

Vaixtara musa qavmahu sab'iyna rajulan limiyqatina falamma axazazumu alrrajfatu qala rabbi lav shita ahlaktahum min qablu vaiyyaya atuhlikuna bima fa'ala alssufahao minna in hiya illa fitnatuka tudillu biha man tashao vatahdiy man tashao anta valiyyuna faig'fir lana vairhamna vanta xayru alg'afiriyna

Vaoktub lana fiy hazihi alddunya hasanatan vafiy alaxirati inna hudna ilayka qala 'azabiy osiybu bihi man ashao varahmatiy vasi'at kulla shayin fasaktubuha lillaziyna yattaquna vayutuna alzzakata vallaziyna hum biayatina yuminuna

Allaziyna yattabi'una alrrasula alnnabiyya alommiyya allaziy yajidunahu maktuban 'indahum fiy alttavrati valinjiyli yamuruhum bialma'rufi vayanhahum 'ani almunkari vayuhillu lahumu alttayyibati vayuharrimu 'alayhimu alxabaiza vayada'u 'anhum israhum valag'lala allatiy kanat 'alayhim fallaziyna amanu bihi va'azzaruhu vanasaruhu vaittaba'u alnnura allaziy onzila ma'ahu olaika humu almuflihuna

Qul ya ayyuha alnnasu inniy rasulu Allohi ilaykum jamiy'an allaziy lahu mulku alssamavati valardi la ilaha illa huva yuhyiy vayumiytu faminu biAllohi varasulihi alnnabiyyi alommiyyi allaziy yuminu biAllohi vakalimatihi vaittabi'uhu la'allakum tahtaduna
Vamin qavmi musa ommatun yahduna bialhaqqi vabihi ya'diluna

Vaqatta'nahumu iznatay 'ashrata asbatan omaman vavhayna ila musa izi istasqahu qavmuhu ani idrib bi'asaka alhajara fainbajasat minhu iznata 'ashrata 'aynan qad 'alima kullu onasin mashrabahum vazallalna 'alayhimu alg'amama vanzalna 'alayhimu almanna valssalva kulu min tayyibati ma razaqnakum vama zalamuna valakin kanu anfusahum yazlimuna
Vaiz qiyla lahumu oskunu hazihi alqaryata vakulu minha hayzu shitum vaqulu hittatun vaodxulu albaba sujjadan nag'fir lakum xatiyatikum sanaziydu almuhsiniyna
Fabaddala allaziyna zalamu minhum qavlan g'ayra allaziy qiyla lahum farsalna 'alayhim rijzan mina alssamai bima kanu yazlimuna
Vaisalhum 'ani alqaryati allatiy kanat hadirata albahri iz ya'duna fiy alssabti iz tatiyhim hiytanuhum yavma sabtihim shurra'an vayavma la yasbituna la tatiyhim kazalika nabluhum bima kanu yafsuquna
Vaiz qalat ommatun minhum lima ta'izuna qavman Allohu muhlikuhum av mu'azzibuhum 'azaban shadiydan qalu ma'ziratan ila rabbikum vala'llohum yattaquna
Falamma nasu ma zukkiru bihi anjayna allaziyna yanhavna 'ani alssui vaxazna allaziyna zalamu bi'azabin baiysin bima kanu yafsuquna
Falamma 'atav 'an ma nuhu 'anhu qulna lahum kunu qiradatan xasiiyna
Vaiz tazzana rabbuka layab'azanna 'alayhim ila yavmi alqiyamati man yasumuhum sua al'azabi inna rabbaka lasariy'u al'iqabi vainnahu lag'afurun rahiymun
Vaqatta'nahum fiy alardi omaman minhumu alssalihuna vaminhum duna zalika vabalavnahum bialhasanati valssayyiati la'llohum yarji'una

Faxalafa min ba'dihim xalfun varizu alkitaba yaxuzuna 'arada haza aladna vayaquluna sayug'faru lana vain yatihim 'aradun mizluhu yaxuzuhu alam yuxaz 'alayhim miyzaqu alkitabi an la yaqulu 'ala Allohi illa alhaqqa vadarasu ma fiyhi valddaru alaxiratu xayrun lillaziyna yattaquna afala ta'qiluna
Vallaziyna yumassikuna bialkitabi vaqamu alssalata inna la nudiy'u ajra almuslihiyna
Vaiz nataqna aljabala favqahum kannahu zullatun vazannu annahu vaqi'un bihim xuzu ma ataynakum biquvvatin vaozkuru ma fiyhi la'allakum tattaquna
Vaiz axaza rabbuka min baniy adama min zuhurihim zurriyyatahum vashhadahum 'ala anfusihim alastu birabbikum qalu bala shahidna an taqulu yavma alqiyamati inna kunna 'an haza g'afiliyna
Av taqulu innama ashraka abaona min qablu vakunna zurriyyatan min ba'dihim afatuhlikuna bima fa'ala almubtiluna
Vakazalika nufassilu alayati vala'llohum yarji'una
Vaotlu 'alayhim naba allaziy ataynahu ayatina fainsalaxa minha fatba'ahu alshshaytanu fakana mina alg'aviyna

Valav shina larafa'nahu biha valakinnahu axlada ila alardi vaittaba'a havahu famazaluhu kamazali alkalbi in tahmil 'alayhi yalhaz av tatruxu yalhaz zalika mazalu alqavmi allaziyna kazzabu biayatina faoqsusi alqasasa la'llohum yatafakkaruna
Sa mazalan alqavmu allaziyna kazzabu biayatina vanfusahum kanu yazlimuna
Man yahdi Allohu fahuva almuhtadiy vaman yudlil faolaika humu alxasiruna

Valaqad zarana lijahannama kaziyran mina aljinni valinsi lahum qulubun la yafqahuna biha valahum a'yunun la yubsiruna biha valahum azanun la yasma'una biha olaika kalan'ami bal hum adallu olaika humu alg'afiluna
Valillahi alasmao alhusna faod'uhu biha vazaru allaziyna yulhiduna fiy asmaihi sayujzavna ma kanu ya'maluna
Vamimman xalaqna ommatun yahduna bialhaqqi vabihi ya'diluna
Vallaziyna kazzabu biayatina sanastadrijuhum min hayzu la ya'lamuna
Vaomliy lahum inna kaydiy matiynun
Avalam yatafakkaru ma bisahibihim min jinnatin in huva illa naziyrun mubiynun
Avalam yanzuru fiy malakuti alssamavati valardi vama xalaqa Allohu min shayin van 'asa an yakuna qadi iqtaraba ajaluhum fabiayyi hadiyzin ba'dahu yuminuna
Man yudlili Allohu fala hadiya lahu vayazaruhum fiy tug'yanihim ya'mahuna

Yasalunaka 'ani alssa'ati ayyana mursaha qul innama 'ilmuha 'inda rabbiy la yujalliyha livaqtiha illa huva saqulat fiy alssamavati valardi la tatiykum illa bag'tatan yasalunaka kannaka hafiyyun 'anha qul innama 'ilmuha 'inda Allohi valakinna aksara alnnasi la ya'lamuna
Qul la amliku linafsiy naf'an vala darran illa ma sha Allohu valav kuntu a'lamu alg'ayba laistakzartu mina alxayri vama massaniya alssuo in ana illa naziyrun vabashiyrun liqavmin yuminuna

Huva allaziy xalaqakum min nafsin vahidatin vaja'ala minha zavjaha liyaskuna ilayha falamma tag'ashshaha hamalat hamlan xafiyfan famarrat bihi falamma azqalat da'ava Alloha rabbahuma lain ataytana salihan lanakunanna mina alshshakiriyna
Falamma atahuma salihan ja'ala lahu shuraka fiyma atahuma fata'ala Allohu 'amma yushrikuna
Ayushrikuna ma la yaxluqu shayan vahum yuxlaquna
Vala yastatiy'una lahum nasran vala anfusahum yansuruna
Vain tad'uhum ila alhuda la yattabi'ukum savaon 'alaykum ada'avtumuhum am antum samituna
Inna allaziyna tad'una min duni Allohi 'ibadun amzalukum faod'uhum falyastajiybu lakum in kuntum sadiqiyna
Alahum arjulun yamshuna biha am lahum aydin yabtishuna biha am lahum a'yunun yubsiruna biha am lahum azanun yasma'una biha quli od'u shurakakum zumma kiyduni fala tunziruni
Inna valiyyiya Allohu allaziy nazzala alkitaba vahuva yatavalla alssalihiyna
Vallaziyna tad'una min dunihi la yastatiy'una nasrakum vala anfusahum yansuruna
Vain tad'uhum ila alhuda la yasma'u vatarahum yanzuruna ilayka vahum la yubsiruna
Xuzi al'afva vamur bial'urfi va'rid 'ani aljahiliyna
Vaimma yanzag'annaka mina alshshaytani nazg'un faista'iz biAllohi innahu samiy'un 'aliymun
Inna allaziyna ittaqav iza massahum taifun mina alshshaytani tazakkaru faiza hum mubsiruna
Vaixvanuhum yamuddunahum fiy alg'ayyi summa la yuqsiruna
Vaiza lam tatihim biayatin qalu lavla ijtabaytaha qul innama attabi'u ma yuha ilayya min rabbiy haza basairu min rabbikum vahudan varahmatun liqavmin yuminuna
Vaiza quria alquranu faistami'u lahu vansitu la'allakum turhamuna
Vaozkur rabbaka fiy nafsika tadarru'an vaxiyfatan vaduna aljahri mina alqavli bialg'uduvvi valasali vala takun mina alg'afiliyna
Inna allaziyna 'inda rabbika la yastakbiruna 'an 'ibadatihi vayusabbihunahu valahu yasjuduna
Yasalunaka 'ani alanfali quli alanfalu lillahi valrrasuli faittaqu Alloha vaslihu zata baynikum vatiy'u Alloha varasulahu in kuntum muminiyna
Innama almuminuna allaziyna iza zukira Allohu vajilat qulubuhum vaiza tuliyat 'alayhim ayatuhu zadazum iymanan va'ala rabbihim yatavakkaluna
Allaziyna yuqiymuna alssalata vamimma razaqnahum yunfiquna
Olaika humu almuminuna haqqan lahum darajatun 'inda rabbihim vamag'firatun varizqun kariymun
Kama axrajaka rabbuka min baytika bialhaqqi vainna fariyqan mina almuminiyna lakarihuna
Yujadilunaka fiy alhaqqi ba'dama tabayyana kannama yusaquna ila almavti vahum yanzuruna
Vaiz ya'idukumu Allohu ihda alttaifatayni annaha lakum vatavadduna anna g'ayra zati alshshavkati takunu lakum vayuriydu Allohu an yuhiqqa alhaqqa bikalimatihi vayaqta'a dabira alkafiriyna
Liyuhiqqa alhaqqa vayubtila albatila valav kariha almujrimuna
Iz tastag'iyzuna rabbakum faistajaba lakum anniy mumiddukum bialfin mina almalaikati murdifiyna
Vama ja'alahu Allohu illa bushra valitatmainna bihi qulubukum vama alnnasru illa min 'indi Allohi inna Alloha 'aziyzun hakiymun
Iz yug'ashshiykumu alnnu'asa amanatan minhu vayunazzilu 'alaykum mina alssamai man liyutahhirakum bihi vayuzhiba 'ankum rijza alshshaytani valiyarbita 'ala qulubikum vayuzabbita bihi alaqdama
Iz yuhiy rabbuka ila almalaikati anniy ma'akum fazabbitu allaziyna amanu saolqiy fiy qulubi allaziyna kafaru alrru'ba faidribu favqa ala'naqi vaidribu minhum kulla bananin
Zalika biannahum shaqqu Alloha varasulahu vaman yushaqiqi Alloha varasulahu fainna Alloha shadiydu al'iqabi
Zalikum fazuquhu vanna lilkafiriyna 'azaba alnnari
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu iza laqiytumu allaziyna kafaru zahfan fala tuvalluhumu aladbara
Vaman yuvallihim yavmaizin duburahu illa mutaharrifan liqitalin av mutahayyizan ila fiatin faqad ba big'adabin mina Allohi vamavahu jahannamu vabisa almasiyru
Falam taqtuluhum valakinna Alloha qatalahum vama ramayta iz ramayta valakinna Alloha rama valiyubliya almuminiyna minhu balan hasanan inna Alloha samiy'un 'aliymun
Zalikum vanna Alloha muhinu kaydi alkafiriyna
In tastaftihu faqad jakumu alfasu vain tantahu fahuva xayrun lakum vain ta'udu na'ud valan tug'niya 'ankum fiatukum shayan valav kasurat vanna Alloha ma'a almuminiyna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu atiy'u Alloha varasulahu vala tavallav 'anhu vantum tasma'una
Vala takunu kallaziyna qalu sami'na vahum la yasma'una
Inna sharra alddavabbi 'inda Allohi alssummu albukmu allaziyna la ya'qiluna
Valav 'alima Allohu fiyhim xayran lasma'ahum valav asma'ahum latavallav vahum mu'riduna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu istajiybu lillahi valilrrasuli iza da'akum lima yuhyiykum vai'lamu anna Alloha yahulu bayna almari vaqalbihi vannahu ilayhi tuhsharuna
Vaittaqu fitnatan la tusiybanna allaziyna zalamu minkum xassatan vai'lamu anna Alloha shadiydu al'iqabi
Vaozkuru iz antum qaliylun mustad'afuna fiy alardi taxafuna an yataxattafakumu alnnasu favakum vayyadakum binasrihi varazaqakum mina alttayyibati la'allakum tashkuruna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la taxunu Alloha valrrasula vataxunu amanatikum vantum ta'lamuna
Vai'lamu annama amvalukum vavladukum fitnatun vanna Alloha 'indahu ajrun 'aziymun
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu in tattaqu Alloha yaj'al lakum furqanan vayukaffir 'ankum sayyiatikum vayag'fir lakum vaAllohu zu alfadli al'aziymi
Vaiz yamkuru bika allaziyna kafaru liyuzbituka av yaqtuluka av yuxrijuka vayamkuruna vayamkuru Allohu vaAllohu xayru almakiriyna
Vaiza tutla 'alayhim ayatuna qalu qad sami'na lav nashao laqulna mizla haza in haza illa asatiyru alavvaliyna
Vaiz qalu llohumma in kana haza huva alhaqqa min 'indika famtir 'alayna hijaratan mina alssamai avi itina bi'azabin aliymin
Vama kana Allohu liyu'azzibahum vanta fiyhim vama kana Allohu mu'azzibahum vahum yastag'firuna
Vama lahum alla yu'azzibahumu Allohu vahum yasudduna 'ani almasjidi alharami vama kanu avliyahu in avliyaohu illa almuttaquna valakinna akzarahum la ya'lamuna
Vama kana salatuhum 'inda albayti illa mukan vatasdiyatan fazuqu al'azaba bima kuntum takfuruna
Inna allaziyna kafaru yunfiquna amvalahum liyasuddu 'an sabiyli Allohi fasayunfiqunaha zumma takunu 'alayhim hasratan zumma yug'labuna vallaziyna kafaru ila jahannama yuhsharuna
Liyamiyza Allohu alxabiysa mina alttayyibi vayaj'ala alxabiysa ba'dahu 'ala ba'din fayarkumahu jamiy'an fayaj'alahu fiy jahannama olaika humu alxasiruna
Qul lillaziyna kafaru in yantahu yug'far lahum ma qad salafa vain ya'udu faqad madat sunnatu alavvaliyna
Vaqatiluhum hatta la takuna fitnatun vayakuna alddiynu kulluhu lillahi faini intahav fainna Alloha bima ya'maluna basiyrun
Vain tavallav fai'lamu anna Alloha mavlakum ni'ma almavla vani'ma alnnasiyru

Vai'lamu annama g'animtum min shayin fanna lillahi xumusahu valilrrasuli valiziy alqurba valyatama valmasakiyni vaibni alssabiyli in kuntum amantum biAllohi vama anzalna 'ala 'abdina yavma alfurqani yavma iltaqa aljam'ani vaAllohu 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun

Iz antum bial'udvati alddunya vahum bial'udvati alqusva valrrakbu asfala minkum valav tava'adtum laixtalaftum fiy almiy'adi valakin liyaqdiya Allohu amran kana maf'ulan liyahlika man halaka 'an bayyinatin vayahya man hayya 'an bayyinatin vainna Alloha lasamiy'un 'aliymun
Iz yuriykahumu Allohu fiy manamika qaliylan valav arakahum kaziyran lafashiltum valatanaza'tum fiy alamri valakinna Alloha sallama innahu 'aliymun bizati alssuduri
Vaiz yuriykumuhum izi iltaqaytum fiy a'yunikum qaliylan vayuqallilukum fiy a'yunihim liyaqdiya Allohu amran kana maf'ulan vaila Allohi turja'u alomuru
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu iza laqiytum fiatan faozbutu vaozkuru Alloha kaziyran la'allakum tuflihuna
Vatiy'u Alloha varasulahu vala tanaza'u fatafshalu vatazhaba riyhukum vaisbiru inna Alloha ma'a alssabiriyna
Vala takunu kallaziyna xaraju min diyarihim bataran varia alnnasi vayasudduna 'an sabiyli Allohi vaAllohu bima ya'maluna muhiytun

Vaiz zayyana lahumu alshshaytanu a'malahum vaqala la g'aliba lakumu alyavma mina alnnasi vainniy jarun lakum falamma tarati alfiatani nakasa 'ala 'aqibayhi vaqala inniy bariyon minkum inniy ara ma la taravna inniy axafu Alloha vaAllohu shadiydu al'iqabi
Iz yaqulu almunafiquna vallaziyna fiy qulubihim maradun g'arra haolai diynuhum vaman yatavakkal 'ala Allohi fainna Alloha 'aziyzun hakiymun
Valav tara iz yatavaffa allaziyna kafaru almalaikatu yadribuna vujuhahum vadbarahum vazuqu 'azaba alhariyqi
Zalika bima qaddamat aydiykum vanna Alloha laysa bizallamin lil'abiydi
Kadabi ali fir'avna vallaziyna min qablihim kafaru biayati Allohi faxazahumu Allohu bizunubihim inna Alloha qaviyyun shadiydu al'iqabi
Zalika bianna Alloha lam yaku mug'ayyiran ni'matan an'amaha 'ala qavmin hatta yug'ayyiru ma bianfusihim vanna Alloha samiy'un 'aliymun
Kadabi ali fir'avna vallaziyna min qablihim kazzabu biayati rabbihim fahlaknahum bizunubihim vag'raqna ala fir'avna vakullun kanu zalimiyna
Inna sharra alddavabbi 'inda Allohi allaziyna kafaru fahum la yuminuna
Allaziyna 'ahadta minhum zumma yanquduna 'ahdahum fiy kulli marratin vahum la yattaquna
Faimma tazqafannahum fiy alharbi fasharrid bihim man xalfahum la'llohum yazzakkaruna
Vaimma taxafanna min qavmin xiyanatan fainbiz ilayhim 'ala savain inna Alloha la yuhibbu alxainiyna
Vala yahsabanna allaziyna kafaru sabaqu innahum la yu'jizuna

Va'iddu lahum ma istata'tum min quvvatin vamin ribati alxayli turhibuna bihi 'aduvva Allohi va'aduvvakum vaxariyna min dunihim la ta'lamunahumu Allohu ya'lamuhum vama tunfiqu min shayin fiy sabiyli Allohi yuvaffa ilaykum vantum la tuzlamuna
Vain janahu lilssalmi faijnah laha vatavakkal 'ala Allohi innahu huva alssamiy'u al'aliymu
Vain yuriydu an yaxda'uka fainna hasbaka Allohu huva allaziy ayyadaka binasrihi vabialmuminiyna
Vallafa bayna qulubihim lav anfaqta ma fiy alardi jamiy'an ma allafta bayna qulubihim valakinna Alloha allafa baynahum innahu 'aziyzun hakiymun
Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu hasbuka Allohu vamani ittaba'aka mina almuminiyna
Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu harridi almuminiyna 'ala alqitali in yakun minkum 'ishruna sabiruna yag'libu miatayni vain yakun minkum miatun yag'libu alfan mina allaziyna kafaru biannahum qavmun la yafqahuna
Alana xaffafa Allohu 'ankum va'alima anna fiykum da'fan fain yakun minkum miatun sabiratun yag'libu miatayni vain yakun minkum alfun yag'libu alfayni biizni Allohi vaAllohu ma'a alssabiriyna
Ma kana linabiyyin an yakuna lahu asra hatta yusxina fiy alardi turiyduna 'arada alddunya vaAllohu yuriydu alaxirata vaAllohu 'aziyzun hakiymun
Lavla kitabun mina Allohi sabaqa lamassakum fiyma axaztum 'azabun 'aziymun
Fakulu mimma g'animtum halalan tayyiban vaittaqu Alloha inna Alloha g'afurun rahiymun
Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu qul liman fiy aydiykum mina alasra in ya'lami Allohu fiy qulubikum xayran yutikum xayran mimma oxiza minkum vayag'fir lakum vaAllohu g'afurun rahiymun
Vain yuriydu xiyanataka faqad xanu Alloha min qablu famkana minhum vaAllohu 'aliymun hakiymun

Inna allaziyna amanu vahajaru vajahadu biamvalihim vanfusihim fiy sabiyli Allohi vallaziyna avav vanasaru olaika ba'duhum avliyao ba'din vallaziyna amanu valam yuhajiru ma lakum min valayatihim min shayin hatta yuhajiru vaini istansarukum fiy alddiyni fa'alaykumu alnnasru illa 'ala qavmin baynakum vabaynahum miyzaqun vaAllohu bima ta'maluna basiyrun
Vallaziyna kafaru ba'duhum avliyao ba'din illa taf'aluhu takun fitnatun fiy alardi vafasadun kabiyrun
Vallaziyna amanu vahajaru vajahadu fiy sabiyli Allohi vallaziyna avav vanasaru olaika humu almuminuna haqqan lahum mag'firatun varizqun kariymun
Vallaziyna amanu min ba'du vahajaru vajahadu ma'akum faolaika minkum vaolu alarhami ba'duhum avla biba'din fiy kitabi Allohi inna Alloha bikulli shayin 'aliymun
Baratun mina Allohi varasulihi ila allaziyna 'ahadtum mina almushrikiyna
Fasiyhu fiy alardi arba'ata ashhurin vai'lamu annakum g'ayru mu'jiziy Allohi vanna Alloha muxziy alkafiriyna

Vazanun mina Allohi varasulihi ila alnnasi yavma alhajji alakbari anna Alloha bariyon mina almushrikiyna varasuluhu fain tubtum fahuva xayrun lakum vain tavallaytum fai'lamu annakum g'ayru mu'jiziy Allohi vabashshiri allaziyna kafaru bi'azabin aliymin
Illa allaziyna 'ahadtum mina almushrikiyna zumma lam yanqusukum shayan valam yuzahiru 'alaykum ahadan fatimmu ilayhim 'ahdahum ila muddatihim inna Alloha yuhibbu almuttaqiyna

Faiza insalaxa alashhuru alhurumu faoqtulu almushrikiyna hayzu vajadtumuhum vaxuzuhum vaohsuruhum vaoq'udu lahum kulla marsadin fain tabu vaqamu alssalata vatavu alzzakata faxallu sabiylahum inna Alloha g'afurun rahiymun
Vain ahadun mina almushrikiyna istajaraka fajirhu hatta yasma'a kalama Allohi zumma ablig'hu mamanahu zalika biannahum qavmun la ya'lamuna
Kayfa yakunu lilmushrikiyna 'ahdun 'inda Allohi va'inda rasulihi illa allaziyna 'ahadtum 'inda almasjidi alharami fama istaqamu lakum faistaqiymu lahum inna Alloha yuhibbu almuttaqiyna
Kayfa vain yazharu 'alaykum la yarqubu fiykum illan vala zimmatan yurdunakum biafvahihim vataba qulubuhum vakzaruhum fasiquna
Ishtarav biayati Allohi samanan qaliylan fasaddu 'an sabiylihi innahum sa ma kanu ya'maluna
La yarqubuna fiy muminin illan vala zimmatan vaolaika humu almu'taduna
Fain tabu vaqamu alssalata vatavu alzzakata faixvanukum fiy alddiyni vanufassilu alayati liqavmin ya'lamuna
Vain nakasu aymanahum min ba'di 'ahdihim vata'anu fiy diynikum faqatilu aimmata alkufri innahum la aymana lahum la'llohum yantahuna
Ala tuqatiluna qavman nakasu aymanahum vahammu biixraji alrrasuli vahum badaukum avvala marratin ataxshavnahum faAllohu ahaqqu an taxshavhu in kuntum muminiyna
Qatiluhum yu'azzibhumu Allohu biaydiykum vayuxzihim vayansurkum 'alayhim vayashfi sudura qavmin muminiyna
Vayuzhib g'ayza qulubihim vayatubu Allohu 'ala man yashao vaAllohu 'aliymun hakiymun
Am hasibtum an tutraku valamma ya'lami Allohu allaziyna jahadu minkum valam yattaxizu min duni Allohi vala rasulihi vala almuminiyna valiyjatan vaAllohu xabiyrun bima ta'maluna
Ma kana lilmushrikiyna an ya'muru masajida Allohi shahidiyna 'ala anfusihim bialkufri olaika habitat a'maluhum vafiy alnnari hum xaliduna
Innama ya'muru masajida Allohi man amana biAllohi valyavmi alaxiri vaqama alssalata vata alzzakata valam yaxsha illa Alloha fa'asa olaika an yakunu mina almuhtadiyna
Aja'altum siqayata alhajji va'imarata almasjidi alharami kaman amana biAllohi valyavmi alaxiri vajahada fiy sabiyli Allohi la yastavuna 'inda Allohi vaAllohu la yahdiy alqavma alzzalimiyna
Allaziyna amanu vahajaru vajahadu fiy sabiyli Allohi biamvalihim vanfusihim a'zamu darajatan 'inda Allohi vaolaika humu alfaizuna
Yubashshiruhum rabbuhum birahmatin minhu varidvanin vajannatin lahum fiyha na'iymun muqiymun
Xalidiyna fiyha abadan inna Alloha 'indahu ajrun 'aziymun
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la tattaxizu abakum vaixvanakum avliya ini istahabbu alkufra 'ala aliymani vaman yatavllohum minkum faolaika humu alzzalimuna

Qul in kana abaokum vabnaokum vaixvanukum vazvajukum va'ashiyratukum vamvalun iqtaraftumuha vatijaratun taxshavna kasadaha vamasakinu tardavnaha ahabba ilaykum mina Allohi varasulihi vajihadin fiy sabiylihi fatarabbasu hatta yatiya Allohu biamrihi vaAllohu la yahdiy alqavma alfasiqiyna
Laqad nasarakumu Allohu fiy mavatina kaziyratin vayavma hunaynin iz a'jabatkum kazratukum falam tug'ni 'ankum shayan vadaqat 'alaykumu alardu bima rahubat zumma vallaytum mudbiriyna
Zumma anzala Allohu sakiynatahu 'ala rasulihi va'ala almuminiyna vanzala junudan lam taravha va'azzaba allaziyna kafaru vazalika jazao alkafiriyna
Zumma yatubu Allohu min ba'di zalika 'ala man yashao vaAllohu g'afurun rahiymun

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu innama almushrikuna najasun fala yaqrabu almasjida alharama ba'da 'amihim haza vain xiftum 'aylatan fasavfa yug'niykumu Allohu min fadlihi in sha inna Alloha 'aliymun hakiymun

Qatilu allaziyna la yuminuna biAllohi vala bialyavmi alaxiri vala yuharrimuna ma harrama Allohu varasuluhu vala yadiynuna diyna alhaqqi mina allaziyna utu alkitaba hatta yu'tu aljizyata 'an yadin vahum sag'iruna
Vaqalati alyahudu 'uzayrun ibnu Allohi vaqalati alnnasara almasiyhu ibnu Allohi zalika qavluhum biafvahihim yudahiuna qavla allaziyna kafaru min qablu qatalahumu Allohu anna yufakuna
Ittaxazu ahbarahum varuhbanahum arbaban min duni Allohi valmasiyha ibna maryama vama omiru illa liya'budu ilahan vahidan la ilaha illa huva subhanahu 'amma yushrikuna
Yuriyduna an yutfiu nura Allohi biafvahihim vayaba Allohu illa an yutimma nurahu valav kariha alkafiruna
Huva allaziy arsala rasulahu bialhuda vadiyni alhaqqi liyuzhirahu 'ala alddiyni kullihi valav kariha almushrikuna

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu inna kaziyran mina alahbari valrruhbani layakuluna amvala alnnasi bialbatili vayasudduna 'an sabiyli Allohi vallaziyna yaknizuna alzzahaba valfiddata vala yunfiqunaha fiy sabiyli Allohi fabashshirhum bi'azabin aliymin
Yavma yuhma 'alayha fiy nari jahannama fatukva biha jibahuhum vajunubuhum vazuhuruhum haza ma kanaztum lianfusikum fazuqu ma kuntum taknizuna

Inna 'iddata alshshuhuri 'inda Allohi izna 'ashara shahran fiy kitabi Allohi yavma xalaqa alssamavati valarda minha arba'atun hurumun zalika alddiynu alqayyimu fala tazlimu fiyhinna anfusakum vaqatilu almushrikiyna kaffatan kama yuqatilunakum kaffatan vai'lamu anna Alloha ma'a almuttaqiyna

Innama alnnasiyo ziyadatun fiy alkufri yudallu bihi allaziyna kafaru yuhillunahu 'aman vayuharrimunahu 'aman liyuvatiu 'iddata ma harrama Allohu fayuhillu ma harrama Allohu zuyyina lahum suo a'malihim vaAllohu la yahdiy alqavma alkafiriyna

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu ma lakum iza qiyla lakumu infiru fiy sabiyli Allohi izzaqaltum ila alardi aradiytum bialhayati alddunya mina alaxirati fama mata'u alhayati alddunya fiy alaxirati illa qaliylun
Illa tanfiru yu'azzibkum 'azaban aliyman vayastabdil qavman g'ayrakum vala tadurruhu shayan vaAllohu 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun

Illa tansuruhu faqad nasarahu Allohu iz axrajahu allaziyna kafaru zaniya iznayni iz huma fiy alg'ari iz yaqulu lisahibihi la tahzan inna Alloha ma'ana fanzala Allohu sakiynatahu 'alayhi vayyadahu bijunudin lam taravha vaja'ala kalimata allaziyna kafaru alssufla vakalimatu Allohi hiya al'ulya vaAllohu 'aziyzun hakiymun
Infiru xifafan vaziqalan vajahidu biamvalikum vanfusikum fiy sabiyli Allohi zalikum xayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamuna

Lav kana 'aradan qariyban vasafaran qasidan laittaba'uka valakin ba'udat 'alayhimu alshshuqqatu vasayahlifuna biAllohi lavi istata'na laxarajna ma'akum yuhlikuna anfusahum vaAllohu ya'lamu innahum lakazibuna
'afa Allohu 'anka lima azinta lahum hatta yatabayyana laka allaziyna sadaqu vata'lama alkazibiyna
La yastazinuka allaziyna yuminuna biAllohi valyavmi alaxiri an yujahidu biamvalihim vanfusihim vaAllohu 'aliymun bialmuttaqiyna
Innama yastazinuka allaziyna la yuminuna biAllohi valyavmi alaxiri vairtabat qulubuhum fahum fiy raybihim yataraddaduna
Valav aradu alxuruja la'addu lahu 'uddatan valakin kariha Allohu inbi'asahum fasabbatahum vaqiyla oq'udu ma'a alqa'idiyna
Lav xaraju fiykum ma zadukum illa xabalan valavda'u xilalakum yabg'unakumu alfitnata vafiykum samma'una lahum vaAllohu 'aliymun bialzzalimiyna
Laqadi ibtag'avu alfitnata min qablu vaqallabu laka alomura hatta ja alhaqqu vazahara amru Allohi vahum karihuna
Vaminhum man yaqulu izan liy vala taftinniy ala fiy alfitnati saqatu vainna jahannama lamuhiytatun bialkafiriyna
In tusibka hasanatun tasuhum vain tusibka musiybatun yaqulu qad axazna amrana min qablu vayatavallav vahum farihuna
Qul lan yusiybana illa ma kataba Allohu lana huva mavlana va'ala Allohi falyatavakkali almuminuna
Qul hal tarabbasuna bina illa ihda alhusnayayni vanahnu natarabbasu bikum an yusiybakumu Allohu bi'azabin min 'indihi av biaydiyna fatarabbasu inna ma'akum mutarabbisuna
Qul anfiqu tav'an av karhan lan yutaqabbala minkum innakum kuntum qavman fasiqiyna
Vama mana'ahum an tuqbala minhum nafaqatuhum illa annahum kafaru biAllohi vabirasulihi vala yatuna alssalata illa vahum kusala vala yunfiquna illa vahum karihuna
Fala tu'jibka amvaluhum vala avladuhum innama yuriydu Allohu liyu'azzibahum biha fiy alhayati alddunya vatazhaqa anfusuhum vahum kafiruna
Vayahlifuna biAllohi innahum laminkum vama hum minkum valakinnahum qavmun yafraquna
Lav yajiduna maljan av mag'aratin av muddaxalan lavallav ilayhi vahum yajmahuna
Vaminhum man yalmizuka fiy alssadaqati fain o'tu minha radu vain lam yu'tav minha iza hum yasxatuna
Valav annahum radu ma atahumu Allohu varasuluhu vaqalu hasbuna Allohu sayutiyna Allohu min fadlihi varasuluhu inna ila Allohi rag'ibuna

Innama alssadaqatu lilfuqarai valmasakiyni val'amiliyna 'alayha valmuallafati qulubuhum vafiy alrriqabi valg'arimiyna vafiy sabiyli Allohi vaibni alssabiyli fariydatan mina Allohi vaAllohu 'aliymun hakiymun

Vaminhumu allaziyna yuzuna alnnabiyya vayaquluna huva ozunun qul ozunu xayrin lakum yuminu biAllohi vayuminu lilmuminiyna varahmatun lillaziyna amanu minkum vallaziyna yuzuna rasula Allohi lahum 'azabun aliymun
Yahlifuna biAllohi lakum liyurdukum vaAllohu varasuluhu ahaqqu an yurduhu in kanu muminiyna
Alam ya'lamu annahu man yuhadidi Alloha varasulahu fanna lahu nara jahannama xalidan fiyha zalika alxizyu al'aziymu
Yahzaru almunafiquna an tunazzala 'alayhim suratun tunabbiohum bima fiy qulubihim quli istahziu inna Alloha muxrijun ma tahzaruna
Valain saltahum layaqulunna innama kunna naxudu vanal'abu qul abiAllohi vayatihi varasulihi kuntum tastahziuna
La ta'taziru qad kafartum ba'da iymanikum in na'fu 'an taifatin minkum nu'azzib taifatan biannahum kanu mujrimiyna
Almunafiquna valmunafiqatu ba'duhum min ba'din yamuruna bialmunkari vayanhavna 'ani alma'rufi vayaqbiduna aydiyahum nasu Alloha fanasiyahum inna almunafiqiyna humu alfasiquna
Va'ada Allohu almunafiqiyna valmunafiqati valkuffara nara jahannama xalidiyna fiyha hiya hasbuhum vala'anahumu Allohu valahum 'azabun muqiymun

Kallaziyna min qablikum kanu ashadda minkum quvvatan vakzara amvalan vavladan faistamta'u bixalaqihim faistamta'tum bixalaqikum kama istamta'a allaziyna min qablikum bixalaqihim vaxudtum kallaziy xadu olaika habitat a'maluhum fiy alddunya valaxirati vaolaika humu alxasiruna

Alam yatihim nabao allaziyna min qablihim qavmi nuhin va'adin vazamuda vaqavmi ibrahiyma vashabi madyana valmutafikati atazum rusuluhum bialbayyinati fama kana Allohu liyazlimahum valakin kanu anfusahum yazlimuna

Valmuminuna valmuminatu ba'duhum avliyao ba'din yamuruna bialma'rufi vayanhavna 'ani almunkari vayuqiymuna alssalata vayutuna alzzakata vayutiy'una Alloha varasulahu olaika sayarhamuhumu Allohu inna Alloha 'aziyzun hakiymun
Va'ada Allohu almuminiyna valmuminati jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu xalidiyna fiyha vamasakina tayyibatan fiy jannati 'adnin varidvanun mina Allohi akbaru zalika huva alfavzu al'aziymu
Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu jahidi alkuffara valmunafiqiyna vaog'luz 'alayhim vamavahum jahannamu vabisa almasiyru

Yahlifuna biAllohi ma qalu valaqad qalu kalimata alkufri vakafaru ba'da islamihim vahammu bima lam yanalu vama naqamu illa an ag'nahumu Allohu varasuluhu min fadlihi fain yatubu yaku xayran lahum vain yatavallav yu'azzibhumu Allohu 'azaban aliyman fiy alddunya valaxirati vama lahum fiy alardi min valiyyin vala nasiyrin
Vaminhum man 'ahada Alloha lain atana min fadlihi lanassaddaqanna valanakunanna mina alssalihiyna
Falamma atahum min fadlihi baxilu bihi vatavallav vahum mu'riduna
Fa'qabahum nifaqan fiy qulubihim ila yavmi yalqavnahu bima axlafu Alloha ma va'aduhu vabima kanu yakzibuna
Alam ya'lamu anna Alloha ya'lamu sirrahum vanajvahum vanna Alloha 'allamu alg'uyubi
Allaziyna yalmizuna almuttavvi'iyna mina almuminiyna fiy alssadaqati vallaziyna la yajiduna illa juhdahum fayasxaruna minhum saxira Allohu minhum valahum 'azabun aliymun
Istag'fir lahum av la tastag'fir lahum in tastag'fir lahum sab'iyna marratan falan yag'fira Allohu lahum zalika biannahum kafaru biAllohi varasulihi vaAllohu la yahdiy alqavma alfasiqiyna

Fariha almuxallafuna bimaq'adihim xilafa rasuli Allohi vakarihu an yujahidu biamvalihim vanfusihim fiy sabiyli Allohi vaqalu la tanfiru fiy alharri qul naru jahannama ashaddu harran lav kanu yafqahuna
Falyadhaku qaliylan valyabku kasiyran jazan bima kanu yaksibuna
Fain raja'aka Allohu ila taifatin minhum faistazanuka lilxuruji faqul lan taxruju ma'iya abadan valan tuqatilu ma'iya 'aduvvan innakum radiytum bialqu'udi avvala marratin faoq'udu ma'a alxalifiyna
Vala tusalli 'ala ahadin minhum mata abadan vala taqum 'ala qabrihi innahum kafaru biAllohi varasulihi vamatu vahum fasiquna
Vala tu'jibka amvaluhum vavladuhum innama yuriydu Allohu an yu'azzibahum biha fiy alddunya vatazhaqa anfusuhum vahum kafiruna
Vaiza onzilat suratun an aminu biAllohi vajahidu ma'a rasulihi istazanaka olu alttavli minhum vaqalu zarna nakun ma'a alqa'idiyna
Radu bian yakunu ma'a alxavalifi vatubi'a 'ala qulubihim fahum la yafqahuna
Lakini alrrasulu vallaziyna amanu ma'ahu jahadu biamvalihim vanfusihim vaolaika lahumu alxayratu vaolaika humu almuflihuna
A'adda Allohu lahum jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu xalidiyna fiyha zalika alfavzu al'aziymu
Vaja almu'azziruna mina ala'rabi liyuzana lahum vaqa'ada allaziyna kazabu Alloha varasulahu sayusiybu allaziyna kafaru minhum 'azabun aliymun
Laysa 'ala alddu'afai vala 'ala almarda vala 'ala allaziyna la yajiduna ma yunfiquna harajun iza nasahu lillahi varasulihi ma 'ala almuhsiniyna min sabiylin vaAllohu g'afurun rahiymun
Vala 'ala allaziyna iza ma atavka litahmilahum qulta la ajidu ma ahmilukum 'alayhi tavallav va'yunuhum tafiydu mina alddam'i hazanan alla yajidu ma yunfiquna
Innama alssabiylu 'ala allaziyna yastazinunaka vahum ag'niyao radu bian yakunu ma'a alxavalifi vataba'a Allohu 'ala qulubihim fahum la ya'lamuna

Ya'taziruna ilaykum iza raja'tum ilayhim qul la ta'taziru lan numina lakum qad nabbana Allohu min axbarikum vasayara Allohu 'amalakum varasuluhu zumma turadduna ila 'alimi alg'aybi valshshahadati fayunabbiokum bima kuntum ta'maluna
Sayahlifuna biAllohi lakum iza inqalabtum ilayhim litu'ridu 'anhum fa'ridu 'anhum innahum rijsun vamavahum jahannamu jazan bima kanu yaksibuna
Yahlifuna lakum litardav 'anhum fain tardav 'anhum fainna Alloha la yarda 'ani alqavmi alfasiqiyna
Ala'rabu ashaddu kufran vanifaqan vajdaru alla ya'lamu hududa ma anzala Allohu 'ala rasulihi vaAllohu 'aliymun hakiymun
Vamina ala'rabi man yattaxizu ma yunfiqu mag'raman vayatarabbasu bikumu alddavaira 'alayhim dairatu alssavi vaAllohu samiy'un 'aliymun

Vamina ala'rabi man yuminu biAllohi valyavmi alaxiri vayattaxizu ma yunfiqu qurubatin 'inda Allohi vasalavati alrrasuli ala innaha qurbatun lahum sayudxiluhumu Allohu fiy rahmatihi inna Alloha g'afurun rahiymun

Valssabiquna alavvaluna mina almuhajiriyna valansari vallaziyna ittaba'uhum biihsanin radiya Allohu 'anhum varadu 'anhu va'adda lahum jannatin tajriy tahtaha alanharu xalidiyna fiyha abadan zalika alfavzu al'aziymu
Vamimman havlakum mina ala'rabi munafiquna vamin ahli almadiynati maradu 'ala alnnifaqi la ta'lamuhum nahnu na'lamuhum sanu'azzibuhum marratayni zumma yuradduna ila 'azabin 'aziymin
Vaxaruna i'tarafu bizunubihim xalatu 'amalan salihan vaxara sayyian 'asa Allohu an yatuba 'alayhim inna Alloha g'afurun rahiymun
Xuz min amvalihim sadaqatan tutahhiruhum vatuzakkiyhim biha vasalli 'alayhim inna salataka sakanun lahum vaAllohu samiy'un 'aliymun
Alam ya'lamu anna Alloha huva yaqbalu alttavbata 'an 'ibadihi vayaxuzu alssadaqati vanna Alloha huva alttavvabu alrrahiymu
Vaquli i'malu fasayara Allohu 'amalakum varasuluhu valmuminuna vasaturadduna ila 'alimi alg'aybi valshshahadati fayunabbiokum bima kuntum ta'maluna
Vaxaruna murjavna liamri Allohi imma yu'azzibuhum vaimma yatubu 'alayhim vaAllohu 'aliymun hakiymun

Vallaziyna ittaxazu masjidan diraran vakufran vatafriyqan bayna almuminiyna vairsadan liman haraba Alloha varasulahu min qablu valayahlifunna in aradna illa alhusna vaAllohu yashhadu innahum lakazibuna
La taqum fiyhi abadan lamasjidun ossisa 'ala alttaqva min avvali yavmin ahaqqu an taquma fiyhi fiyhi rijalun yuhibbuna an yatatahharu vaAllohu yuhibbu almuttahhiriyna
Afaman assasa bunyanahu 'ala taqva mina Allohi varidvanin xayrun am man assasa bunyanahu 'ala shafa jurufin harin fainhara bihi fiy nari jahannama vaAllohu la yahdiy alqavma alzzalimiyna
La yazalu bunyanuhumu allaziy banav riybatan fiy qulubihim illa an taqatta'a qulubuhum vaAllohu 'aliymun hakiymun

Inna Alloha ishtara mina almuminiyna anfusahum vamvalahum bianna lahumu aljannata yuqatiluna fiy sabiyli Allohi fayaqtuluna vayuqtaluna va'dan 'alayhi haqqan fiy alttavrati valinjiyli valqurani vaman avfa bi'ahdihi mina Allohi faistabshiru bibay'ikumu allaziy baya'tum bihi vazalika huva alfavzu al'aziymu
Alttaibuna al'abiduna alhamiduna alssaihuna alrraki'una alssajiduna alamiruna bialma'rufi valnnahuna 'ani almunkari valhafizuna lihududi Allohi vabashshiri almuminiyna
Ma kana lilnnabiyyi vallaziyna amanu an yastag'firu lilmushrikiyna valav kanu oliy qurba min ba'di ma tabayyana lahum annahum ashabu aljahiymi
Vama kana istig'faru ibrahiyma liabiyhi illa 'an mav'idatin va'adaha iyyahu falamma tabayyana lahu annahu 'aduvvun lillahi tabarra minhu inna ibrahiyma lavvahun haliymun
Vama kana Allohu liyudilla qavman ba'da iz hadahum hatta yubayyina lahum ma yattaquna inna Alloha bikulli shayin 'aliymun
Inna Alloha lahu mulku alssamavati valardi yuhyiy vayumiytu vama lakum min duni Allohi min valiyyin vala nasiyrin
Laqad taba Allohu 'ala alnnabiyyi valmuhajiriyna valansari allaziyna ittaba'uhu fiy sa'ati al'usrati min ba'di ma kada yaziyg'u qulubu fariyqin minhum zumma taba 'alayhim innahu bihim raufun rahiymun

Va'ala alzzalazati allaziyna xullifu hatta iza daqat 'alayhimu alardu bima rahubat vadaqat 'alayhim anfusuhum vazannu an la malja mina Allohi illa ilayhi zumma taba 'alayhim liyatubu inna Alloha huva alttavvabu alrrahiymu
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu ittaqu Alloha vakunu ma'a alssadiqiyna

Ma kana liahli almadiynati vaman havlahum mina ala'rabi an yataxallafu 'an rasuli Allohi vala yarg'abu bianfusihim 'an nafsihi zalika biannahum la yusiybuhum zamaon vala nasabun vala maxmasatun fiy sabiyli Allohi vala yatauna mavtian yag'iyzu alkuffara vala yanaluna min 'aduvvin naylan illa kutiba lahum bihi 'amalun salihun inna Alloha la yudiy'u ajra almuhsiniyna
Vala yunfiquna nafaqatan sag'iyratan vala kabiyratan vala yaqta'una vadiyan illa kutiba lahum liyajziyahumu Allohu ahsana ma kanu ya'maluna
Vama kana almuminuna liyanfiru kaffatan falavla nafara min kulli firqatin minhum taifatun liyatafaqqahu fiy alddiyni valiyunziru qavmahum iza raja'u ilayhim la'llohum yahzaruna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu qatilu allaziyna yalunakum mina alkuffari valyajidu fiykum g'ilzatan vai'lamu anna Alloha ma'a almuttaqiyna
Vaiza ma onzilat suratun faminhum man yaqulu ayyukum zadazu hazihi iymanan famma allaziyna amanu fazadazum iymanan vahum yastabshiruna
Vamma allaziyna fiy qulubihim maradun fazadazum rijsan ila rijsihim vamatu vahum kafiruna
Avala yaravna annahum yuftanuna fiy kulli 'amin marratan av marratayni zumma la yatubuna vala hum yazzakkaruna
Vaiza ma onzilat suratun nazara ba'duhum ila ba'din hal yarakum min ahadin zumma insarafu sarafa Allohu qulubahum biannahum qavmun la yafqahuna
Laqad jakum rasulun min anfusikum 'aziyzun 'alayhi ma 'anittum hariysun 'alaykum bialmuminiyna raufun rahiymun
Fain tavallav faqul hasbiya Allohu la ilaha illa huva 'alayhi tavakkaltu vahuva rabbu al'arshi al'aziymi
Aliflamra tilka ayatu alkitabi alhakiymi
Akana lilnnasi 'ajaban an avhayna ila rajulin minhum an anziri alnnasa vabashshiri allaziyna amanu anna lahum qadama sidqin 'inda rabbihim qala alkafiruna inna haza lasahirun mubiynun

Inna rabbakumu Allohu allaziy xalaqa alssamavati valarda fiy sittati ayyamin zumma istava 'ala al'arshi yudabbiru alamra ma min shafiy'in illa min ba'di iznihi zalikumu Allohu rabbukum fao'buduhu afala tazakkaruna

Ilayhi marji'ukum jamiy'an va'da Allohi haqqan innahu yabdao alxalqa zumma yu'iyduhu liyajziya allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati bialqisti vallaziyna kafaru lahum sharabun min hamiymin va'azabun aliymun bima kanu yakfuruna
Huva allaziy ja'ala alshshamsa diyan valqamara nuran vaqaddarahu manazila lita'lamu 'adada alssiniyna valhisaba ma xalaqa Allohu zalika illa bialhaqqi yufassilu alayati liqavmin ya'lamuna
Inna fiy ixtilafi allayli valnnahari vama xalaqa Allohu fiy alssamavati valardi layatin liqavmin yattaquna
Inna allaziyna la yarjuna liqana varadu bialhayati alddunya vaitmannu biha vallaziyna hum 'an ayatina g'afiluna
Olaika mavahumu alnnaru bima kanu yaksibuna
Inna allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati yahdiyhim rabbuhum biiymanihim tajriy min tahtihimu alanharu fiy jannati alnna'iymi
Da'vahum fiyha subhanaka llohumma vatahiyyatuhum fiyha salamun vaxiru da'vahum ani alhamdu lillahi rabbi al'alamiyna
Valav yu'ajjilu Allohu lilnnasi alshsharra isti'jalahum bialxayri laqudiya ilayhim ajaluhum fanazaru allaziyna la yarjuna liqana fiy tug'yanihim ya'mahuna
Vaiza massa alinsana alddurru da'ana lijanbihi av qa'idan av qaiman falamma kashafna 'anhu durrahu marra kan lam yad'una ila durrin massahu kazalika zuyyina lilmusrifiyna ma kanu ya'maluna
Valaqad ahlakna alquruna min qablikum lamma zalamu vajazum rusuluhum bialbayyinati vama kanu liyuminu kazalika najziy alqavma almujrimiyna
Zumma ja'alnakum xalaifa fiy alardi min ba'dihim linanzura kayfa ta'maluna

Vaiza tutla 'alayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allaziyna la yarjuna liqana iti biquranin g'ayri haza av baddilhu qul ma yakunu liy an obaddilahu min tilqai nafsiy in attabi'u illa ma yuha ilayya inniy axafu in 'asaytu rabbiy 'azaba yavmin 'aziymin
Qul lav sha Allohu ma talavtuhu 'alaykum vala adrakum bihi faqad labistu fiykum 'umuran min qablihi afala ta'qiluna
Faman azlamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allohi kaziban av kazzaba biayatihi innahu la yuflihu almujrimuna

Vaya'buduna min duni Allohi ma la yadurruhum vala yanfa'uhum vayaquluna haolai shufa'aona 'inda Allohi qul atunabbiuna Alloha bima la ya'lamu fiy alssamavati vala fiy alardi subhanahu vata'ala 'amma yushrikuna
Vama kana alnnasu illa ommatan vahidatan faixtalafu valavla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laqudiya baynahum fiyma fiyhi yaxtalifuna
Vayaquluna lavla onzila 'alayhi ayatun min rabbihi faqul innama alg'aybu lillahi faintaziru inniy ma'akum mina almuntaziriyna
Vaiza azaqna alnnasa rahmatan min ba'di darra massazum iza lahum makrun fiy ayatina quli Allohu asra'u makran inna rusulana yaktubuna ma tamkuruna

Huva allaziy yusayyirukum fiy albarri valbahri hatta iza kuntum fiy alfulki vajarayna bihim biriyhin tayyibatin vafarihu biha jaza riyhun 'asifun vajahumu almavju min kulli makanin vazannu annahum ohiyta bihim da'avu Alloha muxlisiyna lahu alddiyna lain anjaytana min hazihi lanakunanna mina alshshakiriyna
Falamma anjahum iza hum yabg'una fiy alardi big'ayri alhaqqi ya ayyuha alnnasu innama bag'yukum 'ala anfusikum mata'a alhayati alddunya zumma ilayna marji'ukum fanunabbiokum bima kuntum ta'maluna

Innama mazalu alhayati alddunya kamain anzalnahu mina alssamai faixtalata bihi nabatu alardi mimma yakulu alnnasu valan'amu hatta iza axazati alardu zuxrufaha vaizzayyanat vazanna ahluha annahum qadiruna 'alayha ataha amruna laylan av naharan faja'alnaha hasiydan kan lam tag'na bialamsi kazalika nufassilu alayati liqavmin yatafakkaruna
VaAllohu yad'u ila dari alssalami vayahdiy man yashao ila siratin mustaqiymin
Lillaziyna ahsanu alhusna vaziyadatun vala yarhaqu vujuhahum qatarun vala zillatun olaika ashabu aljannati hum fiyha xaliduna

Vallaziyna kasabu alssayyiati jazao sayyiatin bimizliha vatarhaquhum zillatun ma lahum mina Allohi min 'asimin kannama og'shiyat vujuhuhum qita'an mina allayli muzliman olaika ashabu alnnari hum fiyha xaliduna
Vayavma nahshuruhum jamiy'an zumma naqulu lillaziyna ashraku makanakum antum vashurakaokum fazayyalna baynahum vaqala shurakaohum ma kuntum iyyana ta'buduna
Fakafa biAllohi shahiydan baynana vabaynakum in kunna 'an 'ibadatikum lag'afiliyna
Hunalika tablu kullu nafsin ma aslafat varuddu ila Allohi mavlahumu alhaqqi vadalla 'anhum ma kanu yaftaruna

Qul man yarzuqukum mina alssamai valardi amman yamliku alssam'a valabsara vaman yuxriju alhayya mina almayyiti vayuxriju almayyita mina alhayyi vaman yudabbiru alamra fasayaquluna Allohu faqul afala tattaquna
Fazalikumu Allohu rabbukumu alhaqqu famaza ba'da alhaqqi illa alddalalu fanna tusrafuna
Kazalika haqqat kalimatu rabbika 'ala allaziyna fasaqu annahum la yuminuna
Qul hal min shurakaikum man yabdao alxalqa summa yu'iyduhu quli Allohu yabdao alxalqa summa yu'iyduhu fanna tufakuna
Qul hal min shurakaikum man yahdiy ila alhaqqi quli Allohu yahdiy lilhaqqi afaman yahdiy ila alhaqqi ahaqqu an yuttaba'a amman la yahiddiy illa an yuhda fama lakum kayfa tahkumuna
Vama yattabi'u akzaruhum illa zannan inna alzzanna la yug'niy mina alhaqqi shayan inna Alloha 'aliymun bima yaf'aluna
