Vama kana haza alquranu an yuftara min duni Allohi valakin tasdiyqa allaziy bayna yadayhi vatafsiyla alkitabi la rayba fiyhi min rabbi al'alamiyna
Am yaquluna iftarahu qul fatu bisuratin mislihi vaod'u mani istata'tum min duni Allohi in kuntum sadiqiyna
Bal kazzabu bima lam yuhiytu bi'ilmihi valamma yatihim taviyluhu kazalika kazzaba allaziyna min qablihim faonzur kayfa kana 'aqibatu alzzalimiyna
Vaminhum man yuminu bihi vaminhum man la yuminu bihi varabbuka a'lamu bialmufsidiyna
Vain kazzabuka faqul liy 'amaliy valakum 'amalukum antum bariyuna mimma a'malu vana bariyon mimma ta'maluna
Vaminhum man yastami'una ilayka afanta tusmi'u alssumma valav kanu la ya'qiluna
Vaminhum man yanzuru ilayka afanta tahdiy al'umya valav kanu la yubsiruna
Inna Alloha la yazlimu alnnasa shayan valakinna alnnasa anfusahum yazlimuna
Vayavma yahshuruhum kan lam yalbazu illa sa'atan mina alnnahari yata'arafuna baynahum qad xasira allaziyna kazzabu biliqai Allohi vama kanu muhtadiyna
Vaimma nuriyannaka ba'da allaziy na'iduhum av natavaffayannaka failayna marji'uhum zumma Allohu shahiydun 'ala ma yaf'aluna
Valikulli ommatin rasulun faiza ja rasuluhum qudiya baynahum bialqisti vahum la yuzlamuna
Vayaquluna mata haza alva'du in kuntum sadiqiyna
Qul la amliku linafsiy darran vala naf'an illa ma sha Allohu likulli ommatin ajalun iza ja ajaluhum fala yastaxiruna sa'atan vala yastaqdimuna
Qul araytum in atakum 'azabuhu bayatan av naharan maza yasta'jilu minhu almujrimuna
Azumma iza ma vaqa'a amantum bihi alana vaqad kuntum bihi tasta'jiluna
Zumma qiyla lillaziyna zalamu zuqu 'azaba alxuldi hal tujzavna illa bima kuntum taksibuna
Vayastanbiunaka ahaqqun huva qul iy varabbiy innahu lahaqqun vama antum bimu'jiziyna
Valav anna likulli nafsin zalamat ma fiy alardi laiftadat bihi vasarru alnnadamata lamma ravu al'azaba vaqudiya baynahum bialqisti vahum la yuzlamuna
Ala inna lillahi ma fiy alssamavati valardi ala inna va'da Allohi haqqun valakinna aksarahum la ya'lamuna
Huva yuhyiy vayumiytu vailayhi turja'una
Ya ayyuha alnnasu qad jatkum mav'izatun min rabbikum vashifaon lima fiy alssuduri vahudan varahmatun lilmuminiyna
Qul bifadli Allohi vabirahmatihi fabizalika falyafrahu huva xayrun mimma yajma'una
Qul araytum ma anzala Allohu lakum min rizqin faja'altum minhu haraman vahalalan qul llohu azina lakum am 'ala Allohi taftaruna
Vama zannu allaziyna yaftaruna 'ala Allohi alkaziba yavma alqiyamati inna Alloha lazu fadlin 'ala alnnasi valakinna akzarahum la yashkuruna

Vama takunu fiy shanin vama tatlu minhu min quranin vala ta'maluna min 'amalin illa kunna 'alaykum shuhudan iz tufiyduna fiyhi vama ya'zubu 'an rabbika min mizqali zarratin fiy alardi vala fiy alssamai vala asg'ara min zalika vala akbara illa fiy kitabin mubiynun
Ala inna avliya Allohi la xavfun 'alayhim vala hum yahzanuna
Allaziyna amanu vakanu yattaquna
Lahumu albushra fiy alhayati alddunya vafiy alaxirati la tabdiyla likalimati Allohi zalika huva alfavzu al'aziymu
Vala yahzunka qavluhum inna al'izzata lillahi jamiy'an huva alssamiy'u al'aliymu
Ala inna lillahi man fiy alssamavati vaman fiy alardi vama yattabi'u allaziyna yad'una min duni Allohi shuraka in yattabi'una illa alzzanna vain hum illa yaxrusuna
Huva allaziy ja'ala lakumu allayla litaskunu fiyhi valnnahara mubsiran inna fiy zalika layatin liqavmin yasma'una
Qalu ittaxaza Allohu valadan subhanahu huva alg'aniyyu lahu ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi in 'indakum min sultanin bihaza ataquluna 'ala Allohi ma la ta'lamuna
Qul inna allaziyna yaftaruna 'ala Allohi alkaziba la yuflihuna
Mata'un fiy alddunya zumma ilayna marji'uhum zumma nuziyquhumu al'azaba alshshadiyda bima kanu yakfuruna

Vaotlu 'alayhim naba nuhin iz qala liqavmihi ya qavmi in kana kabura 'alaykum maqamiy vatazkiyriy biayati Allohi fa'ala Allohi tavakkaltu fajmi'u amrakum vashurakakum zumma la yakun amrukum 'alaykum g'ummatan zumma iqdu ilayya vala tunziruni
Fain tavallaytum fama saltukum min ajrin in ajriya illa 'ala Allohi vaomirtu an akuna mina almuslimiyna
Fakazzabuhu fanajjaynahu vaman ma'ahu fiy alfulki vaja'alnahum xalaifa vag'raqna allaziyna kazzabu biayatina faonzur kayfa kana 'aqibatu almunzariyna
Zumma ba'azna min ba'dihi rusulan ila qavmihim fajauhum bialbayyinati fama kanu liyuminu bima kazzabu bihi min qablu kazalika natba'u 'ala qulubi almu'tadiyna
Summa ba'asna min ba'dihim musa vaharuna ila fir'avna vamalaihi biayatina faistakbaru vakanu qavman mujrimiyna
Falamma jahumu alhaqqu min 'indina qalu inna haza lasihrun mubiynun
Qala musa ataquluna lilhaqqi lamma jakum asihrun haza vala yuflihu alssahiruna
Qalu ajitana litalfitana 'amma vajadna 'alayhi abana vatakuna lakuma alkibriyao fiy alardi vama nahnu lakuma bimuminiyna
Vaqala fir'avnu ituniy bikulli sahirin 'aliymin
Falamma ja alssaharatu qala lahum musa alqu ma antum mulquna
Falamma alqav qala musa ma jitum bihi alssihru inna Alloha sayubtiluhu inna Alloha la yuslihu 'amala almufsidiyna
Vayuhiqqu Allohu alhaqqa bikalimatihi valav kariha almujrimuna
Fama amana limusa illa zurriyyatun min qavmihi 'ala xavfin min fir'avna vamalaihim an yaftinahum vainna fir'avna la'alin fiy alardi vainnahu lamina almusrifiyna
Vaqala musa ya qavmi in kuntum amantum biAllohi fa'alayhi tavakkalu in kuntum muslimiyna
Faqalu 'ala Allohi tavakkalna rabbana la taj'alna fitnatan lilqavmi alzzalimiyna
Vanajjina birahmatika mina alqavmi alkafiriyna
Vavhayna ila musa vaxiyhi an tabavva liqavmikuma bimisra buyutan vaij'alu buyutakum qiblatan vaqiymu alssalata vabashshiri almuminiyna

Vaqala musa rabbana innaka atayta fir'avna vamalahu ziynatan vamvalan fiy alhayati alddunya rabbana liyudillu 'an sabiylika rabbana itmis 'ala amvalihim vaoshdud 'ala qulubihim fala yuminu hatta yaravu al'azaba alaliyma
Qala qad ojiybat da'vatukuma faistaqiyma vala tattabi'anni sabiyla allaziyna la ya'lamuna

Vajavazna bibaniy israiyla albahra fatba'ahum fir'avnu vajunuduhu bag'yan va'advan hatta iza adrakahu alg'araqu qala amantu annahu la ilaha illa allaziy amanat bihi banu israiyla vana mina almuslimiyna
Alana vaqad 'asayta qablu vakunta mina almufsidiyna
Falyavma nunajjiyka bibadanika litakuna liman xalfaka ayatan vainna kasiyran mina alnnasi 'an ayatina lag'afiluna
Valaqad bavvana baniy israiyla mubavva sidqin varazaqnahum mina alttayyibati fama ixtalafu hatta jahumu al'ilmu inna rabbaka yaqdiy baynahum yavma alqiyamati fiyma kanu fiyhi yaxtalifuna
Fain kunta fiy shakkin mimma anzalnna ilayka faisali allaziyna yaqrauna alkitaba min qablika laqad jaka alhaqqu min rabbika fala takunanna mina almumtariyna
Vala takunanna mina allaziyna kazzabu biayati Allohi fatakuna mina alxasiriyna
Inna allaziyna haqqat 'alayhim kalimatu rabbika la yuminuna
Valav jazum kullu ayatin hatta yaravu al'azaba alaliyma
Falavla kanat qaryatun amanat fanafa'aha iymanuha illa qavma yunusa lamma amanu kashafna 'anhum 'azaba alxizyi fiy alhayati alddunya vamatta'nahum ila hiynin
Valav sha rabbuka lamana man fiy alardi kulluhum jamiy'an afanta tukrihu alnnasa hatta yakunu muminiyna
Vama kana linafsin an tumina illa biizni Allohi vayaj'alu alrrijsa 'ala allaziyna la ya'qiluna
Quli onzuru maza fiy alssamavati valardi vama tug'niy alayatu valnnuzuru 'an qavmin la yuminuna
Fahal yantaziruna illa mizla ayyami allaziyna xalav min qablihim qul faintaziru inniy ma'akum mina almuntaziriyna
Zumma nunajjiy rusulana vallaziyna amanu kazalika haqqan 'alayna nunjiy almuminiyna
Qul ya ayyuha alnnasu in kuntum fiy shakkin min diyniy fala a'budu allaziyna ta'buduna min duni Allohi valakin a'budu Alloha allaziy yatavaffakum vaomirtu an akuna mina almuminiyna
Van aqim vajhaka lilddiyni haniyfan vala takunanna mina almushrikiyna
Vala tad'u min duni Allohi ma la yanfa'uka vala yadurruka fain fa'alta fainnaka izan mina alzzalimiyna
Vain yamsaska Allohu bidurrin fala kashifa lahu illa huva vain yuridka bixayrin fala radda lifadlihi yusiybu bihi man yashao min 'ibadihi vahuva alg'afuru alrrahiymu
Qul ya ayyuha alnnasu qad jakumu alhaqqu min rabbikum famani ihtada fainnama yahtadiy linafsihi vaman dalla fainnama yadillu 'alayha vama ana 'alaykum bivakiylin
Vaittabi' ma yuha ilayka vaisbir hatta yahkuma Allohu vahuva xayru alhakimiyna
Aliflamra kitabun ohkimat ayatuhu summa fussilat min ladun hakiymin xabiyrin
Alla ta'budu illa Alloha innaniy lakum minhu naziyrun vabashiyrun
Vani istag'firu rabbakum zumma tubu ilayhi yumatti'kum mata'an hasanan ila ajalin musamman vayuti kulla ziy fadlin fadlahu vain tavallav fainiy axafu 'alaykum 'azaba yavmin kabiyrin
Ila Allohi marji'ukum vahuva 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun
Ala innahum yaznuna sudurahum liyastaxfu minhu ala hiyna yastag'shuna ziyabahum ya'lamu ma yusirruna vama yu'linuna innahu 'aliymun bizati alssuduri
Vama min dabbatin fiy alardi illa 'ala Allohi rizquha vaya'lamu mustaqarraha vamustavda'aha kullun fiy kitabin mubiynin

Vahuva allaziy xalaqa alssamavati valarda fiy sittati ayyamin vakana 'arshuhu 'ala almai liyabluvakum ayyukum ahsanu 'amalan valain qulta innakum mab'uzuna min ba'di almavti layaqulanna allaziyna kafaru in haza illa sihrun mubiynun
Valain axxarna 'anhumu al'azaba ila ommatin ma'dudatin layaqulunna ma yahbisuhu ala yavma yatiyhim laysa masrufan 'anhum vahaqa bihim ma kanu bihi yastahziuna
Valain azaqna alinsana minna rahmatan zumma naza'naha minhu innahu layausun kafurun
Valain azaqnahu na'ma ba'da darra massazu layaqulanna zahaba alssayyiatu 'anniy innahu lafarihun faxurun
Illa allaziyna sabaru va'amilu alssalihati olaika lahum mag'firatun vajrun kabiyrun
Fala'allaka tarikun ba'da ma yuha ilayka vadaiqun bihi sadruka an yaqulu lavla onzila 'alayhi kanzun av ja ma'ahu malakun innama anta naziyrun vaAllohu 'ala kulli shayin vakiylun
Am yaquluna iftarahu qul fatu bi'ashri suvarin mislihi muftarayatin vaod'u mani istata'tum min duni Allohi in kuntum sadiqiyna
Fai llam yastajiybu lakum fai'lamu annama onzila bi'ilmi Allohi van la ilaha illa huva fahal antum muslimuna
Man kana yuriydu alhayata alddunya vaziynataha nuvaffi ilayhim a'malahum fiyha vahum fiyha la yubxasuna
Olaika allaziyna laysa lahum fiy alaxirati illa alnnaru vahabita ma sana'u fiyha vabatilun ma kanu ya'maluna

Afaman kana 'ala bayyinatin min rabbihi vayatluhu shahidun minhu vamin qablihi kitabu musa imaman varahmatan olaika yuminuna bihi vaman yakfur bihi mina alahzabi falnnaru mav'iduhu fala taku fiy miryatin minhu innahu alhaqqu min rabbika valakinna aksara alnnasi la yuminuna
Vaman azlamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allohi kaziban olaika yu'raduna 'ala rabbihim vayaqulu alashhadu haolai allaziyna kazabu 'ala rabbihim ala la'natu Allohi 'ala alzzalimiyna
Allaziyna yasudduna 'an sabiyli Allohi vayabg'unaha 'ivajan vahum bialaxirati hum kafiruna
Olaika lam yakunu mu'jiziyna fiy alardi vama kana lahum min duni Allohi min avliya yuda'afu lahumu al'azabu ma kanu yastatiy'una alssam'a vama kanu yubsiruna
Olaika allaziyna xasiru anfusahum vadalla 'anhum ma kanu yaftaruna
La jarama annahum fiy alaxirati humu alaxsaruna
Inna allaziyna amanu va'amilu alsalihati vaxbatu ila rabbihim olaika ashabu aljannati hum fiyha xaliduna
Mazalu alfariyqayni kala'ma valasammi valbasiyri valssamiy'i hal yastaviyani mazalan afala tazakkaruna
Valaqad arsalna nuhan ila qavmihi inniy lakum naziyrun mubiynun
An la ta'budu illa Alloha inniy axafu 'alaykum 'azaba yavmin aliymin

Faqala almalao allaziyna kafaru min qavmihi ma naraka illa basharan mizlana vama naraka ittaba'aka illa allaziyna hum araziluna badiya alrrayi vama nara lakum 'alayna min fadlin bal nazunnukum kazibiyna
Qala ya qavmi araytum in kuntu 'ala bayyinatin min rabbiy vataniy rahmatan min 'indihi fa'ummiyat 'alaykum anulzimukumuha vantum laha karihuna
Vaya qavmi la asalukum 'alayhi malan in ajriya illa 'ala Allohi vama ana bitaridi allaziyna amanu innahum mulaqu rabbihim valakinniy arakum qavman tajhaluna
Vaya qavmi man yansuruniy mina Allohi in taradtuhum afala tazakkaruna

Vala aqulu lakum 'indiy xazainu Allohi vala a'lamu alg'ayba vala aqulu inniy malakun vala aqulu lillaziyna tazdariy a'yunukum lan yutiyahumu Allohu xayran Allohu a'lamu bima fiy anfusihim inniy izan lamina alzzalimiyna
Qalu ya nuhu qad jadaltana faksarta jidalana fatina bima ta'iduna in kunta mina alssadiqiyna
Qala innama yatiykum bihi Allohu in sha vama antum bimu'jiziyna
Vala yanfa'ukum nushiy in aradtu an ansaha lakum in kana Allohu yuriydu an yug'viyakum huva rabbukum vailayhi turja'una
Am yaquluna iftarahu qul ini iftaraytuhu fa'alayya ijramiy vana bariyon mimma tujrimuna
Vauhiya ila nuhin annahu lan yumina min qavmika illa man qad amana fala tabtais bima kanu yaf'aluna
Vaisna'i alfulka bia'yunina vavahyina vala tuxatibniy fiy allaziyna zalamu innahum mug'raquna
Vayasna'u alfulka vakullama marra 'alayhi malaon min qavmihi saxiru minhu qala in tasxaru minna fainna nasxaru minkum kama tasxaruna
Fasavfa ta'lamuna man yatiyhi 'azabun yuxziyhi vayahillu 'alayhi 'azabun muqiymun
Hatta iza ja amruna vafara alttannuru qulna ihmil fiyha min kullin zavjayni iznayni vahlaka illa man sabaqa 'alayhi alqavlu vaman amana vama amana ma'ahu illa qaliylun
Vaqala irkabu fiyha bismi Allohi majraha vamursaha inna rabbiy lag'afurun rahiymun
Vahiya tajriy bihim fiy mavjin kaljibali vanada nuhunu ibnahu vakana fiy ma'zilin ya bunayya irkab ma'ana vala takun ma'a alkafiriyna
Qala saviy ila jabalin ya'simuniy mina almai qala la 'asima alyavma min amri Allohi illa man rahima vahala baynahuma almavju fakana mina almug'raqiyna
Vaqiyla ya ardu ibla'iy maki vaya samao aqli'iy vag'iyda almao vaqudiya alamru vaistavat 'ala aljudiyyi vaqiyla bu'dan lilqavmi alzzalimiyna
Vanada nuhun rabbahu faqala rabbi inna ibniy min ahliy vainna va'daka alhaqqu vanta ahkamu alhakimiyna
Qala ya nuhu innahu laysa min ahlika innahu 'amalun g'ayru salihin fala tasalni ma laysa laka bihi 'ilmun inniy a'izuka an takuna mina aljahiliyna
Qala rabbi inniy a'uzu bika an asalaka ma laysa liy bihi 'ilmun vailla tag'fir liy vatarhamniy akun mina alxasiriyna
Qiyla ya nuhu ihbit bisalamin minna vabarakatin 'alayka va'ala omamin mimman ma'aka vaomamun sanumatti'uhum zumma yamassuhum minna 'azabun aliymun
Tilka min anbai alg'aybi nuhiyha ilayka ma kunta ta'lamuha anta vala qavmuka min qabli haza faisbir inna al'aqibata lilmuttaqiyna
Vaila 'adin axahum hudan qala ya qavmi o'budu Alloha ma lakum min ilahin g'ayruhu in antum illa muftaruna
Ya qavmi la asalukum 'alayhi ajran in ajriya illa 'ala allaziy fataraniy afala ta'qiluna
Vaya qavmi istag'firu rabbakum summa tubu ilayhi yursili alssama 'alaykum midraran vayazidkum quvvatan ila quvvatikum vala tatavallav mujrimiyna
Qalu ya hudu ma jitana bibayyinatin vama nahnu bitarikiy alihatina 'an qavlika vama nahnu laka bimuminiyna
In naqulu illa i'taraka ba'du alihatina bisuin qala inniy oshhidu Alloha vaishhadu anniy bariyon mimma tushrikuna
Min dunihi fakiyduniy jamiy'an zumma la tunziruni
Inniy tavakkaltu 'ala Allohi rabbiy varabbikum ma min dabbatin illa huva axizun binasiyatiha inna rabbiy 'ala siratin mustaqiymin
Fain tavallav faqad ablag'tukum ma orsiltu bihi ilaykum vayastaxlifu rabbiy qavman g'ayrakum vala tadurrunahu shayan inna rabbiy 'ala kulli shayin hafiyzun
Valamma ja amruna najjayna hudan vallaziyna amanu ma'ahu birahmatin minna vanajjaynahum min 'azabin g'aliyzin
Vatilka 'adun jahadu biayati rabbihim va'asav rusulahu vaittaba'u amra kulli jabbarin 'aniydin
Vaotbi'u fiy hazihi alddunya la'natan vayavma alqiyamati ala inna 'adan kafaru rabbahum ala bu'dan li'adin qavmi hudin
Vaila samuda axahum salihan qala ya qavmi o'budu Alloha ma lakum min ilahin g'ayruhu huva anshakum mina alardi vaista'marakum fiyha faistag'firuhu summa tubu ilayhi inna rabbiy qariybun mujiybun
Qalu ya salihu qad kunta fiyna marjuvvan qabla haza atanhana an na'buda ma ya'budu abaona vainnana lafiy shakkin mimma tad'una ilayhi muriybun
Qala ya qavmi araytum in kuntu 'ala bayyinatin min rabbiy vataniy minhu rahmatan faman yansuruniy mina Allohi in 'asaytuhu fama taziydunaniy g'ayra taxsiyrin
Vaya qavmi hazihi naqatu Allohi lakum ayatan fazaruha takul fiy ardi Allohi vala tamassuha bisuin fayaxuzakum 'azabun qariybun
Fa'aqaruha faqala tamatta'u fiy darikum zalazata ayyamin zalika va'dun g'ayru makzubin
Falamma ja amruna najjayna salihan vallaziyna amanu ma'ahu birahmatin minna vamin xizyi yavmiizin inna rabbaka huva alqaviyyu al'aziyzu
Vaxaza allaziyna zalamu alssayhatu fasbahu fiy diyarihim jazimiyna
Kan lam yag'nav fiyha ala inna samuda kafaru rabbahum ala bu'dan lisamuda
Valaqad jat rusuluna ibrahiyma bialbushra qalu salaman qala salamun fama labiza an ja bi'ijlin haniyzin
Falamma ra aydiyahum la tasilu ilayhi nakirahum vavjasa minhum xiyfatan qalu la taxaf inna orsilna ila qavmi lutin
Vaimratuhu qaimatun fadahikat fabashsharnaha biishaqa vamin varai ishaqa ya'quba
Qalat ya vaylata alidu vana 'ajuzun vahaza ba'liy shayxan inna haza lashayon 'ajiybun
Qalu ata'jabiyna min amri Allohi rahmatu Allohi vabarakatuhu 'alaykum ahla albayti innahu hamiydun majiydun
Falamma zahaba 'an ibrahiyma alrrav'u vajazu albushra yujadiluna fiy qavmi lutin
Inna ibrahiyma lahaliymun avvahun muniybun
Ya ibrahiymu a'rid 'an haza innahu qad ja amru rabbika vainnahum atiyhim 'azabun g'ayru mardudin
Valamma jat rusuluna lutan siya bihim vadaqa bihim zar'an vaqala haza yavmun 'asiybun
Vajahu qavmuhu yuhra'una ilayhi vamin qablu kanu ya'maluna alssayyiati qala ya qavmi haolai banatiy hunna azaru lakum faittaqu Alloha vala tuxzuni fiy dayfiy alaysa minkum rajulun rashiydun
Qalu laqad 'alimta ma lana fiy banatika min haqqin vainnaka lata'lamu ma nuriydu
Qala lav anna liy bikum quvvatan av aviy ila ruknin shadiydin

Qalu ya lutu inna rusulu rabbika lan yasilu ilayka fasri biahlika biqit'in mina allayli vala yaltafit minkum ahadun illa imrataka innahu musiybuha ma asabahum inna mav'idahumu alssubhu alaysa alssubhu biqariybin
Falamma ja amruna ja'alna 'aliyaha safilaha vamtarna 'alayha hijaratan min sijjiylin mandudin
Musavvamatan 'inda rabbika vama hiya mina alzzalimiyna biba'iydin
Vaila madyana axahum shu'ayban qala ya qavmi o'budu Alloha ma lakum min ilahin g'ayruhu vala tanqusu almikyala valmiyzana inniy arakum bixayrin vainniy axafu 'alaykum 'azaba yavmin muhiytin
Vaya qavmi avfu almikyala valmiyzana bialqisti vala tabxasu alnnasa ashyahum vala ta'sav fiy alardi mufsidiyna
Baqiyyatu Allohi xayrun lakum in kuntum muminiyna vama ana 'alaykum bihafiyzin
Qalu ya shu'aybu asalatuka tamuruka an natruka ma ya'budu abaona av an naf'ala fiy amvalina ma nashao innaka lanta alhaliymu alrrashiydu

Qala ya qavmi araytum in kuntu 'ala bayyinatin min rabbiy varazaqaniy minhu rizqan hasanan vama oriydu an oxalifakum ila ma anhakum 'anhu in oriydu illa alislaha ma istata'tu vama tavfiyqiy illa biAllohi 'alayhi tavakkaltu vailayhi oniybu
Vaya qavmi la yajrimannakum shiqaqiy an yusiybakum mislu ma asaba qavma nuhin av qavma hudin av qavma salihin vama qavmu lutin minkum biba'iydin
Vaistag'firu rabbakum summa tubu ilayhi inna rabbiy rahiymun vadudun
Qalu ya shu'aybu ma nafqahu kasiyran mimma taqulu vainna lanaraka fiyna da'iyfan valavla rahtuka larajamnaka vama anta 'alayna bi'aziyzin
Qala ya qavmi arahtiy a'azzu 'alaykum mina Allohi vaittaxaztumuhu varakum zihriyyan inna rabbiy bima ta'maluna muhiytun
Vaya qavmi i'malu 'ala makanatikum inniy 'amilun savfa ta'lamuna man yatiyhi 'azabun yuxziyhi vaman huva kazibun vairtaqibu inne ma'akum raqiybun
Valamma ja amruna najjayna shu'ayban vallaziyna amanu ma'ahu birahmatin minna vaxazati allaziyna zalamu alssayhatu fasbahu fiy diyarihim jazimiyna
Kan lam yag'nav fiyha ala bu'dan limadyana kama ba'idat samudu
Valaqad arsalna musa biayatina vasultanin mubiynin
Ila fir'avna vamalaihi faittaba'u amra fir'avna vama amru fir'avna birashiydin
Yaqdumu qavmahu yavma alqiyamati favradahumu alnnara vabisa alvirdu almavrudu
Vaotbi'u fiy hazihi la'natan vayavma alqiyamati bisa alrrifdu almarfudu
Zalika min anbai alqura naqussuhu 'alayka minha qaimun vahasiydun
Vama zalamnahum valakin zalamu anfusahum fama ag'nat 'anhum alihatuhumu allatiy yad'una min duni Allohi min shayin lamma ja amru rabbika vama zaduhum g'ayra tatbiybin
Vakazalika axzu rabbika iza axaza alqura vahiya zalimatun inna axzahu aliymun shadiydun
Inna fiy zalika layatan liman xafa 'azaba alaxirati zalika yavmun majmu'un lahu alnnasu vazalika yavmun mashhudun
Vama nuaxxiruhu illa liajalin ma'dudin
Yavma yati la takallamu nafsun illa biiznihi faminhum shaqiyyun vasa'iydin
Famma allaziyna shaqu fafiy alnnari lahum fiyha zafiyrun vashahiyqun
Xalidiyna fiyha ma damati alssamavatu valardu illa ma sha rabbuka inna rabbaka fa''alun lima yuriydu
Vamma allaziyna su'idu fafiy aljannati xalidiyna fiyha ma damati alssamavatu valardu illa ma sha rabbuka 'atan g'ayra majzuzin
Fala taku fiy miryatin mimma ya'budu haolai ma ya'buduna illa kama ya'budu abaohum min qablu vainna lamuvaffuhum nasiybahum g'ayra manqusin
Valaqad atayna musa alkitaba faixtulifa fiyhi valavla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laqudiya baynahum vainnahum lafiy shakkin minhu muriybun
Vainna kullan lamma layuvaffiyannahum rabbuka a'malahum innahu bima ya'maluna xabiyrun
Faistaqim kama omirta vaman taba ma'aka vala tatg'av innahu bima ta'maluna basiyrun
Vala tarkanu ila allaziyna zalamu fatamassakumu alnnaru vama lakum min duni Allohi min avliya zumma la tunsaruna
Vaqimi alssalata tarafayi alnnahari vazulafan mina allayli inna alhasanati yuzhibna alssayyiati zalika zikra lilzzakiriyna
Vaisbir fainna Alloha la yudiy'u ajra almuhsiniyna
Falavla kana mina alquruni min qablikum olu baqiyyatin yanhavna 'ani alfasadi fiy alardi illa qaliylan mimman anjayna minhum vaittaba'a allaziyna zalamu ma otrifu fiyhi vakanu mujrimiyna
Vama kana rabbuka liyuhlika alqura bizulmin vahluha muslihuna
Valav sha rabbuka laja'ala alnnasa ommatan vahidatan vala yazaluna muxtalifiyna
Illa man rahima rabbuka valizalika xalaqahum vatammat kalimatu rabbika lamlanna jahannama mina aljinnati valnnasi ajma'iyna
Vakullan naqussu 'alayka min anbai alrrusuli ma nuzabbitu bihi fuadaka vajaka fiy hazihi alhaqqu vamav'izatun vazikra lilmuminiyna
Vaqul lillaziyna la yuminuna i'malu 'ala makanatikum inna 'amiluna
Vaintaziru inna muntaziruna
Valillahi g'aybu alssamavati valardi vailayhi yurja'u alamru kulluhu fao'budhu vatavakkal 'alayhi vama rabbuka big'afilin 'amma ta'maluna
Aliflamra tilka ayatu alkitabi almubiynu
Inna anzalnahu quranan 'arabiyyan la'allakum ta'qiluna
Nahnu naqussu 'alayka ahsana alqasasi bima avhayna ilayka haza alqurana vain kunta min qablihi lamina alg'afiliyna
Iz qala yusufu liabiyhi ya abati inniy raytu ahada 'ashara kavkaban valshshamsa valqamara raytuhum liy sajidiyna
Qala ya bunayya la taqsus ruyaka 'ala ixvatika fayakiydu laka kaydan inna alshshaytana lilinsani 'aduvvun mubiynun

Vakazalika yajtabiyka rabbuka vayu'allimuka min taviyli alahadiyzi vayutimmu ni'matahu 'alayka va'ala ali ya'quba kama atammaha 'ala abavayka min qablu ibrahiyma vaishaqa inna rabbaka 'aliymun hakiymun
Laqad kana fiy yusufa vaixvatihi ayatun lilssailiyna
Iz qalu layusufu vaxuhu ahabbu ila abiyna minna vanahnu 'usbatun inna abana lafiy dalalin mubiynin
Oqtulu yusufa avi itrahuhu ardan yaxlu lakum vajhu abiykum vatakunu min ba'dihi qavman salihiyna
Qala qailun minhum la taqtulu yusufa valquhu fiy g'ayabati aljubbi yaltaqizu ba'du alssayyarati in kuntum fa'iliyna
Qalu ya abana ma laka la tamanna 'ala yusufa vainna lahu lanasihuna
Arsilhu ma'ana g'adan yarta' vayal'ab vainna lahu lahafizuna
Qala inniy layahzununiy an zazhabu bihi vaxafu an yakulahu alzzibu vantum 'anhu g'afiluna
Qalu lain akalahu alzzibu vanahnu 'usbatun inna izan laxasiruna
Falamma zahabu bihi vajma'u an yaj'aluhu fiy g'ayabati aljubbi vavhayna ilayhi latunabiannahum biamrihim haza vahum la yash'uruna
Vajau abahum 'ishan yabkuna
Qalu ya abana inna zahabna nastabiqu vatarakna yusufa 'inda mata'ina fakalahu alzzibu vama anta bimuminin lana valav kunna sadiqiyna
Vajau 'ala qamiysihi bidamin kazibin qala bal savvalat lakum anfusukum amran fasabrun jamiylun vaAllohu almusta'anu 'ala ma tasifuna
Vajat sayyaratun farsalu varidahum fadla dalvahu qala ya bushra haza g'ulamun vasarruhu bida'atan vaAllohu 'aliymun bima ya'maluna
Vasharavhu bisamanin baxsin darahima ma'dudatin vakanu fiyhi mina alzzahidiyna

Vaqala allaziy ishtarahu min misra liimratihi akrimiy mazvahu 'asa an yanfa'ana av nattaxizahu valadan vakazalika makkanna liyusufa fiy alardi valinu'allimahu min taviyli alahadiyzi vaAllohu g'alibun 'ala amrihi valakinna akzara alnnasi la ya'lamuna
Valamma balag'a ashuddahu ataynahu hukman va'ilman vakazalika najziy almuhsiniyna
Varavadazu allatiy huva fiy baytiha 'an nafsihi vag'allaqati alabvaba vaqalat hayta laka qala ma'aza Allohi innahu rabbiy ahsana mazvaya innahu la yuflihu alzzalimuna
Valaqad hammat bihi vahamma biha lavla an ra burhana rabbihi kazalika linasrifa 'anhu alssua valfahsha innahu min 'ibadina almuxlasiyna
Vaistabaqa albaba vaqaddat qamiysahu min duburin valfaya sayyidaha lada albabi qalat ma jazao man arada biahlika suan illa an yusjana av 'azabun aliymun
Qala hiya ravadatniy 'an nafsiy vashahida shahidun min ahliha in kana qamiysuhu qudda min qubulin fasadaqat vahuva mina alkazibiyna
Vain kana qamiysuhu qudda min duburin fakazabat vahuva mina alssadiqiyna
Falamma ra qamiysahu qudda min duburin qala innahu min kaydikunna inna kaydakunna 'aziymun
Yusufu a'rid 'an haza vaistag'firiy lizanbiki innaki kunti mina alxatiiyna
Vaqala nisvatun fiy almadiynati imratu al'aziyzi turavidu fataha 'an nafsihi qad shag'afaha hubban inna lanaraha fiy dalalin mubiynin

Falamma sami'at bimakrihinna arsalat ilayhinna va'tadat lahunna muttakan vatat kulla vahidatin minhunna sikkiynan vaqalati oxruj 'alayhinna falamma raynahu akbarnahu vaqatta'na aydiyahunna vaqulna hasha lillahi ma haza basharan in haza illa malakun kariymun
Qalat fazalikunna allaziy lumtunnaniy fiyhi valaqad ravadtuhu 'an nafsihi faist'sama valain lam yaf'al ma amuruhu layusjananna valayakunan mina alssag'iriyna
Qala rabbi alssijnu ahabbu ilayya mimma yad'unaniy ilayhi vailla tasrif 'anniy kaydahunna asbu ilayhinna vakun mina aljahiliyna
Faistajaba lahu rabbuhu fasarafa 'anhu kaydahunna innahu huva alssamiy'u al'aliymu
Summa bada lahum min ba'di ma ravu alayati layasjununnahu hatta hiynin

Vadaxala ma'ahu alssijna fatayani qala ahaduhuma inniy araniy a'siru xamran vaqala alaxaru inniy araniy ahmilu favqa rasiy xubzan takulu alttayru minhu nabbina bitaviylihi inna naraka mina almuhsiniyna

Qala la yatiykuma ta'amun turzaqanihi illa nabbatukuma bitaviylihi qabla an yatiyakuma zalikuma mimma 'allamaniy rabbiy inniy taraktu millata qavmin la yuminuna biAllohi vahum bialaxirati hum kafiruna
Vaittaba'tu millata abaiy ibrahiyma vaishaqa vaya'quba ma kana lana an nushrika biAllohi min shayin zalika min fadli Allohi 'alayna va'ala alnnasi valakinna akzara alnnasi la yashkuruna
Ya sahibayi alssijni arbabun mutafarriquna xayrun ami Allohu alvahidu alqahharu

Ma ta'buduna min dunihi illa asman sammaytumuha antum vabaokum ma anzala Allohu biha min sultanin ini alhukmu illa lillahi amara alla ta'budu illa iyyahu zalika alddiynu alqayyimu valakinna akzara alnnasi la ya'lamuna
Ya sahibayi alssijni amma ahadukuma fayasqiy rabbahu xamran vamma alaxaru fayuslabu fatakulu alttayru min rasihi qudiya alamru allaziy fiyhi tastaftiyani
Vaqala lillaziy zanna annahu najin minhuma ozkurniy 'inda rabbika fansahu alshshaytanu zikra rabbihi falabiza fiy alssijni bid'a siniyna
Vaqala almaliku inniy ara sab'a baqaratin simanin yakuluhunna sab'un 'ijafun vasab'a sunbulatin xudrin vaoxara yabisatin ya ayyuha almalao aftuniy fiy ruyaya in kuntum lilrruya ta'buruna
Qalu adg'asu ahlamin vama nahnu bitaviyli alahlami bi'alimiyna
Vaqala allaziy naja minhuma vaiddakara ba'da ommatin ana onabbiokum bitaviylihi farsiluni
Yusufu ayyuha alssiddiyqu aftina fiy sab'i baqaratin simanin yakuluhunna sab'un 'ijafun vasab'i sunbulatin xudrin vaoxara yabisatin la'alliy arji'u ila alnnasi la'llohum ya'lamuna
Qala tazra'una sab'a siniyna daban fama hasadtum fazaruhu fiy sunbulihi illa qaliylan mimma takuluna
Zumma yatiy min ba'di zalika sab'un shidadun yakulna ma qaddamtum lahunna illa qaliylan mimma tuhsinuna
Zumma yatiy min ba'di zalika 'amun fiyhi yug'azu alnnasu vafiyhi ya'siruna
Vaqala almaliku ituniy bihi falamma jahu alrrasulu qala irji' ila rabbika faisalhu ma balu alnnisvati allatiy qatta'na aydiyahunna inna rabbiy bikaydihinna 'aliymun

Qala ma xatbukunna iz ravadtunna yusufa 'an nafsihi qulna hasha lillahi ma 'alimna 'alayhi min suin qalati imratu al'aziyzi alana hashasa alhaqqu ana ravadtuhu 'an nafsihi vainnahu lamina alssadiqiyna
Zalika liya'lama anniy lam axunhu bialg'aybi vanna Alloha la yahdiy kayda alxainiyna
Vama obarrio nafsiy inna alnnafsa lammaratun bialssui illa ma rahima rabbiy inna rabbiy g'afurun rahiymun
Vaqala almaliku ituniy bihi astaxlishu linafsiy falamma kallamahu qala innaka alyavma ladayna makiynun amiynun
Qala ij'alniy 'ala xazaini alardi inniy hafiyzun 'aliymun
Vakazalika makanna liyusufa fiy alardi yatabavvao minha hayzu yashao nusiybu birahmatina man nashao vala nudiy'u ajra almuhsiniyna
Valajru alaxirati xayrun lillaziyna amanu vakanu yattaquna
Vaja ixvatu yusufa fadaxalu 'alayhi fa'arafahum vahum lahu munkiruna
Valamma jahhazahum bijahazihim qala ituniy biaxin lakum min abiykum ala taravna anniy ufiy alkayla vana xayru almunziliyna
Fain lam tatuniy bihi fala kayla lakum 'indiy vala taqrabuni
Qalu sanuravidu 'anhu abahu vainna lafa'iluna
Vaqala lifityanihi ij'alu bida'atahum fiy rihalihim la'llohum ya'rifunaha iza inqalabu ila ahlihim la'llohum yarji'una
Falamma raja'u ila abiyhim qalu ya abana muni'a minna alkaylu farsil ma'ana axana naktal vainna lahu lahafizuna
Qala hal amanukum 'alayhi illa kama amintukum 'ala axiyhi min qablu faAllohu xayrun hafizan vahuva arhamu alrrahimiyna
Valamma fatahu mata'ahum vajadu bida'atahum ruddat ilayhim qalu ya abana ma nabg'iy hazihi bida'atuna ruddat ilayna vanamiyru ahlana vanahfazu axana vanazdadu kayla ba'iyrin zalika kaylun yasiyrun
Qala lan orsilahu ma'akum hatta tutuni mavsiqan mina Allohi latatunnaniy bihi illa an yuhata bikum falamma atavhu mavsiqahum qala Allohu 'ala ma naqulu vakiylun

Vaqala ya baniyya la tadxulu min babin vahidin vaodxulu min abvabin mutafarriqatin vama og'niy 'ankum mina Allohi min shayin ini alhukmu illa lillahi 'alayhi tavakkaltu va'alayhi falyatavakkali almutavakkiluna
Valamma daxalu min hayzu amarahum abuhum ma kana yug'niy 'anhum mina Allohi min shayin illa hajatan fiy nafsi ya'quba qadaha vainnahu lazu 'ilmin lima 'allamnahu valakinna akzara alnnasi la ya'lamuna
Valamma daxalu 'ala yusufa ava ilayhi axahu qala inniy ana axuka fala tabtais bima kanu ya'maluna
Falamma jahhazahum bijahazihim ja'ala alssiqayata fiy rahli axiyhi zumma azzana muazzinun ayyatuha al'iyru innakum lasariquna
Qalu vaqbalu 'alayhim maza tafqiduna
Qalu nafqidu suva'a almaliki valiman ja bihi himlu ba'iyrin vana bihi za'iymun
Qalu taAllohi laqad 'alimtum ma jina linufsida fiy alardi vama kunna sariqiyna
Qalu fama jazaohu in kuntum kazibiyna
Qalu jazaohu man vujida fiy rahlihi fahuva jazaohu kazalika najziy alzzalimiyna

Fabada biav'iyatihim qabla vi'ai axiyhi zumma istaxrajaha min vi'ai axiyhi kazalika kidna liyusufa ma kana liyaxuza axahu fiy diyni almaliki illa an yasha Allohu narfa'u darajatin man nashao vafavqa kulli ziy 'ilmin 'aliymun
Qalu in yasriq faqad saraqa axun lahu min qablu fasarraha yusufu fiy nafsihi valam yubdiha lahum qala antum sharrun makanan vaAllohu a'lamu bima tasifuna
Qalu ya ayyuha al'aziyzu inna lahu aban shayxan kabiyran faxuz ahadana makanahu inna naraka mina almuhsiniyna
Qala ma'aza Allohi an naxuza illa man vajadna mata'ana 'indahu inna izan lazalimuna

Falamma istayasu minhu xalasu najiyyan qala kabiyruhum alam ta'lamu anna abakum qad axaza 'alaykum mavziqan mina Allohi vamin qablu ma farrattum fiy yusufa falan abraha alarda hatta yazana liy abiy av yahkuma Allohu liy vahuva xayru alhakimiyna
Irji'u ila abiykum faqulu ya abana inna ibnaka saraqa vama shahidna illa bima 'alimna vama kunna lilg'aybi hafiziyna
Vaisali alqaryata allatiy kunna fiyha val'iyra allatiy aqbalna fiyha vainna lasadiquna
Qala bal savvalat lakum anfusukum amran fasabrun jamiylun 'asa Allohu an yatiyaniy bihim jamiy'an innahu huva al'aliymu alhakiymu
Vatavalla 'anhum vaqala ya asafa 'ala yusufa vaibyaddat 'aynahu mina alhuzni fahuva kaziymun
Qalu taAllohi taftao tazkuru yusufa hatta takuna haradan av takuna mina alhalikiyna
Qala innama ashku bassiy vahuzniy ila Allohi va'lamu mina Allohi ma la ta'lamuna
Ya baniyya izhabu fatahassasu min yusufa vaxiyhi vala tayasu min ravhi Allohi innahu la yayasu min ravhi Allohi illa alqavmu alkafiruna
Falamma daxalu 'alayhi qalu ya ayyuha al'aziyzu massana vahlana alddurru vajina bibida'atin muzjatin favfi lana alkayla vatasaddaq 'alayna inna Alloha yajziy almutasaddiqiyna
Qala hal 'alimtum ma fa'altum biyusufa vaxiyhi iz antum jahiluna
Qalu ainnaka lanta yusufa qala ana yusufu vahaza axiy qad manna Allohu 'alayna innahu man yattaqi vayasbir fainna Alloha la yudiy'u ajra almuhsiniyna
Qalu taAllohi laqad asaraka Allohu 'alayna vain kunna laxatiiyna
Qala la tasriyba 'alaykumu alyavma yag'firu Allohu lakum vahuva arhamu alrrahimiyna
Izhabu biqamiysiy haza falquhu 'ala vajhi abiy yati basiyran vatuniy biahlikum ajma'iyna
Valamma fasalati al'iyru qala abuhum inniy lajidu riyha yusufa lavla an tufanniduni
Qalu taAllohi innaka lafiy dalalika alqadiymi
Falamma an ja albashiyru alqahu 'ala vajhihi fairtadda basiyran qala alam aqul lakum inniy a'lamu mina Allohi ma la ta'lamuna
Qalu ya abana istag'fir lana zunubana inna kunna xatiiyna
Qala savfa astag'firu lakum rabbiy innahu huva alg'afuru alrrahiymu
Falamma daxalu 'ala yusufa ava ilayhi abavayhi vaqala odxulu misra in sha Allohu aminiyna

Varafa'a abavayhi 'ala al'arshi vaxarru lahu sujjadan vaqala ya abati haza taviylu ruyaya min qablu qad ja'alaha rabbiy haqqan vaqad ahsana biy iz axrajaniy mina alssijni vaja bikum mina albadvi min ba'di an nazag'a alshshaytanu bayniy vabayna ixvatiy inna rabbiy latiyfun lima yashao innahu huva al'aliymu alhakiymu
Rabbi qad ataytaniy mina almulki va'allamtaniy min taviyli alahadiysi fatira alssamavati valardi anta valiyyiy fiy alddunya valaxirati tavaffaniy musliman valhiqniy bialssalihiyna
Zalika min anbai alg'aybi nuhiyhi ilayka vama kunta ladayhim iz ajma'u amrahum vahum yamkuruna
Vama aksaru alnnasi valav harasta bimuminiyna
Vama tasaluhum 'alayhi min ajrin in huva illa zikrun lil'alamiyna
Vakayyin min ayatin fiy alssamavati valardi yamurruna 'alayha vahum 'anha mu'riduna
Vama yuminu aksaruhum biAllohi illa vahum mushrikuna
Afaminu an tatiyahum g'ashiyatun min 'azabi Allohi av tatiyahumu alssa'atu bag'tatan vahum la yash'uruna
Qul hazihi sabiyliy ad'u ila Allohi 'ala basiyratin ana vamani ittaba'aniy vasubhana Allohi vama ana mina almushrikiyna

Vama arsalna min qablika illa rijalan nuhiy ilayhim min ahli alqura afalam yasiyru fiy alardi fayanzuru kayfa kana 'aqibatu allaziyna min qablihim valadaru alaxirati xayrun lillaziyna ittaqav afala ta'qiluna
Hatta iza istayasa alrrusulu vazannu annahum qad kuzibu jahum nasruna fanujjiya man nashao vala yuraddu basuna 'ani alqavmi almujrimiyna
Laqad kana fiy qasasihim 'ibratun lioliy alalbabi ma kana hadiyzan yuftara valakin tasdiyqa allaziy bayna yadayhi vatafsiyla kulli shayin vahudan varahmatan liqavmin yuminuna
Aliflammiymra tilka ayatu alkitabi vallaziy onzila ilayka min rabbika alhaqqu valakinna akzara alnnasi la yuminuna

Allohu allaziy rafa'a alssamavati big'ayri 'amadin taravnaha zumma istava 'ala al'arshi vasaxxara alshshamsa valqamara kullun yajriy liajalin musamman yudabbiru alamra yufassilu alayati la'allakum biliqai rabbikum tuqinuna
Vahuva allaziy madda alarda vaja'ala fiyha ravasiya vanharan vamin kulli alzzamarati ja'ala fiyha zavjayni iznayni yug'shiy allayla alnnahara inna fiy zalika layatin liqavmin yatafakkaruna

Vafiy alardi qita'un mutajaviratun vajannatun min a'nabin vazar'un vanaxiylun sinvanun vag'ayru sinvanin yusqa bimain vahidin vanufaddilu ba'daha 'ala ba'din fiy alokuli inna fiy zalika layatin liqavmin ya'qiluna
Vain ta'jab fa'ajabun qavluhum aiza kunna turaban ainna lafiy xalqin jadiydin olaika allaziyna kafaru birabbihim vaolaika alag'lalu fiy a'naqihim vaolaika ashabu alnnari hum fiyha xaliduna
Vayasta'jilunaka bialssayyiati qabla alhasanati vaqad xalat min qablihimu almazulatu vainna rabbaka lazu mag'firatin lilnnasi 'ala zulmihim vainna rabbaka lashadiydu al'iqabi
Vayaqulu allaziyna kafaru lavla onzila 'alayhi ayatun min rabbihi innama anta munzirun valikulli qavmin hadin
Allohu ya'lamu ma tahmilu kullu onsa vama tag'iydu alarhamu vama tazdadu vakullu shayin 'indahu bimiqdarin
'alimu alg'aybi valshshahadati alkabiyru almuta'ali
Savaon minkum man asarra alqavla vaman jahara bihi vaman huva mustaxfin biallayli vasaribun bialnnahari

Lahu mu'aqqibatun min bayni yadayhi vamin xalfihi yahfazunahu min amri Allohi inna Alloha la yug'ayyiru ma biqavmin hatta yug'ayyiru ma bianfusihim vaiza arada Allohu biqavmin suan fala maradda lahu vama lahum min dunihi min valin
Huva allaziy yuriykumu albarqa xavfan vatama'an vayunshio alssahaba alzziqala
Vayusabbihu alrra'du bihamdihi valmalaikatu min xiyfatihi vayursilu alssava'iqa fayusiybu biha man yashao vahum yujadiluna fiy Allohi vahuva shadiydu almihali
Lahu da'vatu alhaqqi vallaziyna yad'una min dunihi la yastajiybuna lahum bishayin illa kabasiti kaffayhi ila almai liyablug'a fahu vama huva bibalig'ihi vama du'ao alkafiriyna illa fiy dalalin
Valillahi yasjudu man fiy alssamavati valardi tav'an vakarhan vazilaluhum bialg'uduvvi valasali

Qul man rabbu alssamavati valardi quli Allohu qul afaittaxaztum min dunihi avliya la yamlikuna lianfusihim naf'an vala darran qul hal yastaviy ala'ma valbasiyru am hal tastaviy alzzulumatu valnnuru am ja'alu lillahi shuraka xalaqu kaxalqihi fatashabaha alxalqu 'alayhim quli Allohu xaliqu kulli shayin vahuva alvahidu alqahharu

Anzala mina alssamai man fasalat avdiyatun biqadariha faihtamala alssaylu zabadan rabiyan vamimma yuqiduna 'alayhi fiy alnnari ibtig'a hilyatin av mata'in zabadun mizluhu kazalika yadribu Allohu alhaqqa valbatila famma alzzabadu fayazhabu jufan vamma ma yanfa'u alnnasa fayamkuzu fiy alardi kazalika yadribu Allohu alamzala

Lillaziyna istajabu lirabbihimu alhusna vallaziyna lam yastajiybu lahu lav anna lahum ma fiy alardi jamiy'an vamizlahu ma'ahu laiftadav bihi olaika lahum suo alhisabi vamavahum jahannamu vabisa almihadu
Afaman ya'lamu annama onzila ilayka min rabbika alhaqqu kaman huva a'ma innama yatazakkaru olu alalbabi
Allaziyna yufuna bi'ahdi Allohi vala yanquduna almiyzaqa
Vallaziyna yasiluna ma amara Allohu bihi an yusala vayaxshavna rabbahum vayaxafuna sua alhisabi
Vallaziyna sabaru ibtig'a vajhi rabbihim vaqamu alssalata vanfaqu mimma razaqnahum sirran va'alaniyatan vayadrauna bialhasanati alssayyiata olaika lahum 'uqba alddari
Jannatu 'adnin yadxulunaha vaman salaha min abaihim vazvajihim vazurriyyatihim valmalaikatu yadxuluna 'alayhim min kulli babin
Salamun 'alaykum bima sabartum fani'ma 'uqba alddari
Vallaziyna yanquduna 'ahda Allohi min ba'di miyzaqihi vayaqta'una ma amara Allohu bihi an yusala vayufsiduna fiy alardi olaika lahumu alla'natu valahum suo alddari
Allohu yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao vayaqdiru vafarihu bialhayati alddunya vama alhayatu alddunya fiy alaxirati illa mata'un
Vayaqulu allaziyna kafaru lavla onzila 'alayhi ayatun min rabbihi qul inna Alloha yudillu man yashao vayahdiy ilayhi man anaba
Allaziyna amanu vatatmainnu qulubuhum bizikri Allohi ala bizikri Allohi tatmainnu alqulubu
Allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati tuba lahum vahusnu mabin

Kazalika arsalnaka fiy ommatin qad xalat min qabliha omamun litatluva 'alayhimu allaziy avhayna ilayka vahum yakfuruna bialrrahmani qul huva rabbiy la ilaha illa huva 'alayhi tavakkaltu vailayhi matabi

Valav anna quranan suyyirat bihi aljibalu av qutti'at bihi alardu av kullima bihi almavta bal lillahi alamru jamiy'an afalam yayasi allaziyna amanu an lav yashao Allohu lahada alnnasa jamiy'an vala yazalu allaziyna kafaru tusiybuhum bima sana'u qari'atun av tahullu qariyban min darihim hatta yatiya va'du Allohi inna Alloha la yuxlifu almiy'ada
Valaqadi istuhzia birusulin min qablika famlaytu lillaziyna kafaru zumma axaztuhum fakayfa kana 'iqabi

Afaman huva qaimun 'ala kulli nafsin bima kasabat vaja'alu lillahi shuraka qul sammuhum am tunabbiunahu bima la ya'lamu fiy alardi am bizahirin mina alqavli bal zuyyina lillaziyna kafaru makruhum vasuddu 'ani alssabiyli vaman yudlili Allohu fama lahu min hadin
Lahum 'azabun fiy alhayati alddunya vala'azabu alaxirati ashaqqu vama lahum mina Allohi min vaqin
Mazalu aljannati allatiy vu'ida almuttaquna tajriy min tahtiha alanharu okuluha daimun vazilluha tilka 'uqba allaziyna ittaqav va'uqba alkafiriyna alnnaru
Vallaziyna ataynahumu alkitaba yafrahuna bima onzila ilayka vamina alahzabi man yunkiru ba'dahu qul innama omirtu an a'buda Alloha vala oshrika bihi ilayhi ad'u vailayhi mabi
Vakazalika anzalnahu hukman 'arabiyyan valaini ittaba'ta ahvahum ba'da ma jaka mina al'ilmi ma laka mina Allohi min valiyyin vala vaqin
Valaqad arsalna rusulan min qablika vaja'alna lahum azvajan vazurriyyatan vama kana lirasulin an yatiya biayatin illa biizni Allohi likulli ajalin kitabun
Yamhu Allohu ma yashao vayusbitu va'indahu ommu alkitabi
Vain ma nuriyannaka ba'da allaziy na'iduhum av natavaffayannaka fainnama 'alayka albalag'u va'alayna alhisabu
Avalam yarav anna natiy alarda nanqusuha min atrafiha vaAllohu yahkumu la mu'aqqiba lihukmihi vahuva sariy'u alhisabi
Vaqad makara allaziyna min qablihim falillahi almakru jamiy'an ya'lamu ma taksibu kullu nafsin vasaya'lamu alkuffaru liman 'uqba alddari
Vayaqulu allaziyna kafaru lasta mursalan qul kafa biAllohi shahiydan bayniy vabaynakum vaman 'indahu 'ilmu alkitabi
Aliflamra kitabun anzalnahu ilayka lituxrija alnnasa mina alzzulumati ila alnnuri biizni rabbihim ila sirati al'aziyzi alhamiydi
Allohi allaziy lahu ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi vavaylun lilkafiriyna min 'azabin shadiydin
Allaziyna yastahibbuna alhayata alddunya 'ala alaxirati vayasudduna 'an sabiyli Allohi vayabg'unaha 'ivajan olaika fiy dalalin ba'iydin
Vama arsalna min rasulin illa bilisani qavmihi liyubayyina lahum fayudillu Allohu man yashao vayahdiy man yashao vahuva al'aziyzu alhakiymu
Valaqad arsalna musa biayatina an axrij qavmaka mina alzzulumati ila alnnuri vazakkirhum biayyami Allohi inna fiy zalika layatin likulli sabbarin shakurin
Vaiz qala musa liqavmihi ozkuru ni'mata Allohi 'alaykum iz anjakum min ali fir'avna yasumunakum sua al'azabi vayuzabbihuna abnakum vayastahyuna nisakum vafiy zalikum balaon min rabbikum 'aziymun
Vaiz tazzana rabbukum lain shakartum laziydannakum valain kafartum inna 'azabiy lashadiydun
Vaqala musa in takfuru antum vaman fiy alardi jamiy'an fainna Alloha lag'aniyyun hamiydun

Alam yatikum nabao allaziyna min qablikum qavmi nuhin va'adin vazamuda vallaziyna min ba'dihim la ya'lamuhum illa Allohu jazum rusuluhum bialbayyinati faraddu aydiyahum fiy afvahihim vaqalu inna kafarna bima orsiltum bihi vainna lafiy shakkin mimma tad'unana ilayhi muriybun

Qalat rusuluhum afiy Allohi shakkun fatiri alssamavati valardi yad'ukum liyag'fira lakum min zunubikum vayuaxxirakum ila ajalin musamman qalu in antum illa basharun mizluna turiyduna an tasudduna 'amma kana ya'budu abaona fatuna bisultanin mubiynin

Qalat lahum rusuluhum in nahnu illa basharun mizlukum valakinna Alloha yamunnu 'ala man yashao min 'ibadihi vama kana lana an natiyakum bisultanin illa biizni Allohi va'ala Allohi falyatavakkali almuminuna
Vama lana alla natavakkala 'ala Allohi vaqad hadana subulana valanasbiranna 'ala ma azaytumuna va'ala Allohi falyatavakkali almutavakkiluna
Vaqala allaziyna kafaru lirusulihim lanuxrijannakum min ardina av lata'udunna fiy millatina favha ilayhim rabbuhum lanuhlikanna alzzalimiyna
Valanuskinannakumu alarda min ba'dihim zalika liman xafa maqamiy vaxafa va'iydi
Vaistaftahu vaxaba kullu jabbarin 'aniydin
Min varaihi jahannamu vayusqa min main sadiydin
Yatajarra'uhu vala yakadu yusiyg'uhu vayatiyhi almavtu min kulli makanin vama huva bimayyitin vamin varaihi 'azabun g'aliyzun
Mazalu allaziyna kafaru birabbihim a'maluhum karamadin ishtaddat bihi alrriyhu fiy yavmin 'asifin la yaqdiruna mimma kasabu 'ala shayin zalika huva alddalalu alba'iydu
Alam tara anna Alloha xalaqa alssamavati valarda bialhaqqi in yasha yuzhibkum vayati bixalqin jadiydin
Vama zalika 'ala Allohi bi'aziyzin

Vabarazu lillahi jamiy'an faqala alddu'afao lillaziyna istakbaru inna kunna lakum taba'an fahal antum mug'nuna 'anna min 'azabi Allohi min shayin qalu lav hadana Allohu lahadaynakum savaon 'alayna ajazi'na am sabarna ma lana min mahiysin

Vaqala alshshaytanu lamma qudiya alamru inna Alloha va'adakum va'da alhaqqi vava'adtukum faxlaftukum vama kana liya 'alaykum min sultanin illa an da'avtukum faistajabtum liy fala talumuniy valumu anfusakum ma ana bimusrixikum vama antum bimusrixiyya inniy kafartu bima ashraktumuni min qablu inna alzzalimiyna lahum 'azabun aliymun
Vaodxila allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu xalidiyna fiyha biizni rabbihim tahiyyatuhum fiyha salamun
Alam tara kayfa daraba Allohu masalan kalimatan tayyibatan kashajaratin tayyibatin asluha sabitun vafar'uha fiy alssamai
Tutiy okulaha kulla hiynin biizni rabbiha vayadribu Allohu alamzala lilnnasi la'llohum yatazakkaruna
Vamasalu kalimatin xabiysatin kashajaratin xabiysatin ijtussat min favqi alardi ma laha min qararin
Yuzabbitu Allohu allaziyna amanu bialqavli alzzabiti fiy alhayati alddunya vafiy alaxirati vayudillu Allohu alzzalimiyna vayaf'alu Allohu ma yashao
Alam tara ila allaziyna baddalu ni'mata Allohi kufran vahallu qavmahum dara albavari
Jahannama yaslavnaha vabisa alqararu
Vaja'alu lillahi andadan liyudillu 'an sabiylihi qul tamatta'u fainna masiyrakum ila alnnari
Qul li'ibadiya allaziyna amanu yuqiymu alssalata vayunfiqu mimma razaqnahum sirran va'alaniyatan min qabli an yatiya yavmun la bay'un fiyhi vala xilalun
Allohu allaziy xalaqa alssamavati valarda vanzala mina alssamai man faxraja bihi mina alzzamarati rizqan lakum vasaxxara lakumu alfulka litajriya fiy albahri biamrihi vasaxxara lakumu alanhara
Vasaxxara lakumu alshshamsa valqamara daibayni vasaxxara lakumu allayla valnnahara
Vatakum min kulli ma saltumuhu vain ta'uddu ni'mata Allohi la tuhsuha inna alinsana lazalumun kaffarun
Vaiz qala ibrahiymu rabbi ij'al haza albalada aminan vaojnubniy vabaniyya an na'buda alasnama
Rabbi innahunna adlalna kasiyran mina alnnasi faman tabi'aniy fainnahu minniy vaman 'asaniy fainnaka g'afurun rahiymun

Rabbana inniy askantu min zurriyyatiy bivadin g'ayri ziy zar'in 'inda baytika almuharrami rabbana liyuqiymu alssalata faij'al afidatan mina alnnasi tahviy ilayhim vaorzuqhum mina alzzamarati la'llohum yashkuruna
Rabbana innaka ta'lamu ma nuxfiy vama nu'linu vama yaxfa 'ala Allohi min shayin fiy alardi vala fiy alssamai
Alhamdu lillahi allaziy vahaba liy 'ala alkibari isma'iyla vaishaqa inna rabbiy lasamiy'u alddu'ai
Rabbi ij'alniy muqiyma alssalati vamin zurriyyatiy rabbana vtaqabbal du'ai
Rabbana ig'fir liy valivalidayya valilmuminiyna yavma yaqumu alhisabu
Vala tahsabanna Alloha g'afilan 'amma ya'malu alzzalimuna innama yuaxxiruhum liyavmin tashxasu fiyhi alabsaru
Muhti'iyna muqni'iy ruusihim la yartaddu ilayhim tarfuhum vafidatuhum havaon
Vanziri alnnasa yavma yatiyhimu al'azabu fayaqulu allaziyna zalamu rabbana axxirna ila ajalin qariybin nujib da'vataka vanattabi'i alrrusula avalam takunu aqsamtum min qablu ma lakum min zavalin
Vasakantum fiy masakini allaziyna zalamu anfusahum vatabayyana lakum kayfa fa'alna bihim vadarabna lakumu alamzala
Vaqad makaru makrahum va'inda Allohi makruhum vain kana makruhum litazula minhu aljibalu
Fala tahsabanna Alloha muxlifa va'dihi rusulahu inna Alloha 'aziyzun zu intiqamin
Yavma tubaddalu alardu g'ayra alardi valssamavatu vabarazu lillahi alvahidi alqahhari
Vatara almujrimiyna yavmaizin muqarraniyna fiy alasfadi
Sarabiyluhum min qatranin vatag'sha vujuhahumu alnnaru
Liyajziya Allohu kulla nafsin ma kasabat inna Alloha sariy'u alhisabi
Haza balag'un lilnnasi valiyunzaru bihi valiya'lamu annama huva ilahun vahidun valiyazzakkara olu alalbabi
Aliflamra tilka ayatu alkitabi vaquranin mubiynin
Rubama yavaddu allaziyna kafaru lav kanu muslimiyna
Zarhum yakulu vayatamatta'u vayulhihimu alamalu fasavfa ya'lamuna
Vama ahlakna min qaryatin illa valaha kitabun ma'lumun
Ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha vama yastaxiruna
Vaqalu ya ayyuha allaziy nuzzila 'alayhi alzzikru innaka lamajnunun
Lav ma tatiyna bialmalaikati in kunta mina alssadiqiyna
Ma nunazzilu almalaikata illa bialhaqqi vama kanu izan munzariyna
Inna nahnu nazzalna alzzikra vainna lahu lahafizuna
Valaqad arsalna min qablika fiy shiya'i alavvaliyna
Vama yatiyhim min rasulin illa kanu bihi yastahziuna
Kazalika naslukuhu fiy qulubi almujrimiyna
La yuminuna bihi vaqad xalat sunnatu alavvaliyna
Valav fatahna 'alayhim baban mina alssamai fazallu fiyhi ya'rujuna
Laqalu innama sukkirat absaruna bal nahnu qavmun mashuruna
Valaqad ja'alna fiy alssamai burujan vazayyannaha lilnnaziriyna
Vahafiznaha min kulli shaytanin rajiymin
Illa mani istaraqa alssam'a fatba'ahu shihabun mubiynun
Valarda madadnaha valqayna fiyha ravasiya vanbatna fiyha min kulli shayin mavzunin
Vaja'alna lakum fiyha ma'ayisha vaman lastum lahu biraziqiyna
Vain min shayin illa 'indana xazainuhu vama nunazziluhu illa biqadarin ma'lumin
Varsalna alrriyaha lavaqiha fanzalna mina alssamai man fasqaynakumuhu vama antum lahu bixaziniyna
Vainna lanahnu nuhyiy vanumiytu vanahnu alvarisuna
Valaqad 'alimna almustaqdimiyna minkum valaqad 'alimna almustaxiriyna
Vainna rabbaka huva yahshuruhum innahu hakiymun 'aliymun
Valaqad xalaqna alinsana min salsalin min hamain masnunin
Valjanna xalaqnahu min qablu min nari alssamumi
Vaiz qala rabbuka lilmalaikati inniy xaliqun basharan min salsalin min hamain masnunin
Faiza savvaytuhu vanafaxtu fiyhi min ruhiy faqa'u lahu sajidiyna
Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajma'una
Illa ibliysa aba an yakuna ma'a alssajidiyna
Qala ya ibliysu ma laka alla takuna ma'a alssajidiyna
Qala lam akun liasjuda libasharin xalaqtahu min salsalin min hamain masnunin
Qala faoxruj minha fainnaka rajiymun
Vainna 'alayka alla'nata ila yavmi alddiyni
Qala rabbi fanzirniy ila yavmi yub'azuna
Qala fainnaka mina almunzariyna
Ila yavmi alvaqti alma'lumi
Qala rabbi bima ag'vaytaniy laozayyinanna lahum fiy alardi valaog'viyannahum ajma'iyna
Illa 'ibadaka minhumu almuxlasiyna
Qala haza siratun 'alayya mustaqiymun
Inna 'ibadiy laysa laka 'alayhim sultanun illa mani ittaba'aka mina alg'aviyna
Vainna jahannama lamav'iduhum ajma'iyna
Laha sab'atu abvabin likulli babin minhum juzon maqsumun
Inna almuttaqiyna fiy jannatin va'uyunin
Odxuluha bisalamin aminiyna
Vanaza'na ma fiy sudurihim min g'illin ixvanan 'ala sururin mutaqabiliyna
La yamassuhum fiyha nasabun vama hum minha bimuxrajiyna
Nabbi 'ibadiy anniy ana alg'afuru alrrahiymu
Va anna 'azabiy huva al'azabu alaliymu
Vanabbihum 'an dayfi ibrahiyma
Iz daxalu 'alayhi faqalu salaman qala inna minkum vajiluna
Qalu la tavjal inna nubashshiruka big'ulamin 'aliymin
Qala abashshartumuniy 'ala an massaniya alkibaru fabima tubashshiruni
Qalu bashsharnaka bialhaqqi fala takun mina alqanitiyna
Qala vaman yaqnatu min rahmati rabbihi illa alddalluna
Qala fama xatbukum ayyuha almursaluna
Qalu inna orsilna ila qavmin mujrimiyna
Illa ala lutin inna lamunajjuhum ajma'iyna
Illa imratahu qaddarna innaha lamina alg'abiriyna
Falamma ja ala lutin almursaluna
Qala innakum qavmun munkaruna
Qalu bal jinaka bima kanu fiyhi yamtaruna
Vataynaka bialhaqqi vainna lasadiquna
Fasri biahlika biqit'in mina allayli vaittabi' adbarahum vala yaltafit minkum ahadun vaimdu haysu tumaruna
Vaqadayna ilayhi zalika alamra anna dabira haolai maqtu'un musbihiyna
Vaja ahlu almadiynati yastabshiruna
Qala inna haolai dayfiy fala tafdahuni
Vaittaqu Alloha vala tuxzuni
Qalu avalam nanhaka 'ani al'alamiyna
Qala haolai banatiy in kuntum fa'iliyna
La'amruka innahum lafiy sakratihim ya'mahuna
Faxazazumu alssayhatu mushriqiyna
Faja'alna 'aliyaha safilaha vamtarna 'alayhim hijaratan min sijjiylin
Inna fiy zalika layatin lilmutavassimiyna
Vainnaha labisabiylin muqiymin
Inna fiy zalika layatan lilmuminiyna
Vain kana ashabu alaykati lazalimiyna
Faintaqamna minhum vainnahuma labiimamin mubiynin
Valaqad kazzaba ashabu alhijri almursaliyna
Vataynahum ayatina fakanu 'anha mu'ridiyna
Vakanu yanhituna mina aljibali buyutan aminiyna
Faxazazumu alssayhatu musbihiyna
Fama ag'na 'anhum ma kanu yaksibuna
Vama xalaqna alssamavati valarda vama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi vainna alssa'ata latiyatun faisfahi alssafha aljamiyla
Inna rabbaka huva alxallaqu al'aliymu
Valaqad ataynaka sab'an mina almazaniy valqurana al'aziyma
La tamuddanna 'aynayka ila ma matta'na bihi azvajan minhum vala tahzan 'alayhim vaixfid janahaka lilmuminiyna
Vaqul inniy ana alnnaziyru almubiynu
Kama anzalna 'ala almuqtasimiyna
Allaziyna ja'alu alqurana 'idiyna
Favarabbika lanasalannahum ajma'iyna
'amma kanu ya'maluna
Faisda' bima tumaru va'rid 'ani almushrikiyna
Inna kafaynaka almustahziiyna
Allaziyna yaj'aluna ma'a Allohi ilahan axara fasavfa ya'lamuna
Valaqad na'lamu annaka yadiyqu sadruka bima yaquluna
Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika vakun mina alssajidiyna
Vao'bud rabbaka hatta yatiyaka alyaqiynu
Ata amru Allohi fala tasta'jiluhu subhanahu vata'ala 'amma yushrikuna
Yunazzilu almalaikata bialrruhi min amrihi 'ala man yashao min 'ibadihi an anziru annahu la ilaha illa ana faittaquni
Xalaqa alssamavati valarda bialhaqqi ta'ala 'amma yushrikuna
Xalaqa alinsana min nutfatin faiza huva xasiymun mubiynun
Valan'ama xalaqaha lakum fiyha difon vamanafi'u vaminha takuluna
Valakum fiyha jamalun hiyna turiyhuna vahiyna tasrahuna
Vatahmilu asqalakum ila baladin lam takunu balig'iyhi illa bishiqqi alanfusi inna rabbakum laraufun rahiymun
Valxayla valbig'ala valhamiyra litarkabuha vaziynatan vayaxluqu ma la ta'lamuna
Va'ala Allohi qasdu alssabiyli vaminha jairun valav sha lahadakum ajma'iyna
Huva allaziy anzala mina alssamai man lakum minhu sharabun vaminhu shajarun fiyhi tusiymuna
Yunbitu lakum bihi alzzar'a valzzaytuna valnnaxiyla vala'naba vamin kulli alzzamarati inna fiy zalika layatan liqavmin yatafakkaruna
Vasaxxara lakumu allayla valnnahara valshshamsa valqamara valnnujumu musaxxaratun biamrihi inna fiy zalika layatin liqavmin ya'qiluna
Vama zara lakum fiy alardi muxtalifan alvanuhu inna fiy zalika layatan liqavmin yazzakkaruna
Vahuva allaziy saxxara albahra litakulu minhu lahman tariyyan vatastaxriju minhu hilyatan talbasunaha vatara alfulka mavaxira fiyhi valitabtag'u min fadlihi vala'allakum tashkuruna
Valqa fiy alardi ravasiya an tamiyda bikum vanharan vasubulan la'allakum tahtaduna
Va'alamatin vabialnnajmi hum yahtaduna
Afaman yaxluqu kaman la yaxluqu afala tazakkaruna
Vain ta'uddu ni'mata Allohi la tuhsuha inna Alloha lag'afurun rahiymun
VaAllohu ya'lamu ma tusirruna vama tu'linuna
Vallaziyna yad'una min duni Allohi la yaxluquna shayan vahum yuxlaquna
Amvatun g'ayru ahyain vama yash'uruna ayyana yub'asuna
Ilahukum ilahun vahidun fallaziyna la yuminuna bialaxirati qulubuhum munkiratun vahum mustakbiruna
La jarama anna Alloha ya'lamu ma yusirruna vama yu'linuna innahu la yuhibbu almustakbiriyna
Vaiza qiyla lahum maza anzala rabbukum qalu asatiyru alavvaliyna
Liyahmilu avzarahum kamilatan yavma alqiyamati vamin avzari allaziyna yudillunahum big'ayri 'ilmin ala sa ma yaziruna
Qad makara allaziyna min qablihim fata Allohu bunyanahum mina alqava'idi faxarra 'alayhimu alssaqfu min favqihim vatahumu al'azabu min hayzu la yash'uruna
Zumma yavma alqiyamati yuxziyhim vayaqulu ayna shurakaiya allaziyna kuntum tushaqquna fiyhim qala allaziyna utu al'ilma inna alxizya alyavma valssua 'ala alkafiriyna
Allaziyna tatavaffahumu almalaikatu zalimiy anfusihim falqavu alssalama ma kunna na'malu min suin bala inna Alloha 'aliymun bima kuntum ta'maluna
Faodxulu abvaba jahannama xalidiyna fiyha falabisa masva almutakabbiriyna
Vaqiyla lillaziyna ittaqav maza anzala rabbukum qalu xayran lillaziyna ahsanu fiy hazihi alddunya hasanatun valadaru alaxirati xayrun valani'ma daru almuttaqiyna
Jannatu 'adnin yadxulunaha tajriy min tahtiha alanharu lahum fiyha ma yashauna kazalika yajziy Allohu almuttaqiyna
Allaziyna tatavaffahumu almalaikatu tayyibiyna yaquluna salamun 'alaykumu odxulu aljannata bima kuntum ta'maluna
Hal yanzuruna illa an tatiyahumu almalaikatu av yatiya amru rabbika kazalika fa'ala allaziyna min qablihim vama zalamahumu Allohu valakin kanu anfusahum yazlimuna
Fasabahum sayyiatu ma 'amilu vahaqa bihim ma kanu bihi yastahziuna

Vaqala allaziyna ashraku lav sha Allohu ma 'abadna min dunihi min shayin nahnu vala abaona vala harramna min dunihi min shayin kazalika fa'ala allaziyna min qablihim fahal 'ala alrrusuli illa albalag'u almubiynu

Valaqad ba'azna fiy kulli ommatin rasulan ani o'budu Alloha vaijtanibu alttag'uta faminhum man hada Allohu vaminhum man haqqat 'alayhi alddalalatu fasiyru fiy alardi faonzuru kayfa kana 'aqibatu almukazzibiyna
In tahris 'ala hudahum fainna Alloha la yahdiy man yudillu vama lahum min nasiriyna
Vaqsamu biAllohi jahda aymanihim la yab'asu Allohu man yamutu bala va'dan 'alayhi haqqan valakinna aksara alnnasi la ya'lamuna
Liyubayyina lahumu allaziy yaxtalifuna fiyhi valiya'lama allaziyna kafaru annahum kanu kazibiyna
Innama qavluna lishayin iza aradnahu an naqula lahu kun fayakunu
Vallaziyna hajaru fiy Allohi min ba'di ma zulimu lanubavviannahum fiy alddunya hasanatan valajru alaxirati akbaru lav kanu ya'lamuna
Allaziyna sabaru va'ala rabbihim yatavakkaluna
Vama arsalna min qablika illa rijalan nuhiy ilayhim faisalu ahla alzzikri in kuntum la ta'lamuna
Bialbayyinati valzzuburi vanzalna ilayka alzzikra litubayyina lilnnasi ma nuzzila ilayhim vala'llohum yatafakkaruna
Afamina allaziyna makaru alssayyiati an yaxsifa Allohu bihimu alarda av yatiyahumu al'azabu min hayzu la yash'uruna
Av yaxuzahum fiy taqallubihim fama hum bimu'jiziyna
Av yaxuzahum 'ala taxavvufin fainna rabbakum laraufun rahiymun
Ava lam yarav ila ma xalaqa Allohu min shayin yatafayyao zilaluhu 'ani alyamiyni valshshamaili sujjadan lillahi vahum daxiruna
Valillahi yasjudu ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi min dabbatin valmalaikatu vahum la yastakbiruna
Yaxafuna rabbahum min favqihim vayaf'aluna ma yumaruna
Vaqala Allohu la tattaxizu ilahayni iznayni innama huva ilahun vahidun faiyyaya fairhabuni
Valahu ma fiy alssamavati valardi valahu alddiynu vasiban afag'ayra Allohi tattaquna
Vama bikum min ni'matin famina Allohi zumma iza massakumu alddurru failayhi tajaruna
Zumma iza kashafa alddurra 'ankum iza fariyqun minkum birabbihim yushrikuna
Liyakfuru bima ataynahum fatamatta'u fasavfa ta'lamuna
Vayaj'aluna lima la ya'lamuna nasiyban mimma razaqnahum taAllohi latusalunna 'amma kuntum taftaruna
Vayaj'aluna lillahi albanati subhanahu valahum ma yashtahuna
Vaiza bushshira ahaduhum bialonza zalla vajhuhu musvaddan vahuva kaziymun
Yatavara mina alqavmi min sui ma bushshira bihi ayumsikuhu 'ala hunin am yadussuhu fiy altturabi ala sa ma yahkumuna
Lillaziyna la yuminuna bialaxirati mazalu alssavi valillahi almazalu ala'la vahuva al'aziyzu alhakiymu
Valav yuaxizu Allohu alnnasa bizulmihim ma taraka 'alayha min dabbatin valakin yuaxxiruhum ila ajalin musamman faiza ja ajaluhum la yastaxiruna sa'atan vala yastaqdimuna
Vayaj'aluna lillahi ma yakrahuna vatasifu alsinatuhumu alkaziba anna lahumu alhusna la jarama anna lahumu alnnara vannahum mufratuna
TaAllohi laqad arsalna ila omamin min qablika fazayyana lahumu alshshaytanu a'malahum fahuva valiyyuhumu alyavma valahum 'azabun aliymun
Vama anzalna 'alayka alkitaba illa litubayyina lahumu allaziy ixtalafu fiyhi vahudan varahmatan liqavmin yuminuna
VaAllohu anzala mina alssamai man fahya bihi alarda ba'da mavtiha inna fiy zalika layatan liqavmin yasma'una
Vainna lakum fiy alan'ami la'ibratan nusqiykum mimma fiy butunihi min bayni farsin vadamin labanan xalisan saig'an lilshsharibiyna
Vamin zamarati alnnaxiyli vala'nabi tattaxizuna minhu sakaran varizqan hasanan inna fiy zalika layatan liqavmin ya'qiluna
Vavha rabbuka ila alnnahli ani ittaxiziy mina aljibali buyutan vamina alshshajari vamimma ya'rishuna
Zumma kuliy min kulli alzzamarati faoslukiy subula rabbiki zululan yaxruju min butuniha sharabun muxtalifun alvanuhu fiyhi shifaon lilnnasi inna fiy zalika layatan liqavmin yatafakkaruna
VaAllohu xalaqakum zumma yatavaffakum vaminkum man yuraddu ila arzali al'umuri likay la ya'lama ba'da 'ilmin shayan inna Alloha 'aliymun qadiyrun
VaAllohu faddala ba'dakum 'ala ba'din fiy alrrizqi fama allaziyna fuddilu biraddiy rizqihim 'ala ma malakat aymanuhum fahum fiyhi savaon afabini'mati Allohi yajhaduna
VaAllohu ja'ala lakum min anfusikum azvajan vaja'ala lakum min azvajikum baniyna vahafadatan varazaqakum mina alttayyibati afabialbatili yuminuna vabini'mati Allohi hum yakfuruna
Vaya'buduna min duni Allohi ma la yamliku lahum rizqan mina alssamavati valardi shayan vala yastatiy'una
Fala tadribu lillahi alamsala inna Alloha ya'lamu vantum la ta'lamuna
Daraba Allohu masalan 'abdan mamlukan la yaqdiru 'ala shayin vaman razaqnahu minna rizqan hasanan fahuva yunfiqu minhu sirran vajahran hal yastavuna alhamdu lillahi bal aksaruhum la ya'lamuna

Vadaraba Allohu masalan rajulayni ahaduhuma abkamu la yaqdiru 'ala shayin vahuva kallun 'ala mavlahu aynama yuvajjihhu la yati bixayrin hal yastaviy huva vaman yamuru bial'adli vahuva 'ala siratin mustaqiymin
Valillahi g'aybu alssamavati valardi vama amru alssa'ati illa kalamhi albasari av huva aqrabu inna Alloha 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun
VaAllohu axrajakum min butuni ommahatikum la ta'lamuna shayan vaja'ala lakumu alssam'a valabsara valafidata la'allakum tashkuruna
Alam yarav ila alttayri musaxxaratin fiy javvi alssamai ma yumsikuhunna illa Allohu inna fiy zalika layatin liqavmin yuminuna
VaAllohu ja'ala lakum min buyutikum sakanan vaja'ala lakum min juludi alan'ami buyutan tastaxiffunaha yavma za'nikum vayavma iqamatikum vamin asvafiha vavbariha vash'ariha azazan vamata'an ila hiynin

VaAllohu ja'ala lakum mimma xalaqa zilalan vaja'ala lakum mina aljibali aknanan vaja'ala lakum sarabiyla taqiykumu alharra vasarabiyla taqiykum basakum kazalika yutimmu ni'matahu 'alaykum la'allakum tuslimuna
Fain tavallav fainnama 'alayka albalag'u almubiynu
Ya'rifuna ni'mata Allohi summa yunkirunaha vaksaruhumu alkafiruna
Vayavma nab'azu min kulli ommatin shahiydan zumma la yuzanu lillaziyna kafaru vala hum yusta'tabuna
Vaiza ra allaziyna zalamu al'azaba fala yuxaffafu 'anhum vala hum yunzaruna
Vaiza ra allaziyna ashraku shurakahum qalu rabbana haolai shurakaona allaziyna kunna nad'u min dunika falqav ilayhimu alqavla innakum lakazibuna
Valqav ila Allohi yavmaizin alssalama vadalla 'anhum ma kanu yaftaruna
Allaziyna kafaru vasaddu 'an sabiyli Allohi zidnahum 'azaban favqa al'azabi bima kanu yufsiduna
Vayavma nab'asu fiy kulli ommatin shahiydan 'alayhim min anfusihim vajina bika shahiydan 'ala haolai vanazzalna 'alayka alkitaba tibyanan likulli shayin vahudan varahmatan vabushra lilmuslimiyna
Inna Alloha yamuru bial'adli valihsani vaiytai ziy alqurba vayanha 'ani alfahshai valmunkari valbag'yi ya'izukum la'allakum tazakkaruna
Vavfu bi'ahdi Allohi iza 'ahadtum vala tanqudu alaymana ba'da tavkiydiha vaqad ja'altumu Alloha 'alaykum kafiylan inna Alloha ya'lamu ma taf'aluna

Vala takunu kallatiy naqadat g'azlaha min ba'di quvvatin ankazan tattaxizuna aymanakum daxalan baynakum an takuna ommatun hiya arba min ommatin innama yablukumu Allohu bihi valayubayyinanna lakum yavma alqiyamati ma kuntum fiyhi taxtalifuna
Valav sha Allohu laja'alakum ommatan vahidatan valakin yudillu man yashao vayahdiy man yashao valatusalunna 'amma kuntum ta'maluna
Vala tattaxizu aymanakum daxalan baynakum fatazilla qadamun ba'da zubutiha vatazuqu alssua bima sadadtum 'an sabiyli Allohi valakum 'azabun 'aziymun
Vala tashtaru bi'ahdi Allohi samanan qaliylan innama 'inda Allohi huva xayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamuna
Ma 'indakum yanfadu vama 'inda Allohi baqin valanajziyanna allaziyna sabaru ajrahum biahsani ma kanu ya'maluna
Man 'amila salihan min zakarin av onza vahuva muminun falanuhyiyannahu hayatan tayyibatan valanajziyannahum ajrahum biahsani ma kanu ya'maluna
Faiza qarata alqurana faista'iz biAllohi mina alshshaytani alrrajiymi
Innahu laysa lahu sultanun 'ala allaziyna amanu va'ala rabbihim yatavakkaluna
Innama sultanuhu 'ala allaziyna yatavallavnahu vallaziyna hum bihi mushrikuna
Vaiza baddalna ayatan makana ayatin vaAllohu a'lamu bima yunazzilu qalu innama anta muftarin bal akzaruhum la ya'lamuna
Qul nazzalahu ruhu alqudusi min rabbika bialhaqqi liyuzabbita allaziyna amanu vahudan vabushra lilmuslimiyna
Valaqad na'lamu annahum yaquluna innama yu'allimuhu basharun lisanu allaziy yulhiduna ilayhi a'jamiyyun vahaza lisanun 'arabiyyun mubiynun
Inna allaziyna la yuminuna biayati Allohi la yahdiyhimu Allohu valahum 'azabun aliymun
Innama yaftariy alkaziba allaziyna la yuminuna biayati Allohi vaolaika humu alkazibuna
Man kafara biAllohi min ba'di iymanihi illa man okriha vaqalbuhu mutmainnun bialiymani valakin man sharaha bialkufri sadran fa'alayhim g'adabun mina Allohi valahum 'azabun 'aziymun
Zalika biannahumu istahabbu alhayata alddunya 'ala alaxirati vanna Alloha la yahdiy alqavma alkafiriyna
Olaika allaziyna taba'a Allohu 'ala qulubihim vasam'ihim vabsarihim vaolaika humu alg'afiluna
La jarama annahum fiy alaxirati humu alxasiruna
Zumma inna rabbaka lillaziyna hajaru min ba'di ma futinu zumma jahadu vasabaru inna rabbaka min ba'diha lag'afurun rahiymun
Yavma tatiy kullu nafsin tujadilu 'an nafsiha vatuvaffa kullu nafsin ma 'amilat vahum la yuzlamuna
Vadaraba Allohu mazalan qaryatan kanat aminatan mutmainnatan yatiyha rizquha rag'adan min kulli makanin fakafarat bian'umi Allohi fazaqaha Allohu libasa alju'i valxavfi bima kanu yasna'una
Valaqad jahum rasulun minhum fakazzabuhu faxazahumu al'azabu vahum zalimuna
Fakulu mimma razaqakumu Allohu halalan tayyiban vaoshkuru ni'mata Allohi in kuntum iyyahu ta'buduna
Innama harrama 'alaykumu almaytata valddama valahma alxinziyri vama ohilla lig'ayri Allohi bihi famani idturra g'ayra bag'in vala 'adin fainna Alloha g'afurun rahiymun
Vala taqulu lima tasifu alsinatukumu alkaziba haza halalun vahaza haramun litaftaru 'ala Allohi alkaziba inna allaziyna yaftaruna 'ala Allohi alkaziba la yuflihuna
Mata'un qaliylun valahum 'azabun aliymun
Va'ala allaziyna hadu harramna ma qasasna 'alayka min qablu vama zalamnahum valakin kanu anfusahum yazlimuna
Zumma inna rabbaka lillaziyna 'amilu alssua bijahalatin zumma tabu min ba'di zalika vaslahu inna rabbaka min ba'diha lag'afurun rahiymun
Inna ibrahiyma kana ommatan qanitan lillahi haniyfan valam yaku mina almushrikiyna
Shakiran lian'umihi ijtabahu vahadahu ila siratin mustaqiymin
Vataynahu fiy alddunya hasanatan vainnahu fiy alaxirati lamina alssalihiyna
Summa avhayna ilayka ani ittabi' millata ibrahiyma haniyfan vama kana mina almushrikiyna
Innama ju'ila alssabtu 'ala allaziyna ixtalafu fiyhi vainna rabbaka layahkumu baynahum yavma alqiyamati fiyma kanu fiyhi yaxtalifuna
Od'u ila sabiyli rabbika bialhikmati valmav'izati alhasanati vajadilhum biallatiy hiya ahsanu inna rabbaka huva a'lamu biman dalla 'an sabiylihi vahuva a'lamu bialmuhtadiyna
Vain 'aqabtum fa'aqibu bimisli ma 'uqibtum bihi valain sabartum lahuva xayrun lilssabiriyna
Vaisbir vama sabruka illa biAllohi vala tahzan 'alayhim vala taku fiy dayqin mimma yamkuruna
Inna Alloha ma'a allaziyna ittaqav vallaziyna hum muhsinuna
Subhana allaziy asra bi'abdihi laylan mina almasjidi alharami ila almasjidi alaqsa allaziy barakna havlahu linuriyahu min ayatina innahu huva alssamiy'u albasiyru
Vatayna musa alkitaba vaja'alnahu hudan libaniy israiyla alla tattaxizu min duniy vakiylan
Zurriyyata man hamalna ma'a nuhin innahu kana 'abdan shakuran
Vaqadayna ila baniy israiyla fiy alkitabi latufsidunna fiy alardi marratayni valata'lunna 'uluvvan kabiyran
Faiza ja va'du ulahuma ba'azna 'alaykum 'ibadan lana oliy basin shadiydin fajasu xilala alddiyari vakana va'dan maf'ulan
Summa radadna lakumu alkarrata 'alayhim vamdadnakum biamvalin vabaniyna vaja'alnakum aksara nafiyran
In ahsantum ahsantum lianfusikum vain asatum falaha faiza ja va'du alaxirati liyasuu vujuhakum valiyadxulu almasjida kama daxaluhu avvala marratin valiyutabbiru ma 'alav tatbiyran
'asa rabbukum an yarhamakum vain 'udtum 'udna vaja'alna jahannama lilkafiriyna hasiyran
Inna haza alqurana yahdiy lillatiy hiya aqvamu vayubashshiru almuminiyna allaziyna ya'maluna alssalihati anna lahum ajran kabiyran
Vanna allaziyna la yuminuna bialaxirati a'tadna lahum 'azaban aliyman
Vayad'u alinsanu bialshsharri du'ahu bialxayri vakana alinsanu 'ajulan

Vaja'alna allayla valnnahara ayatayni famahavna ayata allayli vaja'alna ayata alnnahari mubsiratan litabtag'u fadlan min rabbikum valita'lamu 'adada alssiniyna valhisaba vakulla shayin fassalnahu tafsiylan
Vakulla insanin alzamnahu tairahu fiy 'unuqihi vanuxriju lahu yavma alqiyamati kitaban yalqahu manshuran
Iqra kitabaka kafa binafsika alyavma 'alayka hasiyban
Mani ihtada fainnama yahtadiy linafsihi vaman dalla fainnama yadillu 'alayha vala taziru vaziratun vizra oxra vama kunna mu'azzibiyna hatta nab'aza rasulan
Vaiza aradna an nuhlika qaryatan amarna mutrafiyha fafasaqu fiyha fahaqqa 'alayha alqavlu fadammarnaha tadmiyran
Vakam ahlakna mina alquruni min ba'di nuhin vakafa birabbika bizunubi 'ibadihi xabiyran basiyran
Man kana yuriydu al'ajilata 'ajjalna lahu fiyha ma nashao liman nuriydu zumma ja'alna lahu jahannama yaslaha mazmuman madhuran
Vaman arada alaxirata vasa'a laha sa'yaha vahuva muminun faolaika kana sa'yuhum mashkuran
Kullan numiddu haolai vahaolai min 'atai rabbika vama kana 'atao rabbika mahzuran
Onzur kayfa faddalna ba'dahum 'ala ba'din valalaxiratu akbaru darajatin vakbaru tafdiylan
La taj'al ma'a Allohi ilahan axara fataq'uda mazmuman maxzulan
Vaqada rabbuka alla ta'budu illa iyyahu vabialvalidayni ihsanan imma yablug'anna 'indaka alkibara ahaduhuma av kilahuma fala taqul lahuma offin vala tanharhuma vaqul lahuma qavlan kariyman
Vaixfid lahuma janaha alzzulli mina alrrahmati vaqul rabbi irhamhuma kama rabbayaniy sag'iyran
Rabbukum a'lamu bima fiy nufusikum in takunu salihiyna fainnahu kana lilavvabiyna g'afuran
Vati za alqurba haqqahu valmiskiyna vaibna alssabiyli vala tubazzir tabziyran
Inna almubazziriyna kanu ixvana alshshayatiyni vakana alshshaytanu lirabbihi kafuran
Vaimma tu'ridanna 'anhumu ibtig'a rahmatin min rabbika tarjuha faqul lahum qavlan maysuran
Vala taj'al yadaka mag'lulatan ila 'unuqika vala tabsuza kulla albasti fataq'uda maluman mahsuran
Inna rabbaka yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao vayaqdiru innahu kana bi'ibadihi xabiyran basiyran
Vala taqtulu avladakum xashyata imlaqin nahnu narzuquhum vaiyyakum inna qatlahum kana xitan kabiyran
Vala taqrabu alzzina innahu kana fahishatan vasa sabiylan
Vala taqtulu alnnafsa allatiy harrama Allohu illa bialhaqqi vaman qutila mazluman faqad ja'alna livaliyyihi sultanan fala yusrif fiy alqatli innahu kana mansuran
Vala taqrabu mala alyatiymi illa biallatiy hiya ahsanu hatta yablug'a ashuddahu vavfu bial'ahdi inna al'ahda kana masulan
Vavfu alkayla iza kiltum vazinu bialqistasi almustaqiymi zalika xayrun vahsanu taviylan
Vala taqfu ma laysa laka bihi 'ilmun inna alssam'a valbasara valfuada kullu olaika kana 'anhu masulan
Vala tamshi fiy alardi marahan innaka lan taxriqa alarda valan tablug'a aljibala tulan
Kullu zalika kana sayyiohu 'inda rabbika makruhan
Zalika mimma avha ilayka rabbuka mina alhikmati vala taj'al ma'a Allohi ilahan axara fatulqa fiy jahannama maluman madhuran
Afasfakum rabbukum bialbaniyna vaittaxaza mina almalaikati inazan innakum lataquluna qavlan 'aziyman
Valaqad sarrafna fiy haza alqurani liyazzakkaru vama yaziyduhum illa nufuran
Qul lav kana ma'ahu alihatun kama yaquluna izan laibtag'av ila ziy al'arshi sabiylan
Subhanahu vata'ala 'amma yaquluna 'uluvvan kabiyran
Tusabbihu lahu alssamavatu alssab'u valardu vaman fiyhinna vain min shayin illa yusabbihu bihamdihi valakin la tafqahuna tasbiyhahum innahu kana haliyman g'afuran
Vaiza qarata alqurana ja'alna baynaka vabayna allaziyna la yuminuna bialaxirati hijaban masturan
Vaja'alna 'ala qulubihim akinnatan an yafqahuhu vafiy azanihim vaqran vaiza zakarta rabbaka fiy alqurani vahdahu vallav 'ala adbarihim nufuran
Nahnu a'lamu bima yastami'una bihi iz yastami'una ilayka vaiz hum najva iz yaqulu alzzalimuna in tattabi'una illa rajulan mashuran
Onzur kayfa darabu laka alamzala fadallu fala yastatiy'una sabiylan
Vaqalu aiza kunna 'izaman varufatan ainna lamab'uzuna xalqan jadiydan
Qul kunu hijaratan av hadiydan
Av xalqan mimma yakburu fiy sudurikum fasayaquluna man yu'iyduna quli allaziy fatarakum avvala marratin fasayung'iduna ilayka ruusahum vayaquluna mata huva qul 'asa an yakuna qariyban
Yavma yad'ukum fatastajiybuna bihamdihi vatazunnuna in labiztum illa qaliylan
Vaqul li'ibadiy yaqulu allatiy hiya ahsanu inna alshshaytana yanzag'u baynahum inna alshshaytana kana lilinsani 'aduvvan mubiynan
Rabbukum a'lamu bikum in yasha yarhamkum av in yasha yu'azzibkum vama arsalnaka 'alayhim vakiylan
Varabbuka a'lamu biman fiy alssamavati valardi valaqad faddalna ba'da alnnabiyyiyna 'ala ba'din vatayna davuda zaburan
Quli od'u allaziyna za'amtum min dunihi fala yamlikuna kashfa alddurri 'ankum vala tahviylan
Olaika allaziyna yad'una yabtag'una ila rabbihimu alvasiylata ayyuhum aqrabu vayarjuna rahmatahu vayaxafuna 'azabahu inna 'azaba rabbika kana mahzuran
Vain min qaryatin illa nahnu muhlikuha qabla yavmi alqiyamati av mu'azzibuha 'azaban shadiydan kana zalika fiy alkitabi masturan
Vama mana'ana an nursila bialayati illa an kazzaba biha alavvaluna vatayna zamuda alnnaqata mubsiratan fazalamu biha vama nursilu bialayati illa taxviyfan

Vaiz qulna laka inna rabbaka ahata bialnnasi vama ja'alna alrruya allatiy araynaka illa fitnatan lilnnasi valshshajarata almal'unata fiy alqurani vanuxavvifuhum fama yaziyduhum illa tug'yanan kabiyran
Vaiz qulna lilmalaikati osjudu liadama fasajadu illa ibliysa qala asjudu liman xalaqta tiynan
Qala araytaka haza allaziy karramta 'alayya lain axxartani ila yavmi alqiyamati lahtanikanna zurriyyatahu illa qaliylan
Qala izhab faman tabi'aka minhum fainna jahannama jazaokum jazan mavfuran
Vaistafziz mani istata'ta minhum bisavtika vajlib 'alayhim bixaylika varajlika vasharixum fiy alamvali valavladi va'idhum vama ya'iduhumu alshshaytanu illa g'ururan
Inna 'ibadiy laysa laka 'alayhim sultanun vakafa birabbika vakiylan
Rabbukumu allaziy yuzjiy lakumu alfulka fiy albahri litabtag'u min fadlihi innahu kana bikum rahiyman
Vaiza massakumu alddurru fiy albahri dalla man tad'una illa iyyahu falamma najjakum ila albarri a'radtum vakana alinsanu kafuran
Afamintum an yaxsifa bikum janiba albarri av yursila 'alaykum hasiban summa la tajidu lakum vakiylan
Am amintum an yu'iydakum fiyhi taratan oxra fayursila 'alaykum qasifan mina alrriyhi fayug'riqakum bima kafartum summa la tajidu lakum 'alayna bihi tabiy'an
Valaqad karramna baniy adama vahamalnahum fiy albarri valbahri varazaqnahum mina alttayyibati vafaddalnahum 'ala kasiyrin mimman xalaqna tafdiylan
Yavma nad'u kulla onasin biimamihim faman utiya kitabahu biyamiynihi faolaika yaqrauna kitabahum vala yuzlamuna fatiylan
Vaman kana fiy hazihi a'ma fahuva fiy alaxirati a'ma vadallu sabiylan
Vain kadu layaftinunaka 'ani allaziy avhayna ilayka litaftariya 'alayna g'ayrahu vaizan laittaxazuka xaliylan
Valavla an sabbatnaka laqad kidta tarkanu ilayhim shayan qaliylan
Izan lazaqnaka di'fa alhayati vadi'fa almamati zumma la tajidu laka 'alayna nasiyran
Vain kadu layastafizzunaka mina alardi liyuxrijuka minha vaizan la yalbazuna xilafaka illa qaliylan
Sunnata man qad arsalna qablaka min rusulina vala tajidu lisunnatina tahviylan
Aqimi alssalata liduluki alshshamsi ila g'asaqi allayli vaqurana alfajri inna qurana alfajri kana mashhudan
Vamina allayli fatahajjad bihi nafilatan laka 'asa an yab'asaka rabbuka maqaman mahmudan
Vaqul rabbi adxilniy mudxala sidqin vaxrijniy muxraja sidqin vaij'al liy min ladunka sultanan nasiyran
Vaqul ja alhaqqu vazahaqa albatilu inna albatila kana zahuqan
Vanunazzilu mina alqurani ma huva shifaon varahmatun lilmuminiyna vala yaziydu alzzalimiyna illa xasaran
Vaiza an'amna 'ala alinsani a'rada vana bijanibihi vaiza massahu alshsharru kana yausan
Qul kullun ya'malu 'ala shakilatihi farabbukum a'lamu biman huva ahda sabiylan
Vayasalunaka 'ani alrruhi quli alrruhu min amri rabbiy vama utiytum mina al'ilmi illa qaliylan
Valain shina lanazhabanna biallaziy avhayna ilayka zumma la tajidu laka bihi 'alayna vakiylan
Illa rahmatan min rabbika inna fadlahu kana 'alayka kabiyran
Qul laini ijtama'ati alinsu valjinnu 'ala an yatu bimizli haza alqurani la yatuna bimizlihi valav kana ba'duhum liba'din zahiyran
Valaqad sarrafna lilnnasi fiy haza alqurani min kulli mazalin faba akzaru alnnasi illa kufuran
Vaqalu lan numina laka hatta tafjura lana mina alardi yanbu'an
Av takuna laka jannatun min naxiylin va'inabin fatufajjira alanhara xilalaha tafjiyran
Av tusqita alssama kama za'amta 'alayna kisafan av tatiya biAllohi valmalaikati qabiylan
Av yakuna laka baytun min zuxrufin av tarqa fiy alssamai valan numina liruqiyyika hatta tunazzila 'alayna kitaban naqraohu qul subhana rabbiy hal kuntu illa basharan rasulan
Vama mana'a alnnasa an yuminu iz jahumu alhuda illa an qalu aba'aza Allohu basharan rasulan
Qul lav kana fiy alardi malaikatun yamshuna mutmainniyna lanazzalna 'alayhim mina alssamai malakan rasulan
Qul kafa biAllohi shahiydan bayniy vabaynakum innahu kana bi'ibadihi xabiyran basiyran

Vaman yahdi Allohu fahuva almuhtadi vaman yudlil falan tajida lahum avliya min dunihi vanahshuruhum yavma alqiyamati 'ala vujuhihim 'umyan vabukman vasumman mavahum jahannamu kullama xabat zidnahum sa'iyran
Zalika jazaohum biannahum kafaru biayatina vaqalu aiza kunna 'izaman varufatan ainna lamab'uzuna xalqan jadiydan
Avalam yarav anna Alloha allaziy xalaqa alssamavati valarda qadirun 'ala an yaxluqa mizlahum vaja'ala lahum ajalan la rayba fiyhi faba alzzalimuna illa kufuran
Qul lav antum tamlikuna xazaina rahmati rabbiy izan lamsaktum xashyata alinfaqi vakana alinsanu qaturan
Valaqad atayna musa tis'a ayatin bayyinatin faisal baniy israiyla iz jahum faqala lahu fir'avnu inniy lazunnuka ya musa mashuran
Qala laqad 'alimta ma anzala haolai illa rabbu alssamavati valardi basaira vainniy lazunnuka ya fir'avnu mazburan
Farada an yastafizzahum mina alardi fag'raqnahu vaman ma'ahu jamiy'an
Vaqulna min ba'dihi libaniy israiyla oskunu alarda faiza ja va'du alaxirati jina bikum lafiyfan
Vabialhaqqi anzalnahu vabialhaqqi nazala vama arsalnaka illa mubashshiran vanaziyran
Vaquranan faraqnahu litaqrahu 'ala alnnasi 'ala muksin vanazzalnahu tanziylan
Qul aminu bihi av la tuminu inna allaziyna utu al'ilma min qablihi iza yutla 'alayhim yaxirruna lilazqani sujjadan
Vayaquluna subhana rabbina in kana va'du rabbina lamaf'ulan
Vayaxirruna lilazqani yabkuna vayaziyduhum xushu'an
Quli od'u Alloha avi od'u alrrahmana ayyan ma tad'u falahu alasmao alhusna vala tajhar bisalatika vala tuxafit biha vaibtag'i bayna zalika sabiylan
Vaquli alhamdu lillahi allaziy lam yattaxiz valadan valam yakun lahu shariykun fiy almulki valam yakun lahu valiyyun mina alzzulli vakabbirhu takbiyran
Alhamdu lillahi allaziy anzala 'ala 'abdihi alkitaba valam yaj'al lahu 'ivajan
Qayyiman liyunzira basan shadiydan min ladunhu vayubashshira almuminiyna allaziyna ya'maluna alssalihati anna lahum ajran hasanan
Makisiyna fiyhi abadan
Vayunzira allaziyna qalu ittaxaza Allohu valadan
Ma lahum bihi min 'ilmin vala liabaihim kaburat kalimatan taxruju min afvahihim in yaquluna illa kaziban
Fala'allaka baxi'un nafsaka 'ala azarihim in lam yuminu bihaza alhadiyzi asafan
Inna ja'alna ma 'ala alardi ziynatan laha linabluvahum ayyuhum ahsanu 'amalan
Vainna laja'iluna ma 'alayha sa'iydan juruzan
Am hasibta anna ashaba alkahfi valrraqiymi kanu min ayatina 'ajaban
Iz ava alfityatu ila alkahfi faqalu rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan vahayyi lana min amrina rashadan
Fadarabna 'ala azanihim fiy alkahfi siniyna 'adadan
Summa ba'asnahum lina'lama ayyu alhizbayni ahsa lima labisu amadan
Nahnu naqussu 'alayka nabahum bialhaqqi innahum fityatun amanu birabbihim vazidnahum hudan
Varabatna 'ala qulubihim iz qamu faqalu rabbuna rabbu alssamavati valardi lan nad'uva min dunihi ilahan laqad qulna izan shatatan
