Haolai qavmuna ittaxazu min dunihi alihatan lavla yatuna 'alayhim bisultanin bayyinin faman azlamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allohi kaziban
Vaizi i'tazaltumuhum vama ya'buduna illa Alloha favu ila alkahfi yanshur lakum rabbukum min rahmatihi vayuhayyi lakum min amrikum mirfaqan

Vatara alshshamsa iza tala'at tazavaru 'an kahfihim zata alyamiyni vaiza g'arabat taqriduhum zata alshshimali vahum fiy fajvatin minhu zalika min ayati Allohi man yahdi Allohu fahuva almuhtadi vaman yudlil falan tajida lahu valiyyan murshidan
Vatahsabuhum ayqazan vahum ruqudun vanuqallibuhum zata alyamiyni vazata alshshimali vakalbuhum basitun zira'ayhi bialvasiydi lavi ittala'ta 'alayhim lavallayta minhum firaran valamulita minhum ru'ban

Vakazalika ba'aznahum liyatasalu baynahum qala qailun minhum kam labiztum qalu labizna yavman av ba'da yavmin qalu rabbukum a'lamu bima labiztum faib'azu ahadakum bivariqikum hazihi ila almadiynati falyanzur ayyuha azka ta'aman falyatikum birizqin minhu valyatalattaf vala yush'iranna bikum ahadan
Innahum in yazharu 'alaykum yarjumukum av yu'iydukum fiy millatihim valan tuflihu izan abadan

Vakazalika a'zarna 'alayhim liya'lamu anna va'da Allohi haqqun vanna alsa'ata la rayba fiyha iz yatanaza'una baynahum amrahum faqalu ibnu 'alayhim bunyanan rabbuhum a'lamu bihim qala allaziyna g'alabu 'ala amrihim lanattaxizanna 'alayhim masjidan

Sayaquluna zalazatun rabi'uhum kalbuhum vayaquluna xamsatun sadisuhum kalbuhum rajman bialg'aybi vayaquluna sab'atun vazaminuhum kalbuhum qul rabbiy a'lamu bi'iddatihim ma ya'lamuhum illa qaliylun fala tumari fiyhim illa miran zahiran vala tastafti fiyhim minhum ahadan
Vala taqulanna lishayin inniy fa'ilun zalika g'adan
Illa an yasha Allohu vaozkur rabbaka iza nasiyta vaqul 'asa an yahdiyani rabbiy liaqraba min haza rashadan
Valabisu fiy kahfihim salasa miatin siniyna vaizdadu tis'an
Quli Allohu a'lamu bima labisu lahu g'aybu alssamavati valardi absir bihi vasmi' ma lahum min dunihi min valiyyin vala yushriku fiy hukmihi ahadan
Vaotlu ma uhiya ilayka min kitabi rabbika la mubaddila likalimatihi valan tajida min dunihi multahadan

Vaisbir nafsaka ma'a allaziyna yad'una rabbahum bialg'adati val'ashiyyi yuriyduna vajhahu vala ta'du 'aynaka 'anhum turiydu ziynata alhayati alddunya vala tuti' man ag'falna qalbahu 'an zikrina vaittaba'a havahu vakana amruhu furutan

Vaquli alhaqqu min rabbikum faman sha falyumin vaman sha falyakfur inna a'tadna lilzzalimiyna naran ahata bihim suradiquha vain yastag'iyzu yug'azu bimain kalmuhli yashviy alvujuha bisa alshsharabu vasat murtafaqan
Inna allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati inna la nudiy'u ajra man ahsana 'amalan

Olaika lahum jannatu 'adnin tajriy min tahtihimu alanharu yuhallavna fiyha min asavira min zahabin vayalbasuna ziyaban xudran min sundusin vaistabraqin muttakiiyna fiyha 'ala alaraiki ni'ma alzzavabu vahasunat murtafaqan
Vaidrib lahum masalan rajulayni ja'alna liahadihima jannatayni min a'nabin vahafafnahuma binaxlin vaja'alna baynahuma zar'an
Kilta aljannatayni atat okulaha valam tazlim minhu shayan vafajjarna xilalahuma naharan
Vakana lahu samarun faqala lisahibihi vahuva yuhaviruhu ana aksaru minka malan va'azzu nafaran
Vadaxala jannatahu vahuva zalimun linafsihi qala ma azunnu an tabiyda hazihi abadan
Vama azunnu alssa'ata qaimatan valain rudidtu ila rabbiy lajidanna xayran minha munqalaban
Qala lahu sahibuhu vahuva yuhaviruhu akafarta biallaziy xalaqaka min turabin zumma min nutfatin zumma savvaka rajulan
Lakinna huva Allohu rabbiy vala oshriku birabbiy ahadan
Valavla iz daxalta jannataka qulta ma sha Allohu la quvvata illa biAllohi in tarani ana aqalla minka malan vavaladan
Fa'asa rabbiy an yutiyani xayran min jannatika vayursila 'alayha husbanan mina alssamai fatusbiha sa'iydan zalaqan
Av yusbiha maoha g'avran falan tastatiy'a lahu talaban
Vaohiyta bisamarihi fasbaha yuqallibu kaffayhi 'ala ma anfaqa fiyha vahiya xaviyatun 'ala 'urushiha vayaqulu ya laytaniy lam oshrik birabbiy ahadan
Valam takun lahu fiatun yansurunahu min duni Allohi vama kana muntasiran
Hunalika alvalayatu lillahi alhaqqi huva xayrun savaban vaxayrun 'uqban
Vaidrib lahum mazala alhayati alddunya kamain anzalnahu mina alssamai faixtalata bihi nabatu alardi fasbaha hashiyman tazruhu alrriyahu vakana Allohu 'ala kulli shayin muqtadiran
Almalu valbanuna ziynatu alhayati alddunya valbaqiyatu alssalihatu xayrun 'inda rabbika savaban vaxayrun amalan
Vayavma nusayyiru aljibala vatara alarda barizatan vahasharnahum falam nug'adir minhum ahadan
Va'uridu 'ala rabbika saffan laqad jitumuna kama xalaqnakum avvala marratin bal za'amtum allan naj'ala lakum mav'idan

Vavudi'a alkitabu fatara almujrimiyna mushfiqiyna mimma fiyhi vayaquluna ya vaylatana ma lihaza alkitabi la yug'adiru sag'iyratan vala kabiyratan illa ahsaha vavajadu ma 'amilu hadiran vala yazlimu rabbuka ahadan

Vaiz qulna lilmalaikati osjudu liadama fasajadu illa ibliysa kana mina aljinni fafasaqa 'an amri rabbihi afatattaxizunahu vazurriyyatahu avliya min duniy vahum lakum 'aduvvun bisa lilzzalimiyna badalan
Ma ashhadtuhum xalqa alssamavati valardi vala xalqa anfusihim vama kuntu muttaxiza almudilliyna 'adudan
Vayavma yaqulu nadu shurakaiya allaziyna za'amtum fada'avhum falam yastajiybu lahum vaja'alna baynahum mavbiqan
Vara almujrimuna alnnara fazannu annahum muvaqi'uha valam yajidu 'anha masrifan
Valaqad sarrafna fiy haza alqurani lilnnasi min kulli mazalin vakana alinsanu akzara shayin jadalan
Vama mana'a alnnasa an yuminu iz jahumu alhuda vayastag'firu rabbahum illa an tatiyahum sunnatu alavvaliyna av yatiyahumu al'azabu qubulan
Vama nursilu almursaliyna illa mubashshiriyna vamunziriyna vayujadilu allaziyna kafaru bialbatili liyudhidu bihi alhaqqa vaittaxazu ayatiy vama onziru huzuvan

Vaman azlamu mimman zukkira biayati rabbihi fa'rada 'anha vanasiya ma qaddamat yadahu inna ja'alna 'ala qulubihim akinnatan an yafqahuhu vafiy azanihim vaqran vain tad'uhum ila alhuda falan yahtadu izan abadan
Varabbuka alg'afuru zu alrrahmati lav yuaxizuhum bima kasabu la'ajjala lahumu al'azaba bal lahum mav'idun lan yajidu min dunihi mavilan
Vatilka alqura ahlaknahum lamma zalamu vaja'alna limahlikihim mav'idan
Vaiz qala musa lifatahu la abrahu hatta ablug'a majma'a albahrayni av amdiya huquban
Falamma balag'a majma'a baynihima nasiya hutahuma faittaxaza sabiylahu fiy albahri saraban
Falamma javaza qala lifatahu atina g'adana laqad laqiyna min safarina haza nasaban
Qala arayta iz avayna ila alssaxrati fainniy nasiytu alhuta vama ansaniyhu illa alshshaytanu an azkurahu vaittaxaza sabiylahu fiy albahri 'ajaban
Qala zalika ma kunna nabg'i fairtadda 'ala azarihima qasasan
Favajada 'abdan min 'ibadina ataynahu rahmatan min 'indina va'allamnahu min ladunna 'ilman
Qala lahu musa hal attabi'uka 'ala an tu'allimani mimma 'ullimta rushdan
Qala innaka lan tastatiy'a ma'iya sabran
Vakayfa tasbiru 'ala ma lam tuhit bihi xubran
Qala satajiduniy in sha Allohu sabiran vala a'siy laka amran
Qala faini ittaba'taniy fala tasalniy 'an shayin hatta ohdiza laka minhu zikran
Faintalaqa hatta iza rakiba fiy alssafiynati xaraqaha qala axaraqtaha litug'riqa ahlaha laqad jita shayan imran
Qala alam aqul innaka lan tastatiy'a ma'iya sabran
Qala la tuaxizniy bima nasiytu vala turhiqniy min amriy 'usran
Faintalaqa hatta iza laqiya g'ulaman faqatalahu qala aqatalta nafsan zakiyyatan big'ayri nafsin laqad jita shayan nukran
Qala alam aqul laka innaka lan tastatiy'a ma'iya sabran
Qala in saltuka 'an shayin ba'daha fala tusahibniy qad balag'ta min ladunniy 'uzran
Faintalaqa hatta iza ataya ahla qaryatin istat'ama ahlaha fabav an yudayyifuhuma favajada fiyha jidaran yuriydu an yanqadda faqamahu qala lav shita laittaxazta 'alayhi ajran
Qala haza firaqu bayniy vabaynika saonabbioka bitaviyli ma lam tastati' 'alayhi sabran
Amma alssafiynatu fakanat limasakiyna ya'maluna fiy albahri faradtu an a'iybaha vakana varahum malikun yaxuzu kulla safiynatin g'asban
Vamma alg'ulamu fakana abavahu muminayni faxashiyna an yurhiqahuma tug'yanan vakufran
Faradna an yubdilahuma rabbuhuma xayran minhu zakatan vaqraba ruhman

Vamma aljidaru fakana lig'ulamayni yatiymayni fiy almadiynati vakana tahtahu kanzun lahuma vakana abuhuma salihan farada rabbuka an yablug'a ashuddahuma vayastaxrija kanzahuma rahmatan min rabbika vama fa'altuhu 'an amriy zalika taviylu ma lam tasti' 'alayhi sabran
Vayasalunaka 'an ziy alqarnayni qul satlu 'alaykum minhu zikran
Inna makkanna lahu fiy alardi vataynahu min kulli shayin sababan
Fatba'a sababan
Hatta iza balag'a mag'riba alshshamsi vajadaha tag'rubu fiy 'aynin hamiatin vavajada 'indaha qavman qulna ya za alqarnayni imma an tu'azziba vaimma an tattaxiza fiyhim husnan
Qala amma man zalama fasavfa nu'azzibuhu zumma yuraddu ila rabbihi fayu'azzibuhu 'azaban nukran
Vamma man amana va'amila salihan falahu jazan alhusna vasanaqulu lahu min amrina yusran
Summa atba'a sababan
Hatta iza balag'a matli'a alshshamsi vajadaha tatlu'u 'ala qavmin lam naj'al lahum min duniha sitran
Kazalika vaqad ahatna bima ladayhi xubran
Summa atba'a sababan
Hatta iza balag'a bayna alssaddayni vajada min dunihima qavman la yakaduna yafqahuna qavlan
Qalu ya za alqarnayni inna yajuja vamajuja mufsiduna fiy alardi fahal naj'alu laka xarjan 'ala an taj'ala baynana vabaynahum saddan
Qala ma makkanniy fiyhi rabbiy xayrun fa'iynuniy biquvvatin aj'al baynakum vabaynahum radman
Atuniy zubara alhadiydi hatta iza sava bayna alsadafayni qala onfuxu hatta iza ja'alahu naran qala atuniy ofrig' 'alayhi qitran
Fama ista'u an yazharuhu vama istata'u lahu naqban
Qala haza rahmatun min rabbiy faiza ja va'du rabbiy ja'alahu dakka vakana va'du rabbiy haqqan
Vatarakna ba'dahum yavmaizin yamuju fiy ba'din vanufixa fiy alssuri fajama'nahum jam'an
Va'aradna jahannama yavmaizin lilkafiriyna 'ardan
Allaziyna kanat a'yunuhum fiy g'itain 'an zikriy vakanu la yastatiy'una sam'an
Afahasiba allaziyna kafaru an yattaxizu 'ibadiy min duniy avliya inna a'tadna jahannama lilkafiriyna nuzulan
Qul hal nunabbiokum bialaxsariyna a'malan
Allaziyna dalla sa'yuhum fiy alhayati alddunya vahum yahsabuna annahum yuhsinuna sun'an
Olaika allaziyna kafaru biayati rabbihim valiqaihi fahabitat a'maluhum fala nuqiymu lahum yavma alqiyamati vaznan
Zalika jazaohum jahannamu bima kafaru vaittaxazu ayatiy varusuliy huzuvan
Inna allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati kanat lahum jannatu alfirdavsi nuzulan
Xalidiyna fiyha la yabg'una 'anha hivalan
Qul lav kana albahru midadan likalimati rabbiy lanafida albahru qabla an tanfada kalimatu rabbiy valav jina bimislihi madadan
Qul innama ana basharun mislukum yuha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun vahidun faman kana yarju liqa rabbihi falya'mal 'amalan salihan vala yushrik bi'ibadati rabbihi ahadan
Kafhaya'aynsad
Zikru rahmati rabbika 'abdahu zakariyya
Iz nada rabbahu nidan xafiyyan
Qala rabbi inniy vahana al'azmu minniy vaishta'ala alrrasu shayban valam akun bidu'aika rabbi shaqiyyan
Vainniy xiftu almavaliya min varaiy vakanati imratiy 'aqiran fahab liy min ladunka valiyyan
Yarisuniy vayarisu min ali ya'quba vaij'alhu rabbi radiyyan
Ya zakariyya inna nubashshiruka big'ulamin ismuhu yahya lam naj'al lahu min qablu samiyyan
Qala rabbi anna yakunu liy g'ulamun vakanati imratiy 'aqiran vaqad balag'tu mina alkibari 'itiyyan
Qala kazalika qala rabbuka huva 'alayya hayyinun vaqad xalaqtuka min qablu valam taku shayan
Qala rabbi ij'al liy ayatan qala ayatuka alla tukallima alnnasa salasa layalin saviyyan
Faxaraja 'ala qavmihi mina almihrabi favha ilayhim an sabbihu bukratan va'ashiyyan
Ya yahya xuzi alkitaba biquvvatin vataynahu alhukma sabiyyan
Vahananan min ladunna vazakatan vakana taqiyyan
Vabarran bivalidayhi valam yakun jabbaran 'asiyyan
Vasalamun 'alayhi yavma vulida vayavma yamutu vayavma yub'asu hayyan
Vaozkur fiy alkitabi maryama izi intabazat min ahliha makanan sharqiyyan
Faittaxazat min dunihim hijaban farsalna ilayha ruhana fatamazzala laha basharan saviyyan
Qalat inniy a'uzu bialrrahmani minka in kunta taqiyyan
Qala innama ana rasulu rabbiki liahaba laki g'ulaman zakiyyan
Qalat anna yakunu liy g'ulamun valam yamsasniy basharun valam aku bag'iyyan
Qala kazaliki qala rabbuki huva 'alayya hayyinun valinaj'alahu ayatan lilnnasi varahmatan minna vakana amran maqdiyyan
Fahamalazu faintabazat bihi makanan qasiyyan
Fajaha almaxadu ila jiz'i alnnaxlati qalat ya laytaniy mittu qabla haza vakuntu nasyan mansiyyan
Fanadaha min tahtiha alla tahzaniy qad ja'ala rabbuki tahtaki sariyyan
Vahuzziy ilayki bijiz'i alnnaxlati tusaqit 'alayki rutaban janiyyan
Fakuliy vaishrabiy vaqarriy 'aynan faimma tarayinna mina albashari ahadan faquliy inniy nazartu lilrrahmani savman falan okallima alyavma insiyyan
Fatat bihi qavmaha tahmiluhu qalu ya maryamu laqad jiti shayan fariyyan
Ya oxta haruna ma kana abuki imra savin vama kanat ommuki bag'iyyan
Fasharat ilayhi qalu kayfa nukallimu man kana fiy almahdi sabiyyan
Qala inniy 'abdu Allohi ataniya alkitaba vaja'alaniy nabiyyan
Vaja'alaniy mubarakan ayna ma kuntu vavsaniy bialssalati valzzakati ma dumtu hayyan
Vabarran bivalidatiy valam yaj'alniy jabbaran shaqiyyan
Valssalamu 'alayya yavma vulidtu vayavma amutu vayavma ob'asu hayyan
Zalika 'iysa ibnu maryama qavla alhaqqi allaziy fiyhi yamtaruna
Ma kana lillahi an yattaxiza min valadin subhanahu iza qada amran fainnama yaqulu lahu kun fayakunu
Vainna Alloha rabbiy varabbukum fao'buduhu haza siratun mustaqiymun
Faixtalafa alahzabu min baynihim favaylun lillaziyna kafaru min mashhadi yavmin 'aziymin
Asmi' bihim vabsir yavma yatunana lakini alzzalimuna alyavma fiy dalalin mubiynin
Vanzirhum yavma alhasrati iz qudiya alamru vahum fiy g'aflatin vahum la yuminuna
Inna nahnu narisu alarda vaman 'alayha vailayna yurja'una
Vaozkur fiy alkitabi ibrahiyma innahu kana siddiyqan nabiyyan
Iz qala liabiyhi ya abati lima ta'budu ma la yasma'u vala yubsiru vala yug'niy 'anka shayan
Ya abati inniy qad janiy mina al'ilmi ma lam yatika faittabi'niy ahdika siratan saviyyan
Ya abati la ta'budi alshshaytana inna alshshaytana kana lilrrahmani 'asiyyan
Ya abati inniy axafu an yamassaka 'azabun mina alrrahmani fatakuna lilshshyatani valiyyan
Qala arag'ibun anta 'an alihatiy ya ibrahiymu lain lam tantahi larjumannaka vaohjurniy maliyyan
Qala salamun 'alayka sastag'firu laka rabbiy innahu kana biy hafiyyan
Va'tazilukum vama tad'una min duni Allohi vad'u rabbiy 'asa alla akuna bidu'ai rabbiy shaqiyyan
Falamma i'tazalahum vama ya'buduna min duni Allohi vahabna lahu ishaqa vaya'quba vakullan ja'alna nabiyyan
Vavahabna lahum min rahmatina vaja'alna lahum lisana sidqin 'aliyyan
Vaozkur fiy alkitabi musa innahu kana muxlasan vakana rasulan nabiyyan
Vanadaynahu min janibi altturi alaymani vaqarrabnahu najiyyan
Vavahabna lahu min rahmatina axahu haruna nabiyyan
Vaozkur fiy alkitabi isma'iyla innahu kana sadiqa alva'di vakana rasulan nabiyyan
Vakana yamuru ahlahu bialssalati valzzakati vakana 'inda rabbihi mardiyyan
Vaozkur fiy alkitabi idriysa innahu kana siddiyqan nabiyyan
Varafa'nahu makanan 'aliyyan

Olaika allaziyna an'ama Allohu 'alayhim mina alnnabiyyiyna min zurriyyati adama vamimman hamalna ma'a nuhin vamin zurriyyati ibrahiyma vaisraiyla vamimman hadayna vaijtabayna iza tutla 'alayhim ayatu alrrahmani xarru sujjadan vabukiyyan
Faxalafa min ba'dihim xalfun ada'u alssalata vaittaba'u alshshahavati fasavfa yalqavna g'ayyan
Illa man taba vamana va'amila salihan faolaika yadxuluna aljannata vala yuzlamuna shayan
Jannati 'adnin allatiy va'ada alrrahmanu 'ibadahu bialg'aybi innahu kana va'duhu matiyyan
La yasma'una fiyha lag'van illa salaman valahum rizquhum fiyha bukratan va'ashiyyan
Tilka aljannatu allatiy nurisu min 'ibadina man kana taqiyyan
Vama natanazzalu illa biamri rabbika lahu ma bayna aydiyna vama xalfana vama bayna zalika vama kana rabbuka nasiyyan
Rabbu alssamavati valardi vama baynahuma fao'budhu vaistabir li'ibadatihi hal ta'lamu lahu samiyyan
Vayaqulu alinsanu aiza ma mittu lasavfa oxraju hayyan
Avala yazkuru alinsanu anna xalaqnahu min qablu valam yaku shayan
Favarabbika lanahshurannahum valshshayatiyna summa lanuhdirannahum havla jahannama jisiyyan
Summa lananzi'anna min kulli shiy'atin ayyuhum ashaddu 'ala alrrahmani 'itiyyan
Zumma lanahnu a'lamu biallaziyna hum avla biha siliyyan
Vain minkum illa variduha kana 'ala rabbika hatman maqdiyyan
Zumma nunajjiy allaziyna ittaqav vanazaru alzzalimiyna fiyha jiziyyan
Vaiza tutla 'alayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allaziyna kafaru lillaziyna amanu ayyu alfariyqayni xayrun maqaman vahsanu nadiyyan
Vakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu asasan variyan
Qul man kana fiy alddalalati falyamdud lahu alrrahmanu maddan hatta iza rav ma yu'aduna imma al'azaba vaimma alssa'ata fasaya'lamuna man huva sharrun makanan vad'afu jundan
Vayaziydu Allohu allaziyna ihtadav hudan valbaqiyatu alssalihatu xayrun 'inda rabbika zavaban vaxayrun maraddan
Afarayta allaziy kafara biayatina vaqala lautayanna malan vavaladan
Attala'a alg'ayba ami ittaxaza 'inda alrrahmani 'ahdan
Kalla sanaktubu ma yaqulu vanamuddu lahu mina al'azabi maddan
Vanarisuhu ma yaqulu vayatiyna fardan
Vaittaxazu min duni Allohi alihatan liyakunu lahum 'izzan
Kalla sayakfuruna bi'ibadatihim vayakununa 'alayhim diddan
Alam tara anna arsalna alshshayatiyna 'ala alkafiriyna taozzuhum azzan
Fala ta'jal 'alayhim innama na'uddu lahum 'addan
Yavma nahshuru almuttaqiyna ila alrrahmani vafdan
Vanasuqu almujrimiyna ila jahannama virdan
La yamlikuna alshshafa'ata illa mani ittaxaza 'inda alrrahmani 'ahdan
Vaqalu ittaxaza alrrahmanu valadan
Laqad jitum shayan iddan
Takadu alssamavatu yatafattarna minhu vatanshaqqu alardu vataxirru aljibalu haddan
An da'av lilrrahmani valadan
Vama yanbag'iy lilrrahmani an yattaxiza valadan
In kullu man fiy alssamavati valardi illa atiy alrrahmani 'abdan
Laqad ahsahum va'addahum 'addan
Vakulluhum atiyhi yavma alqiyamati fardan
Inna allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati sayaj'alu lahumu alrrahmanu vuddan
Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika litubashshira bihi almuttaqiyna vatunzira bihi qavman luddan
Vakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin av tasma'u lahum rikzan
Taha
Ma anzalna 'alayka alqurana litashqa
Illa tazkiratan liman yaxsha
Tanziylan mimman xalaqa alarda valssamavati al'ula
Alrrahmanu 'ala al'arshi istava
Lahu ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi vama baynahuma vama tahta alssara
Vain tajhar bialqavli fainnahu ya'lamu alssirra vaxfa
Allohu la ilaha illa huva lahu alasmao alhusna
Vahal ataka hadiysu musa
Iz ra naran faqala liahlihi omkuzu inniy anastu naran la'alliy atiykum minha biqabasin av ajidu 'ala alnnari hudan
Falamma ataha nudiya ya musa
Inniy ana rabbuka faixla' na'layka innaka bialvadi almuqaddasi tuvan
Vana ixtartuka faistami' lima yuha
Innaniy ana Allohu la ilaha illa ana fao'budniy vaqimi alssalata lizikriy
Inna alssa'ata atiyatun akadu oxfiyha litujza kullu nafsin bima tas'a
Fala yasuddannaka 'anha man la yuminu biha vaittaba'a havahu fatarda
Vama tilka biyamiynika ya musa
Qala hiya 'asaya atavakkao 'alayha vahushshu biha 'ala g'anamiy valiya fiyha maribu oxra
Qala alqiha ya musa
Falqaha faiza hiya hayyatun tas'a
Qala xuzha vala taxaf sanu'iyduha siyrataha alula
Vaodmum yadaka ila janahika taxruj bayda min g'ayri suin ayatan oxra
Linuriyaka min ayatina alkubra
Izhab ila fir'avna innahu tag'a
Qala rabbi ishrah liy sadriy
Vayassir liy amriy
Vaohlul 'uqdatan min lisaniy
Yafqahu qavliy
Vaij'al liy vaziyran min ahliy
Haruna axiy
Oshdud bihi azriy
Vashrixu fiy amriy
Kay nusabbihaka kasiyran
Vanazkuraka kaziyran
Innaka kunta bina basiyran
Qala qad utiyta sulaka ya musa
Valaqad mananna 'alayka marratan oxra
Iz avhayna ila ommika ma yuha
Ani iqzifiyhi fiy alttabuti faiqzifiyhi fiy alyammi falyulqihi alyammu bialssahili yaxuzhu 'aduvvun liy va'aduvvun lahu valqaytu 'alayka mahabbatan minniy valitusna'a 'ala 'ayniy

Iz tamshiy oxtuka fataqulu hal adullukum 'ala man yakfuluhu faraja'naka ila ommika kay taqarra 'aynuha vala tahzana vaqatalta nafsan fanajjaynaka mina alg'ammi vafatannaka futunan falabizta siniyna fiy ahli madyana zumma jita 'ala qadarin ya musa
Vaistana'tuka linafsiy
Izhab anta vaxuka biayatiy vala taniya fiy zikriy
Izhaba ila fir'avna innahu tag'a
Faqula lahu qavlan layyinan la'llohu yatazakkaru av yaxsha
Qala rabbana innana naxafu an yafruta 'alayna av an yatg'a
Qala la taxafa innaniy ma'akuma asma'u vara
Fatiyahu faqula inna rasula rabbika farsil ma'ana baniy israiyla vala tu'azzibhum qad jinaka biayatin min rabbika valssalamu 'ala mani ittaba'a alhuda
Inna qad uhiya ilayna anna al'azaba 'ala man kazzaba vatavalla
Qala faman rabbukuma ya musa
Qala rabbuna allaziy a'ta kulla shayin xalqahu zumma hada
Qala fama balu alquruni alula
Qala 'ilmuha 'inda rabbiy fiy kitabin la yadillu rabbiy vala yansa
Allaziy ja'ala lakumu alarda mahdan vasalaka lakum fiyha subulan vanzala mina alssamai man faxrajna bihi azvajan min nabatin shatta
Kulu vair'av an'amakum inna fiy zalika layatin lioliy alnnuha
Minha xalaqnakum vafiyha nu'iydukum vaminha nuxrijukum taratan oxra
Valaqad araynahu ayatina kullaha fakazzaba vaba
Qala ajitana lituxrijana min ardina bisihrika ya musa
Falanatiyannaka bisihrin mislihi faij'al baynana vabaynaka mav'idan la nuxlifuhu nahnu vala anta makanan suvan
Qala mav'idukum yavmu alzziynati van yuhshara alnnasu duhan
Fatavalla fir'avnu fajama'a kaydahu summa ata
Qala lahum musa vaylakum la taftaru 'ala Allohi kaziban fayushitakum bi'azabin vaqad xaba mani iftara
Fatanaza'u amrahum baynahum vasarru alnnajva
Qalu in hazani lasahirani yuriydani an yuxrijakum min ardikum bisihrihima vayazhaba bitariyqatikumu almuzla
Fajmi'u kaydakum summa itu saffan vaqad aflaha alyavma mani ista'la
Qalu ya musa imma an tulqiya vaimma an nakuna avvala man alqa
Qala bal alqu faiza hibaluhum va'isiyyuhum yuxayyalu ilayhi min sihrihim annaha tas'a
Favjasa fiy nafsihi xiyfatan musa
Qulna la taxaf innaka anta ala'la
Valqi ma fiy yamiynika talqaf ma sana'u innama sana'u kaydu sahirin vala yuflihu alssahiru haysu ata
Faolqiya alssaharatu sujjadan qalu amanna birabbi haruna vamusa

Qala amantum lahu qabla an azana lakum innahu lakabiyrukumu allaziy 'allamakumu alssihra falaoqatti'anna aydiyakum varjulakum min xilafin valaosallibannakum fiy juzu'i alnnaxli valata'lamunna ayyuna ashaddu 'azaban vabqa
Qalu lan nuziraka 'ala ma jana mina albayyinati vallaziy fatarana faiqdi ma anta qadin innama taqdiy hazihi alhayata alddunya
Inna amanna birabbina liyag'fira lana xatayana vama akrahtana 'alayhi mina alssihri vaAllohu xayrun vabqa
Innahu man yati rabbahu mujriman fainna lahu jahannama la yamutu fiyha vala yahya
Vaman yatihi muminan qad 'amila alssalihati faolaika lahumu alddarajatu al'ula
Jannatu 'adnin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu xalidiyna fiyha vazalika jazao man tazakka
Valaqad avhayna ila musa an asri bi'ibadiy faidrib lahum tariyqan fiy albahri yabasan la taxafu darakan vala taxsha
Fatba'ahum fir'avnu bijunudihi fag'ashiyahum mina alyammi ma g'ashiyahum
Vadalla fir'avnu qavmahu vama hada
Ya baniy israiyla qad anjaynakum min 'aduvvikum vava'adnakum janiba altturi alaymana vanazzalna 'alaykumu almanna valssalva
Kulu min tayyibati ma razaqnakum vala tatg'av fiyhi fayahilla 'alaykum g'adabiy vaman yahlil 'alayhi g'adabiy faqad hava
Vainniy lag'affarun liman taba vamana va'amila salihan summa ihtada
Vama a'jalaka 'an qavmika ya musa
Qala hum olai 'ala asariy va'ajiltu ilayka rabbi litarda
Qala fainna qad fatanna qavmaka min ba'dika vadllohumu alssamiriyyu
Faraja'a musa ila qavmihi g'adbana asifan qala ya qavmi alam ya'idkum rabbukum va'dan hasanan afatala 'alaykumu al'ahdu am aradtum an yahilla 'alaykum g'adabun min rabbikum faxlaftum mav'idiy
Qalu ma axlafna mav'idaka bimalkina valakinna hummilna avzaran min ziynati alqavmi faqazafnaha fakazalika alqa alssamiriyyu
Faxraja lahum 'ijlan jasadan lahu xuvarun faqalu haza ilahukum vailahu musa fanasiya
Afala yaravna alla yarji'u ilayhim qavlan vala yamliku lahum darran vala naf'an
Valaqad qala lahum harunu min qablu ya qavmi innama futintum bihi vainna rabbakumu alrrahmanu faittabi'uniy vatiy'u amriy
Qalu lan nabraha 'alayhi 'akifiyna hatta yarji'a ilayna musa
Qala ya harunu ma mana'aka iz raytahum dallu
Alla tattabi'ani afa'asayta amriy
Qala ya bna omma la taxuz bilihyatiy vala birasiy inniy xashiytu an taqula farraqta bayna baniy israiyla valam tarqub qavliy
Qala fama xatbuka ya samiriyyu
Qala basurtu bima lam yabsuru bihi faqabadtu qabdatan min azari alrrasuli fanabaztuha vakazalika savvalat liy nafsiy
Qala faizhab fainna laka fiy alhayati an taqula la misasa vainna laka mav'idan lan tuxlafahu vaonzur ila ilahika allaziy zalta 'alayhi 'akifan lanuharriqannahu zumma lanansifannahu fiy alyammi nasfan
Innama ilahukumu Allohu allaziy la ilaha illa huva vasi'a kulla shayin 'ilman
Kazalika naqussu 'alayka min anbai ma qad sabaqa vaqad ataynaka min ladunna zikran
Man a'rada 'anhu fainnahu yahmilu yavma alqiyamati vizran
Xalidiyna fiyhi vasa lahum yavma alqiyamati himlan
Yavma yunfaxu fiy alssuri vanahshuru almujrimiyna yavmaizin zurqan
Yataxafatuna baynahum in labistum illa 'ashran
Nahnu a'lamu bima yaquluna iz yaqulu amzaluhum tariyqatan in labiztum illa yavman
Vayasalunaka 'ani aljibali faqul yansifuha rabbiy nasfan
Fayazaruha qa'an safsafan
La tara fiyha 'ivajan vala amtan
Yavmaizin yattabi'una aldda'iya la 'ivaja lahu vaxasha'ati alasvatu lilrrahmani fala tasma'u illa hamsan
Yavmaizin la tanfa'u alshshafa'atu illa man azina lahu alrrahmanu varadiya lahu qavlan
Ya'lamu ma bayna aydiyhim vama xalfahum vala yuhiytuna bihi 'ilman
Va'anati alvujuhu lilhayyi alqayyumi vaqad xaba man hamala zulman
Vaman ya'mal mina alssalihati vahuva muminun fala yaxafu zulman vala hadman
Vakazalika anzalnahu quranan 'arabiyyan vasarrafna fiyhi mina alva'iydi la'llohum yattaquna av yuhdizu lahum zikran
Fata'ala Allohu almaliku alhaqqu vala ta'jal bialqurani min qabli an yuqda ilayka vahyuhu vaqul rabbi zidniy 'ilman
Valaqad 'ahidna ila adama min qablu fanasiya valam najid lahu 'azman
Vaiz qulna lilmalaikati osjudu liadama fasajadu illa ibliysa aba
Faqulna ya adamu inna haza 'aduvvun laka valizavjika fala yuxrijannakuma mina aljannati fatashqa
Inna laka alla taju'a fiyha vala ta'ra
Vannaka la tazmao fiyha vala tadha
Favasvasa ilayhi alshshaytanu qala ya adamu hal adulluka 'ala shajarati alxuldi vamulkin la yabla
Fakala minha fabadat lahuma savatuhuma vatafiqa yaxsifani 'alayhima min varaqi aljannati va'asa adamu rabbahu fag'ava
Summa ijtabahu rabbuhu fataba 'alayhi vahada
Qala ihbita minha jamiy'an ba'dukum liba'din 'aduvvun faimma yatiyannakum minniy hudan famani ittaba'a hudaya fala yadillu vala yashqa
Vaman a'rada 'an zikriy fainna lahu ma'iyshatan dankan vanahshuruhu yavma alqiyamati a'man
Qala rabbi lima hashartaniy a'ma vaqad kuntu basiyran
Qala kazalika atatka ayatuna fanasiytaha vakazalika alyavma tunsa
Vakazalika najziy man asrafa valam yumin biayati rabbihi vala'azabu alaxirati ashaddu vabqa
Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlakna qablahum mina alquruni yamshuna fiy masakinihim inna fiy zalika layatin lioliy alnnuha
Valavla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika lakana lizaman vajalun musamman
Faisbir 'ala ma yaquluna vasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulu'i alshshamsi vaqabla g'urubiha vamin anai allayli fasabbih vatrafa alnnahari la'allaka tarda
Vala tamuddanna 'aynayka ila ma matta'na bihi azvajan minhum zahrata alhayati alddunya linaftinahum fiyhi varizqu rabbika xayrun vabqa
Vamur ahlaka bialssalati vaistabir 'alayha la nasaluka rizqan nahnu narzuquka val'aqibatu lilttaqva
Vaqalu lavla yatiyna biayatin min rabbihi avalam tatihim bayyinatu ma fiy alssuhufi alula
Valav anna ahlaknahum bi'azabin min qablihi laqalu rabbana lavla arsalta ilayna rasulan fanattabi'a ayatika min qabli an nazilla vanaxza
Qul kullun mutarabbisun fatarabbasu fasata'lamuna man ashabu alssirati alssaviyyi vamani ihtada
Iqtaraba lilnnasi hisabuhum vahum fiy g'aflatin mu'riduna
Ma yatiyhim min zikrin min rabbihim muhdazin illa istama'uhu vahum yal'abuna
Lahiyatan qulubuhum vasarru alnnajva allaziyna zalamu hal haza illa basharun mizlukum afatatuna alssihra vantum tubsiruna
Qala rabbiy ya'lamu alqavla fiy alssamai valardi vahuva alssamiy'u al'aliymu
Bal qalu adg'asu ahlamin bali iftarahu bal huva sha'irun falyatina biayatin kama orsila alavvaluna
Ma amanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaha afahum yuminuna
Vama arsalna qablaka illa rijalan nuhiy ilayhim faisalu ahla alzzikri in kuntum la ta'lamuna
Vama ja'alnahum jasadan la yakuluna altta'ama vama kanu xalidiyna
Summa sadaqnahumu alva'da fanjaynahum vaman nashao vahlakna almusrifiyna
Laqad anzalna ilaykum kitaban fiyhi zikrukum afala ta'qiluna
Vakam qasamna min qaryatin kanat zalimatan vanshana ba'daha qavman axariyna
Falamma ahassu basana iza hum minha yarkuduna
La tarkudu vairji'u ila ma otriftum fiyhi vamasakinikum la'allakum tusaluna
Qalu ya vaylana inna kunna zalimiyna
Fama zalat tilka da'vahum hatta ja'alnahum hasiydan xamidiyna
Vama xalaqna alssama valarda vama baynahuma la'ibiyna
Lav aradna an nattaxiza lahvan laittaxaznahu min ladunna in kunna fa'iliyna
Bal naqzifu bialhaqqi 'ala albatili fayadmag'uhu faiza huva zahiqun valakumu alvaylu mimma tasifuna
Valahu man fiy alssamavati valardi vaman 'indahu la yastakbiruna 'an 'ibadatihi vala yastahsiruna
Yusabbihuna allayla valnnahara la yafturuna
Ami ittaxazu alihatan mina alardi hum yunshiruna
Lav kana fiyhima alihatun illa Allohu lafasadata fasubhana Allohi rabbi al'arshi 'amma yasifuna
La yusalu 'amma yaf'alu vahum yusaluna
Ami ittaxazu min dunihi alihatan qul hatu burhanakum haza zikru man ma'iya vazikru man qabliy bal akzaruhum la ya'lamuna alhaqqa fahum mu'riduna
Vama arsalna min qablika min rasulin illa nuhiy ilayhi annahu la ilaha illa ana fao'buduni
Vaqalu ittaxaza alrrahmanu valadan subhanahu bal 'ibadun mukramuna
La yasbiqunahu bialqavli vahum biamrihi ya'maluna
Ya'lamu ma bayna aydiyhim vama xalfahum vala yashfa'una illa limani irtada vahum min xashyatihi mushfiquna
Vaman yaqul minhum inniy ilahun min dunihi fazalika najziyhi jahannama kazalika najziy alzzalimiyna
Avalam yara allaziyna kafaru anna alssamavati valarda kanata ratqan fafataqnahuma vaja'alna mina almai kulla shayin hayyin afala yuminuna
Vaja'alna fiy alardi ravasiya an tamiyda bihim vaja'alna fiyha fijajan subulan la'llohum yahtaduna
Vaja'alna alssama saqfan mahfuzan vahum 'an ayatiha mu'riduna
Vahuva allaziy xalaqa allayla valnnahara valshshamsa valqamara kullun fiy falakin yasbahuna
Vama ja'alna libasharin min qablika alxulda afain mitta fahumu alxaliduna
Kullu nafsin zaiqatu almavti vanablukum bialshsharri valxayri fitnatan vailayna turja'una
Vaiza raka allaziyna kafaru in yattaxizunaka illa huzuvan ahaza allaziy yazkuru alihatakum vahum bizikri alrrahmani hum kafiruna
Xuliqa alinsanu min 'ajalin saoriykum ayatiy fala tasta'jiluna
Vayaquluna mata haza alva'du in kuntum sadiqiyna
Lav ya'lamu allaziyna kafaru hiyna la yakuffuna 'an vujuhihimu alnnara vala 'an zuhurihim vala hum yunsaruna
Bal tatiyhim bag'tatan fatabhatuhum fala yastatiy'una raddaha vala hum yunzaruna
Valaqadi istuhzia birusulin min qablika fahaqa biallaziyna saxiru minhum ma kanu bihi yastahziuna
Qul man yaklaokum biallayli valnnahari mina alrrahmani bal hum 'an zikri rabbihim mu'riduna
Am lahum alihatun tamna'uhum min dunina la yastatiy'una nasra anfusihim vala hum minna yushabuna
Bal matta'na haolai vabahum hatta tala 'alayhimu al'umuru afala yaravna anna natiy alarda nanqusuha min atrafiha afahumu alg'alibuna
Qul innama onzirukum bialvahyi vala yasma'u alssummu alddu'a iza ma yunzaruna
Valain massazum nafhatun min 'azabi rabbika layaqulunna ya vaylana inna kunna zalimiyna
Vanada'u almavaziyna alqista liyavmi alqiyamati fala tuzlamu nafsun shayan vain kana mizqala habbatin min xardalin atayna biha vakafa bina hasibiyna
Valaqad atayna musa vaharuna alfurqana vadiyan vazikran lilmuttaqiyna
Allaziyna yaxshavna rabbahum bialg'aybi vahum mina alssa'ati mushfiquna
Vahaza zikrun mubarakun anzalnahu afantum lahu munkiruna
Valaqad atayna ibrahiyma rushdahu min qablu vakunna bihi 'alimiyna
Iz qala liabiyhi vaqavmihi ma hazihi alttamaziylu allatiy antum laha 'akifuna
Qalu vajadna abana laha 'abidiyna
Qala laqad kuntum antum vabaokum fiy dalalin mubiynin
Qalu ajitana bialhaqqi am anta mina alla'ibiyna
Qala bal rabbukum rabbu alssamavati valardi allaziy fatarahunna vana 'ala zalikum mina alshshahidiyna
VataAllohi lakiydanna asnamakum ba'da an tuvallu mudbiriyna
Faja'alahum juzazan illa kabiyran lahum la'llohum ilayhi yarji'una
Qalu man fa'ala haza bialihatina innahu lamina alzzalimiyna
Qalu sami'na fatan yazkuruhum yuqalu lahu ibrahiymu
Qalu fatu bihi 'ala a'yuni alnnasi la'llohum yashhaduna
Qalu anta fa'alta haza bialihatina ya ibrahiymu
Qala bal fa'alahu kabiyruhum haza faisaluhum in kanu yantiquna
Faraja'u ila anfusihim faqalu innakum antumu alzzalimuna
Summa nukisu 'ala ruusihim laqad 'alimta ma haolai yantiquna
Qala afata'buduna min duni Allohi ma la yanfa'ukum shayan vala yadurrukum
Offin lakum valima ta'buduna min duni Allohi afala ta'qiluna
Qalu harriquhu vaonsuru alihatakum in kuntum fa'iliyna
Qulna ya naru kuniy bardan vasalaman 'ala ibrahiyma
Varadu bihi kaydan faja'alnahumu alaxsariyna
Vanajjaynahu valutan ila alardi allatiy barakna fiyha lil'alamiyna
Vavahabna lahu ishaqa vaya'quba nafilatan vakullan ja'alna salihiyna
Vaja'alnahum aimmatan yahduna biamrina vavhayna ilayhim fi'la alxayrati vaiqama alssalati vaiyta alzzakati vakanu lana 'abidiyna
Valutan ataynahu hukman va'ilman vanajjaynahu mina alqaryati allatiy kanat ta'malu alxabaisa innahum kanu qavma savin fasiqiyna
Vadxalnahu fiy rahmatina innahu mina alssalihiyna
Vanuhan iz nada min qablu faistajabna lahu fanajjaynahu vahlahu mina alkarbi al'aziymi
Vanasarnahu mina alqavmi allaziyna kazzabu biayatina innahum kanu qavma savin fag'raqnahum ajma'iyna
Vadavuda vasulaymana iz yahkumani fiy alharzi iz nafashat fiyhi g'anamu alqavmi vakunna lihukmihim shahidiyna
Fafahhamnaha sulaymana vakullan atayna hukman va'ilman vasaxxarna ma'a davuda aljibala yusabbihna valttayra vakunna fa'iliyna
Va'allamnahu san'ata labusin lakum lituhsinakum min basikum fahal antum shakiruna
Valisulaymana alrriyha 'asifatan tajriy biamrihi ila alardi allatiy barakna fiyha vakunna bikulli shayin 'alimiyna
Vamina alshshayatiyni man yag'usuna lahu vaya'maluna 'amalan duna zalika vakunna lahum hafiziyna
Vayyuba iz nada rabbahu anniy massaniya alddurru vanta arhamu alrrahimiyna
Faistajabna lahu fakashafna ma bihi min durrin vataynahu ahlahu vamizlahum ma'ahum rahmatan min 'indina vazikra lil'abidiyna
Vaisma'iyla vaidriysa vaza alkifli kullun mina alssabiriyna
Vadxalnahum fiy rahmatina innahum mina alssalihiyna
Vaza alnnuni iz zahaba mug'adiban fazanna an lan naqdira 'alayhi fanada fiy alzzulumati an la ilaha illa anta subhanaka inniy kuntu mina alzzalimiyna
Faistajabna lahu vanajjaynahu mina alg'ammi vakazalika nunjiy almuminiyna
Vazakariyya iz nada rabbahu rabbi la tazarniy fardan vanta xayru alvariziyna
Faistajabna lahu vavahabna lahu yahya vaslahna lahu zavjahu innahum kanu yusari'una fiy alxayrati vayad'unana rag'aban varahaban vakanu lana xashi'iyna
Vallatiy ahsanat farjaha fanafaxna fiyha min ruhina vaja'alnaha vaibnaha ayatan lil'alamiyna
Inna hazihi ommatukum ommatan vahidatan vana rabbukum fao'buduni
Vataqatta'u amrahum baynahum kullun ilayna raji'una
Faman ya'mal mina alssalihati vahuva muminun fala kufrana lisa'yihi vainna lahu katibuna
Vaharamun 'ala qaryatin ahlaknaha annahum la yarji'una
Hatta iza futihat yajuju vamajuju vahum min kulli hadabin yansiluna
Vaiqtaraba alva'du alhaqqu faiza hiya shaxisatun absaru allaziyna kafaru ya vaylana qad kunna fiy g'aflatin min haza bal kunna zalimiyna
Innakum vama ta'buduna min duni Allohi hasabu jahannama antum laha variduna
Lav kana haolai alihatan ma varaduha vakullun fiyha xaliduna
Lahum fiyha zafiyrun vahum fiyha la yasma'una
Inna allaziyna sabaqat lahum minna alhusna olaika 'anha mub'aduna
La yasma'una hasiysaha vahum fiy ma ishtahat anfusuhum xaliduna
La yahzunuhumu alfaza'u alakbaru vatatalaqqahumu almalaikatu haza yavmukumu allaziy kuntum tu'aduna
Yavma natviy alssama katayyi alssijlli lilkutubi kama badana avvala xalqin nu'iyduhu va'dan 'alayna inna kunna fa'iliyna
Valaqad katabna fiy alzzaburi min ba'di alzzikri anna alarda yarizuha 'ibadiya alssalihuna
Inna fiy haza labalag'an liqavmin 'abidiyna
Vama arsalnaka illa rahmatan lil'alamiyna
Qul innama yuha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun vahidun fahal antum muslimuna
Fain tavallav faqul azantukum 'ala savain vain adriy aqariybun am ba'iydun ma tu'aduna
Innahu ya'lamu aljahra mina alqavli vaya'lamu ma taktumuna
Vain adriy la'llohu fitnatun lakum vamata'un ila hiynin
Qala rabbi ohkum bialhaqqi varabbuna alrrahmanu almusta'anu 'ala ma tasifuna
Ya ayyuha alnnasu ittaqu rabbakum inna zalzalata alssa'ati shayon 'aziymun
Yavma taravnaha tazhalu kullu murdi'atin 'amma arda'at vatada'u kullu zati hamlin hamlaha vatara alnnasa sukara vama hum bisukara valakinna 'azaba Allohi shadiydun
Vamina alnnasi man yujadilu fiy Allohi big'ayri 'ilmin vayattabi'u kulla shaytanin mariydin
Kutiba 'alayhi annahu man tavllohu fannahu yudilluhu vayahdiyhi ila 'azabi alssa'iyri

Ya ayyuha alnnasu in kuntum fiy raybin mina alba'zi fainna xalaqnakum min turabin zumma min nutfatin zumma min 'alaqatin zumma min mudg'atin muxallaqatin vag'ayri muxallaqatin linubayyina lakum vanuqirru fiy alarhami ma nashao ila ajalin musamman zumma nuxrijukum tiflan zumma litablug'u ashuddakum vaminkum man yutavaffa vaminkum man yuraddu ila arzali al'umuri likayla ya'lama min ba'di 'ilmin shayan vatara alarda hamidatan faiza anzalna 'alayha alma ihtazzat varabat vanbatat min kulli zavjin bahiyjin
Zalika bianna Alloha huva alhaqqu vannahu yuhyiy almavta vannahu 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun
Vanna alssa'ata atiyatun la rayba fiyha vanna Alloha yab'asu man fiy alquburi
Vamina alnnasi man yujadilu fiy Allohi big'ayri 'ilmin vala hudan vala kitabin muniyrin
Zaniya 'itfihi liyudilla 'an sabiyli Allohi lahu fiy alddunya xizyun vanuziyquhu yavma alqiyamati 'azaba alhariyqi
Zalika bima qaddamat yadaka vanna Alloha laysa bizallamin lil'abiydi
Vamina alnnasi man ya'budu Alloha 'ala harfin fain asabahu xayrun itmanna bihi vain asabazu fitnatun inqalaba 'ala vajhihi xasira alddunya valaxirata zalika huva alxusranu almubiynu
Yad'u min duni Allohi ma la yadurruhu vama la yanfa'uhu zalika huva alddalalu alba'iydu
Yad'u laman darruhu aqrabu min naf'ihi labisa almavla valabisa al'ashiyru
Inna Alloha yudxilu allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu inna Alloha yaf'alu ma yuriydu
Man kana yazunnu an lan yansurahu Allohu fiy alddunya valaxirati falyamdud bisababin ila alssamai zumma liyaqta' falyanzur hal yuzhibanna kayduhu ma yag'iyzu
Vakazalika anzalnahu ayatin bayyinatin vanna Alloha yahdiy man yuriydu
Inna allaziyna amanu vallaziyna hadu valssabiiyna valnnasara valmajusa vallaziyna ashraku inna Alloha yafsilu baynahum yavma alqiyamati inna Alloha 'ala kulli shayin shahiydun

Alam tara anna Alloha yasjudu lahu man fiy alssamavati vaman fiy alardi valshshamsu valqamaru valnnujumu valjibalu valshshajaru valddavabbu vakaziyrun mina alnnasi vakaziyrun haqqa 'alayhi al'azabu vaman yuhini Allohu fama lahu min mukrimin inna Alloha yaf'alu ma yashao
Hazani xasmani ixtasamu fiy rabbihim fallaziyna kafaru qutti'at lahum ziyabun min narin yusabbu min favqi ruusihimu alhamiymu
Yusharu bihi ma fiy butunihim valjuludu
Valahum maqami'u min hadiydin
Kullama aradu an yaxruju minha min g'ammin o'iydu fiyha vazuqu 'azaba alhariyqi
Inna Alloha yudxilu allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu yuhallavna fiyha min asavira min zahabin valuluan valibasuhum fiyha hariyrun
Vahudu ila alttayyibi mina alqavli vahudu ila sirati alhamiydi
Inna allaziyna kafaru vayasudduna 'an sabiyli Allohi valmasjidi alharami allaziy ja'alnahu lilnnasi savan al'akifu fiyhi valbadi vaman yurid fiyhi biilhadin bizulmin nuziqhu min 'azabin aliymin
Vaiz bavvana liibrahiyma makana albayti an la tushrik biy shayan vatahhir baytiya lilttaifiyna valqaimiyna valrrukka'i alssujudi
Vazzin fiy alnnasi bialhajji yatuka rijalan va'ala kulli damirin yatiyna min kulli fajjin 'amiyqin
Liyashhadu manafi'a lahum vayazkuru isma Allohi fiy ayyamin ma'lumatin 'ala ma razaqahum min bahiymati alan'ami fakulu minha vat'imu albaisa alfaqiyra
Zumma lyaqdu tafazahum valyufu nuzurahum valyattavvafu bialbayti al'atiyqi
Zalika vaman yu'azzim hurumati Allohi fahuva xayrun lahu 'inda rabbihi vaohillat lakumu alan'amu illa ma yutla 'alaykum faijtanibu alrrijsa mina alavzani vaijtanibu qavla alzzuri
Hunafa lillahi g'ayra mushrikiyna bihi vaman yushrik biAllohi fakannama xarra mina alssamai fataxtafuhu alttayru av tahviy bihi alrriyhu fiy makanin sahiyqin
Zalika vaman yu'azzim sha'aira Allohi fainnaha min taqva alqulubi
Lakum fiyha manafi'u ila ajalin musamman summa mahilluha ila albayti al'atiyqi
Valikulli ommatin ja'alna mansakan liyazkuru isma Allohi 'ala ma razaqahum min bahiymati alan'ami failahukum ilahun vahidun falahu aslimu vabashshiri almuxbitiyna
Allaziyna iza zukira Allohu vajilat qulubuhum valssabiriyna 'ala ma asabahum valmuqiymiy alssalati vamimma razaqnahum yunfiquna

Valbudna ja'alnaha lakum min sha'airi Allohi lakum fiyha xayrun faozkuru isma Allohi 'alayha savaffa faiza vajabat junubuha fakulu minha vat'imu alqani'a valmu'tarra kazalika saxxarnaha lakum la'allakum tashkuruna
Lan yanala Alloha luhumuha vala dimaoha valakin yanaluhu alttaqva minkum kazalika saxxaraha lakum litukabbiru Alloha 'ala ma hadakum vabashshiri almuhsiniyna
Inna Alloha yudafi'u 'ani allaziyna amanu inna Alloha la yuhibbu kulla xavvanin kafurin

Vayasta'jilunaka bial'azabi valan yuxlifa Allohu va'dahu vainna yavman 'inda rabbika kalfi sanatin mimma ta'udduna
Vakayyin min qaryatin amlaytu laha vahiya zalimatun zumma axaztuha vailayya almasiyru
Qul ya ayyuha alnnasu innama ana lakum naziyrun mubiynun
Fallaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati lahum mag'firatun varizqun kariymun
Vallaziyna sa'av fiy ayatina mu'ajiziyna olaika ashabu aljahiymi
Vama arsalna min qablika min rasulin vala nabiyyin illa iza tamanna alqa alshshaytanu fiy omniyyatihi fayansaxu Allohu ma yulqiy alshshaytanu zumma yuhkimu Allohu ayatihi vaAllohu 'aliymun hakiymun
Liyaj'ala ma yulqiy alshshaytanu fitnatan lillaziyna fiy qulubihim maradun valqasiyati qulubuhum vainna alzzalimiyna lafiy shiqaqin ba'iydin
Valiya'lama allaziyna utu al'ilma annahu alhaqqu min rabbika fayuminu bihi fatuxbita lahu qulubuhum vainna Alloha lahadi allaziyna amanu ila siratin mustaqiymin
Vala yazalu allaziyna kafaru fiy miryatin minhu hatta tatiyahumu alssa'atu bag'tatan av yatiyahum 'azabu yavmin 'aqiymin
Almulku yavmaizin lillahi yahkumu baynahum fallaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati fiy jannati alnna'iymi
Vallaziyna kafaru vakazzabu biayatina faolaika lahum 'azabun muhiynun
Vallaziyna hajaru fiy sabiyli Allohi zumma qutilu av matu layarzuqannahumu Allohu rizqan hasanan vainna Alloha lahuva xayru alrraziqiyna
Layudxilannahum mudxalan yardavnahu vainna Alloha la'aliymun haliymun
Zalika vaman 'aqaba bimizli ma 'uqiba bihi zumma bug'iya 'alayhi layansurannahu Allohu inna Alloha la'afuvvun g'afurun
Zalika bianna Alloha yuliju allayla fiy alnnahari vayuliju alnnahara fiy allayli vanna Alloha samiy'un basiyrun
Zalika bianna Alloha huva alhaqqu vanna ma yad'una min dunihi huva albatilu vanna Alloha huva al'aliyyu alkabiyru
Alam tara anna Alloha anzala mina alssamai man fatusbihu alardu muxdarratan inna Alloha latiyfun xabiyrun
Lahu ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi vainna Alloha lahuva alg'aniyyu alhamiydu
Alam tara anna Alloha saxxara lakum ma fiy alardi valfulka tajriy fiy albahri biamrihi vayumsiku alssama an taqa'a 'ala alardi illa biiznihi inna Alloha bialnnasi laraufun rahiymun
Vahuva allaziy ahyakum zumma yumiytukum zumma yuhyiykum inna alinsana lakafurun
Likulli ommatin ja'alna mansakan hum nasikuhu fala yunazi'unnaka fiy alamri vaod'u ila rabbika innaka la'ala hudan mustaqiymin
Vain jadaluka faquli Allohu a'lamu bima ta'maluna
Allohu yahkumu baynakum yavma alqiyamati fiyma kuntum fiyhi taxtalifuna
Alam ta'lam anna Alloha ya'lamu ma fiy alssamai valardi inna zalika fiy kitabin inna zalika 'ala Allohi yasiyrun
Vaya'buduna min duni Allohi ma lam yunazzil bihi sultanan vama laysa lahum bihi 'ilmun vama lilzzalimiyna min nasiyrin

Vaiza tutla 'alayhim ayatuna bayyinatin ta'rifu fiy vujuhi allaziyna kafaru almunkara yakaduna yastuna biallaziyna yatluna 'alayhim ayatina qul afaonabbiokum bisharrin min zalikum alnnaru va'adaha Allohu allaziyna kafaru vabisa almasiyru

Ya ayyuha alnnasu duriba mazalun faistami'u lahu inna allaziyna tad'una min duni Allohi lan yaxluqu zubaban valavi ijtama'u lahu vain yaslubuhumu alzzubabu shayan la yastanqizuhu minhu da'ufa alttalibu valmatlubu
Ma qadaru Alloha haqqa qadrihi inna Alloha laqaviyyun 'aziyzun
Allohu yastafiy mina almalaikati rusulan vamina alnnasi inna Alloha samiy'un basiyrun
Ya'lamu ma bayna aydiyhim vama xalfahum vaila Allohi turja'u alomuru
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu irka'u vaosjudu vao'budu rabbakum vaif'alu alxayra la'allakum tuflihuna

Vajahidu fiy Allohi haqqa jihadihi huva ijtabakum vama ja'ala 'alaykum fiy alddiyni min harajin millata abiykum ibrahiyma huva sammakumu almuslimiyna min qablu vafiy haza liyakuna alrrasulu shahiydan 'alaykum vatakunu shuhada 'ala alnnasi faqiymu alssalata vatu alzzakata vai'tasimu biAllohi huva mavlakum fani'ma almavla vani'ma alnnasiyru
Qad aflaha almuminuna
Allaziyna hum fiy salatihim xashi'una
Vallaziyna hum 'ani allag'vi mu'riduna
Vallaziyna hum lilzzakati fa'iluna
Vallaziyna hum lifurujihim hafizuna
Illa 'ala azvajihim av ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum g'ayru malumiyna
Famani ibtag'a vara zalika faolaika humu al'aduna
Vallaziyna hum liamanatihim va'ahdihim ra'una
Vallaziyna hum 'ala salavatihim yuhafizuna
Olaika humu alvarisuna
Allaziyna yarizuna alfirdavsa hum fiyha xaliduna
Valaqad xalaqna alinsana min sulalatin min tiynin
Summa ja'alnahu nutfatan fiy qararin makiynin
Zumma xalaqna alnnutfata 'alaqatan faxalaqna al'alaqata mudg'atan faxalaqna almudg'ata 'izaman fakasavna al'izama lahman zumma anshanahu xalqan axara fatabaraka Allohu ahsanu alxaliqiyna
Zumma innakum ba'da zalika lamayyituna
Summa innakum yavma alqiyamati tub'asuna
Valaqad xalaqna favqakum sab'a taraiqa vama kunna 'ani alxalqi g'afiliyna
Vanzalna mina alssamai man biqadarin faskannahu fiy alardi vainna 'ala zahabin bihi laqadiruna
Fanshana lakum bihi jannatin min naxiylin va'nabin lakum fiyha favakihu kasiyratun vaminha takuluna

Va'alayha va'ala alfulki tuhmaluna

Faqala almalao allaziyna kafaru min qavmihi ma haza illa basharun mizlukum yuriydu an yatafaddala 'alaykum valav sha Allohu lanzala malaikatan ma sami'na bihaza fiy abaina alavvaliyna
In huva illa rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbasu bihi hatta hiynin
Qala rabbi onsurniy bima kazzabuni

Favhayna ilayhi ani isna'i alfulka bia'yunina vavahyina faiza ja amruna vafara alttannuru faosluk fiyha min kullin zavjayni iznayni vahlaka illa man sabaqa 'alayhi alqavlu minhum vala tuxatibniy fiy allaziyna zalamu innahum mug'raquna
Faiza istavayta anta vaman ma'aka 'ala alfulki faquli alhamdu lillahi allaziy najjana mina alqavmi alzzalimiyna
Vaqul rabbi anzilniy munzalan mubarakan vanta xayru almunziliyna
Inna fiy zalika layatin vain kunna lamubtaliyna
Summa anshana min ba'dihim qarnan axariyna
Farsalna fiyhim rasulan minhum ani o'budu Alloha ma lakum min ilahin g'ayruhu afala tattaquna
Vaqala almalao min qavmihi allaziyna kafaru vakazzabu biliqai alaxirati vatrafnahum fiy alhayati alddunya ma haza illa basharun mizlukum yakulu mimma takuluna minhu vayashrabu mimma tashrabuna
Valain ata'tum basharan mizlakum innakum izan laxasiruna

Hayhata hayhata lima tu'aduna
In hiya illa hayatuna alddunya namutu vanahya vama nahnu bimab'usiyna
In huva illa rajulun iftara 'ala Allohi kaziban vama nahnu lahu bimuminiyna
Qala rabbi onsurniy bima kazzabuni
Qala 'amma qaliylin layusbihunna nadimiyna
Faxazazumu alssayhatu bialhaqqi faja'alnahum g'uzan fabu'dan lilqavmi alzzalimiyna
Summa anshana min ba'dihim qurunan axariyna

Zumma arsalna rusulana tatra kulla ma ja ommatan rasuluha kazzabuhu fatba'na ba'dahum ba'dan vaja'alnahum ahadiyza fabu'dan liqavmin la yuminuna

Ya ayyuha alrrusulu kulu mina alttayyibati vai'malu salihan inniy bima ta'maluna 'aliymun
Vainna hazihi ommatukum ommatan vahidatan vana rabbukum faittaquni

Vahuva allaziy zarakum fiy alardi vailayhi tuhsharuna
Vahuva allaziy yuhyiy vayumiytu valahu ixtilafu allayli valnnahari afala ta'qiluna

Laqad vu'idna nahnu vabaona haza min qablu in haza illa asatiyru alavvaliyna
Qul limani alardu vaman fiyha in kuntum ta'lamuna
Sayaquluna lillahi qul afala tazakkaruna
Qul man rabbu alssamavati alssab'i varabbu al'arshi al'aziymi
Sayaquluna lillahi qul afala tattaquna
Qul man biyadihi malakutu kulli shayin vahuva yujiyru vala yujaru 'alayhi in kuntum ta'lamuna
Sayaquluna lillahi qul fanna tusharuna

Ma ittaxaza Allohu min valadin vama kana ma'ahu min ilahin izan lazahaba kullu ilahin bima xalaqa vala'ala ba'duhum 'ala ba'din subhana Allohi 'amma yasifuna
'alimi alg'aybi valshshahadati fata'ala 'amma yushrikuna

Vainna 'ala an nuriyaka ma na'iduhum laqadiruna
Idfa' biallatiy hiya ahsanu alssayyiata nahnu a'lamu bima yasifuna

Va'uzu bika rabbi an yahduruni

La'alliy a'malu salihan fiyma taraktu kalla innaha kalimatun huva qailuha vamin varaihim barzaxun ila yavmi yub'asuna
Faiza nufixa fiy alssuri fala ansaba baynahum yavmaizin vala yatasaluna
Faman saqulat mavaziynuhu faolaika humu almuflihuna
Vaman xaffat mavaziynuhu faolaika allaziyna xasiru anfusahum fiy jahannama xaliduna
Talfahu vujuhahumu alnnaru vahum fiyha kalihuna
Alam takun ayatiy tutla 'alaykum fakuntum biha tukazzibuna

Rabbana axrijna minha fain 'udna fainna zalimuna

Innahu kana fariyqun min 'ibadiy yaquluna rabbana amanna faig'fir lana vairhamna vanta xayru alrrahimiyna
Faittaxaztumuhum sixriyyan hatta ansavkum zikriy vakuntum minhum tadhakuna
Inniy jazaytuhumu alyavma bima sabaru annahum humu alfaizuna
Qala kam labistum fiy alardi 'adada siniyna
Qalu labisna yavman av ba'da yavmin faisali al'addiyna
Qala in labistum illa qaliylan lav annakum kuntum ta'lamuna
Afahasibtum annama xalaqnakum 'abasan vannakum ilayna la turja'una
Fata'ala Allohu almaliku alhaqqu la ilaha illa huva rabbu al'arshi alkariymi
Vaman yad'u ma'a Allohi ilahan axara la burhana lahu bihi fainnama hisabuhu 'inda rabbihi innahu la yuflihu alkafiruna
Vaqul rabbi ig'fir vairham vanta xayru alrrahimiyna
Suratun anzalnaha vafaradnaha vanzalna fiyha ayatin bayyinatin la'allakum tazakkaruna

Alzzaniyatu valzzaniy faijlidu kulla vahidin minhuma miata jaldatin vala taxuzkum bihima rafatun fiy diyni Allohi in kuntum tuminuna biAllohi valyavmi alaxiri valyashhad 'azabahuma taifatun mina almuminiyna
Alzzaniy la yankihu illa zaniyatan av mushrikatan valzzaniyatu la yankihuha illa zanin av mushrikun vahurrima zalika 'ala almuminiyna
Vallaziyna yarmuna almuhsanati zumma lam yatu biarba'ati shuhada faijliduhum zamaniyna jaldatan vala taqbalu lahum shahadatan abadan vaolaika humu alfasiquna
Illa allaziyna tabu min ba'di zalika vaslahu fainna Alloha g'afurun rahiymun
Vallaziyna yarmuna azvajahum valam yakun lahum shuhadao illa anfusuhum fashahadatu ahadihim arba'u shahadatin biAllohi innahu lamina alssadiqiyna
Valxamisatu anna la'nata Allohi 'alayhi in kana mina alkazibiyna
Vayadrao 'anha al'azaba an tashhada arba'a shahadatin biAllohi innahu lamina alkazibiyna
Valxamisata anna g'adaba Allohi 'alayha in kana mina alssadiqiyna
Valavla fadlu Allohi 'alaykum varahmatuhu vanna Alloha tavvabun hakiymun
Inna allaziyna jau bialifki 'usbatun minkum la tahsabuhu sharran lakum bal huva xayrun lakum likulli imriin minhum ma iktasaba mina alizmi vallaziy tavalla kibrahu minhum lahu 'azabun 'aziymun
Lavla iz sami'tumuhu zanna almuminuna valmuminatu bianfusihim xayran vaqalu haza ifkun mubiynun
Lavla jau 'alayhi biarba'ati shuhada faiz lam yatu bialshshuhadai faolaika 'inda Allohi humu alkazibuna
Valavla fadlu Allohi 'alaykum varahmatuhu fiy alddunya valaxirati lamassakum fiy ma afadtum fiyhi 'azabun 'aziymun
Iz talaqqavnahu bialsinatikum vataquluna biafvahikum ma laysa lakum bihi 'ilmun vatahsabunahu hayyinan vahuva 'inda Allohi 'aziymun
Valavla iz sami'tumuhu qultum ma yakunu lana an natakallama bihaza subhanaka haza buhtanun 'aziymun
Ya'izukumu Allohu an ta'udu limizlihi abadan in kuntum muminiyna
Vayubayyinu Allohu lakumu alayati vaAllohu 'aliymun hakiymun
Inna allaziyna yuhibbuna an tashiy'a alfahishatu fiy allaziyna amanu lahum 'azabun aliymun fiy alddunya valaxirati vaAllohu ya'lamu vantum la ta'lamuna
Valavla fadlu Allohi 'alaykum varahmatuhu vanna Alloha raufun rahiymun

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la tattabi'u xutuvati alshshaytani vaman yattabi' xutuvati alshshaytani fainnahu yamuru bialfahshai valmunkari valavla fadlu Allohi 'alaykum varahmatuhu ma zaka minkum min ahadin abadan valakinna Alloha yuzakkiy man yashao vaAllohu samiy'un 'aliymun
Vala yatali olu alfadli minkum valssa'ati an yutu oliy alqurba valmasakiyna valmuhajiriyna fiy sabiyli Allohi valya'fu valyasfahu ala tuhibbuna an yag'fira Allohu lakum vaAllohu g'afurun rahiymun
Inna allaziyna yarmuna almuhsanati alg'afilati almuminati lu'inu fiy alddunya valaxirati valahum 'azabun 'aziymun
Yavma tashhadu 'alayhim alsinatuhum vaydiyhim varjuluhum bima kanu ya'maluna
Yavmaizin yuvaffiyhimu Allohu diynahumu alhaqqa vaya'lamuna anna Alloha huva alhaqqu almubiynu
Alxabiysatu lilxabiysiyna valxabiysuna lilxabiysati valttayyibatu lilttayyibiyna valttayyibuna lilttayyibati olaika mubarrauna mimma yaquluna lahum mag'firatun varizqun kariymun
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la tadxulu buyutan g'ayra buyutikum hatta tastanisu vatusallimu 'ala ahliha zalikum xayrun lakum la'allakum tazakkaruna
Fain lam tajidu fiyha ahadan fala tadxuluha hatta yuzana lakum vain qiyla lakumu irji'u fairji'u huva azka lakum vaAllohu bima ta'maluna 'aliymun
Laysa 'alaykum junahun an tadxulu buyutan g'ayra maskunatin fiyha mata'un lakum vaAllohu ya'lamu ma tubduna vama taktumuna

VaAllohu xalaqa kulla dabbatin min main faminhum man yamshiy 'ala batnihi vaminhum man yamshiy 'ala rijlayni vaminhum man yamshiy 'ala arba'in yaxluqu Allohu ma yashao inna Alloha 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun
Laqad anzalna ayatin mubayyinatin vaAllohu yahdiy man yashao ila siratin mustaqiymin
Vayaquluna amanna biAllohi vabialrrasuli vata'na zumma yatavalla fariyqun minhum min ba'di zalika vama olaika bialmuminiyna
Vaiza du'u ila Allohi varasulihi liyahkuma baynahum iza fariyqun minhum mu'riduna
Vain yakun lahumu alhaqqu yatu ilayhi muz'iniyna
Afiy qulubihim maradun ami irtabu am yaxafuna an yahiyfa Allohu 'alayhim varasuluhu bal olaika humu alzzalimuna
Innama kana qavla almuminiyna iza du'u ila Allohi varasulihi liyahkuma baynahum an yaqulu sami'na vata'na vaolaika humu almuflihuna
Vaman yuti'i Alloha varasulahu vayaxsha Alloha vayattaqhi faolaika humu alfaizuna
Vaqsamu biAllohi jahda aymanihim lain amartahum layaxrujunna qul la tuqsimu ta'atun ma'rufatun inna Alloha xabiyrun bima ta'maluna
Qul atiy'u Alloha vatiy'u alrrasula fain tavallav fainnama 'alayhi ma hummila va'alaykum ma hummiltum vain tutiy'uhu tahtadu vama 'ala alrrasuli illa albalag'u almubiyna

Va'ada Allohu allaziyna amanu minkum va'amilu alssalihati layastaxlifannahum fiy alardi kama istaxlafa allaziyna min qablihim valayumakkinanna lahum diynahumu allaziy irtada lahum valayubaddilannahum min ba'di xavfihim amnan ya'budunaniy la yushrikuna biy shayan vaman kafara ba'da zalika faolaika humu alfasiquna
Vaqiymu alssalata vatu alzzakata vatiy'u alrrasula la'allakum turhamuna
La tahsabanna allaziyna kafaru mu'jiziyna fiy alardi vamavahumu alnnaru valabisa almasiyru

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu liyastazinkumu allaziyna malakat aymanukum vallaziyna lam yablug'u alhuluma minkum zalaza marratin min qabli salati alfajri vahiyna tada'una ziyabakum mina alzzahiyrati vamin ba'di salati al'ishai zalazu 'avratin lakum laysa 'alaykum vala 'alayhim junahun ba'dahunna tavvafuna 'alaykum ba'dukum 'ala ba'din kazalika yubayyinu Allohu lakumu alayati vaAllohu 'aliymun hakiymun
Vaiza balag'a alatfalu minkumu alhuluma falyastazinu kama istazana allaziyna min qablihim kazalika yubayyinu Allohu lakum ayatihi vaAllohu 'aliymun hakiymun
Valqava'idu mina alnnisai allatiy la yarjuna nikahan falaysa 'alayhinna junahun an yada'na siyabahunna g'ayra mutabarrijatin biziynatin van yasta'fifna xayrun lahunna vaAllohu samiy'un 'aliymun

Laysa 'ala ala'ma harajun vala 'ala ala'raji harajun vala 'ala almariydi harajun vala 'ala anfusikum an takulu min buyutikum av buyuti abaikum av buyuti ommahatikum av buyuti ixvanikum av buyuti axavatikum av buyuti a'mamikum av buyuti 'ammatikum av buyuti axvalikum av buyuti xalatikum av ma malaktum mafatihahu av sadiyqikum laysa 'alaykum junahun an takulu jamiy'an av ashtatan faiza daxaltum buyutan fasallimu 'ala anfusikum tahiyyatan min 'indi Allohi mubarakatan tayyibatan kazalika yubayyinu Allohu lakumu alayati la'allakum ta'qiluna

Innama almuminuna allaziyna amanu biAllohi varasulihi vaiza kanu ma'ahu 'ala amrin jami'in lam yazhabu hatta yastazinuhu inna allaziyna yastazinunaka olaika allaziyna yuminuna biAllohi varasulihi faiza istazanuka liba'di shanihim fazan liman shita minhum vaistag'fir lahumu Alloha inna Alloha g'afurun rahiymun

La taj'alu du'a alrrasuli baynakum kadu'ai ba'dikum ba'dan qad ya'lamu Allohu allaziyna yatasallaluna minkum livazan falyahzari allaziyna yuxalifuna 'an amrihi an tusiybahum fitnatun av yusiybahum 'azabun aliymun
Ala inna lillahi ma fiy alssamavati valardi qad ya'lamu ma antum 'alayhi vayavma yurja'una ilayhi fayunabbiohum bima 'amilu vaAllohu bikulli shayin 'aliymun
Tabaraka allaziy nazzala alfurqana 'ala 'abdihi liyakuna lil'alamiyna naziyran
Allaziy lahu mulku alssamavati valardi valam yattaxiz valadan valam yakun lahu shariykun fiy almulki vaxalaqa kulla shayin faqaddarahu taqdiyran
Vaittaxazu min dunihi alihatan la yaxluquna shayan vahum yuxlaquna vala yamlikuna lianfusihim darran vala naf'an vala yamlikuna mavtan vala hayatan vala nushuran
Vaqala allaziyna kafaru in haza illa ifkun iftarahu va'anahu 'alayhi qavmun axaruna faqad jau zulman vazuran
Vaqalu asatiyru alavvaliyna iktatabaha fahiya tumla 'alayhi bukratan vasiylan
Qul anzalahu allaziy ya'lamu alssirra fiy alssamavati valardi innahu kana g'afuran rahiyman
Vaqalu mali haza alrrasuli yakulu altta'ama vayamshiy fiy alasvaqi lavla onzila ilayhi malakun fayakuna ma'ahu naziyran
Av yulqa ilayhi kanzun av takunu lahu jannatun yakulu minha vaqala alzzalimuna in tattabi'una illa rajulan mashuran
Onzur kayfa darabu laka alamzala fadallu fala yastatiy'una sabiylan
Tabaraka allaziy in sha ja'ala laka xayran min zalika jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu vayaj'al laka qusuran
Bal kazzabu bialssa'ati va'tadna liman kazzaba bialssa'ati sa'iyran
Iza razum min makanin ba'iydin sami'u laha tag'ayyuzan vazafiyran
Vaiza olqu minha makanan dayyiqan muqarraniyna da'av hunalika zuburan
La tad'u alyavma suburan vahidan vaod'u suburan kasiyran
Qul azalika xayrun am jannatu alxuldi allatiy vu'ida almuttaquna kanat lahum jazan vamasiyran
Lahum fiyha ma yashauna xalidiyna kana 'ala rabbika va'dan masulan
Vayavma yahshuruhum vama ya'buduna min duni Allohi fayaqulu antum adlaltum 'ibadiy haolai am hum dallu alssabiyla
Qalu subhanaka ma kana yanbag'iy lana an nattaxiza min dunika min avliya valakin matta'tahum vabahum hatta nasu alzzikra vakanu qavman buran
Faqad kazzabukum bima taquluna fama tastatiy'una sarfan vala nasran vaman yazlim minkum nuziqhu 'azaban kabiyran
Vama arsalna qablaka mina almursaliyna illa innahum layakuluna altta'ama vayamshuna fiy alasvaqi vaja'alna ba'dakum liba'din fitnatan atasbiruna vakana rabbuka basiyran
Vaqala allaziyna la yarjuna liqana lavla onzila 'alayna almalaikatu av nara rabbana laqadi istakbaru fiy anfusihim va'atav 'utuvvan kabiyran
Yavma yaravna almalaikata la bushra yavmaizin lilmujrimiyna vayaquluna hijran mahjuran
Vaqadimna ila ma 'amilu min 'amalin faja'alnahu haban mansuran
Ashabu aljannati yavmaizin xayrun mustaqarran vahsanu maqiylan
Vayavma tashaqqaqu alssamao bialg'amami vanuzzila almalaikatu tanziylan
Almulku yavmaizin alhaqqu lilrrahmani vakana yavman 'ala alkafiriyna 'asiyran
Vayavma ya'addu alzzalimu 'ala yadayhi yaqulu ya laytaniy ittaxaztu ma'a alrrasuli sabiylan
Ya vaylata laytaniy lam attaxiz fulanan xaliylan
Laqad adallaniy 'ani alzzikri ba'da iz janiy vakana alshshaytanu lilinsani xazulan
Vaqala alrrasulu ya rabbi inna qavmiy ittaxazu haza alqurana mahjuran
Vakazalika ja'alna likulli nabiyyin 'aduvvan mina almujrimiyna vakafa birabbika hadiyan vanasiyran
Vaqala allaziyna kafaru lavla nuzzila 'alayhi alquranu jumlatan vahidatan kazalika linuzabbita bihi fuadaka varattalnahu tartiylan
Vala yatunaka bimasalin illa jinaka bialhaqqi vahsana tafsiyran
Allaziyna yuhsharuna 'ala vujuhihim ila jahannama olaika sharrun makanan vadallu sabiylan
Valaqad atayna musa alkitaba vaja'alna ma'ahu axahu haruna vaziyran
Faqulna izhaba ila alqavmi allaziyna kazzabu biayatina fadammarnahum tadmiyran
Vaqavma nuhin lamma kazzabu alrrusula ag'raqnahum vaja'alnahum lilnnasi ayatan va'tadna lilzzalimiyna 'azaban aliyman
Va'adan vazamuda vashaba alrrassi vaqurunan bayna zalika kaziyran
Vakullan darabna lahu alamsala vakullan tabbarna tatbiyran
Valaqad atav 'ala alqaryati allatiy omtirat matara alssavi afalam yakunu yaravnaha bal kanu la yarjuna nushuran
Vaiza ravka in yattaxizunaka illa huzuvan ahaza allaziy ba'aza Allohu rasulan
In kada layudilluna 'an alihatina lavla an sabarna 'alayha vasavfa ya'lamuna hiyna yaravna al'azaba man adallu sabiylan
Arayta mani ittaxaza ilahahu havahu afanta takunu 'alayhi vakiylan
Am tahsabu anna aksarahum yasma'una av ya'qiluna in hum illa kalan'ami bal hum adallu sabiylan
Alam tara ila rabbika kayfa madda alzzilla valav sha laja'alahu sakinan zumma ja'alna alshshamsa 'alayhi daliylan
