Vama anta bihadi al'umyi 'an dalalatihim in tusmi'u illa man yuminu biayatina fahum muslimuna
Allohu allaziy xalaqakum min da'fin zumma ja'ala min ba'di da'fin quvvatan zumma ja'ala min ba'di quvvatin da'fan vashaybatan yaxluqu ma yashao vahuva al'aliymu alqadiyru
Vayavma taqumu alssa'atu yuqsimu almujrimuna ma labizu g'ayra sa'atin kazalika kanu yufakuna
Vaqala allaziyna utu al'ilma valiymana laqad labiztum fiy kitabi Allohi ila yavmi alba'zi fahaza yavmu alba'zi valakinnakum kuntum la ta'lamuna
Fayavmaizin la yanfa'u allaziyna zalamu ma'ziratuhum vala hum yusta'tabuna
Valaqad darabna lilnnasi fiy haza alqurani min kulli mazalin valain jitahum biayatin layaqulanna allaziyna kafaru in antum illa mubtiluna
Kazalika yatba'u Allohu 'ala qulubi allaziyna la ya'lamuna
Faisbir inna va'da Allohi haqqun vala yastaxiffannaka allaziyna la yuqinuna
Aliflammiym
Tilka ayatu alkitabi alhakiymi
Hudan varahmatan lilmuhsiniyna
Allaziyna yuqiymuna alssalata vayutuna alzzakata vahum bialaxirati hum yuqinuna
Olaika 'ala hudan min rabbihim vaolaika humu almuflihuna
Vamina alnnasi man yashtariy lahva alhadiyzi liyudilla 'an sabiyli Allohi big'ayri 'ilmin vayattaxizaha huzuvan olaika lahum 'azabun muhiynun
Vaiza tutla 'alayhi ayatuna valla mustakbiran kan lam yasma'ha kanna fiy ozunayhi vaqran fabashshirhu bi'azabin aliymin
Inna allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati lahum jannatu alnna'iymi
Xalidiyna fiyha va'da Allohi haqqan vahuva al'aziyzu alhakiymu
Xalaqa alssamavati big'ayri 'amadin taravnaha valqa fiy alardi ravasiya an tamiyda bikum vabassa fiyha min kulli dabbatin vanzalna mina alssamai man fanbatna fiyha min kulli zavjin kariymin
Haza xalqu Allohi faruniy maza xalaqa allaziyna min dunihi bali alzzalimuna fiy dalalin mubiynin
Valaqad atayna luqmana alhikmata ani oshkur lillahi vaman yashkur fainnama yashkuru linafsihi vaman kafara fainna Alloha g'aniyyun hamiydun
Vaiz qala luqmanu liibnihi vahuva ya'izuhu ya bunayya la tushrik biAllohi inna alshshirka lazulmun 'aziymun
Vavassayna alinsana bivalidayhi hamalazu ommuhu vahnan 'ala vahnin vafisaluhu fiy 'amayni ani oshkur liy valivalidayka ilayya almasiyru

Vain jahadaka 'ala an tushrika biy ma laysa laka bihi 'ilmun fala tuti'huma vasahibhuma fiy alddunya ma'rufan vaittabi' sabiyla man anaba ilayya summa ilayya marji'ukum faonabbiokum bima kuntum ta'maluna
Ya bunayya innaha in taku misqala habbatin min xardalin fatakun fiy saxratin av fiy alssamavati av fiy alardi yati biha Allohu inna Alloha latiyfun xabiyrun
Ya bunayya aqimi alssalata vamur bialma'rufi vainha 'ani almunkari vaisbir 'ala ma asabaka inna zalika min 'azmi alomuri
Vala tusa''ir xaddaka lilnnasi vala tamshi fiy alardi marahan inna Alloha la yuhibbu kulla muxtalin faxurin
Vaiqsid fiy mashyika vaog'dud min savtika inna ankara alasvati lasavtu alhamiyri

Alam tarav anna Alloha saxxara lakum ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi vasbag'a 'alaykum ni'amahu zahiratan vabatinatan vamina alnnasi man yujadilu fiy Allohi big'ayri 'ilmin vala hudan vala kitabin muniyrin
Vaiza qiyla lahumu ittabi'u ma anzala Allohu qalu bal nattabi'u ma vajadna 'alayhi abana avalav kana alshshaytanu yad'uhum ila 'azabi alssa'iyri
Vaman yuslim vajhahu ila Allohi vahuva muhsinun faqadi istamsaka bial'urvati alvusqa vaila Allohi 'aqibatu alomuri
Vaman kafara fala yahzunka kufruhu ilayna marji'uhum fanunabbiohum bima 'amilu inna Alloha 'aliymun bizati alssuduri
Numatti'uhum qaliylan zumma nadtarruhum ila 'azabin g'aliyzin
Valain saltahum man xalaqa alssamavati valarda layaqulunna Allohu quli alhamdu lillahi bal aksaruhum la ya'lamuna
Lillahi ma fiy alssamavati valardi inna Alloha huva alg'aniyyu alhamiydu
Valav annama fiy alardi min shajaratin aqlamun valbahru yamudduhu min ba'dihi sab'atu abhurin ma nafidat kalimatu Allohi inna Alloha 'aziyzun hakiymun
Ma xalqukum vala ba'sukum illa kanafsin vahidatin inna Alloha samiy'un basiyrun
Alam tara anna Alloha yuliju allayla fiy alnnahari vayuliju alnnahara fiy allayli vasaxxara alshshamsa valqamara kullun yajriy ila ajalin musamman vanna Alloha bima ta'maluna xabiyrun
Zalika bianna Alloha huva alhaqqu vanna ma yad'una min dunihi albatilu vanna Alloha huva al'aliyyu alkabiyru
Alam tara anna alfulka tajriy fiy albahri bini'mati Allohi liyuriyakum min ayatihi inna fiy zalika layatin likulli sabbarin shakurin
Vaiza g'ashiyahum mavjun kalzzulali da'avu Alloha muxlisiyna lahu alddiyna falamma najjahum ila albarri faminhum muqtasidun vama yajhadu biayatina illa kullu xattarin kafurin

Ya ayyuha alnnasu ittaqu rabbakum vaixshav yavman la yajziy validun 'an valadihi vala mavludun huva jazin 'an validihi shayan inna va'da Allohi haqqun fala tag'urrannakumu alhayatu alddunya vala yag'urrannakum biAllohi alg'aruru
Inna Alloha 'indahu 'ilmu alssa'ati vayunazzilu alg'ayza vaya'lamu ma fiy alarhami vama tadriy nafsun maza taksibu g'adan vama tadriy nafsun biayyi ardin tamutu inna Alloha 'aliymun xabiyrun
Aliflammiym
Tanziylu alkitabi la rayba fiyhi min rabbi al'alamiyna
Am yaquluna iftarahu bal huva alhaqqu min rabbika litunzira qavman ma atahum min naziyrin min qablika la'llohum yahtaduna
Allohu allaziy xalaqa alssamavati valarda vama baynahuma fiy sittati ayyamin zumma istava 'ala al'arshi ma lakum min dunihi min valiyyin vala shafiy'in afala tatazakkaruna
Yudabbiru alamra mina alssamai ila alardi summa ya'ruju ilayhi fiy yavmin kana miqdaruhu alfa sanatin mimma ta'udduna
Zalika 'alimu alg'aybi valshshahadati al'aziyzu alrrahiymu
Allaziy ahsana kulla shayin xalaqahu vabada xalqa alinsani min tiynin
Summa ja'ala naslahu min sulalatin min main mahiynin
Summa savvahu vanafaxa fiyhi min ruhihi vaja'ala lakumu alssam'a valabsara valafidata qaliylan ma tashkuruna
Vaqalu aiza dalalna fiy alardi ainna lafiy xalqin jadiydin bal hum biliqai rabbihim kafiruna
Qul yatavaffakum malaku almavti allaziy vukkila bikum zumma ila rabbikum turja'una
Valav tara izi almujrimuna nakisu ruusihim 'inda rabbihim rabbana absarna vasami'na farji'na na'mal salihan inna muqinuna
Valav shina latayna kulla nafsin hudaha valakin haqqa alqavlu minniy lamlanna jahannama mina aljinnati valnnasi ajma'iyna
Fazuqu bima nasiytum liqa yavmikum haza inna nasiynakum vazuqu 'azaba alxuldi bima kuntum ta'maluna
Innama yuminu biayatina allaziyna iza zukkiru biha xarru sujjadan vasabbahu bihamdi rabbihim vahum la yastakbiruna
Tatajafa junubuhum 'ani almadaji'i yad'una rabbahum xavfan vatama'an vamimma razaqnahum yunfiquna
Fala ta'lamu nafsun ma oxfiya lahum min qurrati a'yunin jazan bima kanu ya'maluna
Afaman kana muminan kaman kana fasiqan la yastavuna
Amma allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati falahum jannatu almava nuzulan bima kanu ya'maluna
Vamma allaziyna fasaqu famavahumu alnnaru kullama aradu an yaxruju minha o'iydu fiyha vaqiyla lahum zuqu 'azaba alnnari allaziy kuntum bihi tukazzibuna
Valanuziyqannahum mina al'azabi aladna duna al'azabi alakbari la'llohum yarji'una
Vaman azlamu mimman zukkira biayati rabbihi zumma a'rada 'anha inna mina almujrimiyna muntaqimuna
Valaqad atayna musa alkitaba fala takun fiy miryatin min liqaihi vaja'alnahu hudan libaniy israiyla
Vaja'alna minhum aimmatan yahduna biamrina lamma sabaru vakanu biayatina yuqinuna
Inna rabbaka huva yafsilu baynahum yavma alqiyamati fiyma kanu fiyhi yaxtalifuna
Avalam yahdi lahum kam ahlakna min qablihim mina alquruni yamshuna fiy masakinihim inna fiy zalika layatin afala yasma'una
Avalam yarav anna nasuqu alma ila alardi aljuruzi fanuxriju bihi zar'an takulu minhu an'amuhum vanfusuhum afala yubsiruna
Vayaquluna mata haza alfazu in kuntum sadiqiyna
Qul yavma alfazi la yanfa'u allaziyna kafaru iymanuhum vala hum yunzaruna
Fa'rid 'anhum vaintazir innahum muntaziruna
Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu ittaqi Alloha vala tuti'i alkafiriyna valmunafiqiyna inna Alloha kana 'aliyman hakiyman
Vaittabi' ma yuha ilayka min rabbika inna Alloha kana bima ta'maluna xabiyran
Vatavakkal 'ala Allohi vakafa biAllohi vakiylan

Ma ja'ala Allohu lirajulin min qalbayni fiy javfihi vama ja'ala azvajakumu allaiy tuzahiruna minhunna ommahatikum vama ja'ala ad'iyakum abnakum zalikum qavlukum biafvahikum vaAllohu yaqulu alhaqqa vahuva yahdiy alssabiyla

Od'uhum liabaihim huva aqsatu 'inda Allohi fain lam ta'lamu abahum faixvanukum fiy alddiyni vamavaliykum valaysa 'alaykum junahun fiyma axtatum bihi valakin ma ta'ammadat qulubukum vakana Allohu g'afuran rahiyman

Alnnabiyyu avla bialmuminiyna min anfusihim vazvajuhu ommahatuhum vaolu alarhami ba'duhum avla biba'din fiy kitabi Allohi mina almuminiyna valmuhajiriyna illa an taf'alu ila avliyaikum ma'rufan kana zalika fiy alkitabi masturan
Vaiz axazna mina alnnabiyyiyna miyzaqahum vaminka vamin nuhin vaibrahiyma vamusa va'iysa ibni maryama vaxazna minhum miyzaqan g'aliyzan
Liyasala alssadiqiyna 'an sidqihim va'adda lilkafiriyna 'azaban aliyman
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu ozkuru ni'mata Allohi 'alaykum iz jatkum junudun farsalna 'alayhim riyhan vajunudan lam taravha vakana Allohu bima ta'maluna basiyran
Iz jaukum min favqikum vamin asfala minkum vaiz zag'ati alabsaru vabalag'ati alqulubu alhanajira vatazunnuna biAllohi alzzununa
Hunalika ibtuliya almuminuna vazulzilu zilzalan shadiydan
Vaiz yaqulu almunafiquna vallaziyna fiy qulubihim maradun ma va'adana Allohu varasuluhu illa g'ururan
Vaiz qalat taifatun minhum ya ahla yazriba la muqama lakum fairji'u vayastazinu fariyqun minhumu alnnabiyya yaquluna inna buyutana 'avratun vama hiya bi'avratin in yuriyduna illa firaran
Valav duxilat 'alayhim min aqtariha summa suilu alfitnata latavha vama talabbasu biha illa yasiyran
Valaqad kanu 'ahadu Alloha min qablu la yuvalluna aladbara vakana 'ahdu Allohi masulan
Qul lan yanfa'akumu alfiraru in farartum mina almavti avi alqatli vaizan la tumatta'una illa qaliylan
Qul man za allaziy ya'simukum mina Allohi in arada bikum suan av arada bikum rahmatan vala yajiduna lahum min duni Allohi valiyyan vala nasiyran
Qad ya'lamu Allohu almu'avviqiyna minkum valqailiyna liixvanihim halumma ilayna vala yatuna albasa illa qaliylan

Ashihhatan 'alaykum faiza ja alxavfu raytahum yanzuruna ilayka taduru a'yunuhum kallaziy yug'sha 'alayhi mina almavti faiza zahaba alxavfu salaqukum bialsinatin hidadin ashihhatan 'ala alxayri olaika lam yuminu fahbata Allohu a'malahum vakana zalika 'ala Allohi yasiyran
Yahsabuna alahzaba lam yazhabu vain yati alahzabu yavaddu lav annahum baduna fiy ala'rabi yasaluna 'an anbaikum valav kanu fiykum ma qatalu illa qaliylan
Laqad kana lakum fiy rasuli Allohi osvatun hasanatun liman kana yarju Alloha valyavma alaxira vazakara Alloha kaziyran
Valamma ra almuminuna alahzaba qalu haza ma va'adana Allohu varasuluhu vasadaqa Allohu varasuluhu vama zadahum illa iymanan vatasliyman
Mina almuminiyna rijalun sadaqu ma 'ahadu Alloha 'alayhi faminhum man qada nahbahu vaminhum man yantaziru vama baddalu tabdiylan
Liyajziya Allohu alssadiqiyna bisidqihim vayu'azziba almunafiqiyna in sha av yatuba 'alayhim inna Alloha kana g'afuran rahiyman
Varadda Allohu allaziyna kafaru big'ayzihim lam yanalu xayran vakafa Allohu almuminiyna alqitala vakana Allohu qaviyyan 'aziyzan
Vanzala allaziyna zaharuhum min ahli alkitabi min sayasiyhim vaqazafa fiy qulubihimu alrru'ba fariyqan taqtuluna vatasiruna fariyqan
Vavrasakum ardahum vadiyarahum vamvalahum vardan lam tatauha vakana Allohu 'ala kulli shayin qadiyran
Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu qul liazvajika in kuntunna turidna alhayata alddunya vaziynataha fata'alayna omatti'kunna vaosarrihkunna sarahan jamiylan
Vain kuntunna turidna Alloha varasulahu valddara alaxirata fainna Alloha a'adda lilmuhsinati minkunna ajran 'aziyman
Ya nisa alnnabiyyi man yati minkunna bifahishatin mubayyinatin yuda'af laha al'azabu di'fayni vakana zalika 'ala Allohi yasiyran
Vaman yaqnut minkunna lillahi varasulihi vata'mal salihan nutiha ajraha marratayni va'tadna laha rizqan kariyman
Ya nisa alnnabiyyi lastunna kahadin mina alnnisai ini ittaqaytunna fala taxda'na bialqavli fayatma'a allaziy fiy qalbihi maradun vaqulna qavlan ma'rufan

Vaqarna fiy buyutikunna vala tabarrajna tabarruja aljahiliyyati alula vaqimna alssalata vatiyna alzzakata vati'na Alloha varasulahu innama yuriydu Allohu liyuzhiba 'ankumu alrrijsa ahla albayti vayutahhirakum taziyran
Vaozkurna ma yutla fiy buyutikunna min ayati Allohi valhikmati inna Alloha kana latiyfan xabiyran

Inna almuslimiyna valmuslimati valmuminiyna valmuminati valqanitiyna valqanitati valssadiqiyna valssadiqati valssabiriyna valssabirati valxashi'iyna valxashi'ati valmutasaddiqiyna valmutasaddiqati valssaimiyna valssaimati valhafiziyna furujahum valhafizati valzzakiriyna Alloha kaziyran valzzakirati a'adda Allohu lahum mag'firatan vajran 'aziyman
Vama kana limuminin vala muminatin iza qada Allohu varasuluhu amran an yakuna lahumu alxiyaratu min amrihim vaman ya'si Alloha varasulahu faqad dalla dalalan mubiynan

Vaiz taqulu lillaziy an'ama Allohu 'alayhi van'amta 'alayhi amsik 'alayka zavjaka vaittaqi Alloha vatuxfiy fiy nafsika ma Allohu mubdiyhi vataxsha alnnasa vaAllohu ahaqqu an taxshahu falamma qada zaydun minha vataran zavvajnakaha likay la yakuna 'ala almuminiyna harajun fiy azvaji ad'iyaihim iza qadav minhunna vataran vakana amru Allohi maf'ulan
Ma kana 'ala alnnabiyyi min harajin fiyma farada Allohu lahu sunnata Allohi fiy allaziyna xalav min qablu vakana amru Allohi qadaran maqduran
Allaziyna yuballig'una risalati Allohi vayaxshavnahu vala yaxshavna ahadan illa Alloha vakafa biAllohi hasiyban
Ma kana muhammadun aba ahadin min rijalikum valakin rasula Allohi vaxatama alnnabiyyiyna vakana Allohu bikulli shayin 'aliyman
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu ozkuru Alloha zikran kaziyran
Vasabbihuhu bukratan vasiylan
Huva allaziy yusalliy 'alaykum vamalaikatuhu liyuxrijakum mina alzzulumati ila alnnuri vakana bialmuminiyna rahiyman
Tahiyyatuhum yavma yalqavnahu salamun va'adda lahum ajran kariyman
Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu inna arsalnaka shahidan vamubashshiran vanaziyran
Vada'iyan ila Allohi biiznihi vasirajan muniyran
Vabashshiri almuminiyna bianna lahum mina Allohi fadlan kabiyran
Vala tuti'i alkafiriyna valmunafiqiyna vada' azahum vatavakkal 'ala Allohi vakafa biAllohi vakiylan
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu iza nakahtumu almuminati zumma tallaqtumuhunna min qabli an tamassuhunna fama lakum 'alayhinna min 'iddatin ta'taddunaha famatti'uhunna vasarrihuhunna sarahan jamiylan

Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu inna ahlalna laka azvajaka allatiy atayta ojurahunna vama malakat yamiynuka mimma afa Allohu 'alayka vabanati 'ammika vabanati 'ammatika vabanati xalika vabanati xalatika allatiy hajarna ma'aka vaimratan muminatan in vahabat nafsaha lilnnabiyyi in arada alnnabiyyu an yastankihaha xalisatan laka min duni almuminiyna qad 'alimna ma faradna 'alayhim fiy azvajihim vama malakat aymanuhum likayla yakuna 'alayka harajun vakana Allohu g'afuran rahiyman

Turjiy man tashao minhunna vatuviy ilayka man tashao vamani ibtag'ayta mimman 'azalta fala junaha 'alayka zalika adna an taqarra a'yunuhunna vala yahzanna vayardayna bima ataytahunna kulluhunna vaAllohu ya'lamu ma fiy qulubikum vakana Allohu 'aliyman haliyman
La yahillu laka alnnisao min ba'du vala an tabaddala bihinna min azvajin valav a'jabaka husnuhunna illa ma malakat yamiynuka vakana Allohu 'ala kulli shayin raqiyban

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la tadxulu buyuta alnnabiyyi illa an yuzana lakum ila ta'amin g'ayra naziriyna inahu valakin iza du'iytum faodxulu faiza ta'imtum faintashiru vala mustanisiyna lihadiyzin inna zalikum kana yuziy alnnabiyya fayastahyiy minkum vaAllohu la yastahyiy mina alhaqqi vaiza saltumuhunna mata'an faisaluhunna min varai hijabin zalikum azaru liqulubikum vaqulubihinna vama kana lakum an tuzu rasula Allohi vala an tankihu azvajahu min ba'dihi abadan inna zalikum kana 'inda Allohi 'aziyman
In tubdu shayan av tuxfuhu fainna Alloha kana bikulli shayin 'aliyman

La junaha 'alayhinna fiy abaihinna vala abnaihinna vala ixvanihinna vala abnai ixvanihinna vala abnai axavatihinna vala nisaihinna vala ma malakat aymanuhunna vaittaqiyna Alloha inna Alloha kana 'ala kulli shayin shahiydan
Inna Alloha vamalaikatahu yusalluna 'ala alnnabiyyi ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu sallu 'alayhi vasallimu tasliyman
Inna allaziyna yuzuna Alloha varasulahu la'anahumu Allohu fiy alddunya valaxirati va'adda lahum 'azaban muhiynan
Vallaziyna yuzuna almuminiyna valmuminati big'ayri ma iktasabu faqadi ihtamalu buhtanan vaizman mubiynan
Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu qul liazvajika vabanatika vanisai almuminiyna yudniyna 'alayhinna min jalabiybihinna zalika adna an yu'rafna fala yuzayna vakana Allohu g'afuran rahiyman
Lain lam yantahi almunafiquna vallaziyna fiy qulubihim maradun valmurjifuna fiy almadiynati lanug'riyannaka bihim zumma la yujavirunaka fiyha illa qaliylan
Mal'uniyna aynama zuqifu oxizu vaquttilu taqtiylan
Sunnata Allohi fiy allaziyna xalav min qablu valan tajida lisunnati Allohi tabdiylan
Yasaluka alnnasu 'ani alssa'ati qul innama 'ilmuha 'inda Allohi vama yudriyka la'alla alssa'ata takunu qariyban
Inna Alloha la'ana alkafiriyna va'adda lahum sa'iyran
Xalidiyna fiyha abadan la yajiduna valiyyan vala nasiyran
Yavma tuqallabu vujuhuhum fiy alnnari yaquluna ya laytana ata'na Alloha vata'na alrrasula
Vaqalu rabbana inna ata'na sadatana vakubarana fadalluna alssabiyla
Rabbana atihim di'fayni mina al'azabi vail'anhum la'nan kabiyran
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la takunu kallaziyna azav musa fabarrahu Allohu mimma qalu vakana 'inda Allohi vajiyhan
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu ittaqu Alloha vaqulu qavlan sadiydan
Yuslih lakum a'malakum vayag'fir lakum zunubakum vaman yuti'i Alloha varasulahu faqad faza favzan 'aziyman
Inna 'aradna alamanata 'ala alssamavati valardi valjibali fabayna an yahmilnaha vashfaqna minha vahamalaha alinsanu innahu kana zaluman jahulan
Liyu'azziba Allohu almunafiqiyna valmunafiqati valmushrikiyna valmushrikati vayatuba Allohu 'ala almuminiyna valmuminati vakana Allohu g'afuran rahiyman
Alhamdu lillahi allaziy lahu ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi valahu alhamdu fiy alaxirati vahuva alhakiymu alxabiyru
Ya'lamu ma yaliju fiy alardi vama yaxruju minha vama yanzilu mina alssamai vama ya'ruju fiyha vahuva alrrahiymu alg'afuru

Vaqala allaziyna kafaru la tatiyna alssa'atu qul bala varabbiy latatiyannakum 'alimi alg'aybi la ya'zubu 'anhu mizqalu zarratin fiy alssamavati vala fiy alardi vala asg'aru min zalika vala akbaru illa fiy kitabin mubiynin
Liyajziya allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati olaika lahum mag'firatun varizqun kariymun
Vallaziyna sa'av fiy ayatina mu'ajiziyna olaika lahum 'azabun min rijzin aliymin
Vayara allaziyna utu al'ilma allaziy onzila ilayka min rabbika huva alhaqqa vayahdiy ila sirati al'aziyzi alhamiydi
Vaqala allaziyna kafaru hal nadullukum 'ala rajulin yunabbiokum iza muzziqtum kulla mumazzaqin innakum lafiy xalqin jadiydin
Aftara 'ala Allohi kaziban am bihi jinnatun bali allaziyna la yuminuna bialaxirati fiy al'azabi valddalali alba'iydi
Afalam yarav ila ma bayna aydiyhim vama xalfahum mina alssamai valardi in nasha naxsif bihimu alarda av nusqit 'alayhim kisafan mina alssamai inna fiy zalika layatan likulli 'abdin muniybin
Valaqad atayna davuda minna fadlan ya jibalu avvibiy ma'ahu valttayra valanna lahu alhadiyda
Ani i'mal sabig'atin vaqaddir fiy alssardi vai'malu salihan inniy bima ta'maluna basiyrun

Vanufixa fiy alssuri fasa'iqa man fiy alssamavati vaman fiy alardi illa man sha Allohu zumma nufixa fiyhi oxra faiza hum qiyamun yanzuruna
Vashraqati alardu binuri rabbiha vavudi'a alkitabu vajiya bialnnabiyyiyna valshshuhadai vaqudiya baynahum bialhaqqi vahum la yuzlamuna
Vavuffiyat kullu nafsin ma 'amilat vahuva a'lamu bima yaf'aluna

Vasiyqa allaziyna kafaru ila jahannama zumaran hatta iza jauha futihat abvabuha vaqala lahum xazanatuha alam yatikum rusulun minkum yatluna 'alaykum ayati rabbikum vayunzirunakum liqa yavmikum haza qalu bala valakin haqqat kalimatu al'azabi 'ala alkafiriyna
Qiyla odxulu abvaba jahannama xalidiyna fiyha fabisa masva almutakabbiriyna
Vasiyqa allaziyna ittaqav rabbahum ila aljannati zumaran hatta iza jauha vafutihat abvabuha vaqala lahum xazanatuha salamun 'alaykum tibtum faodxuluha xalidiyna
Vaqalu alhamdu lillahi allaziy sadaqana va'dahu vavrazana alarda natabavvao mina aljannati hayzu nashao fani'ma ajru al'amiliyna
Vatara almalaikata haffiyna min havli al'arshi yusabbihuna bihamdi rabbihim vaqudiya baynahum bialhaqqi vaqiyla alhamdu lillahi rabbi al'alamiyna
Hamiym
Tanziylu alkitabi mina Allohi al'aziyzi al'aliymi
G'afiri alzzanbi vaqabili alttavbi shadiydi al'iqabi ziy alttavli la ilaha illa huva ilayhi almasiyru
Ma yujadilu fiy ayati Allohi illa allaziyna kafaru fala yag'rurka taqallubuhum fiy albiladi
Kazzabat qablahum qavmu nuhin valahzabu min ba'dihim vahammat kullu ommatin birasulihim liyaxuzuhu vajadalu bialbatili liyudhidu bihi alhaqqa faxaztuhum fakayfa kana 'iqabi
Vakazalika haqqat kalimatu rabbika 'ala allaziyna kafaru annahum ashabu alnnari

Allaziyna yahmiluna al'arsha vaman havlahu yusabbihuna bihamdi rabbihim vayuminuna bihi vayastag'firuna lillaziyna amanu rabbana vasi'ta kulla shayin rahmatan va'ilman faig'fir lillaziyna tabu vaittaba'u sabiylaka vaqihim 'azaba aljahiymi
Rabbana vadxilhum jannati 'adnin allatiy va'adtahum vaman salaha min abaihim vazvajihim vazurriyyatihim innaka anta al'aziyzu alhakiymu
Vaqihimu alssayyiati vaman taqi alssayyiati yavmaizin faqad rahimtahu vazalika huva alfavzu al'aziymu
Inna allaziyna kafaru yunadavna lamaqtu Allohi akbaru min maqtikum anfusakum iz tud'avna ila aliymani fatakfuruna
Qalu rabbana amattana iznatayni vahyaytana iznatayni fai'tarafna bizunubina fahal ila xurujin min sabiylin
Zalikum biannahu iza du'iya Allohu vahdahu kafartum vain yushrak bihi tuminu falhukmu lillahi al'aliyyi alkabiyri
Huva allaziy yuriykum ayatihi vayunazzilu lakum mina alssamai rizqan vama yatazakkaru illa man yuniybu
Faod'u Alloha muxlisiyna lahu alddiyna valav kariha alkafiruna
Rafiy'u alddarajati zu al'arshi yulqiy alrruha min amrihi 'ala man yashao min 'ibadihi liyunzira yavma alttalaqi
Yavma hum barizuna la yaxfa 'ala Allohi minhum shayon limani almulku alyavma lillahi alvahidi alqahhari
Alyavma tujza kullu nafsin bima kasabat la zulma alyavma inna Alloha sariy'u alhisabi
Vanzirhum yavma alazifati izi alqulubu lada alhanajiri kazimiyna ma lilzzalimiyna min hamiymin vala shafiy'in yuta'u
Ya'lamu xainata ala'yuni vama tuxfiy alssuduru
VaAllohu yaqdiy bialhaqqi vallaziyna yad'una min dunihi la yaqduna bishayin inna Alloha huva alssamiy'u albasiyru

Ava lam yasiyru fiy alardi fayanzuru kayfa kana 'aqibatu allaziyna kanu min qablihim kanu hum ashadda minhum quvvatan vazaran fiy alardi faxazahumu Allohu bizunubihim vama kana lahum mina Allohi min vaqin
Zalika biannahum kanat tatiyhim rusuluhum bialbayyinati fakafaru faxazahumu Allohu innahu qaviyyun shadiydu al'iqabi
Valaqad arsalna musa biayatina vasultanin mubiynin
Ila fir'avna vahamana vaqaruna faqalu sahirun kazzabun
Falamma jahum bialhaqqi min 'indina qalu oqtulu abna allaziyna amanu ma'ahu vaistahyu nisahum vama kaydu alkafiriyna illa fiy dalalin
Vaqala fir'avnu zaruniy aqtul musa valyad'u rabbahu inniy axafu an yubaddila diynakum av an yuzhira fiy alardi alfasada
Vaqala musa inniy 'uztu birabbiy varabbikum min kulli mutakabbirin la yuminu biyavmi alhisabi

Vaqala rajulun muminun min ali fir'avna yaktumu iymanahu ataqtuluna rajulan an yaqula rabbiyya Allohu vaqad jakum bialbayyinati min rabbikum vain yaku kaziban fa'alayhi kazibuhu vain yaku sadiqan yusibkum ba'du allaziy ya'idukum inna Alloha la yahdiy man huva musrifun kazzabun
Ya qavmi lakumu almulku alyavma zahiriyna fiy alardi faman yansuruna min basi Allohi in jana qala fir'avnu ma oriykum illa ma ara vama ahdiykum illa sabiyla alrrashadi
Vaqala allaziy amana ya qavmi inniy axafu 'alaykum mizla yavmi alahzabi
Mizla dabi qavmi nuhin va'adin vazamuda vallaziyna min ba'dihim vama Allohu yuriydu zulman lil'ibadi
Vaya qavmi inniy axafu 'alaykum yavma alttanadi
Yavma tuvalluna mudbiriyna ma lakum mina Allohi min 'asimin vaman yudlili Allohu fama lahu min hadin
Valaqad jakum yusufu min qablu bialbayyinati fama ziltum fiy shakkin mimma jakum bihi hatta iza halaka qultum lan yab'aza Allohu min ba'dihi rasulan kazalika yudillu Allohu man huva musrifun murtabun
Allaziyna yujadiluna fiy ayati Allohi big'ayri sultanin atahum kabura maqtan 'inda Allohi va'inda allaziyna amanu kazalika yatba'u Allohu 'ala kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbarin
Vaqala fir'avnu ya hamanu ibni liy sarhan la'alliy ablug'u alasbaba
Asbaba alssamavati fattali'a ila ilahi musa vainniy lazunnuhu kaziban vakazalika zuyyina lifir'avna suo 'amalihi vasudda 'ani alssabiyli vama kaydu fir'avna illa fiy tababin
Vaqala allaziy amana ya qavmi ittabi'uni ahdikum sabiyla alrrashadi
Ya qavmi innama hazihi alhayatu alddunya mata'un vainna alaxirata hiya daru alqarari
Man 'amila sayyiatan fala yujza illa mizlaha vaman 'amila salihan min zakarin av onza vahuva muminun faolaika yadxuluna aljannata yurzaquna fiyha big'ayri hisabin
Vaya qavmi ma liy ad'ukum ila alnnajati vatad'unaniy ila alnnari
Tad'unaniy liakfura biAllohi vaoshrika bihi ma laysa liy bihi 'ilmun vana ad'ukum ila al'aziyzi alg'affari
La jarama annama tad'unaniy ilayhi laysa lahu da'vatun fiy alddunya vala fiy alaxirati vanna maraddana ila Allohi vanna almusrifiyna hum ashabu alnnari
Fasatazkuruna ma aqulu lakum vaofavvidu amriy ila Allohi inna Alloha basiyrun bial'ibadi
Favaqahu Allohu sayyiati ma makaru vahaqa biali fir'avna suo al'azabi
Alnnaru yu'raduna 'alayha g'uduvvan va'ashiyyan vayavma taqumu alssa'atu adxilu ala fir'avna ashadda al'azabi
Vaiz yatahajjuna fiy alnnari fayaqulu alddu'afao lillaziyna istakbaru inna kunna lakum taba'an fahal antum mug'nuna 'anna nasiyban mina alnnari
Qala allaziyna istakbaru inna kullun fiyha inna Alloha qad hakama bayna al'ibadi
Vaqala allaziyna fiy alnnari lixazanati jahannama od'u rabbakum yuxaffif 'anna yavman mina al'azabi
Qalu avalam taku tatiykum rusulukum bialbayyinati qalu bala qalu faod'u vama du'ao alkafiriyna illa fiy dalalin
Inna lanansuru rusulana vallaziyna amanu fiy alhayati alddunya vayavma yaqumu alashhadu
Yavma la yanfa'u alzzalimiyna ma'ziratuhum valahumu alla'natu valahum suo alddari
Valaqad atayna musa alhuda vavrasna baniy israiyla alkitaba
Hudan vazikra lioliy alalbabi
Faisbir inna va'da Allohi haqqun vaistag'fir lizanbika vasabbih bihamdi rabbika bial'ashiyyi valibkari
Inna allaziyna yujadiluna fiy ayati Allohi big'ayri sultanin atahum in fiy sudurihim illa kibrun ma hum bibalig'iyhi faista'iz biAllohi innahu huva alssamiy'u albasiyru
Laxalqu alssamavati valardi akbaru min xalqi alnnasi valakinna aksara alnnasi la ya'lamuna
Vama yastaviy ala'ma valbasiyru vallaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati vala almusiyo qaliylan ma tatazakkaruna
Inna alssa'ata latiyatun la rayba fiyha valakinna aksara alnnasi la yuminuna
Vaqala rabbukumu od'uniy astajib lakum inna allaziyna yastakbiruna 'an 'ibadatiy sayadxuluna jahannama daxiriyna
Allohu allaziy ja'ala lakumu allayla litaskunu fiyhi valnnahara mubsiran inna Alloha lazu fadlin 'ala alnnasi valakinna akzara alnnasi la yashkuruna
Zalikumu Allohu rabbukum xaliqu kulli shayin la ilaha illa huva fanna tufakuna
Kazalika yufaku allaziyna kanu biayati Allohi yajhaduna
Allohu allaziy ja'ala lakumu alarda qararan valssama binan vasavvarakum fahsana suvarakum varazaqakum mina alttayyibati zalikumu Allohu rabbukum fatabaraka Allohu rabbu al'alamiyna
Huva alhayyu la ilaha illa huva faod'uhu muxlisiyna lahu alddiyna alhamdu lillahi rabbi al'alamiyna
Qul inniy nuhiytu an a'buda allaziyna tad'una min duni Allohi lamma janiya albayyinatu min rabbiy vaomirtu an oslima lirabbi al'alamiyna

Huva allaziy xalaqakum min turabin zumma min nutfatin zumma min 'alaqatin zumma yuxrijukum tiflan zumma litablug'u ashuddakum zumma litakunu shuyuxan vaminkum man yutavaffa min qablu valitablug'u ajalan musamman vala'allakum ta'qiluna
Huva allaziy yuhyiy vayumiytu faiza qada amran fainnama yaqulu lahu kun fayakunu
Alam tara ila allaziyna yujadiluna fiy ayati Allohi anna yusrafuna
Allaziyna kazzabu bialkitabi vabima arsalna bihi rusulana fasavfa ya'lamuna
Izi alag'lalu fiy a'naqihim valssalasilu yushabuna
Fiy alhamiymi summa fiy alnnari yusjaruna
Summa qiyla lahum ayna ma kuntum tushrikuna
Min duni Allohi qalu dallu 'anna bal lam nakun nad'u min qablu shayan kazalika yudillu Allohu alkafiriyna
Zalikum bima kuntum tafrahuna fiy alardi big'ayri alhaqqi vabima kuntum tamrahuna
Odxulu abvaba jahannama xalidiyna fiyha fabisa masva almutakabbiriyna
Faisbir inna va'da Allohi haqqun faimma nuriyannaka ba'da allaziy na'iduhum av natavaffayannaka failayna yurja'una

Valaqad arsalna rusulan min qablika minhum man qasasna 'alayka vaminhum man lam naqsus 'alayka vama kana lirasulin an yatiya biayatin illa biizni Allohi faiza ja amru Allohi qudiya bialhaqqi vaxasira hunalika almubtiluna
Allohu allaziy ja'ala lakumu alan'ama litarkabu minha vaminha takuluna
Valakum fiyha manafi'u valitablug'u 'alayha hajatan fiy sudurikum va'alayha va'ala alfulki tuhmaluna
Vayuriykum ayatihi fayya ayati Allohi tunkiruna
Afalam yasiyru fiy alardi fayanzuru kayfa kana 'aqibatu allaziyna min qablihim kanu akzara minhum vashadda quvvatan vazaran fiy alardi fama ag'na 'anhum ma kanu yaksibuna
Falamma jazum rusuluhum bialbayyinati farihu bima 'indahum mina al'ilmi vahaqa bihim ma kanu bihi yastahziuna
Falamma rav basana qalu amanna biAllohi vahdahu vakafarna bima kunna bihi mushrikiyna
Falam yaku yanfa'uhum iymanuhum lamma rav basana sunnata Allohi allatiy qad xalat fiy 'ibadihi vaxasira hunalika alkafiruna
Hamiym
Tanziylun mina alrrahmani alrrahiymi
Kitabun fussilat ayatuhu quranan 'arabiyyan liqavmin ya'lamuna
Bashiyran vanaziyran fa'rada akzaruhum fahum la yasma'una
Vaqalu qulubuna fiy akinnatin mimma tad'una ilayhi vafiy azanina vaqrun vamin baynina vabaynika hijabun fai'mal innana 'amiluna
Qul innama ana basharun mislukum yuha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun vahidun faistaqiymu ilayhi vaistag'firuhu vavaylun lilmushrikiyna
Allaziyna la yutuna alzzakata vahum bialaxirati hum kafiruna
Inna allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati lahum ajrun g'ayru mamnunin
Qul ainnakum latakfuruna biallaziy xalaqa alarda fiy yavmayni vataj'aluna lahu andadan zalika rabbu al'alamiyna
Vaja'ala fiyha ravasiya min favqiha vabaraka fiyha vaqaddara fiyha aqvataha fiy arba'ati ayyamin savan lilssailiyna
Summa istava ila alssamai vahiya duxanun faqala laha valilardi itiya tav'an av karhan qalata atayna tai'iyna
Faqadahunna sab'a samavatin fiy yavmayni vavha fiy kulli samain amraha vazayyanna alssama alddunya bimasabiyha vahifzan zalika taqdiyru al'aziyzi al'aliymi
Fain a'radu fuqul anzartukum sa'iqatan mizla sa'iqati 'adin vazamuda
Iz jazumu alrrusulu min bayni aydiyhim vamin xalfihim alla ta'budu illa Alloha qalu lav sha rabbuna lanzala malaikatan fainna bima orsiltum bihi kafiruna
Famma 'adun faistakbaru fiy alardi big'ayri alhaqqi vaqalu man ashaddu minna quvvatan avalam yarav anna Alloha allaziy xalaqahum huva ashaddu minhum quvvatan vakanu biayatina yajhaduna
Farsalna 'alayhim riyhan sarsaran fiy ayyamin nahisatin linuziyqahum 'azaba alxizyi fiy alhayati alddunya vala'azabu alaxirati axza vahum la yunsaruna
Vamma zamudu fahadaynahum faistahabbu al'ama 'ala alhuda faxazazum sa'iqatu al'azabi alhuni bima kanu yaksibuna
Vanajjayna allaziyna amanu vakanu yattaquna
Vayavma yuhsharu a'dao Allohi ila alnnari fahum yuza'una
Hatta iza ma jauha shahida 'alayhim sam'uhum vabsaruhum vajuluduhum bima kanu ya'maluna
Vaqalu lijuludihim lima shahidtum 'alayna qalu antaqana Allohu allaziy antaqa kulla shayin vahuva xalaqakum avvala marratin vailayhi turja'una
Vama kuntum tastatiruna an yashhada 'alaykum sam'ukum vala absarukum vala juludukum valakin zanantum anna Alloha la ya'lamu kaziyran mimma ta'maluna
Vazalikum zannukumu allaziy zanantum birabbikum ardakum fasbahtum mina alxasiriyna
Fain yasbiru falnnaru masvan lahum vain yasta'tibu fama hum mina almu'tabiyna
Vaqayyadna lahum qurana fazayyanu lahum ma bayna aydiyhim vama xalfahum vahaqqa 'alayhimu alqavlu fiy omamin qad xalat min qablihim mina aljinni valinsi innahum kanu xasiriyna
Vaqala allaziyna kafaru la tasma'u lihaza alqurani vailg'av fiyhi la'allakum tag'libuna
Falanuziyqanna allaziyna kafaru 'azaban shadiydan valanajziyannahum asva allaziy kanu ya'maluna
Zalika jazao a'dai Allohi alnnaru lahum fiyha daru alxuldi jazan bima kanu biayatina yajhaduna
Vaqala allaziyna kafaru rabbana arina allazayni adallana mina aljinni valinsi naj'alhuma tahta aqdamina liyakuna mina alasfaliyna
Inna allaziyna qalu rabbuna Allohu zumma istaqamu tatanazzalu 'alayhimu almalaikatu alla taxafu vala tahzanu vabshiru bialjannati allatiy kuntum tu'aduna
Nahnu avliyaokum fiy alhayati alddunya vafiy alaxirati valakum fiyha ma tashtahiy anfusukum valakum fiyha ma tadda'una
Nuzulan min g'afurin rahiymin
Vaman ahsanu qavlan mimman da'a ila Allohi va'amila salihan vaqala innaniy mina almuslimiyna
Vala tastaviy alhasanatu vala alssayyiatu idfa' biallatiy hiya ahsanu faiza allaziy baynaka vabaynahu 'adavatun kannahu valiyyun hamiymun
Vama yulaqqaha illa allaziyna sabaru vama yulaqqaha illa zu hazzin 'aziymin
Vaimma yanzag'annaka mina alshshaytani nazg'un faista'iz biAllohi innahu huva alssamiy'u al'aliymu
Vamin ayatihi allaylu valnnaharu valshshamsu valqamaru la tasjudu lilshshamsi vala lilqamari vaosjudu lillahi alaziy xalaqahunna in kuntum iyyahu ta'buduna
Faini istakbaru fallaziyna 'inda rabbika yusabbihuna lahu biallayli valnnahari vahum la yasamuna
Vamin ayatihi annaka tara alarda xashi'atan faiza anzalna 'alayha alma ihtazzat varabat inna allaziy ahyaha lamuhyiy almavta innahu 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun
Inna allaziyna yulhiduna fiy ayatina la yaxfavna 'alayna afaman yulqa fiy alnnari xayrun am man yatiy aminan yavma alqiyamati i'malu ma shitum innahu bima ta'maluna basiyrun
Inna allaziyna kafaru bialzzikri lamma jahum vainnahu lakitabun 'aziyzun
La yatiyhi albatilu min bayni yadayhi vala min xalfihi tanziylun min hakiymin hamiydin
Ma yuqalu laka illa ma qad qiyla lilrrusuli min qablika inna rabbaka lazu mag'firatin vazu 'iqabin aliymin

Valav ja'alnahu quranan a'jamiyyan laqalu lavla fussilat ayatuhu a'jamiyyun va'arabiyyun qul huva lillaziyna amanu hudan vashifaon vallaziyna la yuminuna fiy azanihim vaqrun vahuva 'alayhim 'aman olaika yunadavna min makanin ba'iydin
Valaqad atayna musa alkitaba faixtulifa fiyhi valavla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laqudiya baynahum vainnahum lafiy shakkin minhu muriybin
Man 'amila salihan falinafsihi vaman asa fa'alayha vama rabbuka bizallamin lil'abiydi
Ilayhi yuraddu 'ilmu alssa'ati vama taxruju min zamaratin min akmamiha vama tahmilu min onza vala tada'u illa bi'ilmihi vayavma yunadiyhim ayna shurakaiy qalu azannaka ma minna min shahiydin
Vadalla 'anhum ma kanu yad'una min qablu vazannu ma lahum min mahiysin
La yasamu alinsanu min du'ai alxayri vain massahu alshsharru fayausun qanutun

Valain azaqnahu rahmatan minna min ba'di darra massazu layaqulanna haza liy vama azunnu alssa'ata qaimatan valain ruji'tu ila rabbiy inna liy 'indahu lalhusna falanunabbianna allaziyna kafaru bima 'amilu valanuziyqannahum min 'azabin g'aliyzin
Vaiza an'amna 'ala alinsani a'rada vana bijanibihi vaiza massahu alshsharru fazu du'ain 'ariydin
Qul araytum in kana min 'indi Allohi summa kafartum bihi man adallu mimman huva fiy shiqaqin ba'iydin
Sanuriyhim ayatina fiy alafaqi vafiy anfusihim hatta yatabayyana lahum annahu alhaqqu avalam yakfi birabbika annahu 'ala kulli shayin shahiydun
Ala innahum fiy miryatin min liqai rabbihim ala innahu bikulli shayin muhiytun
Hamiym
'aynsiynqaf
Kazalika yuhiy ilayka vaila allaziyna min qablika Allohu al'aziyzu alhakiymu
Lahu ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi vahuva al'aliyyu al'aziymu
Takadu alssamavatu yatafattarna min favqihinna valmalaikatu yusabbihuna bihamdi rabbihim vayastag'firuna liman fiy alardi ala inna Alloha huva alg'afuru alrrahiymu
Vallaziyna ittaxazu min dunihi avliya Allohu hafiyzun 'alayhim vama anta 'alayhim bivakiylin
Vakazalika avhayna ilayka quranan 'arabiyyan litunzira omma alqura vaman havlaha vatunzira yavma aljam'i la rayba fiyhi fariyqun fiy aljannati vafariyqun fiy alssa'iyri
Valav sha Allohu laja'alahum ommatan vahidatan valakin yudxilu man yashao fiy rahmatihi valzzalimuna ma lahum min valiyyin vala nasiyrin
Ami ittaxazu min dunihi avliya faAllohu huva alvaliyyu vahuva yuhyiy almavta vahuva 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun
Vama ixtalaftum fiyhi min shayin fahukmuhu ila Allohi zalikumu Allohu rabbiy 'alayhi tavakkaltu vailayhi oniybu
Fatiru alssamavati valardi ja'ala lakum min anfusikum azvajan vamina alan'ami azvajan yazraokum fiyhi laysa kamizlihi shayon vahuva alssamiy'u albasiyru
Lahu maqaliydu alssamavati valardi yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao vayaqdiru innahu bikulli shayin 'aliymun

Shara'a lakum mina alddiyni ma vassa bihi nuhan vallaziy avhayna ilayka vama vassayna bihi ibrahiyma vamusa va'iysa an aqiymu alddiyna vala tatafarraqu fiyhi kabura 'ala almushrikiyna ma tad'uhum ilayhi Allohu yajtabiy ilayhi man yashao vayahdiy ilayhi man yuniybu

Vama tafarraqu illa min ba'di ma jahumu al'ilmu bag'yan baynahum valavla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika ila ajalin musamman laqudiya baynahum vainna allaziyna urizu alkitaba min ba'dihim lafiy shakkin minhu muriybin

Falizalika faod'u vaistaqim kama omirta vala tattabi' ahvahum vaqul amantu bima anzala Allohu min kitabin vaomirtu lia'dila baynakum Allohu rabbuna varabbukum lana a'maluna valakum a'malukum la hujjata baynana vabaynakumu Allohu yajma'u baynana vailayhi almasiyru
Vallaziyna yuhajjuna fiy Allohi min ba'di ma istujiyba lahu hujjatuhum dahidatun 'inda rabbihim va'alayhim g'adabun valahum 'azabun shadiydun
Allohu allaziy anzala alkitaba bialhaqqi valmiyzani vama yudriyka la'alla alssa'ata qariybun
Yasta'jilu biha allaziyna la yuminuna biha vallaziyna amanu mushfiquna minha vaya'lamuna annaha alhaqqu ala inna allaziyna yumaruna fiy alssa'ati lafiy dalalin ba'iydin
Allohu latiyfun bi'ibadihi yarzuqu man yashao vahuva alqaviyyu al'aziyzu
Man kana yuriydu harsa alaxirati nazid lahu fiy harsihi vaman kana yuriydu harsa alddunya nutihi minha vama lahu fiy alaxirati min nasiybin
Am lahum shurakao shara'u lahum mina alddiyni ma lam yazan bihi Allohu valavla kalimatu alfasli laqudiya baynahum vainna alzzalimiyna lahum 'azabun aliymun

Valkitabi almubiyni

Vaqalu ya ayyuha alsahiru od'u lana rabbaka bima 'ahida 'indaka innana lamuhtaduna
Falamma kashafna 'anhumu al'azaba iza hum yankuzuna
Vanada fir'avnu fiy qavmihi qala ya qavmi alaysa liy mulku misra vahazihi alanharu tajriy min tahtiy afala tubsiruna

Falavla olqiya 'alayhi asviratun min zahabin av ja ma'ahu almalaikatu muqtariniyna
Faistaxaffa qavmahu fata'uhu innahum kanu qavman fasiqiyna
Falamma asafuna intaqamna minhum fag'raqnahum ajma'iyna
Faja'alnahum salafan vamasalan lilaxiriyna
Valamma duriba ibnu maryama mazalan iza qavmuka minhu yasidduna
Vaqalu alihatuna xayrun am huva ma darabuhu laka illa jadalan bal hum qavmun xasimuna
In huva illa 'abdun an'amna 'alayhi vaja'alnahu masalan libaniy israiyla
Valav nashao laja'alna minkum malaikatan fiy alardi yaxlufuna
Vainnahu la'ilmun lilssa'ati fala tamtarunna biha vaittabi'uni haza siratun mustaqiymun
Vala yasuddannakumu alshshaytanu innahu lakum 'aduvvun mubiynun

Faixtalafa alahzabu min baynihim favaylun lillaziyna zalamu min 'azabi yavmin aliymin
Hal yanzuruna illa alssa'ata an tatiyahum bag'tatan vahum la yash'uruna
Alaxillao yavmaizin ba'duhum liba'din 'aduvvun illa almuttaqiyna

Odxulu aljannata antum vazvajukum tuhbaruna
Yutafu 'alayhim bisihafin min zahabin vakvabin vafiyha ma tashtahiyhi alanfusu vatalazzu ala'yunu vantum fiyha xaliduna
Vatilka aljannatu allatiy uristumuha bima kuntum ta'maluna

Am abramu amran fainna mubrimuna

Qul in kana lilrrahmani valadun fana avvalu al'abidiyna
Subhana rabbi alssamavati valardi rabbi al'arshi 'amma yasifuna
Fazarhum yaxudu vayal'abu hatta yulaqu yavmahumu allaziy yu'aduna
Vahuva allaziy fiy alssamai ilahun vafiy alardi ilahun vahuva alhakiymu al'aliymu
Vatabaraka allaziy lahu mulku alssamavati valardi vama baynahuma va'indahu 'ilmu alssa'ati vailayhi turja'una
Vala yamliku allaziyna yad'una min dunihi alshshafa'ata illa man shahida bialhaqqi vahum ya'lamuna
Valain saltahum man xalaqahum layaqulunna Allohu fanna yufakuna

Faisfah 'anhum vaqul salamun fasavfa ya'lamuna

Fadlan min rabbika zalika huva alfavzu al'aziymu

Tanziylu alkitabi mina Allohi al'aziyzi alhakiymi
Inna fiy alssamavati valardi layatin lilmuminiyna
Vafiy xalqikum vama yabussu min dabbatin ayatun liqavmin yuqinuna
Vaixtilafi allayli valnnahari vama anzala Allohu mina alssamai min rizqin fahya bihi alarda ba'da mavtiha vatasriyfi alrriyahi ayatun liqavmin ya'qiluna
Tilka ayatu Allohi natluha 'alayka bialhaqqi fabiayyi hadiysin ba'da Allohi vayatihi yuminuna
Vaylun likulli affakin asiymin
Yasma'u ayati Allohi tutla 'alayhi zumma yusirru mustakbiran kan lam yasma'ha fabashshirhu bi'azabin aliymin
Vaiza 'alima min ayatina shayan ittaxazaha huzuvan olaika lahum 'azabun muhiynun
Min varaihim jahannamu vala yug'niy 'anhum ma kasabu shayan vala ma ittaxazu min duni Allohi avliya valahum 'azabun 'aziymun
Haza hudan vallaziyna kafaru biayati rabbihim lahum 'azabun min rijzin aliymin
Allohu allaziy saxxara lakumu albahra litajriya alfulku fiyhi biamrihi valitabtag'u min fadlihi vala'allakum tashkuruna
Vasaxxara lakum ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi jamiy'an minhu inna fiy zalika layatin liqavmin yatafakkaruna
Qul lillaziyna amanu yag'firu lillaziyna la yarjuna ayyama Allohi liyajziya qavman bima kanu yaksibuna
Man 'amila salihan falinafsihi vaman asa fa'alayha summa ila rabbikum turja'una
Valaqad atayna baniy israiyla alkitaba valhukma valnnubuvvata varazaqnahum mina alttayyibati vafaddalnahum 'ala al'alamiyna
Vataynahum bayyinatin mina alamri fama ixtalafu illa min ba'di ma jahumu al'ilmu bag'yan baynahum inna rabbaka yaqdiy baynahum yavma alqiyamati fiyma kanu fiyhi yaxtalifuna
Zumma ja'alnaka 'ala shariy'atin mina alamri faittabi'ha vala tattabi' ahva allaziyna la ya'lamuna

Haza basairu lilnnasi vahudan varahmatun liqavmin yuqinuna
Am hasiba allaziyna ijtarahu alssayyiati an naj'alahum kallaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati savan mahyahum vamamatuhum sa ma yahkumuna

Inna allaziyna qalu rabbuna Allohu zumma istaqamu fala xavfun 'alayhim vala hum yahzanuna
Olaika ashabu aljannati xalidiyna fiyha jazan bima kanu ya'maluna

Vavassayna alinsana bivalidayhi ihsanan hamalazu ommuhu kurhan vavada'azu kurhan vahamluhu vafisaluhu zalazuna shahran hatta iza balag'a ashuddahu vabalag'a arba'iyna sanatan qala rabbi avzi'niy an ashkura ni'mataka allatiy an'amta 'alayya va'ala validayya van a'mala salihan tardahu vaslih liy fiy zurriyyatiy inniy tubtu ilayka vainniy mina almuslimiyna
Olaika allaziyna nataqabbalu 'anhum ahsana ma 'amilu vanatajavazu 'an sayyiatihim fiy ashabi aljannati va'da alssidqi allaziy kanu yu'aduna

Vallaziy qala livalidayhi offin lakuma ata'idaniniy an oxraja vaqad xalati alqurunu min qabliy vahuma yastag'iyzani Alloha vaylaka amin inna va'da Allohi haqqun fayaqulu ma haza illa asatiyru alavvaliyna
Olaika allaziyna haqqa 'alayhimu alqavlu fiy umamin qad xalat min qablihim mina aljinni valinsi innahum kanu xasiriyna
Valikullin darajatun mimma 'amilu valiyuvaffiyahum a'malahum vahum la yuzlamuna

Vayavma yu'radu allaziyna kafaru 'ala alnnari azhabtum tayyibatikum fiy hayatikumu alddunya vaistamta'tum biha falyavma tujzavna 'azaba alhuni bima kuntum tastakbiruna fiy alardi big'ayri alhaqqi vabima kuntum tafsuquna
Vaozkur axa 'adin iz anzara qavmahu bialahqafi vaqad xalati alnnuzuru min bayni yadayhi vamin xalfihi alla ta'budu illa Alloha inniy axafu 'alaykum 'azaba yavmin 'aziymin
Qalu ajitana litafikana 'an alihatina fatina bima ta'iduna in kunta mina alssadiqiyna
Qala innama al'ilmu 'inda Allohi vaoballig'ukum ma orsiltu bihi valakinniy arakum qavman tajhaluna
Falamma ravhu 'aridan mustaqbila avdiyatihim qalu haza 'aridun mumtiruna bal huva ma ista'jaltum bihi riyhun fiyha 'azabun aliymun
Tudammiru kulla shayin biamri rabbiha fasbahu la yura illa masakinuhum kazalika najziy alqavma almujrimiyna

Valaqad makkannahum fiyma in makkannakum fiyhi vaja'alna lahum sam'an vabsaran vafidatan fama ag'na 'anhum sam'uhum vala absaruhum vala afidatuhum min shayin iz kanu yajhaduna biayati Allohi vahaqa bihim ma kanu bihi yastahziuna
Valaqad ahlakna ma havlakum mina alqura vasarrafna alayati la'llohum yarji'una
Falavla nasarahumu allaziyna ittaxazu min duni Allohi qurbanan alihatan bal dallu 'anhum vazalika ifkuhum vama kanu yaftaruna
Vaiz sarafna ilayka nafaran mina aljinni yastami'una alqurana falamma hadaruhu qalu ansitu falamma qudiya vallav ila qavmihim munziriyna
Qalu ya qavmana inna sami'na kitaban onzila min ba'di musa musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi yahdiy ila alhaqqi vaila tariyqin mustaqiymin
Ya qavmana ajiybu da'iya Allohi vaminu bihi yag'fir lakum min zunubikum vayujirkum min 'azabin aliymin
Vaman la yujib da'iya Allohi falaysa bimu'jizin fiy alardi valaysa lahu min dunihi avliya olaika fiy dalalin mubiynin
Avalam yarav anna Alloha allaziy xalaqa alssamavati valarda valam ya'ya bixalqihinna biqadirin 'ala an yuhyiya almavta bala innahu 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun
Vayavma yu'radu allaziyna kafaru 'ala alnnari alaysa haza bialhaqqi qalu bala varabbina qala fazuqu al'azaba bima kuntum takfuruna
Faisbir kama sabara olu al'azmi mina alrrusuli vala tasta'jil lahum kannahum yavma yaravna ma yu'aduna lam yalbasu illa sa'atan min naharin balag'un fahal yuhlaku illa alqavmu alfasiquna
Allaziyna kafaru vasaddu 'an sabiyli Allohi adalla a'malahum
Vallaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati vamanu bima nuzzila 'ala muhammadin vahuva alhaqqu min rabbihim kaffara 'anhum sayyiatihim vaslaha balahum
Zalika bianna allaziyna kafaru ittaba'u albatila vanna allaziyna amanu ittaba'u alhaqqa min rabbihim kazalika yadribu Allohu lilnnasi amzalahum

Faiza laqiytumu allaziyna kafaru fadarba alrriqabi hatta iza azxantumuhum fashuddu alvazaqa faimma mannan ba'du vaimma fidan hatta tada'a alharbu avzaraha zalika valav yashao Allohu laintasara minhum valakin liyabluva ba'dakum biba'din vallaziyna qutilu fiy sabiyli Allohi falan yudilla a'malahum
Sayahdiyhim vayuslihu balahum
Vayudxiluhumu aljannata 'arrafaha lahum
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu in tansuru Alloha yansurkum vayuzabbit aqdamakum
Vallaziyna kafaru fata'san lahum vadalla a'malahum
Zalika biannahum karihu ma anzala Allohu fahbata a'malahum
Afalam yasiyru fiy alardi fayanzuru kayfa kana 'aqibatu allaziyna min qablihim dammara Allohu 'alayhim valilkafiriyna amzaluha
Zalika bianna Alloha mavla allaziyna amanu vanna alkafiriyna la mavla lahum
Inna Alloha yudxilu allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu vallaziyna kafaru yatamatta'una vayakuluna kama takulu alan'amu valnnaru mazvan lahum
Vakayyin min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quvvatan min qaryatika allatiy axrajatka ahlaknahum fala nasira lahum
Afaman kana 'ala bayyinatin min rabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu suo 'amalihi vaittaba'u ahvahum

Mazalu aljannati allatiy vu'ida almuttaquna fiyha anharun min main g'ayri asinin vanharun min labanin lam yatag'ayyar ta'muhu vanharun min xamrin lazzatin lilshsharibiyna vanharun min 'asalin musaffan valahum fiyha min kulli alzzamarati vamag'firatun min rabbihim kaman huva xalidun fiy alnnari vasuqu man hamiyman faqatta'a am'ahum
Vaminhum man yastami'u ilayka hatta iza xaraju min 'indika qalu lillaziyna utu al'ilma maza qala anifan olaika allaziyna taba'a Allohu 'ala qulubihim vaittaba'u ahvahum
Vallaziyna ihtadav zadahum hudan vatahum taqvahum
Fahal yanzuruna illa alssa'ata an tatiyahum bag'tatan faqad ja ashratuha fanna lahum iza jazum zikrahum
Fai'lam annahu la ilaha illa Allohu vaistag'fir lizanbika valilmuminiyna valmuminati vaAllohu ya'lamu mutaqallabakum vamazvakum

Vayaqulu allaziyna amanu lavla nuzzilat suratun faiza onzilat suratun muhkamatun vazukira fiyha alqitalu rayta allaziyna fiy qulubihim maradun yanzuruna ilayka nazara almag'shiyyi 'alayhi mina almavti favla lahum
Ta'atun vaqavlun ma'rufun faiza 'azama alamru falav sadaqu Alloha lakana xayran lahum
Fahal 'asaytum in tavallaytum an tufsidu fiy alardi vatuqatti'u arhamakum
Olaika allaziyna la'anahumu Allohu fasammahum va'ma absarahum
Afala yatadabbaruna alqurana am 'ala qulubin aqfaluha
Inna allaziyna irtaddu 'ala adbarihim min ba'di ma tabayyana lahumu alhuda alshshaytanu savvala lahum vamla lahum
Zalika biannahum qalu lillaziyna karihu ma nazzala Allohu sanutiy'ukum fiy ba'di alamri vaAllohu ya'lamu israrahum
Fakayfa iza tavaffazumu almalaikatu yadribuna vujuhahum vadbarahum
Zalika biannahumu ittaba'u ma asxata Alloha vakarihu ridvanahu fahbata a'malahum
Am hasiba allaziyna fiy qulubihim maradun an lan yuxrija Allohu adg'anahum
Valav nashao laraynakahum fala'araftahum bisiymahum valata'rifannahum fiy lahni alqavli vaAllohu ya'lamu a'malakum
Valanabluvannakum hatta na'lama almujahidiyna minkum valssabiriyna vanabluva axbarakum
Inna allaziyna kafaru vasaddu 'an sabiyli Allohi vashaqqu alrrasula min ba'di ma tabayyana lahumu alhuda lan yaduru Alloha shayan vasayuhbitu a'malahum
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu atiy'u Alloha vatiy'u alrrasula vala tubtilu a'malakum
Inna allaziyna kafaru vasaddu 'an sabiyli Allohi zumma matu vahum kuffarun falan yag'fira Allohu lahum
Fala tahinu vatad'u ila alssalmi vantumu ala'lavna vaAllohu ma'akum valan yatirakum a'malakum
Innama alhayatu alddunya la'ibun valahvun vain tuminu vatattaqu yutikum ojurakum vala yasalkum amvalakum
In yasalkumuha fayuhfikum tabxalu vayuxrij adg'anakum

Hantum haolai tud'avna litunfiqu fiy sabiyli Allohi faminkum man yabxalu vaman yabxal fainnama yabxalu 'an nafsihi vaAllohu alg'aniyyu vantumu alfuqarao vain tatavallav yastabdil qavman g'ayrakum summa la yakunu amsalakum
Inna fatahna laka fazan mubiynan
Liyag'fira laka Allohu ma taqaddama min zanbika vama taxxara vayutimma ni'matahu 'alayka vayahdiyaka siratan mustaqiyman
Vayansuraka Allohu nasran 'aziyzan
Huva allaziy anzala alssakiynata fiy qulubi almuminiyna liyazdadu iymanan ma'a iymanihim valillahi junudu alssamavati valardi vakana Allohu 'aliyman hakiyman
Liyudxila almuminiyna valmuminati jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu xalidiyna fiyha vayukaffira 'anhum sayyiatihim vakana zalika 'inda Allohi favzan 'aziyman

Vayu'azziba almunafiqiyna valmunafiqati valmushrikiyna valmushrikati alzzanniyna biAllohi zanna alssavi 'alayhim dairatu alssavi vag'adiba Allohu 'alayhim vala'anahum va'adda lahum jahannama vasat masiyran
Valillahi junudu alssamavati valardi vakana Allohu 'aziyzan hakiyman
Inna arsalnaka shahidan vamubashshiran vanaziyran
Lituminu biAllohi varasulihi vatu'azziruhu vatuvaqqiruhu vatusabbihuhu bukratan vasiylan
Inna allaziyna yubayi'unaka innama yubayi'una Alloha yadu Allohi favqa aydiyhim faman nakaza fainnama yankuzu 'ala nafsihi vaman avfa bima 'ahada 'alayhu Alloha fasayutiyhi ajran 'aziyman

Sayaqulu laka almuxallafuna mina ala'rabi shag'alatna amvaluna vahluna faistag'fir lana yaquluna bialsinatihim ma laysa fiy qulubihim qul faman yamliku lakum mina Allohi shayan in arada bikum darran av arada bikum naf'an bal kana Allohu bima ta'maluna xabiyran
Bal zanantum an lan yanqaliba alrrasulu valmuminuna ila ahliyhim abadan vazuyyina zalika fiy qulubikum vazanantum zanna alssavi vakuntum qavman buran
Vaman lam yumin biAllohi varasulihi fainna a'tadna lilkafiriyna sa'iyran
Valillahi mulku alssamavati valardi yag'firu liman yashao vayu'azzibu man yashao vakana Allohu g'afuran rahiyman

Sayaqulu almuxallafuna iza intalaqtum ila mag'anima litaxuzuha zaruna nattabi'kum yuriyduna an yubaddilu kalama Allohi qul lan tattabi'una kazalikum qala Allohu min qablu fasayaquluna bal tahsudunana bal kanu la yafqahuna illa qaliylan

Qul lilmuxallafiyna mina ala'rabi satud'avna ila qavmin oliy basin shadiydin tuqatilunahum av yuslimuna fain tutiy'u yutikumu Allohu ajran hasanan vain tatavallav kama tavallaytum min qablu yu'azzibkum 'azaban aliyman

Laysa 'ala ala'ma harajun vala 'ala ala'raji harajun vala 'ala almariydi harajun vaman yuti'i Alloha varasulahu yudxilhu jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu vaman yatavalla yu'azzibhu 'azaban aliyman
Laqad radiya Allohu 'ani almuminiyna iz yubayi'unaka tahta alshshajarati fa'alima ma fiy qulubihim fanzala alsakiynata 'alayhim vazabahum fazan qariyban
Vamag'anima kaziyratan yaxuzunaha vakana Allohu 'aziyzan hakiyman
Va'adakumu Allohu mag'anima kaziyratan taxuzunaha fa'ajjala lakum hazihi vakaffa aydiya alnnasi 'ankum valitakuna ayatan lilmuminiyna vayahdiyakum siratan mustaqiyman
Vaoxra lam taqdiru 'alayha qad ahata Allohu biha vakana Allohu 'ala kulli shayin qadiyran
Valav qatalakumu allaziyna kafaru lavallavu aladbara zumma la yajiduna valiyyan vala nasiyran
Sunnata Allohi allatiy qad xalat min qablu valan tajida lisunnati Allohi tabdiylan
Vahuva allaziy kaffa aydiyahum 'ankum vaydiyakum 'anhum bibatni makkata min ba'di an azfarakum 'alayhim vakana Allohu bima ta'maluna basiyran

Humu allaziyna kafaru vasaddukum 'ani almasjidi alharami valhadya ma'kufan an yablug'a mahillahu valavla rijalun muminuna vanisaon muminatun lam ta'lamuhum an tatauhum fatusiybakum minhum ma'arratun big'ayri 'ilmin liyudxila Allohu fiy rahmatihi man yashao lav tazayyalu la'azzabna allaziyna kafaru minhum 'azaban aliyman

Iz ja'ala allaziyna kafaru fiy qulubihimu alhamiyyata hamiyyata aljahiliyyati fanzala Allohu sakiynatahu 'ala rasulihi va'ala almuminiyna valzamahum kalimata alttaqva vakanu ahaqqa biha vahlaha vakana Allohu bikulli shayin 'aliyman

Laqad sadaqa Allohu rasulahu alrruya bialhaqqi latadxulunna almasjida alharama in sha Allohu aminiyna muhalliqiyna ruusakum vamuqassiriyna la taxafuna fa'alima ma lam ta'lamu faja'ala min duni zalika fazan qariyban
Huva allaziy arsala rasulahu bialhuda vadiyni alhaqqi liyuzhirahu 'ala alddiyni kullihi vakafa biAllohi shahiydan

Muhammadun rasulu Allohi vallaziyna ma'ahu ashiddao 'ala alkuffari ruhamao baynahum tarahum rukka'an sujjadan yabtag'una fadlan mina Allohi varidvanan siymahum fiy vujuhihim min azari alssujudi zalika mazaluhum fiy alttavrati vamazaluhum fiy alinjiyli kazar'in axraja shatahu fazarahu faistag'laza faistava 'ala suqihi yu'jibu alzzurra'a liyag'iyza bihimu alkuffara va'ada Allohu allaziyna amanu va'amilu alssalihati minhum mag'firatan vajran 'aziyman
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la tuqaddimu bayna yadayi Allohi varasulihi vaittaqu Alloha inna Alloha samiy'un 'aliymun
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la tarfa'u asvatakum favqa savti alnnabiyyi vala tajharu lahu bialqavli kajahri ba'dikum liba'din an tahbata a'malukum vantum la tash'uruna
Inna allaziyna yag'udduna asvatahum 'inda rasuli Allohi olaika allaziyna imtahana Allohu qulubahum lilttaqva lahum mag'firatun vajrun 'aziymun
Inna allaziyna yunadunaka min varai alhujurati akzaruhum la ya'qiluna
Valav annahum sabaru hatta taxruja ilayhim lakana xayran lahum vaAllohu g'afurun rahiymun
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu in jakum fasiqun binabain fatabayyanu an tusiybu qavman bijahalatin fatusbihu 'ala ma fa'altum nadimiyna

Vai'lamu anna fiykum rasula Allohi lav yutiy'ukum fiy kasiyrin mina alamri la'anittum valakinna Alloha habbaba ilaykumu aliymana vazayyanahu fiy qulubikum vakarraha ilaykumu alkufra valfusuqa val'isyana olaika humu alrrashiduna
Fadlan mina Allohi vani'matan vaAllohu 'aliymun hakiymun

Vain taifatani mina almuminiyna iqtatalu faslihu baynahuma fain bag'at ihdahuma 'ala aloxra faqatilu allatiy tabg'iy hatta tafiya ila amri Allohi fain fat faslihu baynahuma bial'adli vaqsitu inna Alloha yuhibbu almuqsitiyna
Innama almuminuna ixvatun faslihu bayna axavaykum vaittaqu Alloha la'allakum turhamuna

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la yasxar qavmun min qavmin 'asa an yakunu xayran minhum vala nisaon min nisain 'asa an yakunna xayran minhunna vala talmizu anfusakum vala tanabazu bialalqabi bisa alismu alfusuqu ba'da aliymani vaman lam yatub faolaika humu alzzalimuna

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu ijtanibu kaziyran mina alzzanni inna ba'da alzzanni izmun vala tajassasu vala yag'tab ba'dukum ba'dan ayuhibbu ahadukum an yakula lahma axiyhi maytan fakarihtumuhu vaittaqu Alloha inna Alloha tavvabun rahiymun
Ya ayyuha alnnasu inna xalaqnakum min zakarin vaonza vaja'alnakum shu'uban vaqabaila lita'arafu inna akramakum 'inda Allohi atqakum inna Alloha 'aliymun xabiyrun
Qalati ala'rabu amanna qul lam tuminu valakin qulu aslamna valamma yadxuli aliymanu fiy qulubikum vain tutiy'u Alloha varasulahu la yalitkum min a'malikum shayan inna Alloha g'afurun rahiymun
Innama almuminuna allaziyna amanu biAllohi varasulihi zumma lam yartabu vajahadu biamvalihim vanfusihim fiy sabiyli Allohi olaika humu alssadiquna
Qul atu'allimuna Alloha bidiynikum vaAllohu ya'lamu ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi vaAllohu bikulli shayin 'aliymun
Yamunnuna 'alayka an aslamu qul la tamunnu 'alayya islamakum bali Allohu yamunnu 'alaykum an hadakum liliymani in kuntum sadiqiyna
Inna Alloha ya'lamu g'ayba alssamavati valardi vaAllohu basiyrun bima ta'maluna
Qaf valqurani almajiydi
Bal 'ajibu an jahum munzirun minhum faqala alkafiruna haza shayon 'ajiybun
Aiza mitna vakunna turaban zalika raj'un ba'iydun
Qad 'alimna ma tanqusu alardu minhum va'indana kitabun hafiyzun
Bal kazzabu bialhaqqi lamma jahum fahum fiy amrin mariyjin
Afalam yanzuru ila alssamai favqahum kayfa banaynaha vazayyannaha vama laha min furujin
Valarda madadnaha valqayna fiyha ravasiya vanbatna fiyha min kulli zavjin bahiyjin
Tabsiratan vazikra likulli 'abdin muniybin
Vanazzalna mina alssamai man mubarakan fanbatna bihi jannatin vahabba alhasiydi
Valnnaxla basiqatin laha tal'un nadiydun
Rizqan lil'ibadi vahyayna bihi baldatan maytan kazalika alxuruju
Kazzabat qablahum qavmu nuhin vashabu alrrassi vazamudu
Va'adun vafir'avnu vaixvanu lutin
Vashabu alaykati vaqavmu tubba'in kullun kazzaba alrrusula fahaqqa va'iydi
Afa'ayiyna bialxalqi alavvali bal hum fiy labsin min xalqin jadiydin
Valaqad xalaqna alinsana vana'lamu ma tuvasvisu bihi nafsuhu vanahnu aqrabu ilayhi min habli alvariydi
Iz yatalaqqa almutalaqqiyani 'ani alyamiyni va'ani alshshimali qa'iydun
Ma yalfizu min qavlin illa ladayhi raqiybun 'atiydun
Vajat sakratu almavti bialhaqqi zalika ma kunta minhu tahiydu
Vanufixa fiy alssuri zalika yavmu alva'iydi
Vajat kullu nafsin ma'aha saiqun vashahiydun
Laqad kunta fiy g'aflatin min haza fakashafna 'anka g'itaka fabasaruka alyavma hadiydun
Vaqala qariynuhu haza ma ladayya 'atiydun
Alqiya fiy jahannama kulla kaffarin 'aniydin
Manna'in lilxayri mu'tadin muriybin
Allaziy ja'ala ma'a Allohi ilahan axara falqiyahu fiy al'azabi alshshadiydi
Qala qariynuhu rabbana ma atg'aytuhu valakin kana fiy dalalin ba'iydin
Qala la taxtasimu ladayya vaqad qaddamtu ilaykum bialva'iydi
Ma yubaddalu alqavlu ladayya vama ana bizallamin lil'abiydi
Yavma naqulu lijahannama hali imtalati vataqulu hal min maziydin
Vaozlifati aljannatu lilmuttaqiyna g'ayra ba'iydin
Haza ma tu'aduna likulli avvabin hafiyzin
Man xashiya alrrahmana bialg'aybi vaja biqalbin muniybin
Odxuluha bisalamin zalika yavmu alxuludi
Lahum ma yashauna fiyha valadayna maziydun
Vakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqabu fiy albiladi hal min mahiysin
Inna fiy zalika lazikra liman kana lahu qalbun av alqa alssam'a vahuva shahiydun
Valaqad xalaqna alssamavati valarda vama baynahuma fiy sittati ayyamin vama massana min lug'ubin
Faisbir 'ala ma yaquluna vasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulu'i alshshamsi vaqabla alg'urubi
Vamina allayli fasabbihhu vadbara alssujudi
Vaistami' yavma yunadi almunadi min makanin qariybin
Yavma yasma'una alssayhata bialhaqqi zalika yavmu alxuruji
Inna nahnu nuhyiy vanumiytu vailayna almasiyru
Yavma tashaqqaqu alardu 'anhum sira'an zalika hashrun 'alayna yasiyrun
Nahnu a'lamu bima yaquluna vama anta 'alayhim bijabbarin fazakkir bialqurani man yaxafu va'iydi

Valssamai zati alhubuki
Innakum lafiy qavlin muxtalifin
Yufaku 'anhu man ofika
Qutila alxarrasuna
Allaziyna hum fiy g'amratin sahuna
Yasaluna ayyana yavmu alddiyni
Yavma hum 'ala alnnari yuftanuna
Zuqu fitnatakum haza allaziy kuntum bihi tasta'jiluna
Inna almuttaqiyna fiy jannatin va'uyunin
Axiziyna ma atahum rabbuhum innahum kanu qabla zalika muhsiniyna
Kanu qaliylan mina allayli ma yahja'una
Vabialashari hum yastag'firuna
Vafiy amvalihim haqqun lilssaili valmahrumi
Vafiy alardi ayatun lilmuqiniyna
Vafiy anfusikum afala tubsiruna
Vafiy alssamai rizqukum vama tu'aduna
Favarabbi alssamai valardi innahu lahaqqun misla ma annakum tantiquna
Hal ataka hadiysu dayfi ibrahiyma almukramiyna
Iz daxalu 'alayhi faqalu salaman qala salamun qavmun munkaruna
Farag'a ila ahlihi faja bi'ijlin samiynin
Faqarrabahu ilayhim qala ala takuluna
Favjasa minhum xiyfatan qalu la taxaf vabashsharuhu big'ulamin 'aliymin
Faqbalati imratuhu fiy sarratin fasakkat vajhaha vaqalat 'ajuzun 'aqiymun
Qalu kazaliki qala rabbuki innahu huva alhakiymu al'aliymu
Qala fama xatbukum ayyuha almursaluna

I'lamu annama alhayatu alddunya la'ibun valahvun vaziynatun vatafaxurun baynakum vatakazurun fiy alamvali valavladi kamazali g'ayzin a'jaba alkuffara nabatuhu zumma yahiyju fatarahu musfarran zumma yakunu hutaman vafiy alaxirati 'azabun shadiydun vamag'firatun mina Allohi varidvanun vama alhayatu alddunya illa mata'u alg'ururi
Sabiqu ila mag'firatin min rabbikum vajannatin 'arduha ka'ardi alssamai valardi o'iddat lillaziyna amanu biAllohi varusulihi zalika fadlu Allohi yutiyhi man yashao vaAllohu zu alfadli al'aziymi
Ma asaba min musiybatin fiy alardi vala fiy anfusikum illa fiy kitabin min qabli an nabraha inna zalika 'ala Allohi yasiyrun
Likayla tasav 'ala ma fatakum vala tafrahu bima atakum vaAllohu la yuhibbu kulla muxtalin faxurin
Allaziyna yabxaluna vayamuruna alnnasa bialbuxli vaman yatavalla fainna Alloha huva alg'aniyyu alhamiydu

Laqad arsalna rusulana bialbayyinati vanzalna ma'ahumu alkitaba valmiyzana liyaquma alnnasu bialqisti vanzalna alhadiyda fiyhi basun shadiydun vamanafi'u lilnnasi valiya'lama Allohu man yansuruhu varusulahu bialg'aybi inna Alloha qaviyyun 'aziyzun
Valaqad arsalna nuhan vaibrahiyma vaja'alna fiy zurriyyatihima alnnubuvvata valkitaba faminhum muhtadin vakaziyrun minhum fasiquna

Zumma qaffayna 'ala azarihim birusulina vaqaffayna bi'iysa ibni maryama vataynahu alinjiyla vaja'alna fiy qulubi allaziyna ittaba'uhu rafatan varahmatan varahbaniyyatan ibtada'uha ma katabnaha 'alayhim illa ibtig'a ridvani Allohi fama ra'avha haqqa ri'ayatiha fatayna allaziyna amanu minhum ajrahum vakaziyrun minhum fasiquna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu ittaqu Alloha vaminu birasulihi yutikum kiflayni min rahmatihi vayaj'al lakum nuran tamshuna bihi vayag'fir lakum vaAllohu g'afurun rahiymun
Lialla ya'lama ahlu alkitabi alla yaqdiruna 'ala shayin min fadli Allohi vanna alfadla biyadi Allohi yutiyhi man yashao vaAllohu zu alfadli al'aziymi
Qad sami'a Allohu qavla allatiy tujadiluka fiy zavjiha vatashtakiy ila Allohi vaAllohu yasma'u tahavurakuma inna Alloha samiy'un basiyrun
Allaziyna yuzahiruna minkum min nisaihim ma hunna ommahatihim in ommahatuhum illa allaiy valadnahum vainnahum layaquluna munkaran mina alqavli vazuran vainna Alloha la'afuvvun g'afurun
Vallaziyna yuzahiruna min nisaihim zumma ya'uduna lima qalu fatahriyru raqabatin min qabli an yatamassa zalikum tu'azuna bihi vaAllohu bima ta'maluna xabiyrun

Faman lam yajid fasiyamu shahrayni mutatabi'ayni min qabli an yatamassa faman lam yastati' fait'amu sittiyna miskiynan zalika lituminu biAllohi varasulihi vatilka hududu Allohi valilkafiriyna 'azabun aliymun
Inna allaziyna yuhadduna Alloha varasulahu kubitu kama kubita allaziyna min qablihim vaqad anzalna ayatin bayyinatin valilkafiriyna 'azabun muhiynun
Yavma yab'asuhumu Allohu jamiy'an fayunabbiohum bima 'amilu ahsahu Allohu vanasuhu vaAllohu 'ala kulli shayin shahiydun

Alam tara anna Alloha ya'lamu ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi ma yakunu min najva zalazatin illa huva rabi'uhum vala xamsatin illa huva sadisuhum vala adna min zalika vala akzara illa huva ma'ahum ayna ma kanu zumma yunabbiohum bima 'amilu yavma alqiyamati inna Alloha bikulli shayin 'aliymun

Alam tara ila allaziyna nuhu 'ani alnnajva zumma ya'uduna lima nuhu 'anhu vayatanajavna bializmi val'udvani vama'siyati alrrasuli vaiza jauka hayyavka bima lam yuhayyika bihi Allohu vayaquluna fiy anfusihim lavla yu'azzibuna Allohu bima naqulu hasbuhum jahannamu yaslavnaha fabisa almasiyru
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu iza tanajaytum fala tatanajav bializmi val'udvani vama'siyati alrrasuli vatanajav bialbirri valttaqva vaittaqu Alloha allaziy ilayhi tuhsharuna
Innama alnnajva mina alshshaytani liyahzuna allaziyna amanu valaysa bidarrihim shayan illa biizni Allohi va'ala Allohi falyatavakkali almuminuna

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu iza qiyla lakum tafassahu fiy almajalisi faifsahu yafsahi Allohu lakum vaiza qiyla onshuzu faonshuzu yarfa'i Allohu allaziyna amanu minkum vallaziyna utu al'ilma darajatin vaAllohu bima ta'maluna xabiyrun
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu iza najaytumu alrrasula faqaddimu bayna yaday najvakum sadaqatan zalika xayrun lakum vazaru fain lam tajidu fainna Alloha g'afurun rahiymun
'shfaqtum an tuqaddimu bayna yaday najvakum sadaqatin faiz lam taf'alu vataba Allohu 'alaykum faqiymu alssalata vatu alzzakata vatiy'u Alloha varasulahu vaAllohu xabiyrun bima ta'maluna
Alam tara ila allaziyna tavallav qavman g'adiba Allohu 'alayhim ma hum minkum vala minhum vayahlifuna 'ala alkazibi vahum ya'lamuna
A'adda Allohu lahum 'azaban shadiydan innahum sa ma kanu ya'maluna
Ittaxazu aymanahum junnatan fasaddu 'an sabiyli Allohi falahum 'azabun muhiynun
Lan tug'niya 'anhum amvaluhum vala avladuhum mina Allohi shayan olaika ashabu alnnari hum fiyha xaliduna
Yavma yab'azuhumu Allohu jamiy'an fayahlifuna lahu kama yahlifuna lakum vayahsabuna annahum 'ala shayin ala innahum humu alkazibuna
Istahvaza 'alayhimu alshshaytanu fansahum zikra Allohi olaika hizbu alshshaytani ala inna hizba alshshaytani humu alxasiruna
Inna allaziyna yuhadduna Alloha varasulahu olaika fiy alazalliyna
Kataba Allohu lag'libanna ana varusuliy inna Alloha qaviyyun 'aziyzun

La tajidu qavman yuminuna biAllohi valyavmi alaxiri yuvadduna man hadda Alloha varasulahu valav kanu abahum av abnahum av ixvanahum av 'ashiyratahum olaika kataba fiy qulubihimu aliymana vayyadahum biruhin minhu vayudxiluhum jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu xalidiyna fiyha radiya Allohu 'anhum varadu 'anhu olaika hizbu Allohi ala inna hizba Allohi humu almuflihuna
Sabbaha lillahi ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi vahuva al'aziyzu alhakiymu

Huva allaziy axraja allaziyna kafaru min ahli alkitabi min diyarihim liavvali alhashri ma zanantum an yaxruju vazannu annahum mani'atuhum husunuhum mina Allohi fatahumu Allohu min hayzu lam yahtasibu vaqazafa fiy qulubihimu alrru'ba yuxribuna buyutahum biaydiyhim vaydiy almuminiyna fai'tabiru ya oliy alabsari
Valavla an kataba Allohu 'alayhimu aljala la'azzabahum fiy alddunya valahum fiy alaxirati 'azabu alnnari
Zalika biannahum shaqqu Alloha varasulahu vaman yushaqqi Alloha fainna Alloha shadiydu al'iqabi
Ma qata'tum min liynatin av taraktumuha qaimatan 'ala osuliha fabiizni Allohi valiyuxziya alfasiqiyna
Vama afa Allohu 'ala rasulihi minhum fama avjaftum 'alayhi min xaylin vala rikabin valakinna Alloha yusallitu rusulahu 'ala man yashao vaAllohu 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun

Ma afa Allohu 'ala rasulihi min ahli alqura falillahi valilrrasuli valiziy alqurba valyatama valmasakiyni vaibni alssabiyli kay la yakuna dulatan bayna alag'niyai minkum vama atakumu alrrasulu faxuzuhu vama nahakum 'anhu faintahu vaittaqu Alloha inna Alloha shadiydu al'iqabi
Lilfuqarai almuhajiriyna allaziyna oxriju min diyarihim vamvalihim yabtag'una fadlan mina Allohi varidvanan vayansuruna Alloha varasulahu olaika humu alssadiquna

Vallaziyna tabavvau alddara valiymana min qablihim yuhibbuna man hajara ilayhim vala yajiduna fiy sudurihim hajatan mimma utu vayuziruna 'ala anfusihim valav kana bihim xasasatun vaman yuqa shuhha nafsihi faolaika humu almuflihuna
Vallaziyna jau min ba'dihim yaquluna rabbana ig'fir lana valiixvanina allaziyna sabaquna bialiymani vala taj'al fiy qulubina g'illan lillaziyna amanu rabbana innaka raufun rahiymun

Alam tara ila allaziyna nafaqu yaquluna liixvanihimu allaziyna kafaru min ahli alkitabi lain oxrijtum lanaxrujanna ma'akum vala nutiy'u fiykum ahadan abadan vain qutiltum lanansurannakum vaAllohu yashhadu innahum lakazibuna
Lain oxriju la yaxrujuna ma'ahum valain qutilu la yansurunahum valain nasaruhum layuvallunna aladbara summa la yunsaruna
Lantum ashaddu rahbatan fiy sudurihim mina Allohi zalika biannahum qavmun la yafqahuna
La yuqatilunakum jamiy'an illa fiy quran muhassanatin av min varai judurin basuhum baynahum shadiydun tahsabuhum jamiy'an vaqulubuhum shatta zalika biannahum qavmun la ya'qiluna
Kamazali allaziyna min qablihim qariyban zaqu vabala amrihim valahum 'azabun aliymun
Kamazali alshshaytani iz qala lilinsani okfur falamma kafara qala inniy bariyon minka inniy axafu Alloha rabba al'alamiyna
Fakana 'aqibatahuma annahuma fiy alnnari xalidayni fiyha vazalika jazao alzzalimiyna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu ittaqu Alloha valtanzur nafsun ma qaddamat lig'adin vaittaqu Alloha inna Alloha xabiyrun bima ta'maluna
Vala takunu kallaziyna nasu Alloha fansahum anfusahum olaika humu alfasiquna
La yastaviy ashabu alnnari vashabu aljannati ashabu aljannati humu alfaizuna
Lav anzalna haza alqurana 'ala jabalin laraytahu xashi'an mutasaddi'an min xashyati Allohi vatilka alamzalu nadribuha lilnnasi la'llohum yatafakkaruna
Huva Allohu allaziy la ilaha illa huva 'alimu alg'aybi valshshahadati huva alrrahmanu alrrahiymu
Huva Allohu allaziy la ilaha illa huva almaliku alquddusu alssalamu almuminu almuhayminu al'aziyzu aljabbaru almutakabbiru subhana Allohi 'amma yushrikuna
Huva Allohu alxaliqu albario almusavviru lahu alasmao alhusna yusabbihu lahu ma fiy alssamavati valardi vahuva al'aziyzu alhakiymu

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la tattaxizu 'aduvviy va'aduvvakum avliya tulquna ilayhim bialmavaddati vaqad kafaru bima jakum mina alhaqqi yuxrijuna alrrasula vaiyyakum an tuminu biAllohi rabbikum in kuntum xarajtum jihadan fiy sabiyliy vaibtig'a mardatiy tusirruna ilayhim bialmavaddati vana a'lamu bima axfaytum vama a'lantum vaman yaf'alhu minkum faqad dalla sava alssabiyli
In yasqafukum yakunu lakam a'dan vayabsutu ilaykum aydiyahum valsinatahum bialssui vavaddu lav takfuruna
Lan tanfa'akum arhamukum vala avladukum yavma alqiyamati yafsilu baynakum vaAllohu bima ta'maluna basiyrun

Qad kanat lakum osvatun hasanatun fiy ibrahiyma vallaziyna ma'ahu iz qalu liqavmihim inna burao minkum vamimma ta'buduna min duni Allohi kafarna bikum vabada baynana vabaynakumu al'adavatu valbag'dao abadan hatta tuminu biAllohi vahdahu illa qavla ibrahiyma liabiyhi lastag'firanna laka vama amliku laka mina Allohi min shayin rabbana 'alayka tavakkalna vailayka anabna vailayka almasiyru
Rabbana la taj'alna fitnatan lillaziyna kafaru vaig'fir lana rabbana innaka anta al'aziyzu alhakiymu
Laqad kana lakum fiyhim osvatun hasanatun liman kana yarju Alloha valyavma alaxira vaman yatavalla fainna Alloha huva alg'anniyyu alhamiydu
'asa Allohu an yaj'ala baynakum vabayna allaziyna 'adaytum minhum mavaddatan vaAllohu qadiyrun vaAllohu g'afurun rahiymun
La yanhakumu Allohu 'ani allaziyna lam yuqatilukum fiy alddiyni valam yuxrijukum min diyarikum an tabarruhum vatuqsitu ilayhim inna Alloha yuhibbu almuqsitiyna
Innama yanhakumu Allohu 'ani allaziyna qatalukum fiy alddiyni vaxrajukum min diyarikum vazaharu 'ala ixrajikum an tavallavhum vaman yatavllohum faolaika humu alzzalimuna

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu iza jakumu almuminatu muhajiratin faimtahinuhunna Allohu a'lamu biiymanihinna fain 'alimtumuhunna muminatin fala tarji'uhunna ila alkuffari la hunna hillun lahum vala hum yahilluna lahunna vatuhum ma anfaqu vala junaha 'alaykum an tankihuhunna iza ataytumuhunna ojurahunna vala tumsiku bi'isami alkavafiri vaisalu ma anfaqtum valyasalu ma anfaqu zalikum hukmu Allohi yahkumu baynakum vaAllohu 'aliymun hakiymun
Vain fatakum shayon min azvajikum ila alkuffari fa'aqabtum fatu allaziyna zahabat azvajuhum mizla ma anfaqu vaittaqu Alloha allaziy antum bihi muminuna

Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu iza jaka almuminatu yubayi'naka 'ala an la yushrikna biAllohi shayan vala yasriqna vala yazniyna vala yaqtulna avladahunna vala yatiyna bibuhtanin yaftariynahu bayna aydiyhinna varjulihinna vala ya'siynaka fiy ma'rufin fabayi'hunna vaistag'fir lahunna Alloha inna Alloha g'afurun rahiymun
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la tatavallav qavman g'adiba Allohu 'alayhim qad yaisu mina alaxirati kama yaisa alkuffaru min ashabi alquburi
Sabbaha lillahi ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi vahuva al'aziyzu alhakiymu
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu lima taquluna ma la taf'aluna
Kabura maqtan 'inda Allohi an taqulu ma la taf'aluna
Inna Alloha yuhibbu allaziyna yuqatiluna fiy sabiylihi saffan kannahum bunyanun marsusun
Vaiz qala musa liqavmihi ya qavmi lima tuzunaniy vaqad ta'lamuna anniy rasulu Allohi ilaykum falamma zag'u azag'a Allohu qulubahum vaAllohu la yahdiy alqavma alfasiqiyna

Vaiz qala 'iysa ibnu maryama ya baniy israiyla inniy rasulu Allohi ilaykum musaddiqan lima bayna yadayya mina alttavrati vamubashshiran birasulin yatiy min ba'diy ismuhu ahmadu falamma jahum bialbayyinati qalu haza sihrun mubiynun
Vaman azlamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allohi alkaziba vahuva yud'a ila alislami vaAllohu la yahdiy alqavma alzzalimiyna
Yuriyduna liyutfiu nura Allohi biafvahihim vaAllohu mutimmu nurihi valav kariha alkafiruna
Huva allaziy arsala rasulahu bialhuda vadiyni alhaqqi liyuzhirahu 'ala alddiyni kullihi valav kariha almushrikuna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu hal adullukum 'ala tijaratin tunjiykum min 'azabin aliymin
Tuminuna biAllohi varasulihi vatujahiduna fiy sabiyli Allohi biamvalikum vanfusikum zalikum xayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamuna
Yag'fir lakum zunubakum vayudxilkum jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu vamasakina tayyibatan fiy jannati 'adnin zalika alfavzu al'aziymu
Vaoxra tuhibbunaha nasrun mina Allohi vafazun qarriybun vabashshiri almuminiyna

Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu kunu ansara Allohi kama qala 'iysa ibnu maryama lilhavariyyiyna man ansariy ila Allohi qala alhavariyyuna nahnu ansaru Allohi famanat taifatun min baniy israiyla vakafarat taifatun fayyadna allaziyna amanu 'ala 'aduvvihim fasbahu zahiriyna
Yusabbihu lillahi ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi almaliki alquddusi al'aziyzi alhakiymi
Huva allaziy ba'aza fiy alommiyyiyna rasulan minhum yatlu 'alayhim ayatihi vayuzakkiyhim vayu'allimuhumu alkitaba valhikmata vain kanu min qablu lafiy dalalin mubiynin
Vaxariyna minhum lamma yalhaqu bihim vahuva al'aziyzu alhakiymu
Zalika fadlu Allohi yutiyhi man yashao vaAllohu zu alfadli al'aziymi
Mazalu allaziyna hummilu alttavrata zumma lam yahmiluha kamazali alhimari yahmilu asfaran bisa mazalu alqavmi allaziyna kazzabu biayati Allohi vaAllohu la yahdiy alqavma alzzalimiyna
Qul ya ayyuha allaziyna hadu in za'amtum annakum avliyao lillahi min duni alnnasi fatamannavu almavta in kuntum sadiqiyna
Vala yatamannavnahu abadan bima qaddamat aydiyhim vaAllohu 'aliymun bialzzalimiyna
Qul inna almavta allaziy tafirruna minhu fainnahu mulaqiykum zumma turadduna ila 'alimi alg'aybi valshshahadati fayunabbiokum bima kuntum ta'maluna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu iza nudiya lilssalati min yavmi aljumu'ati fais'av ila zikri Allohi vazaru albay'a zalikum xayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamuna
Faiza qudiyati alssalatu faintashiru fiy alardi vaibtag'u min fadli Allohi vaozkuru Alloha kaziyran la'allakum tuflihuna
Vaiza rav tijaratan av lahvan infaddu ilayha vatarakuka qaiman qul ma 'inda Allohi xayrun mina llohvi vamina alttijarati vaAllohu xayru alrraziqiyna
Iza jaka almunafiquna qalu nashhadu innaka larasulu Allohi vaAllohu ya'lamu innaka larasuluhu vaAllohu yashhadu inna almunafiqiyna lakazibuna
Ittaxazu aymanahum junnatan fasaddu 'an sabiyli Allohi innahum sa ma kanu ya'maluna
Zalika biannahum amanu zumma kafaru fatubi'a 'ala qulubihim fahum la yafqahuna
Vaiza raytahum tu'jibuka ajsamuhum vain yaqulu tasma' liqavlihim kannahum xushubun musannadatun yahsabuna kulla sayhatin 'alayhim humu al'aduvvu faihzarhum qatalahumu Allohu anna yufakuna
Vaiza qiyla lahum ta'alav yastag'fir lakum rasulu Allohi lavvav ruusahum varaytahum yasudduna vahum mustakbiruna
Savaon 'alayhim astag'farta lahum am lam tastag'fir lahum lan yag'fira Allohu lahum inna Alloha la yahdiy alqavma alfasiqiyna
Humu allaziyna yaquluna la tunfiqu 'ala man 'inda rasuli Allohi hatta yanfaddu valillahi xazainu alssamavati valardi valakinna almunafiqiyna la yafqahuna
Yaquluna lain raja'na ila almadiynati layuxrijanna ala'azzu minha alazalla valillahi al'izzatu valirasulihi valilmuminiyna valakinna almunafiqiyna la ya'lamuna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu la tulhikum amvalukum vala avladukum 'an zikri Allohi vaman yaf'al zalika faolaika humu alxasiruna
Vanfiqu min ma razaqnakum min qabli an yatiya ahadakumu almavtu fayaqula rabbi lavla axxartaniy ila ajalin qariybin fassaddaqa vakun mina alssalihiyna
Valan yuaxxira Allohu nafsan iza ja ajaluha vaAllohu xabiyrun bima ta'maluna
Yusabbihu lillahi ma fiy alssamavati vama fiy alardi lahu almulku valahu alhamdu vahuva 'ala kulli shayin qadiyrun
Huva allaziy xalaqakum faminkum kafirun vaminkum muminun vaAllohu bima ta'maluna basiyrun
Xalaqa alssamavati valarda bialhaqqi vasavvarakum fahsana suvarakum vailayhi almasiyru
Ya'lamu ma fiy alssamavati valardi vaya'lamu ma tusirruna vama tu'linuna vaAllohu 'aliymun bizati alssuduri
Alam yatikum nabao allaziyna kafaru min qablu fazaqu vabala amrihim valahum 'azabun aliymun
Zalika biannahu kanat tatiyhim rusuluhum bialbayyinati faqalu abasharun yahdunana fakafaru vatavallav vaistag'na Allohu vaAllohu g'aniyyun hamiydun
Za'ama allaziyna kafaru an lan yub'azu qul bala varabbiy latub'azunna zumma latunabbaonna bima 'amiltum vazalika 'ala Allohi yasiyrun
Faminu biAllohi varasulihi valnnuri allaziy anzalna vaAllohu bima ta'maluna xabiyrun

Yavma yajma'ukum liyavmi aljam'i zalika yavmu alttag'abuni vaman yumin biAllohi vaya'mal salihan yukaffir 'anhu sayyiatihi vayudxilhu jannatin tajriy min tahtiha alanharu xalidiyna fiyha abadan zalika alfavzu al'aziymu
Vallaziyna kafaru vakazzabu biayatina olaika ashabu alnnari xalidiyna fiyha vabisa almasiyru
Ma asaba min musiybatin illa biizni Allohi vaman yumin biAllohi yahdi qalbahu vaAllohu bikulli shayin 'aliymun
Vatiy'u Alloha vatiy'u alrrasula fain tavallaytum fainnama 'ala rasulina albalag'u almubiynu
Allohu la ilaha illa huva va'ala Allohi falyatavakkali almuminuna
Ya ayyuha allaziyna amanu inna min azvajikum vavladikum 'aduvvan lakum faihzaruhum vain ta'fu vatasfahu vatag'firu fainna Alloha g'afurun rahiymun
Innama amvalukum vavladukum fitnatun vaAllohu 'indahu ajrun 'aziymun
Faittaqu Alloha ma istata'tum vaisma'u vatiy'u vanfiqu xayran lianfusikum vaman yuqa shuhha nafsihi faolaika humu almuflihuna
In tuqridu Alloha qardan hasanan yuda'ifhu lakum vayag'fir lakum vaAllohu shakurun haliymun
'alimu alg'aybi valshshahadati al'aziyzu alhakiymu

Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu iza tallaqtumu alnnisa fatalliquhunna li'iddatihinna vahsu al'iddata vaittaqu Alloha rabbakum la tuxrijuhunna min buyutihinna vala yaxrujna illa an yatiyna bifahishatin mubayyinatin vatilka hududu Allohi vaman yata'adda hududa Allohi faqad zalama nafsahu la tadriy la'alla Alloha yuhdizu ba'da zalika amran
